Having read many reviews about this beach, I was unsure whether to visit as I would prefer to spend my time on quiet beaches. I decided to try it at sunset. It was absolutely perfect. Almost everybody had left. Parked up very easily for 5 euros, the very nice parking attendant stayed until I returned just before it got really dark.There were about 10 people there, and then in the 30 mins after sunset, 8:30-9pm, when the sky was at its best and most beautiful, there was nobody else thereThe pink sky reflected the pink sand and it was breathtaking. I’m a huge nature lover and there were lots of birds around and it was incredible to paddle around on the sandbanks. An amazing experience that I’ll never forget. My heart is full 🩷

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crete Maldives
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The trip from Agia Mariana went over the mountains, we rented a car for the day (about 600 SEK) the trip contained incredible views. Many have been worried about narrow roads but it was no problem to drive, never felt unsafe.When we rolled into Elafonissi there was a guy and waved us into the first parking lot, it cost 5 Euro per day, do not go in there, go past him, the parking lots that are closer to the beach cost 3 Euro and are much shorter to walk. The road to the beach is partly rocky but no problem walking.The sea was crystal clear and the sand was not so pink anymore but it does not matter, clearly worth the trip. What views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi beach is simply magical: turquoise water, pink sand in places, and an end-of-the-world impression. A must in Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist trap
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tourist trap. ..As soon as you arrive a folding machine encourages you to enter a parking lot. I insisted on continuing but he stayed in the middle of the road making great signs as if I could not go any further. So don't do as I do because the parking cost us 5 euros and 1 km on foot with my disabled husband, while the same parking at the same price is just near the end of the road. What to say on the beach. Probably prettier than others on the island but a crazy world heading to the same place. Fortunately for us the weather was rainy because I dare not imagine if it had been nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don't go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was a BIG disappointment! It's supposedly one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete but it's overcrowded and there is nothing beautiful to see except several hundreds people crampes together. The beach isn't even visible - it's so drowned out by the mass of people (and we arrive in the late morning in May) and the supposedly pink sand was barely pink for 2 meters. There are more picturesque and beautiful beaches to visit on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Keep your expectations low
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Is the beach beautiful? Yes. Is the water clean? It looks like a pool, crystal clear. Can you see the pink? Yes, but they are nuances and you notice sometimes more and sometimes less. Don't trust the photos, that intense pink doesn't exist. Otherwise it is a beautiful beach. Go early in the morning to avoid the crowd.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Many times to Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous beach, friendly people, crystal clear sea but never go in July or August, too many people and loses its beauty

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was a beautiful beach, but it was very crowded but it was still a stunning beach with lots of pink sand! The only negatives were the walk from the car park because it is very far and hot and how crowded the beach was but overall an amazing beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A really beautiful beach and well worth the visit.  We parked at the Mega Car park which is at the very end of the access road.   It was €5 for all day parking but did have toilets and shops.  Please be aware that there is a car park just before the Mega car park operated by men in yellow hi-viz jackets  who were posing as the official car park so I recommend you just drive past as they were quite insistent.  It is a long walk down a gravel road to the beach (at least 800 metres) so would be difficult for people like me with mobility issues however, we were pleased to find out that is a small minibus which will take you to the beach and bring you back for free which is run by the government   The sunbeds were €20 which consisted of 2 sunbeds and a parasol.  We went in May and was quite busy so I imagine in high season it will be heaving...a beautiful place all the same

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing. The pink sand beach, no pink sand.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beach too far away, ideal for children. You have to walk deep inside to be covered by water.The pink sand, disappeared (it was taken by the wind, it was taken by the sea... it was taken by tourists...?)Paid parking. Between 3 and 5€.Sun loungers with parasol 20€ a couple. And few establishments to drink.In my opinion, it is not worth going, unless you are staying nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I read all the reviews and was torn about going- but I am so glad I did. In May it was gorgeous and not very crowded.The drive through the mountains from Chania was nice in our rental car. Took about 1.5 hours. Yes there are some tight and winding roads but not too bad in my opinion. I would NOT want to be on a big tour bus for the drive though...lolThat being said, it's a MUST to check the wind speeds. This place would not be fun at all if the wind picks up, which I know happens often. Catch it on a calm day and it's paradise.It was worth it to pay the 5 euros to park by the Mini Market that is the closest and walk down. The walk is not difficult at all, unless you make it difficult by not walking on the gravel road and climbing down the rocks which we saw some people do.We waded over to the "island" and just relaxed all day reading a book. Lots of places to tuck in to-- no need to stay by the main area with all of the loungers unless you have kids and want to do that scene.The water is magical and yes...there are ribbons of pink sand.Very glad I just ignored reviews and checked it out on my own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach,We look forward to coming again.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach,making it perfect for swimming and water sports. turquoise waters and beautiful scenery, We are had a great weekend with our girls, look forward to coming again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi Beach in Crete, Greece, is a breathtaking paradise renowned for its pink-hued sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Named the *world’s best beach* in Tripadvisor’s 2025 rankings, it offers a unique blend of natural beauty and tranquility . The shallow lagoon is ideal for families, while the surrounding dunes and hiking trails appeal to adventurers . Visit in May or September for fewer crowds and perfect weather . Note: The pink sand, formed from crushed shells, is fragile—avoid taking souvenirs to preserve its charm . With amenities like sunbeds and snack bars, it’s a must-visit for an unforgettable coastal escape .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated piece of beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated. Overrated. Very touristy. Don't fall for the parking trap! Guys in yellow vests want to send you into a parking lot because the road ahead would be blocked. Nonsense and costs you 5 euros in parking costs. There is plenty of parking space further down. The walk from the car to the beach is 1.2 km, takes you first past all kinds of shops and then a gravel / rock path. Difficult walking for the elderly and disabled although they have a car for driving (cost unknown). Two sunbeds with parasol cost 20 euros and then you are on a sandy beach with shallow water. You can also walk through, but we didn't. For someone who grew up near Noordwijk, this is very disappointing. I know nicer and quieter beaches on Crete that are free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL BAY..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Upon arrival they invite you, putting yourself in the middle of the road, to park at 5 euros per day... do not do it.... continue in the next parking costs less than 3 euros.... then , after a very short walk in the middle of the moor, you will have a breathtaking view.... THE LAGOON OF ELAFONISSI... good holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect island!!! Amazing blue-green waters!!! You have nothing to envy of the rest of the islands!!! Beaches with sand!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No doubt this is a beautiful spot. We booked a trip through Tui with limited information. If we’d been given honest info we probably wouldn’t have gone. Charged approx £100 for two adults and a 4 year old! 5 minutes before we arrived at the beach we were told if was very windy and often was so we wouldn’t be able to stay as long. Because it’s a nature spot there are only so many sun beds allowed and unlikely to be any by the time we turned up, recommended to by a umbrella at the top of hill by shops/cafes so we did. We weren’t expecting a 20 minute walk down to the beach, when we got there it was rammed and only one cafe open. Sun beds were full. Signs up saying No umbrellas and couldn’t stick it in the ground anyway and wind also made it impossible, €10 wasted. The force of the wind was whipping the sand up and there was no where to escape it and no shade. Weather can’t be helped but if it’s like it the majority of the time it should be mentioned. My daughter couldn’t cope with being sand blasted so we headed back up to the cafes for next few hours. The people “looking after” this area need to make a choice of a spot for tourists or a nature reserve, it can’t be both. Spotted a lot of litter and toilets smelt awful on the beach (and you had to pay!).  Obviously no pink sand like the pictures as it’s all been pinched over the years. Would hate to think what it’s like in the heat of the season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elaphonesos!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The white beaches in Elafonisos are well known to everyone. Easily accessible place without expensive ferries. Unique beautiful place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisso Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can't get anywhere near the beach!Paid parking 5€ Tourist scam After 3 hours of raging road! Don't inflict this torture on yourself or go by boat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Andate
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the sea are beautiful but a bit wild. To get there there is a hike to do once you leave the car at the parking lot. As I recall, the beach is poorly equipped compared to the huge flow of people who arrive there. Still worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi Beach – A Caution for Families and Those with Mobility Issues
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonisi Beach – A Caution for Families and Those with Mobility IssuesA visit to Elafonisi Beach turned into an unsettling experience. Upon arrival, drivers were aggressively waved off the main road and funneled into a €5 paid car park, with an added €1 charge to use the toilet. The atmosphere felt more like entering a restricted zone than a popular tourist destination.Despite having a small child in a buggy and a senior with mobility difficulties, parking was only available a 20-minute walk from the nearest café bar — not even the beach itself. As a result, several family members, including one with limited mobility, were unable to make it to the beach at all.On the way back, it became obvious that closer parking spaces were available, but had been deliberately blocked by attendants forming a human barrier. When this was questioned, one attendant removed his sunglasses and physically grabbed a member of the group — an act that felt threatening and escalated the situation unnecessarily. The behaviour was aggressive, and the children in the group were visibly frightened.The beach itself may well be beautiful, but the controlled access, lack of accommodation for families or those with mobility needs, and hostile attitude of the parking staff left a lasting negative impression.Visitors should plan ahead and be aware — for those unfamiliar with the area, Elafonisi is not the peaceful, welcoming spot many online reviews suggest.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful, cinematic scenery, we were there at the end of April, still quiet from tourists. Parking lot further away, you could walk for a long time. There was a restaurant open and a shop with beach-friendly products before the beach area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really sad to see.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was once a heavenly spot. But over tourism has ruined it. There are attempts to protect the wild habitats, but it may be too late. In addition, strong tides in recent years have rearranged and removed big swathes of the sand so more people are crowding onto less beach! Do not waste valuable time if it will take you several hours on narrow roads to reach this beach. There are far better ones. Tragic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic place with incredible waters! The beach is very big but still the world is everywhere. The best month to visit is September!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach I’ve ever seen!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While the travel to it is a long cliff driving adventure, simply put it is worth it!!!  Don’t park where the first guys are waving you down.  Closer parking is further in.  About 700 meters walk and it looked like a place not on earth.  A little pink sand a lot of shades of blue and a lot of little islands in the near and far distance.  Some of these islands you can wade to without swimming.  One of the most beautiful things I’ve seen!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top 5 most beautiful beaches Crete.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful! I was here 25 years ago too. In terms of parking... a lot has changed.Don’t fall for the parking trap!People with yellow vests kind of force you to drive in.And ask €5.00 for a day.Not much in itself but if you drive 100 meters it is free.You used to be able to park just up to something in front of the beach.Now you have to walk a bit.Also on the beach itself have the choice to lie down between the mute.Or you can walk a bit through the water to the island.There you lie a bit more sheltered and you also have beach.The water is very shallow super for children. No stones just sand.There is a restaurant and a newsstand.There are clean toilets available.Just the drive to it is beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No.1 maybe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Currently rated No.1 beach in the world - Maybe - whilst the pretty lagoon shape, clear waters and soft white sands justify it's appeal , can get very busy even in the shoulder season. Worth doing it once to tick the bucket list , but not sure would make it a habit. Still the loungers ($20 euro for two) and the closest parking fior $5 euro was worth it . We enjoyed a relaxing day here in breezy 23 deg. temps. Got a couple beaches back in NZ that would be as good as  without the crowds. Worth the drive if only once 😄

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach w/ a little pink
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Crystal clear water! Just not pink like the pictures online! It has very little pink nowadays! So if you are only wanting to go to see pink, then you may be disappointed, but I loved the beach! It was huge! Fun day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, touristy but worth it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have given this beach 4 stars as, although an absolutely beautiful beach and sea, it is filled with tourists, you have to pay for toilets and the parking attendants are dishonest. The beach itself is not pink but has some pink sand near the waters edge, I imagine it might be more/less visible in different seasons/weather. The water is lovely and turquoise, can get some great pictures and reminds you of the Caribbean, though the water isn't as warm. When you drive towards the beach you first reach a car park where the attendant stops you and tells you that you can go no further. This is a lie! There is a much closer car park that is also for the supermarket and cafe. Yes I'm busy season it might be full but when we went it definitely wasn't and yet we were still bullied into parking at the first one. It was a longer walk to the beach and if we had known we would have driven on!Deck chairs are €5 and umbrella with 2 deck chairs are €20. Toilets are €1 There is a snack bar on the beach and supermarket/cafe/shop before you get there. Very stoney walk down so people with limited mobility might struggle

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Totally stunning beauty.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Totally wow 🤩 did not miss ... it deserves because few roads to access it. Beautiful 🥰Don't necessarily stop at the 1st parking lot paying 5 eur the 2nd qq free place and plan enough to drink and eat. Small convenience stores and souvenir shops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place is the sea is clean and the place is suitable for my summer vacation. I like the place very much

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Earthly paradise Clean water, beautiful location!!Clean beach. It is worth passing across the island. In August there are also the beads of the Virgin Mary that grow in the sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pink sand, blue-green shallow waters and exotic beauty in a unique landscape of Crete. It's worth visiting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARADIES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far the most beautiful beach I have seen. Be sure to visit if you are in Crete. Uniquely beautiful ... actually an 11 out of 10!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best sea in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view was really great The sea was diamond the waters clearly I really liked it recommend you go with your family for a terrific vacation

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing experience.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove through the mountains and dropped down to this idyllic beach. The crystal clear waters and sandbanks make this place stunning. There's plenty of parking available for a fee, we paid €5 for the day.  Toilets 50c, they were acceptable,  just. The walking track down to the beach is steep in places and topped with stones and gravel.  Care needed for those who are mobility impaired.  It's maybe a 15 minute walk.There were no sunbeds available but it did look as if they were preparing them for the high season. There was a W.C on the beach but I didn't use it.I didn't find any litter bins on the beach.There was a snack bar on the beach, i didn't use it.There are a few Tavernas and shops on the main road.Well worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink Sand Beach! Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A splendid view ....the sea the blond sand with pink reflections....a descent through the cedars and the smell of thyme.A place that deserves....car journey plus descent on foot to the sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment, totally expendable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I wish I could say otherwise, but I would lie and it has entered the top ten of the disappointments of my travels. The visit to this beach is completely dispensable, firstly because in Crete there are dozens of much better alternatives, secondly because it is difficult to find pink sand and thirdly because if in April it looks like the verbena of the Dove, I do not want to imagine what will be in August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Highly recommended
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there on March 16th, during the off-season. The beach is huge and very beautiful. The water is an incredible color, and the sand is slightly pink — probably depending on the time of year.There were almost no people, and I even went for a swim! The water was refreshing, around 16°C. The sand was clean, and the place was stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bellissima
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is reached in the southwest of the island. From the number of parking lots you can see how busy it is but at the end of April we did well! Parking 5€ , use of adjacent bathrooms 0,50. You walk along a stretch of dirt road and you arrive at a beautiful lagoon. The water is crystal clear and in some places presents this magnificent pink sand. The beach is very large and decidedly Caribbean. It is nature reserve. It deserves the trip to Crete just to see it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Indescribably beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking, especially because we got there early and were one of the first to enjoy this beautiful beach and bay and also made a beautiful walk up to chapel. The shades of colour were overwhelming. Turquoise, blue, green, pink. The vegetation was also at its best

reviewsWithKeywords.title: For sure will go soon.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Planning to visit soon since I heard about it. It's amazing how they talked about it and how it looks. Like Mykonos in its good days and even better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very well organized.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately, the weather tricked us, it was super windy when we arrived. But the beach was incredible, the crystal clear water and definitely a great place to stay. Just be sure to check the wind forecast before you go you could save yourself some time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must be a marketing ploy to get people to go to Greece
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I didn’t think it was that great so I’m surprised this is ranked as best beach in the world. Also it smells awful and we couldn’t tell if it was the outhouses or the rocks and beach itself. Also the sand is not very pink at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Azure but not pink
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, wonderful relaxation, azure water and very photogenicPink sand, however, should be looked for carefully. Walk through the water from the main beach and then take another path on the right, you will end up on a lovely beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place! Must see!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is not overrated! We loved it! 1h45 drive from Georgiopouli. The road is very nice to get there. Then parking five euros for the day. A short walk to get to this superb beach and quite special because of its many lagoons. A real little jewel! The water is super transparent and turquoise. We had the chance to discover it without deckchairs, umbrellas and with not too many people. A little disappointed however with the sand that is not very pink as you can see on Instagram or other photos but that is the nature, and it is very good like this!☺️ be careful, even in April, plan sunscreen! Despite the wind, we didn’t realize that the sun was hitting... we were fooled and we came home like two little lobsters 🦞🫣

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very comfortable beach nor spotless water beautiful experience so beautiful that I can not help but remember it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Moderate... but one must go once.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic landscape but until there.. not the best beach in the world.. surely one should go once but until there.. I am from Crete (Heraklion) and I have gone 2 times in my life. If it was worth that, I'd go for more. The "best" beach in the world requires you to be able to take a bath! The waters are so shallow there that you can not take a bath.. June - August is the wasteland.. the waters are dirty and blurred by many people.. I for the best beaches in the world would look less famous. For example, the beaches of the open camp in Lefki in Lasithi are infinitely better. It has people but not much, it does not raise waves, it is fantastic .. turquoise water clear .. it has a beach to surf if you want to. The bad thing is that you have to get good weather, i.e. there is no air and the access is far away .. i.e. it is in the most southeastern part of Crete .. Tourists come every year from all over Europe.. last year we met a German who comes every year. If it weren't worth it, people would not have come from this far. So I disagree that Elafonisi is the best beach in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ruination
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went to this beach in 1985.It was deserted and absolutely the most beautiful beach in the world .Now all that has been ruined by the tourist industry. Before  that in 1960 I had been to Hog Island in Nassau ,Bahamas which has also been crucified and is now 'Paradise' Beach. Glad I am too old to travel anymore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best summer getaway!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fairy beauty of the landscape with calm and crystal clear waters is a source of life and pleasure for summer holidays!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: how is the beach of crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: when you go to the greece then must visit the elafonissi beach , you have no idea about that how beautiful it is  it is  located in crete

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Obviously it’s overlooked!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with pink sand in places, turquoise water... and tourists! And again, at the beginning of the season I think there were not too many people (no umbrella, no deckchair, parking spaces available ..).The mountain road to access it is an adventure!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Way overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sep 2024 • CouplesWay overrated beach. Terribly crowded and a long walk from the coach park. Few chairs available and poor facilities. It was pink, so what. This is definitely not the best beach in Europe, or even Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too bad it lost its wild charm
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Still beautiful but everything has become very touristy. Compulsory parking even in April, shops. Barely reach the end of the road you get alpine by a parking.man...5 Euros for 10min or a day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Way overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Way overrated beach. Terribly crowded and a long walk from the coach park. Few chairs available and poor facilities. It was pink, so what. This is definitely not the best beach in Europe, or even Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: W-O-N-D-E-R-F-U-L
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There’s no other word to describe this beach. It’s one of the best beaches ever.Not too easy to reach as the it’s a long way to get here and even a little bit crowdy but the nature here is at its best.Rose sand and crystal water. No need to get anywhere else.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Surfing, but unavoidable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Either way you couldn't not go! Its reputation is such that it is almost an obligation when you go to Crete. And yet... The site is certainly privileged, but it's crowded, and it ruins everything.So go ahead and make sure you're not blamed when you get back from your stay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: it's an experience you won’t forget.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sunbeds may be pricey, but they’re essential unless you bring your own umbrella. If you're traveling through the mountains, don’t miss the charming roadside vendors offering a variety of natural Cretan productsespecially the incredible honey balm. On your way back, take the coastal road for a breathtaking drive, though it’s not for the faint-hearted. And be sure to catch the stunning sunset.
Not like the pictures at all!! Very sad for be super crowed as expected , pink sand ??? Where ??? Still a beautiful location

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don't go.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My family said it was the worst beach in the world. I found a cockroach at the beach bar, a pamphlet pancakes, a prosthetic grotesque. Your mother told me, and then I told him what you said, and he told me not to talk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top destination for just about everyone.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly the premier beach on Crete. Excluding July and August there is room to find that secluded spot. Beware the midday sun! The cooling breeze is deceptive. Arrive early, leave around midday and take plenty of water. Alternatively arrive late afternoon and have the beach to yourself and watch the magnificent sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A natural spectacle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: spectacular beach with really suggestive pink sand parts, crystal clear water, very busy, but usable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach, a true paradise! Crystal clear water, shallow waters where you can walk for km , well cared for and managed by local associations, absolutely not to be missed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but not very pink
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We actually went in June 2023.Very crowded, and hard to find a spot to snorkel.The waters are beautiful, clear, and warm. Pink sand? Bring your microscope! There was hardly any to be seen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's really not worth it!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were with the rental car of Rethymno which drove a good 2 hours and only found tourists nepp when parking, far too many people there, expensive loungers and even the toilet trip on the beach had to be paid!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and impossible!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the sea are dreamy that becomes nightmare for tourist crowding also compared to other Greek beaches lacks any other possibility of shade but umbrellas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Many people little sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The first photo is not of Elafonisi beach (that beach is deserving of a 10) Elafonisi beach is not worth it because it is full of people walking from here to there and there is not a cm. of sand to put the towel if you do not want to be stepped on.Another thing will be if you go in February-May

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beaches ruined by the aggression of tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi in Crete, like its namesake islet in front of Neapoli in Peloponnese, are two unique and beautiful beaches, too bad that mass tourism has ruined them.Don't go there, by now you would only find an incredible mass of people who have ruined the beauty and uniqueness of these places.If you really want to enjoy them go out of season, from October to May, in this period you can enjoy the uniqueness of the pink sand that plunges into the crystal clear waters. Also not to be missed is walking on the dunes and bending down to observe the flora that is born and lives on the rocks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ELAFONISSI
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good morning. The beach I agree is among the best but I point out that the 1 photo refers to Elafonissos (equally magnificent) which is located in Laconia (Peloponnese) and is the beach of Simos on the island of Elafonissos and the beach is divided into 2 bays a wider one (about 1 KM) which is Sarakiniko while the smallest U-shaped is called Fragos. It is divided by a strip of sand that connects to a wide hillformed by sand dunes in which there are specimens of Cedars although personally they seem to me Junipers and a splendid Mediterranean vegetation enriched by white Lilies

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and clean beach, it's a shame that inconsiderate tourists have unfortunately been stealing the pink sand. I recommend getting there early to get a spot to rent a deck chair as the sun gets very strong at this beach. The water is nice a shallow so safe for swimming

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Extremely beautiful. Can get very hot and crowded in high season. You will need all essentials. There is a beach bar and parts are organised. But the best of this area is found away from the organised beach. Though lagoon over toward the sea. There are several different stretches of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 2nd visit, after 2021, and it's still the wouaouh effect! well, ... early in the morning around 0900 from the small headland overlooking the beach,. the place is beautiful also because of its isolation with a preserved landscape.If not, and although the number of deckchairs has been reduced, from 10:30 a.m. until about 1600, there are people, because the entire buses disembark their passengers.  It's the tripadvisor effect and its drawbacks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stay Home
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Don’t go!!Save the beauty for the rest of us :)The waters here are crystal clear and calm. We didn’t really see much of the pink sand (because apparently idiots take it as souvenirs). Our visit was during low season so there were less than 20 people. We were told though that there are days with up to 5k people during summer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very cool water in October for swimming. The water is beautiful. Some traces of pink on the sand but do not expect a pink candy beach. A lot of people. Long way to get there. Compulsory parking at 5€ whether you stay 5 minutes or the day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A true paradise beach, it feels like the Caribbean. Small swim in October, a little fresh but it was a real treat!!! We stepped away from the finish and felt like we were alone. On top

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach, we went in October so it wasn’t overcrowded.  Nice shallow water for children and nice deep water for swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun Times at Elafonissi Beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were in Chania for a couple of days and were excited to drive over to Elafonissi Beach. We were there mid October and the beach had enough people for people watching but was not over crowded.  People were coming and going all day.  We arrived late morning and some people were already leaving. Our only regret is we didn't get up at the crack of dawn in order to have more time while there.  Would have loved to have a couple more hours.  I can't imagine what it's like during peak season though.The water is very shallow and clear which made it great for my cautious sister.  This is the perfect beach for families with little ones.  Would definitely tell people to visit if they are anywhere in the area.Even the fun/challenging drive through the mountains would not deter me from returning.  My sister on the other hand, might not.  She was scared by the drop off/cliffs and when the road goes down to one lane.BE WARE of the men going out in the road to direct you to the first parking lot.  There's more parking lots closer to the beach path.  Some of the lots were cheaper too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach with spectacular sea. Rent umbrella and two sunbeds at 20 euros per day. Ample paid parking 5 euros per day. There are toilets at 1 euro. Highly recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect lagoon -highlight of our trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible lagoon to visit-like the Caribbean. Saw the pink sand and I don’t care that it wasn’t as vivid as the photos online. Went on tour from Chania on last day and gutted I didn’t go sooner. Not many people there even at midday and it’s quite amusing to read ‘too many tourists’ comments written by tourists!! It was the highlight of our trip

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Elaphonix
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach suitable for both families and young boys. For those who want umbrella and sunbed you have to arrive early by 9.15 otherwise you will not find anything , alternatively you can bring umbrella etc because there is so much free beach. There are two small bars offering drinks, sandwiches and pizzas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unless partying, give this a miss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too much tourism for us, far to busy and commercialised, no where sensible to park. Possibly a good experience if you are young and want a full day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth visiting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We made sure to arrive before 11 and the buses, and had no problem getting loungers.  It definitely got crowded, but we had a few hours in the morning to wander around to the different areas when it was more quiet.  The sand is the tiniest bit pink, but it's still a gorgeous beach.  And the walk back to the car is nice and short!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bof
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there in windy weather so not great, then it's crowded, a beautiful beach but as there are plenty of crests, it's not worth it to pile up in high season for me

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach with pink sand! The pleasure of the eyes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach! But very very very frequented (even in the middle of October) that makes lose a little of its charm at the beach but that does not prevent to have a good time. One of the most beautiful beaches if not the most beautiful in Crete! And the pink reflections of the sand are just beautiful. By necessarily visible all at once when we arrive once in the water we see them

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unfortunately turned into a tourist trap
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Thousands of tourists - large crowded pitchesThe pink sand - was beautiful, but there was not much and difficult to spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Red beach and turquoise sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy access .one of the most beautiful ridge beaches. Ideal for snorkling. Do not hesitate to cross the lagoon and get away from conventional beaches. Beauty is pure

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Never again!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tourinepp! The beach is completely crowded even at the end of the low season. What used to be pink is now black from the legacies , like sunscreen, oil, pippi... of tourists. Then the parking lot mafia wants another €5. We were just excited! If this is a TopTen attraction in Crete, this island has nothing to offer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: In the postseason 😉
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In the low season, in October little crowded by tourists. The pink beach can also be seen well in some places. Clear water, very nice surroundings. A trip there is worthwhile. Tip: Arrive in the late afternoon and enjoy the sunset. Most leave the beach earlier.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sketchy drive- narrow roads, cliffs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a rental car and drove here Oct 14, very pretty beach. Pink sand is visible but definitely not like the google pictures. I was unable to capture it on camera.There are plenty of restaurants and cafes on your way in but you will also find food on the beach, bathrooms for a small fee (1 euro) changing huts, umbrellas and chairs (20 euros for 2 chairs). Parking is between 3-5 euros depending on what lot you get into. It takes about 10-15 min to walk to the beach from the parking lot.The drive is a bit sketchy narrow and sharp turns the closer you get to the villages but the town is beautiful. If you’re driving on your own, smaller cars have an easier time driving through. The water is nice, specially to cool down from the heat. The Water is a tap cold but you can adjust to the temperature quickly.The water is warmer than the US but colder than the Caribbean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach, the small waves wash up the pink color, which you then perceive as a strip on the shore. Areas are recommended to arrive early and preferably stay in the suburbs before the crowds of tourists invade with the buses or rental cars like the grasshoppers. There are suburban supermarkets, restaurants, canteen (food stalls). Shower and toilet are also available. The water is crystal clear, sunbeds can be rented (2024 for € 20). Parking is available for a fee and the path to the beach leads downhill for about 10 minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonisi is really one of those places that sound like a fairy tale, but in reality can be a disappointment. Pink sand sounds great, but the massive influx of tourists and commerce can quickly make the magic fade. A waste of time!! A waste of money. I wouldn't spend any time on it. The local beaches are so much better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Site became overused .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Even in October, this site has lost its charm because of its overcrowding and the business it generates.people who scream and who are there because you have to be there.The surroundings are horrible and charmless, The lagoon and the beach without interest with everyone.Farther afield, on the side of krios and palaiochora , you will find beautiful, super wild places of incredible beauty.The choice is not in dispute.This is the authentic ridge away from this horror.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: SUCH a beautiful beach.  Something for everyone.  There are quiet corners on Elafonisi island...and nice snorkeling too ... as well as shallow warm waters on the main beach.  We loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful lagoon!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is true that the road has been long! 2h car like us, which are between Chania and Heraklion. In autumn several parking rates but generally 5 €. I advise you to go arriving rather the better 😁 in front, crossing the lagoon, you will have less people and the beach continues thereafter on your right. Very nice place and we do not regret the few hours drive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not crowded if you arrive early.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I arrived early and it was fabulous! I got to the beach on a Wednesday at 9 am and it was largely empty. It stayed fairly empty until about 10:30.  It was early October and the water was still warm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise before 12:00... it's beautiful! Then it's pointless... hell!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous but only in the morning! Between 9 am and 12 pm the beach and the lagoon are extraordinary ❗...We enjoy the transparent water, the fish, the pink sand... the small islands... the place is magical! After 12 noon hundreds and hundreds of tourists arrive...and it becomes hell!...No more charm, run away! It screams, and everything's invaded... plus an M2 available. We're going from Heaven to Hell!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Why the negative reviews?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nearly didn't come here after reading the negative views. Dangerous roads, mafia running the parking, dirty, overcrowded, and worst of all, no pink sand having being stolen by the tourists. I'm not sure if I'm in the right place, but our experience seems a little different. The roads are beautiful with gorgeous scenery and plenty of stops. There are various parking options, all with a short walk of the beach ranging from 3 - 5 euro. They appear well run and keeping traffic out of the park. There are plenty of beach chairs, with 2 loungers and a parasol 20 euro ( just checked account and cost just under £17. Two pints and perhaps a packet of crisps in manchester). Best of all, I'm sitting here, and it's beautiful. The scenery is stunning, and the sea is crystal clear. Pink sand is washing up with the waves and just realising why this is one of the top places to visit in Crete. Happy travels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What should I add to the review title? Wonderful place that leaves you breathless, crystal clear water... really one of the best beaches seen in the world

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stupenda!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It absolutely deserves to be visited, with the pink beach and crystal clear water! beautiful panorama .. the only Recommendation is to be careful of illegal valets! they get in the middle of the road to stop you and let you in to park by them, but it costs much more and they make you park away!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Got sucked in by the guy that runs the last parking place before the gravel road that takes you close to the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is quite a large pretty beach with little lagoons and tight poolsEven though I read a review that said to ignore the guys trying to get you to park when the paved road ends, the parking lot attendant directed us into his lot and charged five euros. After waling about 15 minutes to the beach down the gravel path we realized we could have driven almost all the way down The parking lot at sea level had only two cars in it on October 7 at 11 AM when we visited.  And it’s FREE.  The beach wasn’t overly crowded when we arrived, but within a half hour, several tour buses arrived and most of the lounges and Palapas were in use.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist trap like no tomorrow. Not worth it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Save your time and money and visit other beaches more worthwhile. The promotional pictures depicting this beach are highly photoshopped or enhanced by AI. The pink sand is scares, only few small  patches here and there. The “enhanced” pictures attract thousands of people daily, making you feel like a sardine in its box.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but not delightful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, especially at sunset. But going there on purpose, in my opinion, is definitely not worth it.The water is pure. Developed infrastructure near the beach itself. But you have to be prepared for the fact that from the parking lot all the way to the beach, you have to walk 15 minutes on a dusty road. We were lucky, in early October and afternoon the weather was not hot, but in the heat the pleasure is doubtful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place ruined.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful place just ruined by the daily procession from miles around by the mass of tourists. People everywhere, in every direction, we left after ten minutes. I'd far sooner be at the rocky beach ten minutes up the road, no one there at all, no need to pay for parking, no need for a 15 minute walk, no pink inflatables and no people. If the throb of tourism somewhere beautiful doesn't bother you, this place is for you. If, like us, you hate it, steer well clear. I mean, who's the imbecile who decided to carve smiley faces into the cactus???

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Only for an Insta photo you don't necessarily have to go, as the beach is only slightly pink. But for bathing it was great.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there to see the pink beach as the teenagers were informed about it on Insta.The approach from Chania almost 1.5h. The ride was a bit like Mario Cart, quite winding.Once there we did not let the park attendants guide us at the beginning, but drove through to the end. 5 Euro per day / payment on exit.There's also a toilet right there. ( 1 Euro)You can then reach the beach in 10 minutes. There you can rent sunbeds with umbrellas ( 20 euros per double bed)We decided on the sand and a towel. It's really crowded. I can't imagine what it must be like in midsummer.We really just wanted to stay for 2 hours.But it was really Caribbean paradic. Flat water, perfect for small children. Also great for snorkeling. Crystal clear water. We have seen a moraine, a sea needle, a giant sea urchin and many other fish.In the end we were there for 6h. It has toilets, shower and a snack bar.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One and Done - pink beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I came here to see the “pink beach” so many people talk about…I was heavily disappointed. There’s barely any pink sand and the little patches of pink that is here really isn’t worth the 3+ hour drive that we made. I will say that the beach itself is pretty and mostly shallow and the water wasn’t too cold. However, it is EXTREMELY CROWDED and it’s hard to find a spot. This is definitely more of a one and done type of thing.Side note:I saw online that there’s a nudist area here if you’re into that. Supposedly it’s across the water (which is shallow enough to walk through) to a stand alone small island. We couldn’t find it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited with a tour operator , arriving at 11am. The beach was super busy already . There were no sunbed/parasols left . We found a space near the surfing school to set up .  The waters were still and crystal clear , the pink sand is not that visible but it’s there . It’s not like the Google pictures , I understand it’s dependant on weather the night before . Amenities are good and I was surprised the food shack had reasonable prices . The shop is very well equipped which things needed for a beach trip.Toilets are €1 .There are shacks to change but limited . I just went in a corner and changed . Not a great deal of shade . Going in the water certainly helps

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fin strand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Traveled there by rental car. Very twisted roads, they recommend with height fear to close their eyes on the trip there.Clean and nice beach, but not as pink as in the pictures.Was very windy when we were there, but still nice to swim. Absolutely a nice day trip

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Deception
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surfing. Nothing sensational except a small lagoon if you can say so. A lot of people. The preveli beach is much more beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautifully overclaimed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful, but very overrated. Lots of people. Missing shade at the diners. Far to make from parking down to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: superb
reviewsWithKeywords.text: actually do not get fooled with the first parking follow your way , then yes there are people , but there is nothing we can do about it , meanwhile this beach is superb with pink sand by the water , surprising and to do anyway;

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Do not let you have the Check-out on the first parking lots , we easily think that the guys regulate while they push to park in their parking lot at 5 euros! While others are 3€Then, apart from the beauty of the water, there is a quiet corner and the .... It's not easy! A fairly touristic and very dense population spoils a lot the magic of the place. Maybe you have to go out of season or very early in the morning to appreciate the beauty of this sandy beach and turquoise water.And watch out for the wind which can become quite annoying because the fine sand will spoil your tranquility

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with pink sand beautiful colors We went in September and it was quite crowded The beaches are equipped with sun loungers and umbrellas but are also free There are refreshment points We ate in a restaurant at the panorama tavern from which you can see all the view Great food and affordable prices

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Is Worth Feeling Like In The Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautifully, however, it was already quite crowded in the low season, in the summer it will probably be breaking full from noon. The way there is not without a coach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with pink sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water and pink sand. The route to get there by car from the north is a bit winding, and the area fills up easily. But beauty is worth the effort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy, a long way from parking, not enough loungers to rent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went with two small children aged 3 and 1. We were herded into the highest car park 0.8 miles from the start of the walk to the beach but then there seemed to be lots more closer, walk to beach then snakes round a longer road, very busy despite late September midweek, toilets are all paid (bit of a pain with a 3 year old) and parasol / sun loungers all full / seemingly not enough for numbers of visitors. Husband set of back to buy a parasol and we attempted to shelter by an olive tree but all shade has been cordoned off and we were told we couldn’t stand under it?!? All in all a pretty beach but has been massively over sold and now feels very touristy and a bit of a money making racket, wouldn’t recommend with small children

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Thunderstorm with natural beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself is beautiful, the pink sand is only on the shore but this does not make you lose beauty. It is true that there are too many people.. but the beach is totally beautiful and to walk or spend the day this great, it is a Top visit. When we went we got caught in a thunderstorm and we couldn't enjoy it but on a sunny day it has to be a 10.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi parking overcharge
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yesterday we were in  Elafonisi and I hade bad experience with parking.. It was  5 euro  Isnd used visa machine and I didn't check my account at the moment .. After 1 hour then I checked my account they charged  twice... so we Paid 10 euro for carparking... Just wanted to let you know guys if you use visa machine just  check your account straight away..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too touristy, not worth it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach probably if you can see it between all the hordes of tourists. We hoped it would be less busy at the end of September, unfortunately not. Quickly reversed to beach further down. Please note, when entering village you are immediately ushered into a parking lot but there are many more with enough space further on, saves a lot of walking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice surprise.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is paradise, the road is accessible. Parking 5 euros a day. Cabin to change, toilet at 1€, deckchair 20€. We have been on the peninsula the sand is pink, it is quieter. I had a memorable afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mass tourism
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove by car about 70 minutes to the beach and arrived around 11am. You have to park upstairs according to the instructions of a park usher and then you walk down to the beach for about 15 minutes. You could already see the crowds from above. On the beach you have to laboriously clear a path through towels to get to a somewhat freer area. The water and the beach are really great, but due to the crowds it is not very pleasant to lie there. We didn't stay long. There was no free space left in the parking lot and about 30 tourist buses were waiting for the tourists there.Conclusion : a beautiful beach in Crete , but a long drive is not worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A postcard landscape
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent the afternoon on Sunday, September 22, on this beautiful sandy beach with translucent waters. It is an unmissable excursion if you want to discover the Crete in the best it has to offer. If the road to get there is in fact quite difficult on some sections , it allows you to travel through mountainous terrain and incidentally to understand the life of the small villages crossed. We don’t regret that it took us long to reach this protected and still very busy site in mid-September. The landscape is beautiful and the waters crystal clear. A postcard landscape. We recommend crossing the lagoon on foot to escape the overcrowding of the place. The water is shallow. We then reach a beach located behind the much quieter dune. Unfortunately, the wind picked up and we had to shorten the experience. Avoid taking the seaside route on your way back to Platinos . This road is very winding and dangerous because it is neither stabilized nor secure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The supposed pink sand is hard to find, if anything ...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 5€ Parking fees at the beginning of the place, we were stopped by the parking staff, could have continued in truth, there were very many parking spaces further down free, sometimes only 3€/day. We took coffee in the cafe above the beach, with a poor service and did not taste good.The beach was totally crowded, we were looking for a quiet corner on the edge. Very nice water, but the supposed pink sand was extremely rare to find in mixture of normal sand. The transition to the island by the water, at most at Po level, was fun. The island is very beautiful, with nature conservation for dunes and sand lilies. Lying here is even nicer than in the bay.An interesting experience, but as I heard from other visitors, once seen is enough. The journey takes a long time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exhausting, a bit disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So when you first get to ellafonissi, you are flagged down by parking attendants. We assumed that we couldn’t go any further. That wasn’t true, there were nearer car parks. It’s 5€ for the whole day, or the one after is 3€. I walk with a walking stick due to problems with my legs. There was no one there to ask about whether disabled people can get down to the beach another way. I suffered walking on uneven and stone paths for half an hour. Then seeing that some cars do go down there. When I eventually got there, was guided to the disabled sun chair area. Was charged 30€ for the privilege. Everywhere else was 20€ for 2 beds and an umbrella. Felt cheated and battered. 😫

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not pink but WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 4/5 rated because it advertises with a pink beach, which is not always or not guaranteed pink. For example, it rained the day before - maybe it was because you only saw a slight pink tinge in some places. (!!) Basically, however, "wow" —> finest sandy beach and crystal clear sea. In addition, it is possible to stand & walk in the water forever. We were only there at half past 11/11 - parking was no problem. We parked at the last parking lot. So on arrival the last on departure the first parking lot. 5€ for the whole day, totally OK.There are sunbeds and umbrellas on the beach. Was written for € 25 ,-. By the time we got there, everyone was already occupied. So if you want to have a shaded spot guaranteed, you should definitely bring your own umbrella. Showers and toilets available. Toilet € 1,- ... Super clean! You like to leave a euro for that. Catering facilities available. Rather fast food, was fine. The coffee was really good.Further up by the parking lots would be another restaurant.  On the whole, a trip definitely pays off, even if the beach might not be pink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Refreshing, beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The tour was really good. The bus driver and guide were very knowledgeable about the region. The drive is beautiful and very curvy. The walk to the beach is about 15 minutes but when you get there ….WOW. Crystal clear water and very refreshing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Site oversold, very disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Quite disappointed to see this site so crowded...it is probably pretty but out of season and in my opinion, even out of season, this beach is not as beautiful as what is touted on tourist guides. Balos is definitely much more beautiful...There's almost no room to put his towel down. The little beach is occupied by paid sunbathing and umbrellas, which are on top of each other...no privacy and frankly no interest!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poorly managed parking lots
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As we came down the road to the beach area the parking lot attendants at the first lot stepped out into the street forcing the line of cars into their lot. We didn’t think we had a choice. As walked down to the beach we passed the second lot which was completely empty. The obese man sitting in his chair was too lazy to wave cars down to his lot. Finally we passed a third almost empty lot much closer the beach. All of the lots are managed by Mega. I’m in my 70’s with a bad knee and had to walk much farther than necessary because of the jerks in the first lot. You can bypass the first lot and go down to the first. Another small lot charges two euros less but it will probably be full.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Slightly overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was far to walk down to the beach from the parking lot and sure it was long and big but overclaimed I thought and it was very shallow you have to walk a long way out to be able to dip. The restaurant there was closed too early I think in the season despite a lot of people. And some pink beach well I didn't see that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too many people. We considered a lot but this was outrages. Every squaremeter of shadow, every sun bed was used. Even outside of the main travel time the pure mass of people was too much for the region. Parked at mega parking - nearest and good place but huuuge. The place is overwhelmed by its own celebrity. Consider to be there very early or take another beach. Arrived at 11, left at 12:30 and still the line of people arriving was endless

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not recommended
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is much too crowded, much of the pink sand is not visible and it stinks. Were 5min there and left again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better to go in the less frequented months but unforgettable!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We immediately crossed into beautiful water to go to the islet unique landscape.  Placed in a protected area and we hope it will remain

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach victim of its success. About tourism.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not seen a beach with pink sand, I saw an overcrowded beach where most people walk around phone in hand looking for pink sand to post on Instagram I guess. I don’t like much but everyone likes what they want.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were so excited to go to this beach after reading the many wonderful reviews. Sadly, it was a huge disappointment. First the parking sucks, a lot! A guy stepped out into the street and herded us in saying this was the only available parking. It was not! We paid 5 euros to park in the last lot when there was parking much closer for 3 euros.The walk to the beach was long. About a mile. When we finally got to the beach it was overly crowded and it’s September. Couldn’t imagine it in the height of summer. There was no pink sand to be found. Something we were excitedly were looking forward to. The water was clear and beautiful. We never got it. After seeing the many people and realizing the water closet was 1 euro, we thought it best not to. The best part of this excursion was the ride from Chania to Elafonisi Beach. The view from the top of the hill to the beach was also pretty spectacular. Many more other beautiful beaches here in Crete worth the time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Everyone at the supermarket
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An open-air supermarket!! if you love shopping centers, Italian beaches model one on top of the other this is the place for you!! if you love and respect the sea, beaches, privacy and enjoy your well-deserved vacation go elsewhere!!! other thing selfie tourists are very accepted in this place!!! I forgot sunbeds at 30 euros.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying in Chania for 8 nights and wanted to break up our trip so booked to stay here overnight . We took the ktel bus . Booked online from uk 10 euros each per person . We got the bus that leaves 9am arriving at 11 direct . Bus full . You get ticket number but sit anywhere . Journey is scary through single tracks small villages and scary mountain roads ! Drivers are goodArrived at 11 and it was busy . We stayed at Elafonisi village hotel which was excellent.  We saw the beach quiet when crowds left and got up for sunrise and walked all around the beach . Beautiful.  Coach leaves 4pm and goes back the same scary way ! Pleased to have visited but wouldn't do it again purely on the white knuckle coach ride

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very disappointed!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very disappointed! Overcrowded beach, we must look for grains of pink sand. The place was probably idyllic a few years ago but it is nothing extraordinary. In Crete it is possible to find beaches and sites much more pleasant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably one of the most beautiful beaches.Sea transparent, clean, blue.There is plenty of space for the free beach, there are also umbrellas and sun loungers at 20€ I think I read. As soon as you arrive, after an easy walk of about 10min from the car park (for a fee, the first 3€, the nearest 5€)There is the first part of the wide and wide beach, instead crossing the water (max water at the waist) you can get to the other islet in front and stop there too.Walking instead behind the islet you find yourself on the back as well as wilder than elafonissi.I loved it for its colors, the shallow water for walking, beautiful.The pink sand is there but I thought more honestly, I found one much further north, very small, with much more pink sand! Anyway go there

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARADISE on Earth.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: PARADISE EXISTS!I don't add anything else... the words fail to express the beauty of the place. Although crowded there is space x all.Really incomprehensible reviews with only 3 stars.For me it is the TOP!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had 120km from our place, which meant 2.5 hours drive. From the parking lot it was about 300 meters to go. It was already quite busy, we switched to the island through the shallow spot. There a small natural shade sought and off into the water. One side was very shallow for a long time, the other side slowly but steadily deepened. Even if there was a lot going on, in the water we had a lot of space to ourselves. It was really with the most beautiful beach where we have ever been. Caribbean is the best place. We would take the long drive for it again at any time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Like a paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this place, a must see.Be there early around 8 in the morning, after some hours it will get crowded.The water is clear. Its like a paradise before the people arrive.When you visit Elafonissi I also recommend you to stay at Taverna Stomio, its close by.Its a lovely restaurant with animals around. We had chickens next to our table.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach and a must visit!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What an incredible place! We stayed overnight at the Elafonissi resort by Kalomirakis near the entrance to the beach so were able to see the beach at sunset and early morning.The water is beautifully clear, the pink grains of sand dance around at the waters edge and the water is shallow enough for far enough to walk around in the water.Yes, it's quite a long, winding drive down to the beach especially if you are staying around the Heraklion area but if you're only visiting the island once and plan on seeing other parts of the world before you come back, you MUST get down to Elafonissi. Easily in the top 3 beaches I've ever been to!Naturally you'll have to pay for a sunbed if you want to be there for the day but do it. Just do it. You won't regret being there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too touristy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nice beach, water is super clean, but that is everywhere in Crete. Too touristy and therefore of course too busy. We had to drive two hours for it and that is not worth it, but fortunately we did it for a reason because a few kilometers away is the beach “Kedrodasos”, it is worth much more and fortunately we went there to look, otherwise two hours drive would have been for nothing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too many people too bad
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Frankly disappointed, it's black people it's like Auchan at Christmas time, what a shame!Of course it is to be seen , the lagoon is beautiful but overcrowded!I do not advise with young child and stroller, you have to walk on steep path in full peak of the sun..The first car park we sign you that there is no car park on the beach , but there is one more ready anyway! Of course we got screwed...The Parking Award is €5 with no imposed time. Pink sand has to look for it, there are very few.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: SHAMEFUL
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There's no pink sand, too many people They couldn't keep and protect this place It's shameful, because it's profitable, you have to pay for parking, the beach is not maintained, in short a shame.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Burning disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We deliberately added two nights in the Elafonissi area during our holiday in Crete, since on paper it was the most unmissable beach of all: what a disappointment!Clearly a lot depends on the wind, but I traveled a lot and honestly this was one of the least beautiful beaches seen in many years: murky water, zero pink sand, umbrellas massed and expensive compared to the Greek average (but this was known), obviously all Italian because probably the magical narrative about Elafonissi is only there for us... fortunately we stay 5 min away, otherwise it would have been a joke.In short, with all the isolated, inexpensive, beautiful and well-served beaches of Crete, this really is not up to scratch! If you have more than 15/20 min of travel to reach it, it is not really worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, good for families
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful. The water is very shallow. There are toilets, showers and ways to get something to drink or eat. However, it is very crowded there and the path from the parking lot to the beach is rather uneven and long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day at the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went here with family. The beach is lovely. The sea is really clear and couldn’t resist going for a swim. The views of the mountains and the sea is magnificent would go again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go early-super crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove from Chania. 1 1/2 hour drive. About half is difficult through small villages and mountainous roads. We drove to the last parking lot-closest to the path to the beach. 5 euro to park. It’s a little bit of a walk to actually get to the beach.Rented chairs and umbrella-luckily, they run out when crowded. There’s snack stands with a variety of drinks and snacks. You can see some pink sand and it’s beautiful but there’s so many other spectacular beaches in Crete I’m not sure if it’s worth the effort and battling crowds to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clear shallow water, but that's it :)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Don't trust the media and expect to see a beautiful beach with pink sand. There is hardly pink sand anymore, so in this sense this beach is not different to any other. What you will see is clear shallow water, where only small kids can swim and tons of "Instagram models" trying to make a perfect picture. The Beach is overcrowded and the food here is overpriced and low quality (that was the "dryest" pizza in my life) .The sand is nice though and in contrast to other greek beaches it's comfortable to walk on (no big hot stones or slimy seaweed) A pair of sunbeds cost 20 Euros but make sure to come for them as early as possible, after 12pm the beach is swarming with people. If you drive here by car you might enjoy some nice mountain ride on your way here, parking is affordable (5 euros for the whole day) and the way to the beach is quite easy and quick. The beach is also wheelchair accessible.This place is a nice alternative incase you got "lucky' with stormy weather during your vacation, since the waves here won't get too high and dangerous and according to personnel it never rains here for too long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise on Earth ❤️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Whatever I write is limiting and will never explain well the beauty of this place. Beach and sea of kille colors. Seen in August, with the chaos typical of the period, it is wonderful. I want to come back in June because, in my opinion, it will be even more beautiful. You can't even compare it to the beaches of the Caribbean, which remain beautiful, but will never come to such a wonder.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and a little pink sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice place, warm water and turquoise because shallow over a great distance Very good for young child because no wave (a large pool 30cm / 50cm deep)People but frankly the space is large so it’s okay!5min walkSeveral paid car parksAnd the most expensive back parking costs 5€...but it's worth getting closer Little mini-market next door!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, go early because at 11 the umbrellas were already all taken. The first parking is the cheapest and is not far from the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were really looking forward to visiting here as one of the best places to visit in Crete. But unfortunately we were disappointed. The place was packed, which meant it lost some of it's beauty. Very limited on the "pink" sand too, which was disappointing. Google images have a lot to answer for!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is magnificent but be prepared for lots of other visitors and a long walk down from the carparks.Make sure you don’t stop at the first carpark as there are lots of carparks much closer to the beach entrance. Sun beds are expensive but necessary unless you have your own sun umbrella with you. If you are travelling through the mountains be sure to stop at the small vendors along the way selling lots of natural Cretan products including honey balm which is amazing. Also take the coast road home it is a magnificent drive but not for the faint hearted! Enjoy the sunset too

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but overpopulated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Unfortunately being one of the most famous is really too flat people especially in the afternoon. Recommendation to arrive very early to enjoy the landscape and not to stop at umbrellas but to continue and go to the island in front and enjoy the true nature.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mixed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach to see, but there is very little pink sand left, a very small line at the edge in some places. The number of tourists is a bit confusing, it looks like on the French Riviera in the middle of July-August. And even if we cross the other side, with water sometimes above the knees, there are still a lot of people... You really still have to walk to find a quieter place. However, it remains magnificent. Water not super hot, but refreshed considering the outside temperature and pleasant wind. Consider eating and drinking if you plan not to stay on the main beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A wasted day !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wasted day, there is nothing spectacular, go to Balos! There is no pink sand, the water deepens after approx. 90 m from the shore, too crowded for my taste. If you're still curious, come after 5 p.m. Nice holidays !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Elafonissi is very beautiful but there are must limit to the equipped part because the beauty is just to explore the entire reserve and get to the top of the church. The walk is feasible and you do not notice the fatigue because the walk is dotted with rocks, bays and coves that tempt you to enter the water at every step. Sand and white dunes, clear and transparent water. The beauty is finding a space all to yourself. The view from the top of the church is beautiful. Recommendation, if you want to choose the equipped beach, to stay on the right side where the water is shallower because, at least it is clear; where the water is higher it is cloudier.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to be!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went on early September to Elafonisi Beach.We took  the public transport bus and all went ok. Not so crowded as previous reviews. There is plenty of space for everybody.There are few area with "pink sand" -actually rest of some shells, but it worth it .If you want to stay prety close to "pink sand" maybe could be crowded,  but there is also a wild part of the beach with specific Mediterranean vegetation-trees where you can find a shade. The blue lagoon is very nice, clear water, wild vegetation , kite-surfing, a nature masterpiece. The way to Elafonisi is also quite impressive,  there are some areas where you are surrounded by mountains, you will pass through small and nice Greek villages.If you pass by Crete you must visit Elafonisi Beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THE REAL PARADISE!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was amazing..exotic..a unique experience...a natural lake....and, at the time so romantic...the best beach all over the world!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's not lost!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not lost!!! Excellent beach, mirror the sea with white sand. The truth is that there are too many people but they suffer because of the vast area. Parking you will find nearby and walking access easy. There is a canteen-bar and sunbeds but for the many-many breakfasts. Cleaning everywhere!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Like a swimming pool!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To get to this wonderful lagoon from Agia Marina, we faced a challenging journey: more than an hour and a half of "mountain road" between hairpin bends, cliffs, narrow streets and narrow tunnels dug into the rock. The route, not exactly relaxing, is made a little more pleasant by the view: you cross characteristic villages surrounded by olive groves and you will be breathless observing the bottom of the barren and rocky valley from above. Once at your destination you have several parking possibilities. Recommendation not to park immediately (5 euros for the whole day) but to proceed to the area where several mini markets are concentrated; here the cost is lower (3 euros), there are toilets and you are closer to the beginning of the pedestrian path that leads to the different coves of the lagoon. This is where an important question needs to be asked: whether or not to buy an umbrella? In fact, along the entire beach of elafonissi there are several "bathhouses" with small bars and the possibility of booking umbrellas and sunbeds but they are often not available because they are crowded early in the morning. After an easy walk of about 5 minutes, (nothing comparable to the endless, challenging and dusty path that leads to the lagoon of Balos!!!), you get to the different beaches of Elafonissi.  Even if the visitors are many, you do not have the feeling of crowding. I recommend not to stop immediately but to proceed all the way. Here the beach is more spacious and it is not a problem to plant the purchased umbrella (prices are modest) and lay the beach towels and, above all... you are in the open sea.The spectacle that opens to the eyes is heavenly! It looks like a Maldives beach! Clean, crystal clear water with all shades, from blue to light blue. The bottom of fine sand is very shallow for several meters and allows children to have fun in the water without anxiety. The small bars allow you to buy drinks and simple snacks so that you can safely have lunch on the beach without worries.
