Highly Recommendation to visit this beach, in my opinion, much more beautiful from a naturalistic point of view, than the lagoon of Balos (presence of tar July rocks!!!)However, I remain of the opinion that the beach of Falassarna is the most complete: free parking very large, clean beach of fine sand that, for this reason, is not annoying, sea that contemplates all shades of blue, impeccable beach services thanks to Dimitri and his collaborators can also guarantee restaurant service on the beach (at no additional cost) at reasonable prices.Happy holidays everyone!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very nice beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great day! As far as pink sand is concerned, there’s not much of a small line at the beginning of the sea but that’s it. In any case, the water is incredibly TRANSPARENT and AT VERY GOOD TEMPERATURE 😻!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Thanks to Tripadvisor, I was forewarned that a) there wouldn’t be much pink sand, b) it would be rammed with people, and c) there is a horrible walk back up to the car park.Having set my expectations quite low, it turned out to be a very nice day, because it really is beautiful. We waded over to the island which has much more space, just be warned that you will be wading to hip-height so have everything securely packed away. Don’t drop your whole towel in the water like I did!Unfortunately we were on a coach day trip, and while the drive both ways (from Chania) was worth paying for in itself, I  would rather have done the walk back to the coach when it was cooler (not 3.30pm). Do allow yourself loads of time, it is a killer. Also you do need to bring or buy a beach umbrella (one between 2 people), as sun beds and umbrellas get snapped up early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trying to believe!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It might put off the crowds and buses walking to the beach BUT just walk a little more (to the right) to discover a wild side and find an exclusive spot! Recommended x snorkeling and to take time to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach in the lagoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach with umbrella and deckchair ( 20 € both deckchair with umbrella and 5 € extra deckchair. Parking between 3 and 5 €. Snaking possible on site but a little expensive!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A crowded paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi beach in Crete is truly enchanting, with crystal clear waters and unique pink sand. However, in August it is very crowded. It is advisable to arrive early to secure an umbrella, especially on the right, and prepare to defend your space. The bath is magnificent and the strip of sand leading to the island offers a fascinating hike. The view of the pink beaches and the scent of lilies in August make the experience unforgettable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beach to discover absolutely 👍
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach of fine pink sand , we swim with small fish and small shrimp ... we will have to walk away and cross to the other side for a real discovery of the beach ... we preferred to wander and get away from the crowd that was at the first beach ... Put on your cream and go discover this almost island 😀😀... One thing you are not told is that it is windy! Lots of wind but protect your skin anyway because it is sunny...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not to be missed during your stay Cretan
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place with translucent waters. Plan to go early so you can fully enjoy the scenery before tourists arrive. Sunbeds and umbrellas are storming the main beaches. Trip Tip: feel free to walk along the beach to the right to be away. You will find many coves where you will feel like you are alone in the world in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Partially disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We reached the beach of Elafonissi with a speedboat excursion leaving Paleochora at 16. After two stops, and as many dives in the enchanting beaches of Viena (clear water with green colors) and Kedrodasos, semi-desert with wonderful crystal clear blue waters.  Arrived in Elafonissi at about 17, given the hour, we thought we would find a beach with fewer people, but this was not the case, overflowing and with rather murky waters in the lagoon, a little better towards the open sea, little pink sand on the shore, a real disappointment! Fortunately on the way back, we met four dolphins that delighted us with some vaults in the blue waters of the Libyan Sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow!!! PERFECT COMBO
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, lovely. There are parking spaces for 5 and 3 euros. If you go to the bottom you will find the parking at 3 euros, do not stop at the first parking. There are beaches and of course free beach. The lagoon is wonderful, it is blue and on the other side of the islet it turns turquoise green, then if you go even deeper you will find fewer people and more privacy and the sea all your own. You will have to walk about 10/15 Min from the parking lot. I recommend it, for now it is the most beautiful beach I have ever seen until now. It is a perfect combo between turquoise blue/green sea, the mountains behind, the lagoon, the white beach with contrasting rocks and of course the pink sand. Beautiful, GO THERE. EVEN SEVERAL TIMES. Ah, then Recommendation a nice dry bag where you put things inside and always move around and explore the whole beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A true paradise.I start with explaining some things I have read in other reviews. If you have been to Sardinia, in Stintino for example, you know that the most beautiful beaches are very crowded everywhere in the world. Now, compared to Stintino, this beach was a deserted island. So many people, yes, but absolutely it was possible to find your own space to place an umbrella and be comfortable. Nothing unlivable. At least as far as my experience of a Tuesday in August is concerned. Maybe the weekend gets fuller?? I don't know.Now let's talk about the beauty of this beach. I state that I am Sardinian and I came to Crete because often this and other beaches are compared to ours, expectations were high as well as the fear of disappointment. And instead I must admit that it is perhaps one of the most beautiful beaches I have seen in my life (and I have also been to the Caribbean and the Indian Ocean, in addition to my Sardinia).No photo you see online can capture the beauty of this beach in my opinion, with its intertwining sand tongues joined by lagoons from the sea of a blinding blue in which you can walk with the crystal clear water that comes to life.Let's talk about Pink for a moment. Exactly as for our Budelli.... Pink is there, but they are shades due to corals, in some places more evident, in others less so. Forget the photoshopped photos. However, what makes it special is not pink but its shape that almost resembles a beach in the Bahamas. Finally to have an umbrella in the establishment you have to arrive very early. So, either find a way to stay in the nearby b&b or hotels or you will have to wake up very early because it is 1 hour and 30 from Chania.We had two umbrellas loaned from the chania hotel and we managed without much difficulty. Our neighbors were at least 10 feet away and we were like hell.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must visit!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Simply a must visit if you are staying to a hotel nearby Chania. The road it’s pretty rough, but the view is very beautiful. Absolutely stunning view. Me and my friend went there by bus through an agency. I would say the road from parking to the beach is pretty accessible. It took us between 15-20 minutes. It’s true that the beach was very crowded, but it was worth it. The beach is very large, so that everyone can enjoy it. I understand that there are some people who dislike crowds. But I would say it’s normal, because Elafonissi it’s in top five beaches in the Greece. So what do you expect? Especially in mid season. The view on the beach was fantastic, with the mountains surrounding the beach. Also the water was crystal clear. There are some places on the beach where the water isn’t that great, so choose carefully your spot. I recommend not to pay for sunbeds (very limited), but instead just bring your own umbrella. As I said, the beach is very large and it’s enough space for everybody. Since I am visiting Greece, I think this one is on the second place, after Balos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Idyllic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice idyllic beach, like on postcards. Watch out for sunburn, no gray areas. The sunbeds and umbrellas were stormed. It is not possible to plant his on the page because too much wind. Very nice experience, to do!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent decision to visit this beautiful beach for the sunset without the crowds. You will not regret it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We decided to visit for the sunset and arrived at 6pm as people were leaving, so after parking up at the final car park before the beach (€5 for the day) we strolled down and it wasn’t too busy at all.We waded through the lagoon on the left and after a quick dip we then walked to the right on the path that takes you to a much quieter part of the beach and is best for seeing the sunset.The pink sand on this side was outstanding all the way along, the water was super clear. We finished our evening there feeling very happy and as we were walking back, we captured further pictures of a magnificent sunset.We are all happy that we chose to go for the evening rather than the full day and would recommend this option if you don’t want crowds. There is a toilet for €1, options for buying food and drinks and also a changing cubicle which was very helpful.All in all it was a 5 star experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good, but busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A victim of it's own success, beautiful beach but too crowded.  If arriving by car drive straight to the end to park and ignore all the previous car parking attendants waving you down as you'll have to walk far.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Like the illuminated swimming pool. Divine!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Caribbean you can smoke in the pipe. One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. Highly recommended. Disadvantage: Crowds and the beach bar reminds beach canteens as they are known in Italy. Tasteless. They could come up with a little more, like in the rest of Greece. Otherwise, everything well organized. The walk from the parking lot to the beach is not very long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beauty that goes lost...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately, we didn't look for it long before and we hit it.... In principle, don't get into the first parking lot, even though it's a 'master' who flies in the middle of the street and says the road is closed after. Lie. It is the most expensive parking and there are closest to the beach and cheaper a little further down. The bottle of water is 50 minutes more expensive the closer the store to the beach. Arriving at the beach, be prepared for the 'popular pilgrimage' that prevails! One on the other... At the point where there are sunbeds, it is half a meter from those around. 20€ for the two beds. As a natural landscape it is very beautiful but unfortunately they destroy it. I can tell you at least 10 beaches in Crete, better or equally good, with half the people and half the cost, less advertised simply (fortunately in the end!) I am sorry about this and I would suggest the Municipality, instead of renting sunbeds at selling prices, to take care of a little to check this situation instead of participating!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful experience and discomfort at the same time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It reminds of the pilgrimage, because of the crowd. You just go to experience an experience and suffering at the same time. It's a special place. A beautiful beach, but wants the preparation to go doches in the summer months, umbrella, sandy etc. It has a walk until you arrive. Very shallow water. You can't stay for a long time.The ground is rocky and it doesn't have much space, just put the towel, a little disappointing for me.For parking, don't park at the first(5€), it's below (3€).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not as good as the hype.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The hype outweighs reality. Some parts of it are lovely of course, but it’s absolutely mobbed and largely not as good as beaches at Falassarna or even the lovely little beach at Paleochora. If you like shoulder to shoulder busy beaches then maybe it will suit you here. Wasn’t for us. Toilets are €1 if you need to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very bad experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Initially while there is enough parking space below (as it was earlier), now you are forced to park 900 meters ahead and walk up there to pay the 5 euros that the parking has. Very shallow sea and the people overnumbered for this particular beach, one on the other. I ⁇ 't go back. Nice landscape but the discomfort is great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful sea place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: definitely it is a must of clay and in fact it pays the very high number of tourists. Recommendation to cross the basin and go beyond the islet. it is open sea, there are fewer people and certainly calmer. beautiful and clear water. many speak of the most beautiful sea of clay. I do not know.in Apulia there are many similar beaches.you make an uncomfortable walk and definitely not equipped for strollers and / or wheelchairs. there are lidos and bars as always more than decent prices.If you are on clay, you have to come. It is a dutypsdo not expect pink sand like in an enchanted castle. in some places there is pink, but nothing dazzling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but uncomfortable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice but disappointing. Beach with quite crowded and quite frequented. Hence becoming uncomfortable and being almost impossible to enjoy such beauty. It is a pity that this heritage of nature will deteriorate, derived from the massive presence of tourism. It should have limited space, and even be paid, in order to preserve this heritage.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, pink for real, lagoon, crystal clear, shallow water. An open-air swimming pool. Compared to Balos is accessed after a walking path with little slope and therefore pleasant and feasible (about 10 minutes). We returned from Chania a second time as beautiful as it is, of course the car route is challenging because it takes about 1.30h in the mountains but it is absolutely worth going and... returning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: ... and one of the most beautiful I have ever visited.Crystal clear sea, white sand (in some places it is really pink), good amenities. The only sin is the many people, not always polite, who meet in August.There are also (few) umbrellas and sunbeds available at prices that, in Italy, we dream of.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is really unmissable if you travel to Crete. It has well earned its location among the best beaches in the world. Its crystal clear waters, pink sand and breadth make it worth the trip on a path full of curves. I have been to the Caribbean several times, but this beach seems a thousand times better for its absolute absence of waves. One can go deep inside just by walking. There are agencies that offer tours to Elafonisi, but I think it is much better to rent a car and go freelance. There is ample parking nearby, only 5 euros per day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Together with the cedar forest the best beach! It is exotic with clear waters and vast sand! You can also walk from one shore to the other and be in the sea as the waters are shallow! One of the best experiences and one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARADISE 🏝️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A paradise .. clear sea with beautiful colors. It feels like being in a huge pool. The most beautiful sea in Crete .The route to get there is very feasible and on the beach there are umbrellas and services.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A sea of a thousand shades...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach I have seen in Crete. I was there twice just as much as I liked although I had to make a journey of about 1 h and a half. Convenient parking and a short walk to the sea. The beach is equipped with various points with umbrellas and sunbeds and the cost for the set (umbrella + 2 sunbeds) is 20€. My husband and I chose the right side where there are 2 small points with a few umbrellas close to 2 lagoons... in our opinion theBest point. We had the pleasure of meeting a beach attendant who in our opinion is a lovely person. Tourists are provided with detailed information on the beach and its surroundings. He shows attention to the cleanliness of the beach by picking up here and there what is left by the patrons through neglect or distraction. His kindness shines through in every little attention he places on customer service. His name is Ioannis. There were such people around who demonstrate love and respect for the environment around us. An example to follow. Discounted tip: you have to arrive early to find free umbrellas otherwise be equipped on your own to guarantee a little shade.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unquestionably the most beautiful place in Chania district.Crystal clear sea, white sabbath, shallow waters, mountains frame all this.It’s August, of course a myriad of people arrive and the show loses some of its shine but the game is worth the candle.You can take an umbrella with two sunbeds for 20 euros but you must arrive no later than 10 am, otherwise bring an umbrella and arm yourself with patience because you will have to find a place and it will not be easy.Parking 3 or 5 euros depending on which you choose.Worth a social mention Johannis, beautiful boy who takes care of his lido, entering the beach you have to go to the right of the small beach bar.Very kind, from advice, explanations, cleans everywhere, practically a cicero and plastic detector.Also thanks to him Elafonissi was my favorite place.I highly recommend dedicating a day to this place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with fantastic waters. They have closed access for people to the beach and have done very well to protect the environment. You leave the car at the parking lot for 5 euros and walk 10 minutes on a good road without any problems (I was with the slippers). We went there at 8:00 and ⁇  a beautiful landscape. The only negative is the crowd . Since 10:30 a.m. there is a lot of people gathering that spoil the beauty of the landscape. And one tip: it blows very often. Plastic cheap umbrellas do not do for this place. Either you have a good umbrella or you go too early to catch beds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To see but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place, the colors are superb, the water is translucent, the turquoise of the sea puts you in a postcard. But... to flee in summer! Tourist place to the highest point with full coaches tours, finally with the world it breaks all the charm. Or do it sooner or later in the evening. Provide paid parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overestimated...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Let me share the experience so that one knows what awaits him in August. From Chania is almost 2 hours drive. BOAK and then not even a rural network, but villages streets (beautiful villages!) Very careful and low speeds because the risks are many. On my trial route I was respected by the locals (their favourite) and I was disappointed by the foreigners who with the nuts they rent have seen Juha Kandotten in the asphalt rally of Crete... Go to the last parking lot! What says MEGA Parking and you will pay €5 (good as here-we got...!) Then starts the descent to the beach at least 15 minutes walk on rough paths. Very careful if you have children to have them by hand. You won't find sunbeds unless you go to 8:00! Yours are hard to carry (I did). When there's air, there's air! And finally you won't swim, because it's 30 points of water...In conclusion, the advertising has caught! Or it used to be worth it and not now. 4 hours from Chania! Wasted time! In my opinion the most overrated place. It really has much better places in Chania than Elafonisi. Of course, age also plays a role. If you're a group of students, you have kids, and I'm with you! If you're a family member, let my friend go!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Do not go in August
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolute tourist trap. What felt like millions of people arriving by buses and cars. The parking lots are a 20 min walk from the beach, could probably be less but you will be walking with thousands of people, just as if you are about to enter a stadium for a football game or a pop star concert. Once we arrived at the beach, we literally couldn’t walk without stepping on someone’s feet. There were no available sun beds, and even if we had our own umbrella, there was no space to place it. Although we drove all the way from Chania, we left after only 5 min and we are definitely not coming back, at least not in August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but overcrowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To enjoy the beach we left at dawn and arrived in Elafinissi at 8:15. We did not stop at the first umbrellas but we took the little road on the right and arrived at some very nice straw umbrellas, we took possession of them and after about an hour the guy came for payment. We immediately went to the islet that is worth visiting. It is full of small coves, if you go with your own umbrella I highly Recommendation to go there. There are also structures handcrafted from beach logs that can be used for shelter if you find them still available. The real problem is that the river of people coming never stops. At 15 we left also because in the afternoon there is a lot of windFor those coming from Chania, you should consider at least 1 hour and 20 minutes. The last kilometers before arriving at the beach are in the middle of the mountains, without guard rails. Very cautious

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To flee in August
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a disappointment, we ended up on a crowded beach. There are so many people that you do not see pink sand, only a few grains, nothing spectacular. This type of beach should be protected in order to conserve a gem. Overtourism is becoming a real problem.Note the war between parking lots! We were beckoned to enter the 1st parking lot when there was room below!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Avoid in high season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice place spoiled by the crowd, there are places just as beautiful and also wild little frequented aroundDo not hesitate to walk on the left along the coastA little more complicated to get into the water but at least you will be quiet under the pines

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Touristic trap, people on top of one another
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you have never seen beaches in your life, this place is for you. Absolutely crowded, everyone sitting on top of one another. Not enough seats and umbrellas, even if you bring your own, there is hardly any place for it. Barely 3 small cabins to change which are super old and the doors are with broken locks. Was are not free, its 1euro per entrance, there were 3 of them in the vicinity. Everything is absolutely super touristic, reminded me of those stables with cattles, when you are dropped by bus at 11 and collected at 4pm (the bus going from Chania is operated by Ktel, another bad experience, absolutely zero customer service). The worst beach experience

reviewsWithKeywords.title: How to Destroy a Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrived at 9:15 (after a 1.30’ drive) the MegaParking car park was at 20% capacity but umbrellas almost all taken. Sea still livable with some beautiful areas There are 2 locations to rent umbrellas as soon as you enter and on the right more hidden. Absurd the amount of people who arrive and keep arriving until 2 pm. Few facilities , poorly managed , old umbrellas and sunbeds .In the water you cannot stay with people who are there. At the beach you can not walk. But how badly you got.. DIAL CLOSED , increase prices and provide adequate services .I'll never come back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we arrived in a week-end in august, by car. there are 3 parkings- first one cheaper than the others two. but also you could park further whith no charge. we have park in the biggest parking, the closer to the beach, near the store. the region was very windy. it's a short and easy walk to the beach arriving there, since it was very hot, we have rent an umbrella and 2 deckchairs pt 20 euros/day- no cards accepted, only cash. the man in charge it was very rude. since it was very windy and hot, we have left at 12. obviously he didn't return half of the amount, even if by the time we picked up the sunbeds had already been rented to other tourists - obviously he still charged them also 20 eurosthe beach....it's not pink at all....absolutely no pink. we have been also to Balos beach- which is more "pink" than Elafonissi. the water is very clear, but it is not deep, it is ideal for very small children, but disturbingly small for adults - you can't really swim. also...the toilettes- no comments. so, after driving more than an hour to arrive here, the all experience just to put on a "to see list", but there are much more beautiful beaches in Crete, such as Balos

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Elafonisi is a true paradise.The water is so clean and crystal clear that it looks like a pool.The sand is pink. Crazy colors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: CROWD MADNESS
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gone yesterday and arrived at 8 and after a while the umbrellas were already all occupied. Then comes not so much but so many people who put themselves everywhere. Overcrowded would be saying little. It would be a nice beach, but you can't enjoy it. I strongly advise against this period. The Greeks should at least put a closed number on the buses....but God money is worth more than nature...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARALIARA!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach in Greece. We heard about difficult access etc. Nothing to do. 5 minutes walk and you're in heaven. It is so big that you will definitely find a nice place to sit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bofffff
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To visit out of season...August = overcrowded.I think there are other places less crowded and much more surprising in Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is very very crowded, it's só cowded that people camp on the rocks, haveing no choise.  There are no shades unless you rent an umbrela or You bring yourself one.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Much change in 3 years - disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our experience has been increasingly disappointing. Contrary to what we saw 3 years ago, there was almost no pink sand (perhaps a season ago?) Certainly Instagram was involved in the destruction of this splendid place!  We start by dropping 25€ for 2 deckchairs and 5€ for parking and no deckchair rental option for half a day is available. The beach was overcrowded from 9:30-10:00, without any respite, bus after bus, which made the experience tiring. The barrier to limit access is a good ecological idea (before we parked openly at the foot of the beach in the shrubs), but in practice it means you have to walk a lot, which is a real nightmare with a stroller and young children. (Only pregnant and disabled women can get off by car)For those who still wish to try the experience, I recommend taking a nearby accommodation and arriving very early in the morning to avoid the crowds.There are also some superb beaches not far away, without this human tide and without that feeling that the tourist is an inexhaustible cash cow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lagoon with grey/pink sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful lagoon with clear waters and grey and pink sand. It is recommended to get there very early. We arrived at 9:30 at the beach and found no unoccupied umbrellas with sunbeds. By the way, they cost 20 Euros a pair with an umbrella and 5 Euro each extra sunbed.Overall, a fine trip, we walked 2 or 3 km on the shore and thru the water to see the island and then took a nice bath, but made and early escape, at around 12:30 as we had no umbrellas with sunbeds and the sun was hot. We had our own umbrellas but we could not plant them in the sand because of the wind and hard soil. There were places in the lagoon with thick and fine sand to put the umbrellas, but not near the areas with all the amenities (toilletes and sunbar).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: EXTRA EXPOSITIVE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A BEACH THAT YOU MUST VISIT.UNBELIEVABLE WATERS AND UNBELIEVABLE LANDSCAPE.LITTLE CHILDREN LEAVE THEM AND PLUNGE WITHOUT FEAR OF DROWNING.SOME ADVICE: BE THERE UP TO 09.30 TO GET A GOOD POSITION BY CONNECTING THE SEA WITH WATER TO THE MIDDLE OF THE PROVISION.GET EVERYWHERE WITH YOUR UMBRELLA IN THE BROOKS IF YOU FIND, IT HAS A GOOD SHADD TO DON’T GO TO THE HORSE.NOT STAND IN THE LOCAL.PARTIQUETH NOW BODY BODY BODY BODY (PAKET 10).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crete on the road 2024
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but absolutely to avoid in this period. Very crowded.Impossible to find a place in the shade and even less deck chairs and umbrella. Hordes of people

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. You can get there easily by car. Parking is charged 5€, then there are about 15 min walk Recommendation put comfortable sneakers, rough terrain. It is necessary to arrive early in the morning between 8:00 and 9:00 then you will no longer find the parasol, essential. The cost is 20€ (umbrella + 2 sunbeds) if in the main beach everything is busy, immediately to the right there are 2 other equipped beaches. The umbrella brought from home unfortunately flies away easily, the area is very ventilated and under the sand, because of the stone slabs, it is difficult to pitch the umbrella, better a tent. The pink sand is visible but not much, you will have to move on foot to the islet in front where it is most visible. Unfortunately, the impact of man on the environment can also be seen here!! Shallow water almost everywhere, crystal clear (it looks like a swimming pool) unfortunately very cold so I RECOMMEND the shirts those special for water. A nice experience accessible even with children!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Never again
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach, however, overrated, crowded, there is no way to book a sunbed and, despite arriving at 9 am, the umbrella can only be dreamed. A bad experience, just as with a woman who had to fill the role of lifeguard, dishonest, rude and too presumptuous for what her job should be (all this in the early morning, I dare not imagine after a day of work how she is). We ran away after 10 minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wordt beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice Beach BUT the  Business is more important then the tourist. Parking places would be directly at the beach but the business people making a barrier to come to the beach. Result is walking 15-20 min for nothing. It’s here really all about the money. To Long ways even if the beach is beautiful. And if you really want to go there take the last parking place, they stay already 500 meters before the last big parking place and say you have to park here. Also really aggressive!!!! I think you could spent your time and money better in your holidays !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach... But too many people!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, it reminds me a lot of the hairy Stintino, unfortunately in August is not the best time to visit ..We arrived at 10, after twenty minutes of walking in the sun and there was no longer a cot available besides the flood of people who kept coming, at 11 after a swim we escaped!!So Recommendation for those who want to go there, to arrive early in the morning!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach to see absolutely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Elafonissi is really beautiful and the water is so crystal clear that it looks like a natural pool.Few shaded areas and if strong wind blows put umbrellas is practically impossible.So Recommendation to arrive early or to take umbrella and deck chairs at a cost of 20 € or to occupy a shaded space.There are several parking lots .. the last one costs 5€ and is a few meters closer to the entrance to the beach. Walking path of about 500 meters feasible ..To see

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Day in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our day in Elafonissi is unforgettable, turquoise sea, translucent water, beautiful landscape. We took a bus Check-out from Rethymnon. There is something to eat on site.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach!!!All is beautiful blue day The sand is white K white!Ideal for families!!!K for couples

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ignore the negative reviews!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes the drive is not for the faint hearted, so if you're not confident, book an excursionDon't park at the first 2 car parks, ignore those at €3 and head to the last car park at €5 (it's closer to the beach)When walking to the beach, after the white mini market. Verge right, this is a gentle slope and not rockyIt's also not a long way down as others would suggest It is very busy, we arrived at 9.30am, you need to get there for 8/8.30am to get a sun loungerWe laid on the beach, swam in the crystal clear waters and enjoyed ourselves.If you don't like many people, don't go! If you enjoy people watching and enjoying beautiful waters, then its definitely worth the visit.On the way back,we stopped at a beautiful taverna on a cliff edge.I would definitely visit again, just slightly earlier next time

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exceptional indeed! A paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Actually much of what is described in previous reviews and ‘useless to repeat, and indeed, thanks to one of these we arrived in time to get an umbrella with 3 sunbeds for only (for the place that is) 25 € per day!! Recommendation, I recommend it even in August, even with many people, because it is beautiful and the water is wonderful. Just past the dunes and the first rocks looking at the sea on the right there are also fewer people, and you bathe divinely.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun, Touristy Beach Spot!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The drive to the beach from Chania was not as bad as I saw online, it's definitely mountainous but just take your time and you'll be fine! The beach itself was gorgeous, but it was extremely busy and full of tourists. So try to get there early to avoid the rush and ensure you get an umbrella/daybeds. It was 20 euros for the day and it really was needed because there was honestly no shade on the beach! Also, be sure to check the weather before hand because it can get extremely windy on the coast and the strong winds made it difficult for us to fully enjoy the beach day (we had originally brought our own beach umbrella and the wind broke it!). Overall, it was a fun, touristy beach spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don’t go there
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi Beach is probably a nice place to visit when there are no tourists. However, in August, it was one of the most miserable places I have ever seen. First, the parking lot is huge, and if it’s windy, you’ll be walking through clouds of dust. From the parking lot, you have to walk a long way to the beach, with no signs or infrastructure to guide you. By the time you get there, exhausted, you’ll be surrounded by millions of people, and if you’re lucky, you won’t end up next to someone with smelly feet. This place is so disorganized and overcrowded that the beauty of the beach is completely lost. Not to mention, the  people who work in the parking lot are exposed to the sun all day long without any protection. This was the worst experience I’ve had in Greece, and I’ve been coming almost every summer for over 30 years

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trip from Chania to Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Reading the reviews I expected much more from the beachThe road to get from Chania to Elafonissi is a treasure trove of truly beautiful landscapes: canyons, small villages, a tiny tunnel that you walk in alternate one-way. The sea actually is very beautiful and crystal clear, but of pink sand practically nothing. I've seen more in Balos. Apart from the last two meters from the shore there is no sand but ground mixed with sand that makes it difficult to plant the umbrella. In summary the place is very nice to look at but impractical to stay there a day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful, the word that describes this wonderful protected area! White sand, with pink reflections, transparent water, turquoise. You walk everywhere with water at leg height. Wow! To reach the beach you have to walk about 1km from the parking lot but I consider it of absolute importance to safeguard the area. In August it is very busy but worth the trip to Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It's a lost paradise, not worth it anymore
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A horrible experience.I've known the beach for 15 years and what exists now has nothing to do with it.No pink sand, no peace or relaxation.You can't even admire its beauty.Massage (thousands of clustered people) and businesses (parking, cafeterias) with abusive prices for tourists.The parasols and sunbeds are already like a joke, the price is absolutely crazy.People with reduced mobility cannot go because you have to park far away (in paid parking lots) and the return is totally uphill.I hadn't been there for six years, what a pity of paradise I lost. He'll need time to recover.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly with some foresight
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Elafonissi is among the most beautiful in Crete and therefore also among the most coveted and frequented, however with some care you can live a pleasant and stress-free day. Shortly before arrival in Elafonissi there are various parking lots where you can leave your car at a price including three € 3 and € 5 per day, essential to arrive early. Leaving the car we proceed on foot to the beach which is divided into two parts: a coastal one where most people stop also because of the presence of bathing establishments; and an island characterized by an offshoot of dunes and rocks that extends offshore. This is the part where Recommendation to go because unspoilt and less frequented, to do so you have to cross a stretch of sea from the height of about 1 meter, doable then walking getting wet up to the waist. Once on the island the setting is heavenly where small bays of white sand alternate with dark rocks, the water, needless to say, seems that of the Caribbean and almost never reaches remarkable heights. If you want to explore this part of the beach Recommendation to take a walk to the most exposed point out to sea, characterized by a higher rocky promontory on which is placed a small church and allows you to enjoy a breathtaking view of the sea and the whole Elafonissi.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but prepare for a lot of people and a bit of an hike.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. We did not get there early enough to get sunbeds. We were not prepared for the long walk down to the beach. Can be tough with small children. We walked over to the opposite beach and it was quite the adventure. Overall a very nice visit. It was very windy but warm. The children were having a tough time so we cut the visit short.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holidays
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach.but don't stop at the first parking lot with 5 E is lower with 3 .forces the other to park given that there is no parking lot below.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I could be paradise if it wasn't for people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is spectacular, but it is so crowded that it loses all its charm.You certainly can't leave in August. Its waters are crystal clear, really pink sand, like a pool. Access is not complicated as they say, if you are not a duck driving, it is not difficult at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favourite beach in Crete: huge (does not feel crowded even with tons of tourists), beautiful, crystal clear water, and easy to reach (unlike Balos for example...) . Unfortunately, it is a bit far from Crete airports, but it is really worth driving all the way there and stay a few days in some accommodation nearby :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stupenda!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, we arrived at noon and parked in the last (giant) parking lot at the bottom, we found a place with our umbrella without problems, there are many people but the beach is so big that there is room for a huge amount of people. Water and fabulous beaches, ideal for children! Must see as Balos!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and crystal clear sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really beautiful beach, recommended to go very early if you want to take sunbed and umbrella, the only flaw is the huge amount of people who arrive at all hours, at lunchtime and 'really chaotic. Huge parking about 600 meters from the beach, Recommendation not to go to the first parking lots you meet but to use the mega parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not even..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We left Heraklion at 5am (good thing we did! A bathroom without 1000 people around we managed to do it), a decidedly tourist destination and crowded especially after 9.We took the umbrella and 3 sunbeds in the front row paying a correct amount, but after 20 minutes we had in front of us 3 rows of umbrellas not of the beach ..The pink beach does not reflect the photos found online.Recommended if it is maximum one hour from your location.There are no restaurants but only a couple of bars.40 € for two salads, a portion of chips and 2 waters seems a bit excessive ..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach, with blue-green waters and colorful sand. Prefer months when there is not much people to enjoy your bath!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnificent place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with fabulous sea. Pink sand may not be what will catch your eye but the color is phenomenal. We went on Sunday (and I was told that buses organized on this day do not arrive) at 9 am I was already at the beach, the available stations end by 10 am (not after). 20€.on the far right, entering the beach , there is another small place where they rent umbrellas, it is not visible as soon as you enter and then you have to look out (there should be a flag flying). If you go in the afternoon you can try renting instead of leaving. Facing west you have to calculate that there is no unfavorable wind. Recommendation to park at the last parking at a cost of € 5, provides the bathroom at a cost of € 0.50 . You pay at the exit.  You have to stay until sunset and enjoy the beauty of the place. To eat there is immediately a kiosk attached to the beach, and one with a quick kitchen just above. Bathrooms for a fee of 1€.The road from Kissamos is not short and you have to go slowly, narrow roads, hairpin bends and beautiful canyons. Local produce vendors on the street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Turquoise water pink sand ....magic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exceptional then yes it is armored, the road is endless especially behind a bus but we take full eyes. We arrived at 10:30 we avoided the first drop-offs to park at the last car park (€5) 2 € more expensive than the car parks at the entrance but we were very happy on the way back to have our car next door after a hard lift in the middle of the country. To access the beach, a downhill walk of 10 min if you have sneakers c is better but can be done in tap. On the spot it was anarchy, I advise you to cross to the islet then tip over to the other side following the marked path after the rescue station, you will be more sheltered from the wind, quieter and with turquoise blue and pink on the sand just to you. Feast!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eh
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice enough beach. More of a beach with a shallow river in front of it. Super crowded. No real pink sand. If you go, bring or buy an umbrella and walk over to the island, it is much less crowded over there

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just bad and overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really overrated beach, I have visited much nicer beaches around the world and this beach is in top no idea why, First its long walk from the parking, Parking mafias has occupied area around 2km before beach and force you to park there and then its a long walk to the beach where very difficult with small children to reach the beach, Water is nice and no pink sand as advertised everywhere, its just a beach as any other but difficult to reach. We had bad luck also with the wind, the day we visited it was extremely windy and we could not enjoy much and its overcrowded too.There is lot of potential to make it better by throwing all the parking mafia out and use the empty area near beach to have built parking etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must do
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach of fine sand slightly pink. Transparent water , a very pleasant swim! We went there at the end of the day to avoid the world, we took advantage of the low tide and sunset, to end up in a restaurant next to the parking which was very nice!The beach of elagonissi is a must

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Come. I saw. I ran away.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Experience overall not recommended, easily categorized among the 12 labors of Hercules.  We left Hersonissos at 6am to arrive on the beach at 11am passing through mountain roads that I do not recommend to those suffering from car sickness. Once we arrived we did just under 1km to get to the beach; since it was high season the umbrellas were already occupied and the beach almost completely full but we still manage to find a place to settle. Very hot day and with gusts of wind, so zigzagging between umbrellas flying and sand rising, we manage to get into the water: clean, spotless but there is no trace of pink, for the most part the height of the water reaches up to the waist. After a fleeting lunch we decide to go up from the beach and wait for our bus to return to the hotel. 8 hours of travel for 3 and a half hours of beach, absolutely not recommended for those leaving from afar. Highly overrated beach that does not reflect the appearance of the photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What is hell?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a disappointment! Beach in theory heavenly but actually a real hell. Lots of people perched everywhere with the illusion of being on the most popular beach in Crete. Dozens of buses and thousands of cars in mega parking lots.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bath beach with many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A really nice beach and nice water. But there is not much red sand, to say nothing at all. There were troubled many people, but the weather was also good.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mass destruction
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach should be closed to tourism as they already did for Chrissi Island. An impressive amount of people (I counted 22 buses in the mega parking lot and hundreds of cars) are destroying this beautiful and delicate ecosystem and soon it will be just a memory

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unmissable!!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach seen in this area of Crete much more beautiful even than Balos. We arrived at about 11.30 and it was very crowded, but we crossed the sea on foot which has very shallow water and in a few minutes we arrived at the 'island in front where instead there were very few people and we had a great time.Going there, also, you have the opportunity to swim in different areas where the sea is even more spectacular.Sull'island, however, there are no bars or beaches so go equipped.Pink sand is seen at times and depends on the light ....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most stunning beach I have ever seen, it takes your breath away. Reading reviews we are apprehensive, but no need to be.Get there by 9 am to guarantee a sunbed, it’s a 10 minute walk from the car park, down hill but not steep.  Coming up was fine. I did it in flip flops.Beach bars were good, well stocked.  You can pay a Euro to pee in a serviced toilet.They have sunbeds on a hard standing for the disabled and a chair on tracks to take them into the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dare it!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Today's experience we reached a good road country narrow without any problem but access to the parking lot is easy and the descent is difficult !!!Set umbrellas 20 enough to go early in the morning to get there!!!They write and prevent the people as if they would go to 5 stars with the jeep in front of the sea!!!If you do not dare you will not receive this magical visit to something beautiful!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise beach. You have to walk for a short distance before reaching the beach, but once you arrive it seems to be in paradise. We went very early to find umbrellas and sunbeds (25€ all set, umbrella and 2 sunbeds)It remains and will remain the most beautiful beach in all of Crete

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Holiday in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crowded beach, after 10 am you can not find a place. To get to the beach there is a dirt road, in full sun, and the route, downhill on the way, then uphill on the way back, it takes about 25 minutes!!Few possibilities 'to eat, just a kiosk with very few seats.Honestly, the way I was described, Elafonissi, I expected better!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A heavenly swimming pool
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perhaps the best beach after balos for beauty. Parking is 5 euros to pay when you leave.Umbrellas cost 20 euros but hurry up, do not think of sleeping late and come comfortably after resting badly. Here you come early or stay on the ground in the free beach. By 9:30 in the morning everything is already full.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Easy walking access (15 minutes walk accessible to all). You have to be there in the morning at 9am and leave at noon when the crowd arrives. Parking 5 € per day with bcp places available in the morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular sea, too bad it's crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived at 8:30 and already half of the umbrellas available were occupied.We also recommend coming no later than 8:30 because in a couple of hours the beach fills up in an unlikely way.However spectacular sea and toilet services well organized food and drink showers at the few kiosks available

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Petite reiterates previous reviews: little pink sand, people and a little difficult access. However, these small drawbacks must be put into perspective. Given the experiences described, it is necessary to organize a minimum to make the most of this extraordinary site (yes yes extraordinary). If as we have no choice but to leave in summer, leaving very early in the morning (I speak of 6 or 7am), you will have no one on the beach and you can enjoy an incredible transparency of water. For pink sand, yes, you will see it, even if there are few and it moves in places (I think it also depends on the time of year depending on sunlight). It is worth it, because in my experience I have never seen one elsewhere.:) Reviews to brave mornings and those who appreciate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded! :-(
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice but unfortunately too crowded. I would recommend the trip only in a low season and best very early in the morning.Be sure to take water shoes with you and walk the path with sturdy shoes as it is already very rocky.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stunning beach, we found a quieter spot on the other side of the main beach to chill and swim in the sea. The water is crystal clear and so beautiful! Highly recommend a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise literally. Reading a lot of reviews from Greeks for a lot of walking , narrow streets etc. I had a little scared but really what the people write. The road from Chania to Elafonisi is really very good. The route is just magical, you pass through mountains, villages etc and the landscape enchanting you. At some point, it's okay, it's narrow but without any danger. Once you get there from the first car park they try to put you inside and well that the others are full but just ignore them and park at the last one called mega parking and costs 5€ all day.From there it is exactly 8 minutes walk with a timetable on a very normal road with sea fields I was okay and didn't slip half a time. As soon as you arrive at the beach there are sunbeds with 20€ the set if you will hardly find it is few. We arrived at 11:30 and although the beaches were full the people were beautifully shared and we sat right in front of the water with our umbrella. The waters are crystal clear, warm and clear and the landscape simply enchanting you.We liked it so much that we walked and swam in all points. For the unorganized there are several canteens right on the beach that offer all the cafes, food and drinks at very normal prices.No reviews are read from grinarides who have consistently parked in the water and parked them for distances etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must go beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Undoubtedly one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece!!! Clear, shallow waters and a magnificent landscape, unlike any other.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful.  Few umbrellas available, so Recommendation to get there before 9:30. By 10:00, they were all busy. Cost of 1 umbrella and 2 deck chairs 20 euros. Otherwise, at 10 euros, in the shop before the beach, you can buy one. Beach equipped with bar, toilet at a cost of 1 euro and showers.Pink sand and crystal clear sea. To do about 1km walk from the parking lot to the beach and the route is not difficult, but I recommend sneakers especially to children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A stunning beauty spot ruined
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Elafonisi maybe 10 years ago.  It was quiet with a rough & ready car park amongst the trees.  There was one food outlet, and that was about it.  Now it feels almost industrial in it's effort to get people on the beach.  There are numerous large (and one HUGE), car parks, with "officials" in hi-viz jackets waving you in.  The beach is a long & rough trek down a rocky hill.  There are large fast food type shops.  The beach is absolutely crammed with coachloads of people & sunbeds (at 20 euros a pop). Absolutely spoiled by tourism (and I know I'm just as guilty as everybody else).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise to preserve some human beasts.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: See English tourist, what are you going to do with a pink sandbag when you arrive in your gray city?. Please respect the natural spaces and go drink beer that seems like the only thing you can do. You should be fined €10,000 to see if you learn.Besides warning you you kept picking up more sand when I turned... when I told the police you were gone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over rated beach, not worth the drive. Definitely don't go on a windy day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Over rated beach.We visited when it was windy, which made the beach fairly unpleasant.  Clearly that was one of those things though I noted all the shops on the walk to the beach sold windbreakers. The 1st car park you come to, is v keen for you to park there and crams the cars in which can be tricky if leave early like we did. The parking prices are similar at all the car parks even those closer.The beach is hyped as pink, barely obvious, it has a shallow bay so good if there with little kids. There are sunbeds to hire but I suspect you would need to be v early to get those. It's at least 15 min walk to beach over quite rough terrain, so be aware of that.Personally we felt it wasn't worth the hype, long drive etc, there are much nicer beaches with more accessibility and nicer outlook.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family trip Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately, the trip to the “pink” sandy beach was a total failure. The beach was little to no pink, but totally crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The pink beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Difficult to reach but very suggestive, a huge expanse of light sand with pink shades. Cold sea for my taste but pleasant. A lot of wind! Nearby paid parking and restaurants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach, would def visit again
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach! Iconic pink sand, and nice shallow depth for miles. Great for both strong swimmers and non swimmers. Lots of access to food, but get early if you want to rent beach umbrellas, it cost us €20. we also had to pay for parking, but we packed a few snacks and water. Very lovely beach with nice soft sand and clear water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and worth a visit. Topolia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Practical advise first... There is a downhill walk to get to the beach (remember it's all uphill to get back). There are shops and places to get refreshments and food that are fairly priced given the location. Parking is chargeable and slightly cheaper if you are happy to walk an extra minute.The view and beach itself are beautiful and will be hard to match, the children loved the fact the sea was calm and very warm. Definitely worth a visit!The main route from north to south where the beach is has a quait town called Topolia which was a lovely bakery and store selling authentic wooden items. The people there went out of their way to be welcoming, worth a stop

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To see but like almost all around the island at least once
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The French like to complain too much. Personally full of August I had a beautiful perimeter in the water while I was at the Check-out point between the beach and the small island that formed in front of... a crazy world but still many places. You don't have to fight for deckchairs... and you just don't have to go. The beaches of the coast in France are so crowded if not worse sometimes 🤣🤣 nan it's serious enjoy this moment instead of grumbling. The weak point is perhaps the road some tight or mountain passes that make some vertiginous effects. Otherwise go for a ride or enjoy only beautiful beaches all around Crete

reviewsWithKeywords.title: World 🌎 Famous Elefonisi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ok, what else to say about this world 🌍 famous beach ⛱️??? Just Some practical things. You have to park your car around 600 metres away from the beach (parking costs 3€ or 5€ - depending on how far the parking lot is). There is a down hill with 3-4 shops at the beginning. So you can grab coffee food or water. There are also 2-3 cantines on the beach. Sun beds cost 20€ per set. During August come early because you won't even find a place to put your own umbrella!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sea 🔝 pink sand very little, a bit overrated.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, wonderful sea, wrong to advertise it for pink sand, which is really too little and in very few areas, good just for the istagram photo but nothing more...Compared to Balos in my opinion it is less unmissable, a lot of people from 10 to 15:00, if I had to make a comparison, I carry C-section in Salento.If I had to redo 2 hours by car to go back I would not do them again, in my opinion it is very overrated, despite nothing to say to the amazing sea that deserves 5 stars.For services:good parking, not far from the beach, 5 minutes walk, umbrellas not many, you need to arrive early, for 9:00, for food and drink no problem.Toilet for 1 euro, shower for free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful lagoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful lagoon! Shallow transparent water. Cross to go to the small island opposite, you will see pink sand on the edge and blue lagoon water. Obviously very touristy, only paid parking (5 € for the nearest) and then you have to go down to the beach (and go up in full sun!). But there is when the place to settle and the lagoon is great. Watch the wind.The site deserves to make the road (windy!). It is beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long journey with hairpin bends
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From Chania 70 km including 38 normal road full of hairpin bends (not recommended for those suffering from car sickness. Once in Elafonissi you will find a series of parking lots, do not stop at the first even if the valets invite you to do so, go to the one closest to the beach. From there, however, on foot you will have to walk for 600 meters a rough road but also feasible with children from 4 years old. Forget about finding Mikonos-style establishments, you will find 4 cross establishments with 20 umbrellas each and 4 shacks, some without tables and chairs, to take salads, sandwiches, hamburgers. If you feel like it, bring a parasol because you will not find a place at the establishments unless you go early in the morning or adapt and lie under a dune or a tree.Beautiful place, shallow water for many meters, ideal place for children under 4 years. Adults will have to stray a long way from the shore before taking a good swim.The pink beach I have not seen.... a dense expanse of people yes. Once enough is enough, I much prefer to return to Falassarna... in my opinion more organized and served and the color of the sea equal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal water and completely clear
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view is beautiful..The beach plays to be the most beautiful and the cleanest that exists in Crete ⁇  and in Greece ..Unbelievable colors and very shallow that should .. We are talking about the Maldives

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To avoid in summer
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach lagoon but only for the view. In this month of July a lot of people, almost no shade and mediocre deckchairs taken by storm. Besides, we can only wade, not swim. As for pink sand, there is ultimately very little. To visit probably outside of July and August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful, until 11..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is breathtaking, definitely worth a visit. We arrived at 11.30 and I felt like I was at the stadium from the confusion, both in the parking lots and on the beach. When I return to Crete, I will definitely go to this beach by 8/8.30 to stay until 11.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I absolutely love this beach!! It is huge!! The water is cold and sparkling clean!! There are lots of families and young people enjoying themselves! There are sunbeds but unfortunately we did not manage to get one because they were sold out. There are toilets and changing facilities available. There are places to eat near and close to the beach. The walk from the parking lot to the beach is about 20 to 30 minutes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magical colors
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a wonderful beach and its colours are magical. Be well prepared when visiting with kids. It can get quite windy and it is best to arrive early in the morning to get an umbrella and chairs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just shit!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was unpleasantly surprised when we arrived, they have closed the road to the beach and as far as we read it decided the municipality of Kissamos in 2023 so you are forced to pay for parking which have grown like mushrooms with a charge of 5€ (there is no free crucifixion anywhere) and when you go down to the beach (if you save the trap) has sun loungers that say above ( Municipality of Kissamos) charge 20€ per set!!!! I have come in the past 2 times, it is definitely the last time I come, no longer worth the trouble!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Much wind for nothing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were yesterday at Elafonisi Beach ,totally crowded ,no more deckchairs available ,the way back and forth to the beach very rocky and long .Of course it looks very nice and the water is clear .But to get to the other side you had to walk through the sea with your things (bags etc ) All in all you can do ,but you don't have to

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, Watch out for the wind, and quite a walk before arriving at the lagoon but it is worth it!!! Very clean beach, with shower and toilet

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lot of people.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Waterlifting tourist trap. Several thousand people and very few beach chairs available, For 30 euros for 2. The pink sand you really need to look for. Lovely beach, with low water, but too oversold

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Much overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at this beach a few days ago. Surely the view is really beautiful but the influx of tourists, the total unavailability of services, the great confusion to grab some shaded areas make this area absolutely overrated. The view is certainly beautiful but bathing is practically impossible: you have to do at least a couple of kilometers to have water at shoulder level there is a set of people who do not allow a minimum of relaxation. The services are also poor and totally inadequate for the thousands of people who arrive every morning. A tip there are many parking lots at the beginning of the beach we advise you not to stop at the first three but to reach either the fourth on the left that costs three euros per day or the last one that costs five euros but also the three-euro one is very close to the beach entrance. The first parking lots are a little further away you will see the people who tell you that the road is closed but you can reach the last one that is closest where there is also a small supermarket where you can buy something to drink because there it is absolutely impossible to reach any kind of service Given the considerable number of people who come every morning. Even the road to get there is not particularly easy we were in Chiania we took more than an hour and a half.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Much easier to reach than Balos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, water and panorama. You can walk all around and it's really nice. The sand, however, is not pink except for tiny stretches on the shore in the distance on the islet opposite. You have to arrive very early because the umbrellas put on the free beach fly for too much wind and the beach fills up immediately. Just two restaurants to eat offering bar-ready and expensive food. Too crowded without free beach services and super hot. Parking near paid 3/5€ per day plus a fairly long walk

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Better than his reputation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After a spontaneous visit recently, I would like to put into perspective what you read here.We were there in the high season heading into the evening and we enjoyed it overall. The journey over the funny serpentines is picturesque and unexciting for island conditions. We took the last parking lot before the beach (“Big Parking”) because we are lazy. Slightly before that there was also something for 3€. Both are acceptable to me. Elsewhere, very different amounts are called upon. The beach is not small, so despite the loungers you will find plenty of uncommercialized space. It wasn't really crowded in the water either. No comparison to some sardine beaches on Malle.Beach and water were overall in good condition Some garbage in the water in one place really stood out. A little of the pink sand was also everywhere, if you looked properly. Overall a great bathing evening in an oversized bathtub.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking beach, cost umbrella and two sunbeds 20 euros, there is a bar selling stuff to eat, ice cream and soft drinks.Beautiful for both bathing and exploring the place.Also recommended for children since the water is very shallow in some areas of the beach.Parking 5€ but there was also one at 3€ a little further.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Challenging drive, lovely beach, terrible wind and sand/grit blasted
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only 2 stars, mostly because it was incredibly windy - so strong you had to hold onto your sunglasses and it blew sand and grit at you so hard that it hurt. Check the weather forecast before you go! The beach (beaches really) are lovely, with shallow lagoons that you can paddle in. We deliberately arrived late afternoon to avoid the worst of the crowds and sun, and could have got sunbeds, if we'd wanted to. We'd hired a car and the highlight of the day was the drive their (from Chania) through the beautiful mountains and villages. It's a challenging road (very narrow in places, with hairpin bends) and not for the nervous driver, but I enjoyed it. However, we didn't stay for an evening meal in Elafonissi, as I really wouldn't have fancied that mountain pass in the dark! Car parking (€5) is from 2024 a long-ish walk from the beach down an unpleasant grit path  (more wind + grit) and then through the old car park areas nearer the sea - maybe they'll re-wild them eventually, but they're an eyesore for now. A couple of tavernas said they rented rooms, so staying a night or two might be a good bet, if I ever come again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not to be missed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Unfortunately crowded. Just arrived I recommend watching for an umbrella because they sell out very soon. For parking the last one costs 5 euros anyway. In the others you spend 3 euros. I recommend reaching the islet in front of the beach, which you can reach by walking in the water, if you want to be quieter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not so extraordinary
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 1h30 drive from Chania including 1h of mountain roads. You have to be motivated.  No luck, nois had wind, a little too much for a pleasant experience.  We arrived at 6pm, not too crowded. Pink, you really have to look for it; indeed, a reflection by the water... We were a little disappointed, but the setting was pretty anyway.  Do not hesitate to cross to go to the islet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Passion
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No trouble! It was blowing too much..There is quite a distance from where you leave the car to the beach. The sunbeds €20

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning, paradise like beach with pink sand, not as crowded as we expected, plenty of space to take nice photos without other tourosts in the background, must visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too many people and pink it is not.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There were simply too many tourists. It was not to find a place, not even in the sand one could find a place. Otherwise very nice and nice water but unfortunately still too many people. Pink wasn't it. I would recommend going to another beach where there are not so many.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mages
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A magnificent landscape and a beach with such beautiful colors! It may be far from Chania, but it really is worth it!If you start early you will be able to see the beach almost empty and enjoy the landscape

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To see! Once...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 1h30 drive to go...so yes it is super pretty, Undoubtedly... nice sea, transparent etc...but you have to go very early! Impressive mass of people, little room, you have to move a little... a small walk is necessary when you leave the parking lot, in full sun, very hot, you have to motivate! 5 euros parking, there is enough to eat but we opted for the insulated backpack, (see the world queuing for drinks ..) short very tourist site, which loses its beauty ....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice place but super busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was stunning with infamous pink sand on the edge of the water. The coves and beaches around were very impressive and this beach would be nice to spend a long time at (unfortunately we only had enough time to spend an hour or two here).The beach features a very large shallow area which would be perfect for children to swim in unattended.At the top of the beach there is a small cafe/shop where you can buy snacks, drinks or ice creams from which is a necessity as there isn’t loads else in the area.The beach took us around 2.5 hours to get to by car driving from Rethymno. The roads there were slightly treacherous as you drive down a valley on what felt like the edge of a big drop, but a confident driver would manage with no issue. The only downside to this beach was how busy it was. We went at midday on a Thursday in September and it was packed. It was difficult to find an area by the shore to lay our towels.When we went the parking at the beach was closed so we had to park about 1km away and walk to the beach, so be prepared for this just in case.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but a lot of people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really lovely for the Caribbean colors. Obviously to enjoy it to the fullest you must arrive by 9. However from 11 is practically a carnaio of people both on the beach and in the water .. if there is strong wind you can not even open the umbrella brought from home (as we wanted to do) We say that a day there is not the real relaxation of Greek beach, but the view deserves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice to see, but....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Goin' there takes time (aprox. 3 hrs. if you come from Heraklion area), the road in the mountains is quite dangerous if you're not a good driver. A lot of cars and buses goin' there and not everybody has skills to drive on serpentines. You should arrive early (9 a.m.) to have a sunbed, only two places to have it), otherwise be prepared with your own umbrella. By the way, two sunbeds and one umbrella -20 €, extra bed 5 € :)). To eat-half gyros, some pies, not a vaiery, pricey - 4-5 €, better come with some sandwiches.  Toilets 1 €, no free shower. First part of the day very crowded, in the afternoon the atmosphere became more relaxing. Conclusion: the feeling was that people try to rip you off, a little filthy, good to see but not so special as i've been told, not coming back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To flee in July August
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Here we are! As all the guides indicate this beach as amazing, we drove almost 1h30 from beacon to get there. And the, very big disappointment. The beach is black with people; even thePrivate beaches are invaded with 5 6 people crammed underUmbrellas and 2 sunbeds! Pink sand you said? Even if you look hard, there's none. So certainly the water is translucent but this is not enough to make this beach beautiful. Probably out of season. But in July August to flee, do not waste your time, you will inevitably be disappointed. Not to mention the parking scam on arrival; people blocked our way to tell us their parking indicating that the road was closed. Walking to the beach we realized that they had sent us to the farthest and most expensive parking (double the price of parking near the beach!!!!).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very pale pink
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach but it was incredibly crowded which of course you have to expect and the sand was not as pink as you thought when you saw the commercial. Lovely clear water that despite all the people there felt fresh.If you’re in the mood for some snorkeling, it’s fine but it wasn’t that much fish, not surprising considering how many people there were. Guess it's much more exciting when it's not high season

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As soon as you get to the beach you risk being “disappointed” by the view but if you want to take a walk around the dunes you can easily reach a magnificent place (Recommend to arrive early in the morning because at 10/11 it starts to be already too full) The beauty of this place is the possibility to always walk in the water because you touch practically everywhere and then look for the magical place of this islet away from people. The pink beach is really there, just don’t stop at the first space of sand just arrived

reviewsWithKeywords.title: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL BEACH IN THE WORLD
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The highlight of the stay!The road to this paradise beach is very dangerous. It is very steep and on the mountainside. Several bus companies fly to this destination from major Cretan cities. For about twenty euros, you will have peace of mind. If you prefer the car, you will probably drive between two buses.Once there, we remain speechless in front of the beauty of this landscape. First of all, the turquoise blue of the lagoons is absolutely beautiful. Then there's the pink sand. Unfortunately, the latter is becoming more and more rare because tourists had become used to taking them home in a plastic bottle. Today this is no longer the case, and there is no police monitoring tourists. The water is warm and pleasant. The ideal beach during heavy heat waves because it is very windy.Must-see during your stay in Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This review is for the parking situation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: WARNING rip off !!! Keep an eye out for parking. The parking lot (where people in warm vests, standing in the middle of the street, lead you to it) right at the entrance to the town and without price signage is a scam. Closer parking to Elafonesi beach costs 3€ !! When leaving the fraudster parking lot you are told that you have to pay 5€, which is not signposted. If you refuse payment, you are threatened by the controllers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 5 stars because there are no others. Two hours drive to get there, but really worth it. Once you arrive you will find several parking lots (for a fee of 5€) with valets inviting you to go to the pirmo (further away), avoid and go further. Try to arrive early if you want to find an umbrella (there are several) at a cost of 20 € including two sunbeds.  The beautiful water and pink sand make this place lovely, other than Balos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A dream beach 🤩
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well what about, such a place is usually only found in magazines, do not stop at the equipped beach cross the ford and enjoy the white dunes and the various pink beaches, the water has breathtaking colors!To get to the beach you have to park in the various paid parking lots 3/5€, take a very quiet dirt road but in the sun... then you will arrive at the beach equipped with umbrellas and 2 sunbeds for €20 an extra sunbed €5. But to find them available it is recommended to arrive by 9:00!Recommendation to walk along the beach and enjoy the scenery is truly paradise!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pictures don't reflect reality
