reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stick to the pictures.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, but.... Unbelievable people, literally "Siloam's swimming pool". If it somehow magically had 1/10 of the world it does, it would be the most beautiful beach. Now not.....it also has more than 500 meters of walking, -while some cars have gone all the way down-.and of course because of the people it wasn't clean either. The road to reach it, full of turns. Stick to the pictures.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picturesque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A lovely beach with some pink sand (dependant upon the season of your visit) and clear, turquoise waters (which are a very pleasant temperature due the heat the south of Crete experiences in the peak season). Due to the amount of tourists visiting, the beach will be busy however you will still, comfortably, find yourself a spot. If you want a more peaceful and tranquil experience, consider visiting the island which can be accessed by a short walk through the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place. I recommend arriving early (9.00 maximum) to find free umbrellas in the central part and enjoy the beach and the sea before it fills up. However, even when full it is a beautiful place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For me it's not the most beautiful, I've seen more pink sand on Balos.And above all there are so many people, the water is warm, the sand fine but overpriced

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb site to do BEFORE the Balos lagoon (not after)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beach, quite touristy obviously, with some pink reflections.After the Balos Lagoon, we still didn't have the "wow" effect.We arrived there around 4 p.m., crowded but it was manageable.We stayed 1 night at the Elafonissi resort, ideal for parking and great in terms of services (hotel, dinner, breakfast, reception).A very beautiful site!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beach. The site is splendid.One of the most beautiful beaches in Crete.Parking price at 5€ is expensiveCatering on site is very expensive, eg €7 per portion of fries, it's a bit of a scam.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Enchanting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enchanting place, it looks like a natural swimming pool because the water is very shallow and clear. I recommend going early and taking an umbrella because there are few shady places and it is hot. The path to get there is short and very doable. There is a small refreshment point there (they sell sandwiches), while where there is the car park, above, you will find a restaurant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A piece of heaven on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed on the last Sunday of August, before 9.30am and found a place for a sunbed and umbrella for 20 euros. The beach is a dream, and until 11.30 there weren't many people, then it filled up. The pink sand and natural pools with shallow, calm water make this place a true paradise. Absolutely not to be missed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The perfect beach, with wonderful waters!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The perfect beach, with wonderful waters! The parking costs 5 euros and from there you walk for 5 easy minutes. It has a canteen to get a coffee, and plenty of space to put your umbrella. No matter how crowded it is, it's great! You better come as early as possible!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi - Too good to be true
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice place would be SOMEDAY. With so many people gathering now and with the air we achieved, you are not happy about it. The buses leave you quite a distance to walk on rocky places and with the sun baking you until you reach the beach. We could NOT see the famous pink sand - maybe - because of the wind.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach with pink sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach, you have to arrive early enough for the sunbeds, by 9.30 they are still on the right side. Alternatively, a large free beach, they also sell umbrellas at the top of the beach.The road by car is quite simple, a few curves. Once you arrive you can park for 5 euros all day and go down for a few minutes. Nothing too complex.It is worth going to see the islet, the water is beautiful and there are fewer people there compared to the main beach which gets quite crowded.Two flaws: the food was nothing special and where we ate towards the beginning the lady at the cash register was a little rude.As for the sunbeds, wait to pay and get a receipt before going for a walk and leaving them unattended, we witnessed an argument between those who had bought the sunbed very early but had not yet paid and those who had paid for it and grabbed it even though they had arrived. late, the fault of the managers of the sunbeds who did not check that they were really free. The cost is 20 euros, cash only.In general, a beach not to be missed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Low and warm water, very few people. Stunning pine forest and super excellent bars for everyone's palate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over advertised
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Over advertised!All the charm and all the potential beauty disappears in the crowd of all the people and the lack of sunbeds.No, unfortunately it wasn't worth wasting a whole day,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi, unmissable beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: wherever you are in Crete, Elafonissi beach, in the prefecture of Chania, cannot be missed.an expanse of sea awaits you with five different shades of blue in which strips of white and coral pink sand are inserted. if you are lying in the water you have to make sure you are wet, you may not notice it as it is transparent and crystalline.bring water and something to eat with you and stay in this place as long as you can.unmissable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good bath but overcrowded!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place itself is amazing; a large area of shallow, turquoise water with a sandy beach in between. The sand is sometimes (depending on the winds) shimmering pink - but not when we were there, a Saturday in August.The information you don't get before you go there is that the car parks cost €5 (a pittance) but it's a long way to walk through the terrain, on rocky ground down to the beach area itself. There are very limited parasols and sunbeds, if you come after 10, the place feels packed. We found a rock to put our things on while we bathed.There is nowhere to buy refreshments down on the beach area - from what we saw anyway. Bring everything you need to eat and drink and wear good shoes for the hike down and back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but lower your expectations about the “pinkness of the sand” very low depth of water so you cant actually swim there and parking costs 5 euros.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Recommended experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You arrive at this beach after about thirty km of mountain roads, narrow and full of hairpin bends and, unfortunately, also traveled by tourist buses. After leaving the car there is then a stretch of about a quarter of an hour to walk. We arrived at 11am and there were no more umbrellas available. Obviously there is the possibility of bringing your own. Huge beach, gorgeous water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hordes of tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Do you think Benidorm beach is full in summer? You don't know Elafonisi's. The limits of physics are not met here. There is so much crowding that the main business is the several giant parking lots for so many cars. From there, an endless line of ants for almost 15 minutes until reaching the beach, where the umbrellas are immediately occupied, and there is no shade to shelter under.The shore is not pink sand, but there is a narrow pink strip made of shells. The photos on the internet are highly retouched. If the intention is to visit a beautiful place, I don't think that crowding justifies it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach for us,Parking cost 5 euros.You travel along a small, fairly "arid" stretch of road and then immerse yourself in a paradise of life.Ideal for children and for those who love walking in the water, a "packed lunch" is recommended because during peak hours the place to eat is a considerable distance away and also very crowded.Even though there were many people, we managed to fully enjoy this paradise.Absolutely not to be missed!😍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach cannot be described, you have to come here and immerse yourself in the beauty of this paradise, I have never seen such a fascinating and wonderful beach.At times very windy, but pleasant because the day is very hot, the road to get there is very doable, nothing dangerous, the road is entirely asphalted. Park in the last open space before the descent which can be done easily with trainers.Heaven is here!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise😎😎😎😎😎😎😎
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach of dazzling beauty... crystal clear and clean water nothing to envy of the Caribbean... I recommend arriving early to see the almost deserted lagoon before the crowds arrive... an absolute must see

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A miracle!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It will take you almost 1.5 hours to reach the beach.There are enough parking lots to park but quite far from the beach. It takes at least 15 minutes of walkingTo the beach.Although much further down right next to the beach there is a HUGE parking lot that is unknown why they don't let people go. But if you persist, they might let you go. If you have a health problem or some other problem, they will definitely let you go! We, after a lot of fuss with a rude gentleman, passed!There are canteens that have snacks drinks soft drinks etcThe set of sunbeds costs €20, but they are relatively few for the volume of people. If you are there early, eg until 9, you might find.The beach really is a miracle!! Wonderful clear waters with unique pink sand!! Unique images that we only see in photos, come to life in front of you! It is more than worth visiting this unique place which, in my opinion, is one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but it feels like being at a fair
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed during a day in mid-August, perhaps not exactly the best time.Although the beach is truly beautiful and the sea is stupendous, too many tourists reign supreme. Buses arrive from all over the island and an infinite amount of cars which cause many queues entering and leaving the beach. They are very organized with huge car parks, bars and taverns which, despite being comfortable, ruin the landscape in my opinion.A trip to take two photos is worth doing but a whole day is too much (at least when we were there).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is crystal clear but there are really a lot of people. A 2 minute drive away there is a much more beautiful but less known beach. The lagoon is suitable for children. The pink sand is really there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Arrive early and go to the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beaches, not to be missed, but very crowded.When I was there 20+ years ago it was an almost deserted paradise, now it is more crowded than a lido on the Romagna Riviera.They should put a limited number with reservationYou need to arrive early (before 9:00) and go to the island, as far forward as possible to avoid the crowds in the area where there are umbrellas and sunbeds.If you want shade, bring an umbrella or buy one on the street.Parking at €5: reasonable (don't stop at the first parking lots).Umbrellas for €20: expensive, but given the amount of people they could charge whatever price they want.Then there are the usual idiots who take away pink sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded beach with long walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is like a crowded Bellevue or Hornbæk beach.Quite nice, but not suitable for people with poor walking. Not something to brag about. Long descent and you also have to go up again. A small train would help those who have difficulty walking and they are also tourists who must have the opportunity.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi, Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Getting to Elafonissi from Eraklion is not easy, the last 20 km of road are tortuous, of course everything is rewarded by the spectacle that lies before you, no parking problems, at the fixed cost of 5 euros. Sneakers are recommended for the easy descent into the sea. Given the large number of people who enjoy this beach, it is best to bring your own umbrella and waterproof mats because the ground is often full of water. Stunning beach and unmissable for anyone visiting Crete; Please don't take the local pink sand in an uncivilized way, it's running out and it's a shame.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated beach, marketed as the pink beach but only the rocks right at the water's edge are pink. It's beautiful and shallow, but insanely crowded and for a family with children, it's too far to walk for small children's legs.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Somewhere here there is a beautiful beach trying to escape. However, before you undertake a 3 hour car journey, pay 5€ to park your hire car and walk 15 minutes to the beach, this stretch of occasional pink sand is populated by thousands upon thousands of well meaning, sun seeking tourists. Make no mistake, this place is busy, very busy, bodies everywhere, for us a beach we could not remain on. So after staying for 10 minutes we preferred the 3 hour return journey. That’s just us, perhaps we should have researched a little deeper before we picked this day trip. At least if you read this review you’ll know what to expect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly, even crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went on mid-August, left from Planias, an hour's drive, arrived around 2pm, lots of people, but at that time we found a parking space because there are always people coming and going. Full car park, we parked in a small street before the descent, without needing a ticket.A short downhill road reaches the beach, there is a refreshment point, with showers and umbrella/sunbed sets. From the beach there is a strip of sand that goes towards the sea, if there is wind you can move to the more sheltered side, or go beyond the dune which is located at the end of the strip of sand. However, it is so large that once you get past the initial part you will find plenty of space to sunbathe while lying on the huge shoreline, you can play beach volleyball, tennis or just stay and admire the pink sand under your feet.The next day we preferred to come back here rather than go to Balos beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Negative
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most irritating places in all of Crete.10.30 am, super crowded with people and children screaming.The beach itself is very beautiful but at 8.30 in the morning.Negative experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, lots of people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the scenery are magical! The only negative is that it was too crowded! I would suggest the unorganized spots because the organized ones were quite dirty. It is worth visiting! Easy access with children too! Also, leaving your car in the last parking lot costs the same as the rest and you will travel a much shorter distance on foot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This is not heaven.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning colors, but that's all.Parking nearby and a quiet 5/10 minute walk to get to the beach.Very few umbrellas (we arrived at the beach by car at 9.30 and there were perhaps 4/5 left in the area on the right, the least beautiful).Around 11 all the organized tours arrive and the beach loses all its charm.Very crowded, noisy, people everywhere, mainly shallow and warm water.Fortunately we "explored" the beach as soon as we arrived and enjoyed the wonderful coves beyond the hill when they were still deserted, an indescribable peace.From midday onwards the water takes on even more unforgettable shades, but the strong wind picks up (strong enough to windsurf, impossible to keep a hat on your head).In short, if you go to Crete, a day in Elafonissi is mandatory, but see it once and never go back again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Passage to elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a magnificent place that you absolutely must do early in the morning, after 11 a.m. it’s just mass tourism.I confirm some opinions that the beach is not pink but that you can admire in certain places pieces of coral coloring the sand pink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Camp
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful place but really poorly managed. Forget the umbrella and get ready for a very wild and not very relaxing day!A shame!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A dream
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beach to see at least once in your life and will become your comparison for all the others you will see, cheap and convenient parking, cheap services but there are also large isolated and heavenly spaces for walks and the sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beach with a spectacular view.The water with different shades of blue… great for families and to enjoy a relaxed day at the beach.Lack of umbrellas for the number of visitors it receives.I recommend the visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A disappointment!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You don't describe in words if no one sees it!!!! The influx of people like ants has no sunbeds (we didn't even have such a request!!) Not even a small piece of land to sit on!!! To clarify, we were there at 10:30 !!! Well, we paid 5 euros for parking, you mean with a 10' walk because we didn't have any other choice!! Passing a little water, they explained to us that this happens every day from 9 in the morning when all the buses arrive and leave tourists until 2 in the afternoon!! In the simple world that comes from very early!! We didn't know that!!! We ate all the twists and turns until we arrived!!! Like a view - water - very very shallow on one side - we didn't go on the other!! We had to go over the world!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach with pink sand, great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went for Elafonissi with an organized tour and had 4 hours at the beach. The busses stops about 15-20 minutes walking distance from the actual beach but the walk isn’t too bad as long as you make sure to wear sunblock, a hat and have water with you. There was a lot of people there but we still managed to get our own spot on the beach close to the waterline and the pink sand. The waters were crystal clear and while snorkeling we saw lots of different fish. It was quite windy which was good in regards to the heat, but we were also covered in sand. Lovely day though!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sublime beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very busy beach but worth the detour. Beyond the famous pink sand there are magnificent shades of blue. The water temperature is ideal but be careful of sunburn.
Fairytale lagoon with adjoining island reachable on a strip of sand. The only flaw is that the umbrellas are too close together

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice sandy beach. The transparent and clear water with the sand having a light pink color. When you arrive there is parking at a cost of 5 euros for the whole day, then there is a small walk to get to the beach but it is very doable. Once you arrive at the beach there is both an equipped and a free beach and there are also bars and kiosks for lunch. For the free beach, equip yourself with an umbrella because it is very hot and there is nothing to shelter from the sun.I highly recommend arriving early in the morning because the beach then fills up with people and you risk having trouble finding a good place to put your towel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Boring for families with children
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magical landscape.. wonderful, exotic.But if you make the mistake of going with a baby, or if you don't have the stamina to walk... you stepped on it.I had been there before years ago. What is valid now is that it is not allowed to drive down to the beach. So after taking 1 hour of turns, you have to walk 10 minutes to get there.Ok go for it…. Come on, it's uphill with incredible sun, it's very difficult. I'm not talking about it if you carry equipment with you (umbrellas, chairs, etc.)...We went at 9 in the morning and it had about 300 people. When we left at 1, it had over 3000... you could barely fit in to swim or put your towel on.Set of sunbeds €20, a good deal compared to other prices on other beaches. Refreshment very expensive.Put on a triple layer of sunscreen or you'll need yogurt afterwards for the burns ☺️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beautiful beach but cold seaThere is a lagoon with shallow waterThe area is very ventilatedYou arrive by car, parking €5 then a doable walk to the beachThere are sun loungers at the bar and a free beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disrespectful tourists
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The place is very beautiful, particular, definitely worth visiting if you go and see the photos on the internet you can get an idea of what it really is like... but: you have to go very early, the crowd (we're talking about more than 6000 people) arrives around 10. This means that the beach becomes a frenzy, there is a shortage of space for umbrellas and you certainly won't find paid ones.Don't stop at the beginning of the beach, cross over and go to the other side towards the open sea. It is equally beautiful but more sheltered from the wind and there are fewer people on the beach. Rudeness and lack of respect prevail due to the inaction of staff. You will find residues of human shit (yeah) if you move under the trees and many regardless of the crumbling fences bivouac among the very rare wild flowers in the dunes. Very sad.I hope that instead of illegal car parkers they will put a toll and a limited number of parking spaces, otherwise very little will remain of the beautiful dunes and the lagoon with the pink beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: HEAVENLY place!!!!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach absolutely worth seeing!!!!!We left Chania at around 7.30am, as it takes around an hour and a half to get there; the road is a bit winding, but well asphalted (DJ advised us to take the internal road, because it got longer with the more panoramic road).Parking cost 5 euros per day.I recommend comfortable shoes or sandals as there is a slightly dirt shortcut to get to the beach.It is preferable to arrive at the beach at 9.30 at the latest because otherwise there will be no umbrellas available (to be on the safe side I recommend bringing your own umbrella in case nothing is free).The place is difficult to describe....you have to see it!!!!Calling it a beach is an understatement!!!!!On the side towards the sea there are some stretches where the pink sand can be seen very well!!!!!!MANDATORY stop!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rose??? A little bit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived no later than 10.30am even earlier and all the few sunbeds were already sold out. All that remains is to lie down on the ground, too bad that the sand is very damp (perhaps because it gets flooded with water in the evening? Dunno) and the towels get so soaked in humidity that they are very wet. I recommend bringing a mat/something plastic to avoid this. Overcrowded (ok it's August). Water actually super clean (on the left side more beautiful, turquoise while on the right even lower and tending towards green/very transparent). I have proof that many photos are full of filters: pink can be seen very little in the photo and on the same beach as I imagined it is not very present.. Well maybe it was a question of sea storms and I was unlucky! There is only one shower: think about the queue... However, the experience itself was quite disappointing compared to how busy the beach is, at least for me who hates the free beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach full of people. In the evening when everyone has gone you can enjoy a paradise while the sun sets. In my opinion Falasarna is much better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I strongly advise against
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A word of advice, move on! The road to get there is horrible, for long hours you are on zigzag mountain paths at very high altitude and once you arrive there there will be so many people that it looks more like the Cergy pond than a heavenly beach. Besides, don’t be fooled by the advertising of pink sand, there isn’t any left at all!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradises in destruction
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the surroundings are wonderful but like everything that becomes popular, in summer it is massive. I have known this beach and this environment for more than 20 years and the change in the last 4+pandemic + post-pandemic has been dizzying.Although they prevent (it is not clear that they have authorization to do so) parking in the old parking lots and that makes the cars further away, it has been at the cost of creating parking monstrosities that charge you without a ticket or receipt at 5 €.the environmental awareness posters have disappeared. You will only see some 20x40 handwritten signs that ask you not to uproot plants or take shells or sand. Nothing about exposing the environmental wealth of the area.Then there is that this parking business has some workers of Pakistani origin as jobs (who you will also see in the tuner asking to clean your car while you wait). You will see that in an area of the old parking lot, when you go down to the beach, there is a group of old girls who seem to have a bad life.Then there are the people who skip the dune protection cord to settle under the trees of the coastal dune or explore the islet, like an explorer. The locals do this, the Germans, the English, Italians, Spaniards...Then there is kite surfing. That after the pandemic has literally taken over the beach, usurping one of the islets to the family bathroom. Why can a kite surf school and a motorcycle company take over half of the beach?Then there is the plastic. Greenhouses have grown massively on the island, and this area is no exception.The environment is on its way to becoming a landscape like that of Paleochora. This year they continue to grow.Hopefully soon the local authorities will protect this wonder a little, taking care of environmental education with posters and some surveillance; controlling these businesses (motorcycles and kites, parking...and those to come) so that they become businesses but coexist better with the urgent need for environmental sustainability, the rights of workers (the car park caretakers housed in caravans), etc.But I'm telling you, the road works herald an even more massive future...🤞🏼.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, white/pink seabed, one of the most beautiful I've seen. It's a shame, but with the period it couldn't have been otherwise, due to the sea of people. Come like us at 8 in the morning and spend the morning, at 12 it is already full although livable. If you arrive early there are trees which with their shade will save you the money for the umbrella, which ran out already at 9am. For parking, as already said by others, it is best to use the last one before the closed road, even if they try to let you in first.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: an open-air swimming pool
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sea with a thousand shades of blue, very spacious beach, but poorly used (there are only 2 establishments), shades of pink only on the shore. Arrive early in the morning to get an umbrella!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A paradise on earth!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beauty of the water and the beach in this little corner of Crete will leave you speechless! Here are some indications:- the road to get from Kissamos (1 hour) is full of curves but entirely asphalted;- parking costs 5 euros and is a 10 minute walk away;- I arrived at the beach at 9.45 and there were still few people;- at 11.30 the beach filled up and at 12.00 the initial part was really invaded;- to enjoy tranquility, I recommend moving to the "islet"... the further you go the fewer people you will find. Here you will find yourself in a postcard environment with white beaches, dunes and a wonderful sea. In this way, we were able to enjoy tranquility even on a very popular day like Sunday 13 August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: a dream beach in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fabulous beach, it's worth seeing and spending the day here.Despite being very popular with tourists, it is also very large so there is always space to lie down on the sand.it is often very exposed to the wind but there are some areas that are more sheltered than others.The colors of the water here are incomparable, wonderful, it looks like a swimming pool due to how transparent it is. You never want to get out of the water...A fairy tale!The journey to reach it is a bit long and at times tortuous but nothing impossible.Wonderful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi in October
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach known for its crystal clear water and pink sand. I went there on October 26, it was hot from late morning and the water was very pleasant.When you arrive there is ample free parking.We arrive at a first crescent-shaped beach, but we can cross the sea to the right, water height at thigh-waist level (I'm 1.57m) to access another area of the beach, quieter. This area appeals to me. was more reminiscent of the Landes with its small weeds obviously without its waves.Corner suitable for children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Privatization of the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am sorry that such a beautiful beach, being one of the treasures of Greece, has become miserable.They force you to leave the car 20 minutes before the beach and to pay the €5 fee. From there you have to walk to the beach, where they don't charge you €30 for a set of sunbeds with umbrellas. There are very few sunbeds and you have to go very early in the morning to find a seat.The world is countless and the beauty of the landscape is destroyed.The use of the toilet is also charged with €1 per visit.Having visited this beach many times in the past, I am disappointed. It has been privatized and the current owners of the beach have sacrificed everything on the altar of money.We probably want this Greece. Deserving of our fate.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The views were  amazing. The beach has a lovely pink hue. It's shallow waters go on for miles. In crystal clear waters. A must go if your in Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. There are numerous loungers and umbrellas available for a fee. It is very busy, but the beach is also very large. You can go far into the water without sinking.It is a beautiful sandy beach with a very gentle slope and is also suitable for non-swimmers. Parking spaces on site can be scarce, but it was worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly, but you better arrive early
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful area.The road is worth the detour,The success of the place is deserved.You have to accept being on the peak in August... there are people.Let all the authors of the comments about tourists rest assured, they are indeed one of them!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All on the altar of money
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You drive 1 and a half hours to get there from Chania and when you arrive there is a ban on cars and vehicles 1 kilometer before the sea and they oblige you to leave the car in a parking lot (payment means 5€). They informed us that the beach has changed ownership and for this reason they no longer allow motor vehicles to proceed to the beach while it has plenty of space to park cars (in short exploitation to take them from the private parking lot). As for the beach, good, but avoid it when it's windy. Few sunbeds for the crowd that gathers. All at the altar of money. I'm not going to come again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Shit black
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We left the car at the third parking lot and walked for half an hour to the beach... They all say pink sand and there was none.... inside, the sea was too shallow to be able to swim, you had to go all the way in... and because windy the beach was dirty... Also it was so windy that the sand rose up, you couldn't put your umbrella and it was so crowded that we were on top of each other... I have never been to a worse beach I don't recommend it to anyone to go

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overcrowded beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A word of advice: go your way, it’s a tourist trap!We went there at the end of the day, thinking that the “most” of the crowds had passed (seeing all the buses/cars coming back up) big mistake! The beach was still crowded, I didn’t take any photos…not interesting with so many people!In fact the beach must be nice but not in July/August…but I find its reputation more than overrated :/There is almost no pink sand (or more), of course it is pleasant to walk on a sandy bottom but with all these people, less…The icing on the cake, if I may say so, as the toilets are chargeable (1 euro is not excessive either!) some preferred...defecating in the water :(

reviews.title: Overflowing and not authentic
reviews.text: I personally cannot recommend it.There are far too many tourists and influencers on the beach. Really enjoying it and experiencing it authentically is hardly possible. Getting to the beach is also not particularly easy, as you have to drive numerous serpentines by car.I have been to many beaches in the world. My personal highlight was Nosy Iranja, especially in the evening when the day tourists were gone and only those who stayed there remained on the island. The beach right in front of the cabin and hardly any people there ... a dream!

reviews.title: Unbelievable experience!
reviews.text: A test spot! For everyone! Clean! Nice local flowers rare! Pink sand that you will hardly see elsewhere! A test spot for a sea rest!

reviews.title: to see
reviews.text: Elafonissi is the icing on the cake called Crete. you need to spend at least a day to taste the beauty of the place; we went there at the end of September and the tourism was nothing short of ... mighty. the clear water and the shoreline attract

reviews.title: WONDERFUL and unique
reviews.text: A true paradise! I thought I would never find the magical colors of my Budelli, now closed to the public for years, to preserve its fragile and uncontaminated environment, and instead... Elafonissi was an unforgettable emotion, as soon as you get there it takes your breath away. We arrived with 40 minutes by local bus, super crowded, from Chania, along mountain trails a bit rough, but the trip was worth it.  A magical, heavenly, indescribable place that took my breath away. We hope it stays that way.... I can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Markthal – a stunning building, but a bit disappointing in terms of price and crowds
reviews.text: Markthal looks beautiful and the design is certainly attractive, but the experience was a bit mixed for me. Although there are many food stalls inside, it seems quite expensive in terms of price. On weekends, it is very crowded, so it is difficult to sit and eat properly or take pictures. The artwork of Horn of Plenty is really great, but there's not much to do outside of architecture. So, once in a while, nothing special.

reviews.title: Perfect day
reviews.text: Wonderful, excellent beach, excellent water, although very far worth making kilometers to visit. Go early to get the most out of it.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Overflowing mass handling and a few crumbs of pink sand. Overrated and too expensive. The wooden paths are dangerous in accidents.

reviews.title: Avoid the crowds.
reviews.text: The drive from Chania was superb. The beach is huge and when we were there early it accomodated all the tourists. The pink sand was more subtle than in photos and the water was very shallow.Stunning landscapes and surrounds. By midday the beach was swarming with tourists - a lot of them unaware of others space.  Once again sadly a place that pretty looses its initial beauty when over run with tourists. So go as early as you can on a shoulder season.

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: It is a beautiful beach! It is really worth walking further away , it is nicer there and has almost no people 💗

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Beautiful place, they charge you 5euros to park, there are several businesses in the area and the beach is amazing!! Don't miss it at any time of year

reviews.title: Parking scam!
reviews.text: Do not park in the closest lot. They will tell you that everything else is full and it’s 5 euro. Everything else is either free or cheaper. Don’t fall for the scam.

reviews.title: Very disappointing. There are other beaches as beautiful and quieter
reviews.text: If there was a lot of pink sand, there are just a few grains left!The wind whips the sand in mid-October, there are people but very few brave swimmers.Going further allows you to discover other pretty beaches less crowded

reviews.title: Get a tour to see this gem
reviews.text: We got a tour ,no hassel with parking. The most stunning beach and crystal clear water. We enjoyed the beach although it was quite windy! A tiny bit pink!

reviews.title: Welcome to Disneyland Cretans 🤦‍♂️
reviews.text: How can there be more than 13,000 positive reviews for 800 negatives...such a gap is incredible and really suggests that people are revelling in crowding and scamming. Everything is said in the reviews one or two stars. Scam at from the parking lot , Scam on the "paradise" side of the site (pink sand)....1h30 from Chania, you might as well stay on beaches nearby. Crete becomes, even out of season now, a tourist factory. But hey..., the majority of tourists have to delight in such experiences given the vast majority of reviews. So keep playing sheep to pile you up in Elafonssini, I'll go somewhere else. Cretans, wake up!

reviews.title: Alm Beach
reviews.text: A pretty ordinary beach not worth a visit all too many tourists prices are screwed up and it costs 1 euro to get to the toilet find you another lovely beach to spend your holiday on

reviews.title: Never again! A mass event with a nasty rip-off while parking
reviews.text: I was disappointed and angry! It started with the fact that right at the beginning of the place we were pushed by official-looking folders with high-visibility vests into a parking lot that was huge and should cost 5 euros. Already on this place we had to walk very far to the exit. Then we passed several parking lots that were closer to the beach and cost only 3 euros. Quite a rip-off! However, we felt that the folders were officially from the community. It's a huge outrage how this single car park operator swindles his money! Then you first walk past the other cheaper parking lots and then you walk with an army with other visitors about 20 minutes in the scorching heat down a gravel road to the water. I had the impression that it was going to a Mega Pop event or a football game. From above you could see all the many people on the beach and in the water, not much of the landscape remained. For us it was not worth it after the exhausting arrival and departure in the rental car. Almost 5 hours driving time and then to be in such a mass event! Terrible!!!!! Oh yes, toilet 1 euro! There are countless other beautiful and idyllic beaches on Crete!

reviews.title: Pretty Good & Chill
reviews.text: Overall Elafonisi is a really nice beach… Nice sand, shallow and super accessible especially for kids, nice mini hike to the beach…However I will say that there aren’t many services there. There is a quaint little bar on the beach front with a few drinks and ice cream and W/Cs that you have to pay a Euro to use but other than that there isn’t much.It is a really nice place though. Like I said, it’s a chill low effort beach to relax on but due to the lack of services isn’t very long.There is a mini market, restaurant and more up the dirt road away from the beach towards the car park but it is quite a trek from A to B. We also got really confused as there is a parking lot for €5 next to a more obscure parking lot for €3 and got a bit confused as to where to go and whether we were getting scammed or not.Still recommend it but wouldn’t say to put too high expectations on it because it’s quite a travel from major spots on the island like Chania or Heraklion (also is just a bit ummm… odd)Nice place, just not much there!

reviews.title: Don't go to Elafonissi if you would like to have good day!!
reviews.text: Parking lots were full, beach full of people, sun bed receipt checks in every hour, no toilets etc.... we left this place after two hours and next beach Falassarna was 5/5!!

reviews.title: Beach like so many
reviews.text: Not worth a longer drive.There is nothing special about this beach compared to so many other beaches.Typical tourist trap.

reviews.title: Parking lot rip-off but picturesque beach
reviews.text: The one about the parking lot folders that make the impression of official people is probably a permanent problem. We got caught too and we were waved out on the first dirt track (the guy was standing in the middle of the road) and maneuvered into the last corner. I was really annoyed by this! With the 5€ parking fee we not only had the most expensive parking, but also the longest walk to the beach. As we drove away again we saw that many cars parked right on the main road for free.The stand itself is already picturesque and was not as crowded in October as already reported. We also had the impression that everyone was following the rules.

reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: No pink beach showing even in the sunshine, you are then told you have to be on the island to see the pink beach but the island is almost an 45 minute walk...we travelled 4 hours to see this beach. Parking is a total rip off, you are guided into what you think is a genuine car parking space only to find they lock the car park once full and then charge €5 to get out of the car park even though you are only there an hour, it's not even worth a coach trip unless you are guaranteed you can be there if the tide is out on the island and the sun is shining in the right direction....this is an honest review as we hired a car for a week to drive 400 miles one way to visit this beach , we parked up and left 40 minutes later as no pink beach was on show!!!

reviews.title: Not so pink anymore.
reviews.text: Nice place to sunbathe and swim.  Very crowded on the site and annoying vsg there. Not much pink sand left. All the pictures you see are bad. I'm sorry.

reviews.title: Pink sand
reviews.text: I love this place , although I find access to paid parking unacceptable before we could park for free near the beach . On the other hand I wanted to point out that I saw a group filling bags with pink sands and leaving quietly with about twenty kilos it is scandalous if it continues like this in a few years there will be no pink sands I told a Greek who told me that nobody cares , and that there was a cave where everyone broke stalactites, result closed cave.

reviews.title: No pink sand what so ever.
reviews.text: Absolutely no pink sand in sight! A Nice sallow sandy beach but not worth a 2 hour drive each way and I wish I hadn’t wasted a day on this

reviews.title: Nice Beach- long Access
reviews.text: The beach, the sand and the water are perfect. They have chairs for rent but when we arrive they were all busy. The worth thing is the access to the beach is to long walk Take in mind the sand is only pink in some small partes

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The beach is so beautiful and well maintained. We enjoyed the sun and clear water but it does get crowded in the afternoon when its streaming with visitors. Otherwise, it is a stunning place to visit in Crete and unwind for a couple of hours.

reviews.title: Elafonisi beach is gorgeous!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach, everyone visits and it gets crowded, go early  to get a spot. I recommend walking past where all the beach chairs are set up and you can experience a more serene version of the beach.

reviews.title: ok
reviews.text: great beach, not my favourite cheap beds make sure you park as close to the shops cafe as you can it's a long walk otherwise drive to the end

reviews.title: Cute beach but gets busy...
reviews.text: We got there before 10 and it wasn't overly busy yet!! .. Yes we paid 5 euro to park but we were the first car park close to the entrance so I don't mind.Also used the little food vending shop for a coffee and the toilet both were perfect.. The beach itself had tints of pink but that is it.. Loved padding in the crystal clear water and walking over to the other island.. Ice cold beer on the beach went down a treat (5 euro) BUT it does get busy, people just pop there towel down anywhere so close to one another. Walking around can become a little challenging when it's busy as no-one wants to step on anyone.. We left before 1 and was pleased we did.. it does become super busy.. People  just keep coming and coming  lol!! Do get there early to enjoy it!! Glad I went but there won't be a re-visit!!

reviews.title: Parkingmaffia Elafonisi
reviews.text: When you go to elafonisi DO NOT use first parking . Do not sort to the right. Just ride further to parking 2 3 4 or 5They are all 3 euro a day .Parkingplace 1 is 5 euro ( even for 1 hour)If you sort right the force you in their parking

reviews.title: Defintely a tourist trap - Avoid!
reviews.text: I was looking forward to enjoying my time at Elafonissi Beach and was highly disappointed.I knew it could be busy. So, I visited it in October and arrived after 4.00pm on a cloudy day.First, it is quite isolated. So, wherever you are based in Crete, it will take at least 1.5 hour to drive there, on winding roads.When I arrived, I was invited to park on designated parking places. Mine was 15 min away from the beach. 5 euros.Then I went to the beach; it was Disneyland! Myriads (literally hundreds of people) coming back from the beach in the other direction. Souvenir shops, supermarkets, etc.The beach: a little bit of pink sand and some turquoise (and quite warm, even in October) water. I collected some business cards left on the sand to make sure they do not go to the sea. A pair of briefs laying on the pathway. If you need to go to the toilets, it is one Euro.There are many other beaches in Crete that are more beautiful and relaxing. This one is far too much overrated but it seems to be a big local business.

reviews.title: A real disappointment!!
reviews.text: Not worth it, when you arrive you will be sent to a parking lot. Which you have to pay 5 euros for afterwards. Then you have to walk very far to the beach where a lot of people walk. There's nothing to see. I don't know if they say it's one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete. Have seen much nicer beaches

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in Crete
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach Pure Turquoise WaterThis beach is known for its pink sand, but in fact the sand is not as pink as the images on the Internet.  Also pink color of sand depends on weather and lighting But the water is really chic, big, shallow lagoons, perfect for kids. The beach is crowded, come early Then you can guarantee a parking spot, and pick a nice spot on the beach. From the parking lot to the beach walk +/- 700mThere are sun loungers and cafes where you can eat One minus, it was very windy.

reviews.title: Victim of its success
reviews.text: An enchanting place certainly, pink sand also... But far too many people and between paid parking lots, tour buses, souvenir shops: it spoils a little fun Fortunately I went there on my own taking the time to go along the coast from kissamos The ride is part of the adventure

reviews.title: Very comfortable
reviews.text: Today we get to see the Beach Bar Service and all very well the treatment of the gentleman very attentive I want to congratulate you. Thank you very much for your treatment for us

reviews.title: The paradise of Crete
reviews.text: The photos do not make the colors of this magnificent beach. Sand of the shoreline of a beautiful pink color. The absence of hotel facilities make it uncontaminated. A trip to this beautiful beach should not be missed by those who go to Crete.

reviews.title: Somewhat overrated.
reviews.text: The water colour is beautiful but the pink sand is hard to find. Beware of the parking sharks who do not display their fee when you approach the beach. You are also parked quite a distance from the beach. Coming from Australia, this beach would be middle rank. Not worth the long drive.

reviews.title: Unfortunately to avoid
reviews.text: It is of course a very nice beach and the water is turquoise. But there are so many people that you can't see the pink sand. It has become an extreme commercial machine and the ridge has even more beautiful places. Do not take the first parking lot. It requires you to go home but they are more expensive and further away. It is a mafia behavior but accepted here in elafonissi.

reviews.title: Parking
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, but busy.Please note that upon arrival they will try to send you into a parking lot. Don't do this!!Plenty of parking space down the road and a lot cheaper

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: There is very little pink left, the photos on the net are retouched, clean water and nice beach but in my opinion the lagoon of Balos is much more beautiful especially if you come from above going down the mountain

reviews.title: Probably the most photoshopped beach in the world!
reviews.text: I’m not really a beach person as I’m not a sunbather and I tend to get bored quite easily, but having said that Elafonissi Beach is a stunning beach - even with 3 million people strewn across it! Okay, this might be a slight exaggeration, but prepare yourself for a LOT of people vying for a spot to cremate themselves.Most people tend to congregate around the area where the beds and umbrellas are rented out, but if you wander away from the masses you’ll be rewarded with tranquility and beautiful views. The beach isn’t really a swathe of pinkness either - it’s more a teasing glimpse of pink sand here and there along the coastline. I think it’s a fair assumption to say that quite a few pics are photoshopped or enhanced with filters. It’s still worth visiting, but rein in your expectations!

reviews.title: Elafonisi
reviews.text: The first part of my life that, although I made a way to get there for an hour and a half, after five minutes I picked up my things and left Unfortunately it was not worth my expectations

reviews.title: Pretty but don’t need to come back
reviews.text: We were blown away by the number of people at the beach. Coach loads started arriving at breakfast time and it was crowded. It is (was once) a beautiful beach but as always, humans have spoilt it. There is pink sand visible but it depends on the weather and amount of sunshine. We won’t bother coming back.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but if you’re going for the pink sand, you will be greatly disappointed. There’s a little here and there but not much left from people taking it.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Very overrated in my opinion, in Sardinia there is definitely better! Pink was nowhere near present in the meantime. Bottoms really too shallow you have to go a long way in the water to have water waist height. Valet parking that force you to stop at the first parking lot that costs 5 euros (the most expensive) and you have to do a lot of walking! It's all right that you have to live but this is really thieves! Anyway nice water!

reviews.title: Scammers aloud to operate in the National Park!!!
reviews.text: Was scammed at the 1st Parking as they blocked the road and made as think that the parking near to the beach is closed, had to pay to wash my car after wards! Disgusting corrupt people!

reviews.title: Doesn't have to be
reviews.text: The not so good reviews can be easily understood, totally crowded, extremely windy, 20 euros for beach chairs and umbrella, shower is in the last corner and the toilet costs. The first dusty parking lot charges 5 euros, further down it costs only 3 euros. We didn't discover pink either. You can safely save yourself.

reviews.title: Nice beach- be obs on parking.
reviews.text: Lovely beach - although you have to look for the pink sand. There is shallow and beautiful crystal clear water. You have to walk a bit to get down there - and parking costs - between 3€ and 5€. We were guided by a man in a reflex vest, who very urgently got us into their p-place. It turned out that there were other P places cheaper and closer. It cost money to drive out again from this p-place immediately. Note this.

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach - 2 hour drive from Chania. Crystal clear water and the best part was the water stays at waist height for as far as you can walk! It’s about a 15 min walk from the parking lot. Recommend getting there early to avoid the crowds!Must do if on the western side of Crete!

reviews.title: Nice without more
reviews.text: Don't stop at the first parking lot!The guy stands in the middle of the road, arms crossed and signals you to enter the parking lot, as if we had to... 5 euros for this one while the ones after are 3 euros! It's not okay to do that kind of thing.For the beach, it is nice, the sand is beautiful but not pink as in the photos that can be seen on the internet and to reach it, it takes about 10 minutes to walk.It's not a must-see in my opinion!

reviews.title: Long way to a crowded place
reviews.text: We decided for us, it was not worth it. Unless you want to see hundreds of half-naked people. The pink of the beach is hardly to be seen, the whole area is very touristy, although you are told that you are entering an environmentally sensitive area. There is lots of waste everywhere in the bushes, tourists get driven there in coaches. As for most places in Crete the best times are before 10 and after 16 hours. There is no shade along the beach, so people bring umbrellas. Sunbeds were 20 Euros. The drive to Elafonisi over the side roads however is beautiful. The honey and oil they sell on the road are too expensive. Better buy in the villages. If you want to eat good Greek food, stop in Topolia, after you have driven through the old tunnel.

reviews.title: ATTENTION TO CHEATING PARKING
reviews.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach we have seen in Crete, but much traveled by tourists, so I write some tips based on our experience: PARKING Absolutely avoid the trap of the first parking lot, where an intruder tries to force you to enter his parking lot with aggressive attitude, parking that costs 5 €. Don't care, even if this guy's in the middle of the road, and keep going down the road, which is downhill. There are other parking lots for 3€ more convenient to the beach. The point beyond which you can not go is well signposted, get there, there is all the place to turn around and go back choosing comfortably which parking to choose. The one we chose also had bathrooms, better to take advantage, there is not much on the beach (stinky and for a fee). CROWDING: obviously there are a lot of people, so the sooner you get there, the better you place. We arrived at 10, and the umbrellas were already finished. It must be said cmq that the beach is very long and articulated, so a quiet place is always found, perhaps at the ends. SHADOW buy a parasol at the supermarket (they also sell them in convenience stores near parking lots), there is plenty of place to plant them. If you don't even have that, on the left of the beach, coming, there are trees, some unfenced. Or on the islet on the right, within walking distance (the water is shallow) there are rocks where you can hang towels for shade. VIVERI: I had brought everything from home. There's a bar on the beach, but I don't know what it's like. At the beginning of the walking route there are convenience stores. ON FOOT, once parked, you have to make a 10-minute walk of downhill dirt road, a path suitable for everyone. But for disabled people or those with problems, I saw a van with the wheelchair symbol. SHOWER: I saw only one, near the bathrooms, uninviting. I put two big bottles of water in the car, and I rinsed myself with them. ENJOY THIS BEAUTIFUL BEACH!!!

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Beautiful!! 🤩 Lots of coves, pink sand. Has everything, toilets, showers and a great shop/cafe. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.title: Superb natural beach
reviews.text: A place not to be missed. The road from Chania will offer you beautiful shots in the mountains. The beach is one of the most beautiful and clean. Upon arrival, you will find that there is no longer free parking. The closest to the trail costs $5. You are a 10-minute walk away. There are plenty of people, but enough space to find a place of your own. Pink is a little overrated. There is a dewy glow on the edge of the beach, but nothing like the photos that are circulating.

reviews.title: Between ELAFONISSI & Kedrodassos: que du Bonheur!! <3
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach... To do! Even if it's crowded, it's no problem! Take the tenacious one! Take the European trail on your left... sneak to Kedrodassos... you will have beautiful nuggets... almost deserted that same beginning of September!:)

reviews.title: Well, it goes like this
reviews.text: I have to say it's not worth it until 5 pm .... pink hardly visible probably only around 5.30 , it was very windy, like almost daily and the sand whips you around the ears . Water was very good ,from the parking about 10 min to the beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but go over to the island, THERE lies the pearl.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, but the sun bed was busy long before you reached the beach.But the real pearl was if you just went over to the other side of the bay and to the island. Then walk the little path to the other side. There was deep and beautiful where you could swim right in crystal clear water.The beach by the sunbeds was all right, the sandy beach in the middle was nice, but the beauty was hidden on the other side of the sandy beach. Just a few hundred yards from where everyone else was sitting.

reviews.title: Terrible.
reviews.text: It was the horror mass bus tourists - from the far away parking lot an endless crowd of people goes to the hopelessly crowded beach - an immediate escape proves to be almost hopeless due to the oncoming traffic on the rocky and dusty goat paths- despite immediate return to the car 5€ parking fee - even for the toilet has to be paid 1€ per toilet. Terrible how this former gem has degenerated.

reviews.title: Get there at 8am for a couple of hours bliss
reviews.text: Get there at 8am is my advice and enjoy the calmness of the beach and clear water , this means you will also get a sunbed ( 2 for €20) , bear round to the right and go on the little section by itself . I say get there at 8am as from 10 am is starts to fill up and at 11am the coaches descend and then it is no longer nice , you won't get a sunbed by then and there is no shade otherwise. Everyone trying to get photos of the tiny bit of pinkish sand on striking the poses required for Instagram! I'm glad I have been but there are much better places , not crowded .Park at the Mega Car Park , it is the nearest one . There is food and drink that is reasonable

reviews.title: You don't have to do that to yourself. Not worth seeing
reviews.text: You don't have to do that to yourself. You have an arduous long journey and then you see a beach that has nothing worth seeing.You can really save that.

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, or beaches.Very shallow. Clear water.Unfortunately, a little too many tourists, though all could fit, both in the water and on the beach.But .... saw no pink sand .... Not at all. False advertising!The road there was exciting, sometimes a little too exciting. Narrow, curvy and incredibly beautiful views.Also long walk down to the beach.Nothing too limp and limp!

reviews.title: Nice to see sometime. Come on time!!!
reviews.text: Be on time because very touristy and later in the morning it flows full and very busy. Prices for sunbeds very expensive. Nice to take nice pictures but no more than that. Most beautiful beach of 2025 I absolutely disagree.

reviews.title: Nice but...
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful less pink than the various influencers show but whatever, the only flaw is the parking. Just arrived there is a valet who arms in the middle of the road stating that ahead everything is full and the road is closed, a scam nice and good! Up ahead there are at least three other parking lots with lower prices. It is not because of the price difference but on principle!

reviews.title: A most beautiful and stunning must see beach, but go early and ignore the parking attendant you meet first !
reviews.text: I gave this 5/5 purely for the beach and our experience, there were downsides but this grading is for the beach, the view and the gorgeous water. The beach is beyond stunning with the most lovely warm aqua water, and a beautiful back drop. When we were there we didn’t see any boats arrive to spoil the water or view. The downside is the parking as people have mentioned in previous reviews as you are forced to park at the car park furthest away, only to find as you walk down there are closer ones. If going here and you have infirm or lots of really young children, ignore those in the road guiding you to the first car park and drive on (you can always come back if full) There is a bit of a walk, downhill, but the view and beach are worth it. We went in August and the beaches were very very busy. We went to the far side and enjoyed silence and beautiful water all day. I am glad we went as Elefonisi along with Balos was part of the reason we chose this part of Crete. If we were to go again, and we would go again,  we would arrive earlier, aim for a closer car park and go to the far side again. I think it’s a must see if you are this side of the island :-)

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Much to overflow! Two sunbeds cost 25€ and the umbrella an additional 5€. In addition, there are too many people to receive loungers at all.  After an eternally long serpentine ride, this beach is not recommended. The sand and water are beautiful but still there are so many beautiful and not so crowded beaches all over Crete!

reviews.title: Beautiful but meh…
reviews.text: Depends from where you’re coming. We came a really long way to see this beach and balos and even if it’s beautiful , it’s not worth the hourssss of driving. Pakistani scammers, 1€ to use the toilet?! You should encourage people to use it not charge for everything. The road to get there is a bit dangerous as well . Idk. Also very few sunbeds, it was windy so it was imposibile to put an umbrela up and sun is melting you

reviews.title: Beware of the first parking lot Pakistani scammers
reviews.text: Great beach, just don't park in the first parking. They will tell you the others are full but it's just a scam to charge you more and trick you

reviews.title: Expectations exceed reality
reviews.text: Surely the beach has some points where the sand takes a pink color but in others not, shallow water you walk everywhere except in some places at the bottom but unfortunately being full of people is unmanageable, despite it being September. We were also left without umbrellas because they were all full, all after paying € 5 parking at the entrance (you have to look good and not stop at the first parking lot because there were others who took € 3 for the whole day). Unfortunately like everything when it gets too sponsored you end up being disappointed by expectations. I wouldn't go back.

reviews.title: Attention to valet parking
reviews.text: Arrived at the parking lots do not stop at the first, forcibly avoid the valets who try to stop you and continue, you will save yourself a nice stretch of road on foot.The beach is very nice but I recommend you go early in the morning so as to avoid the crowd.

reviews.title: Beautiful and... Impossible
reviews.text: Beautiful water, beach as well but too crowded and expensive. My advice is to pop in, two photos and look for a beach among the many beautiful of the island

reviews.title: Fairy place!!!
reviews.text: It's one of those places you don't think exists. Magical landscape, crystal clear waters, incredible experience that is worth all to experience. The only thing I didn't like was the behavior of people in the parking lot. You're incredibly rude and act like crazy for the money. I also came across a scene where a stranger was almost beaten up. A little embarrassing...

reviews.title: Beautiful but…
reviews.text: We drove the 90 minutes from Chania and actually thought the twisty road through the mountains was very thrilling. Yes the beach is amazing…and thought there were 5 individual ones to enjoy. However we likely would not return given the drive and lack of umbrellas and loungers.Is it Number One in the World? No.  But yes worth seeing at least once.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but very busy
reviews.text: This beach is amazing & we ended up going 2x in our 10 day holiday. We hired a car there as it was only 1hr away from our hotel. As you arrive to the beach there are scammers that stand in the road saying that the main car park is closed when it’s not just drive round them or say your going to the shop down the road & you can get through so you can park closer to the beach (€5) for the whole day cash or card. There are 2 shops & a cafe before you start the walk down to the beach which takes about 15 mins. There are also 2 beach bars offering hot snacks, drinks etc on the beach. The first part of the beach is really really busy but if you cross the water & carry on walking it’s really quiet & your almost on your own also the snorkling is absolutely amazing in this area. As for the pink sand… you can definitely see it’s pink in the main area but there isn’t as much of it as you see in the pics on Google but again once you walk further it does get a bit pinker. Would definitely recommend a trip here as it’s absolutely beautiful but go early to beat the rush. We got there for 9.30am the second time we went & it was already starting to get a bit busy but as I said is you walk an extra 15 mins there are hardly any people.

reviews.title: Stunning Elafonisi 😎😘
reviews.text: Well worth the two hour drive through the mountains (which is an event on its own!) A stunningly beautiful place, take time to wade over the lagoon and explore the left hand side of the peninsula and it's pink sandy and rocky areas. It's so lovely here 😎

reviews.title: Spectacular beach
reviews.text: We were there on a bus excursion, 2 hours of travel, but once we arrived, we were enchanted by so much beauty. Immense beach of white sand and in some stretches with pink shades, the sea looks like a pool, definitely one of the most beautiful we have seen. In the first stretch there are a series of umbrellas and deckchairs with 2 kiosks, but personally too exploited and crowded, a shame in such a natural paradise.  Crossing a small and shallow (about 50 cm maximum) stretch of sea you reach an islet where a long stretch of beach begins, less frequented, without services, with a succession of spectacular coves with incredible colors of the sea and beach.

reviews.title: Advertised but no longer worth so much
reviews.text: It has become completely commercial and due to the exploitation and crowd it has unfortunately lost the glamour that it had a few years ago.. a lot of walking for nothing.. tip: don't get into the 1st parking lot that is more expensive, it has more down and cheaper and closer.

reviews.title: Wicked Wicked Wicked
reviews.text: I'm so sorry about this place that's so beautiful and you can't have access if you don't pay the parking bastards who block you from everywhere. So many people I'd never do it again.

reviews.title: Beach visit Elafonissi
reviews.text: Were back in Elafonissi after over 15 years and are totally disappointed as it is completely overrun. You used to be able to drive to the beach by car, now you have to go down in the heat for 15 minutes and pay for the parking. Also the prices for the loungers are already very considerable and must be reserved in advance, otherwise you will not get one. Shade places are almost nonexistent.Beach is nice, but to avoid in the mass tourism (peak season).

reviews.title: Overflowing and overrated – once is enough
reviews.text: As with many hyped social media places, this beach turned out to be a typical tourist trap. As soon as you arrive, it begins with the well-known parking history. Tip: Just drive past the first parking angles – there are still plenty of parking spaces closer to the beach further ahead. One of them costs only 3 euros, then you reach the beach with a short walk.On the beach itself, there is crowding. I explained it to my partner as a Swiss: “It’s like the Street Parade in Zurich.” Those who expect beach romance, tranquillity, security for their valuables or sufficient shade will be disappointed. Although there are chairs and umbrellas, they are paid and too few anyway – almost like on Rimini beach.The only really worth seeing is the sandy tongue, on which you can walk far out into the sea. Everything else is more like an illusion. For example, the color pink. The only pink I saw in the sand were the thousands and thousands of tourist feet. Stop your stupid filters.We accepted four hours of driving and four hours of walking back for this trip – a second time we would certainly not do that. There are plenty of beaches, not only in Crete.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text: It is truly majestic, but impossible to see its beauty. Around 10 o'clock in the morning already filled with sunbathers like herrings. I couldn't even take a photo. An other not nice thing is people in high vis vest try to stop you at the first car park by standing in your way and saying road ahead is closed. Go around them, they are lying to make you pay for them. That is the worst car park, off-road and far from everything. There are huge places closer to the shops and beach, with asphalt and some are even cheaper.

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches / pools in the world, we were astonished, offers equipped beaches and two kiosks for the supply of sandwiches

reviews.title: Nice beach, disappointing parking experience
reviews.text: The beach is gorgeous like others say, don’t expect the Instagram pink but the water is as blue as it looks in pictures. We arrived at 10:30 and the beach was so full of people it was hard to find a place to put our towel down. There is also no shade anywhere! When you enter the beach area there is a car park on the right and has an attendant that tells you to go in and when you say you want to keep going he shows a sign that the road is closed. This is a scam as there are 3 more car parks with lots of spaces after and they cost less. Drive by the first attendant if you want to save a bit and park closer. The attendant was also very rude to us when we pointed out that there are cheaper car parks closer to the beach as we had read previous reviews, he started shouting at us. There are plenty of shops for food, drinks, souvenirs, also toilets that cost €1 everywhere and changing cabins. The water is shallow so perfect for kids too. Overall really enjoyed it but the parking situation was a bit of a let down.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, it is sure that the place is paradisiacal, crystal clear and warm waters but unfortunately too many people who spoil the decor a little. A quota wouldn't be too bad. Watch out for parking, we are forced to stop as far away as is most expensive! Say no to people in the parking lot and go closer to pay less and walk less

reviews.title: Disappointment with local beach management behaviour
reviews.text: The beach is undoubtedly beautiful! Too bad every year is worse as no one enforces or controls compliance with the rules especially the protection of the beach park. Yes, compared to the past they have fenced with stakes and ropes the unique natural areas. Unfortunately, the uncivilized people on the rise come in and lay their towels eating and bivouacing inside these nature reserves and nobody says anything. Then another sore note often in some bars and rentals sunbeds "does not go credit card" and arrive tour operators with cash in hand to take and rissrvare dozens of beds for the arrival later 'of their guests by bus. That's not cool. If that's playing by the rules? One gets the impression that they don t want tourists only to live off rent tourism for the whole year! Too bad that another top natural location is endangered by human cause! Emblematic is the writing that no one in over 10 years has ever eliminated that appears in the shower area 🤔 Elafonisi gone

reviews.title: Don’t bother
reviews.text: We left Agia port with KYRIAKAKIS travel at 8.45am. After a horrendous drive over narrow mountain roads, with enormous drops and no barriers, we eventually arrived at Elanfonissi beach at 12.15pm. To then have a 30 min walk down a stone hill in the hot sun, to find not one bit of shade or a bed, which if you could get one was €30 to Inc umbrella and 2 beds, and a couple of small snack bars. You could hardly walk for bodies everywhere. We eventually found shade behind the wooden toilets. We were promised 4hours on the beach but were only given 2hours 15min Before the long haul back up hill to the coach. Then a compulsory 1hour stop at an isolated restaurant for lunch at 4.30 pm. Which is not included in the price. Eventually getting home to Agia marina at 6.30pm. Although the beach is beautiful if it was not covered with bodies. Genuinely not worth it.

reviews.title: Be careful with first parking lot. They fool you.
reviews.text: Be careful with the first parking lot that you find when you arrive. They fool you saying that you cannot continue and oblige you to enter their parking. It is 5€ instead of 3€ in the next ones. It is not that it is more expensive, it is the fact that it is a tourist trap. And nobody likes to feel fooled.

reviews.title: Beware of Fake Parking Guides – Beautiful Beach Worth Visiting
reviews.text: Be careful with the parking situation near this beach. A group of people tries to mislead tourists by standing in the middle of the road and insisting that you must park in the first parking lot they point to. You do not have to. If you drive just a little further, there is another official parking area for only €3, and even more parking options closer to the beach. Don’t let yourself be pressured — you have better and cheaper choices.That said, the beach itself is absolutely beautiful, wide enough for everyone to enjoy without feeling crowded. Please respect the nature around you — don’t damage the dunes and help keep this place as stunning as it is.

reviews.title: Disappointing and nothing special
reviews.text: The sand was not pink! There was fish everywhere, and despite the sand not being pink the overall beach was disappointing and nothing special. I wouldn’t waste my time here. Overcrowded and there is MUCH nicer beaches around Crete that aren’t packed. Water was quite clear though

reviews.title: Comfortable and fantastic
reviews.text: We stayed there 2 times in a week as the best for families for ease of approach (10 minutes walk), fine sand and shallow, crystal clear water. We stayed in the tongue of sand accessible across the sea and on both days there was no crowding. The only problem was the wind (if you have umbrellas bring anchors). Parking closest to the sea very large at € 5 (do not stop at the first even if they tell you that the next ones are full). Also recommended for snorkeling

reviews.title: No Pink Sand to be seen .
reviews.text: Booking through Travel company who we came with was 60 euros each , we booked in the resort for 25 euros each , it’s called Pink Beach for its sand colour but there was no Pink Sand there at all very misleading when you have to travel 3 hours to get there , the beach was absolutely packed people practically sitting inches from you . Very disappointing going by the photos they use to advertise the Pink Sand Beach .

reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text: First you are forced to take the first parking space, which is of course the most expensive and farthest from the beach, although you want to drive further as there are cheaper and sufficient parking spaces closer to the beach. Then already visible at the parking lot, tourist stronghold. We at the Love Parade.The stand totally overflowed. The stand itself is beautiful. But it is not fun and in my opinion is not worth seeing. Better hit another beach.

reviews.title: Once and never again.
reviews.text: Completely overrated, no pink beach/shore area found.Were there at about 08.30, in front of the tourist streams.From the parking lot still about 500m to walk / crawl, not for the elderly or disabled. Expensive beds close to close,0 privacy. Not recommended, once u.never again, are gone after 30 min.Not worth it at all ,there are much nicer beaches.

reviews.title: The most beautiful sea in Crete
reviews.text: Spectacular sea!!! , crowded beach. Paid parking lots, but don't stop at the first one you find coming (they get smart)

reviews.title: Disappointment in Elafonissi!!!!
reviews.text: The road to the beach is long, very mountainous and full of turns. We arrived at 10am and the beach was already crowded. It is impossible to find deckchairs, all occupied in the morning, so obligation to land directly on the sand. This wouldn’t be a problem in itself, but as it is a lagoon, the sand is constantly wet: our towels were soaked in a few minutes.The beach is beautiful, but overcrowding totally ruins the experience. We lasted barely two hours before leaving so crowded.In my opinion, this beach is not worth a visit. I recommend the Balos lagoon, much more beautiful and pleasant.

reviews.title: Not worth it….
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful beach - no doubt - big lagoons, crystal clear water, soft sand. But it’s not pink, there are no real amenities (limited chairs/umbrellas, one panini snack shop), a 20-30 min walk from the parking to the beach and a ZILLION people. Plus it was a pain to get there. Hard pass. There are plenty of of gorgeous beaches in Crete without all of the people, amenities etc. if you are going to go bring everything in with you - towels, chairs, drinks, food, umbrella and go early or late as it’s hard to find a spot.

reviews.title: One of the few beaches to remember in Crete
