In this regard, a dispassionate tip: it is not advisable to go to the establishment because the sunbeds are very very close and especially because those who arrived later calmly stood in front with towels and umbrellas without anyone saying anything. In fact, the same staff of the plant placed umbrella and sunbed in front of the "fixed" ones. In Italy this as well as being forbidden would have resulted in a mega collective brawl.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: I was very disappointed to see this place that I discovered 12 years ago. It has become very touristy with a very large number of visitors, a multitude of deckchairs, umbrellas and glitter. In addition, you are directed to a car park that turns out to be paid for when you leave. In addition it is the furthest parking at 5 euros while there are 2 closer to the beach at 3 euros. It also takes a lot of mar her to reach the beach. When I discovered this place there was a wild side and an irresistible desire to launch it. Actually agreed very very touristy and that is a shame. Good luck to those who would like to venture there.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: It's worth it, the water looked like the Caribbean. The wind is a bit strong but I recommend going at least once if you go to Crete. The wonderful water.

reviews.title: Beautiful as Balos but simpler
reviews.text: Al.contrario.di Balos, to the.beach of Elafunissi you can easily get there by car. Do not stop the first parking at € 5 but get to the bottom, parking very close to € 3. Beautiful beach, umbrella and 2 sunbeds, if available, at 20 € and cloister on the beach with sandwiches and more to eat cheap. Beach and sea top

reviews.title: Too bad.
reviews.text: From a naturalistic point of view it is definitely a wonder, dream water (in the morning at least). Too bad about everything else. Mass tourism, crowded people and rudeness, as witnessed by butts and plastic in the sand. That's a shame.

reviews.title: Had hoped to see it as you see in the pictures on the net
reviews.text: We were there on 3/7-25 and there was almost nothing pink. Asked a guide the next day, after which he replied that the best time was in August, that I would have shown. The water is piv cold

reviews.title: To avoid
reviews.text: Back to Elafonissi 30 years later... the appalling damage of mass tourism: crowds piled up like sardines on the beach, cordons that do not prevent going where you want, scams of all kinds... How can one give positive notes to such a horror??... if despite this you absolutely want to go, beware of the first parking lot. They will try to get you into their car park for 5 euros, while 200 m later, closer to the beach, there is one as large for 3 euros...

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning, a  must see place!!  When drive up, ignore the 1st car parks as they are a long walk away and is cheaper ones further down!.  Before setting off on the long walk down, get plenty of drinks qnd go the loo!  It's quite a walk in the heat!! But once you get down, makes it totally worth it    simply stunning !!!

reviews.title: Beautiful and impossible
reviews.text: The beach and the sea are dreamy. The occupation of the beach for the amount of people present by nightmare. It certainly has its charm, but really too many people and thank goodness it was June....

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: I returned to Elafonissi three years after the previous visit, and I was a little disappointed. The sea is always beautiful, turquoise in color, but there is little pink sand left of three years ago; there are far fewer umbrellas, and they fill up very early, at 9 am there are already very few free. Now it is not possible to get to the bottom with the car, you have to park 500 meters away, at a cost of € 5; there are several showers (free) and bathrooms for € 1.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach large enough, the water is shallow so warm, the sand is not as pink as in the photos, there is no shade and often wind. Be careful not to stop at the 1st parking even if you are made to believe that you can not go further it is false it is just the most expensive parking.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviews.text: Impressively beautiful beach, perhaps one of the most beautiful I have ever been to. Parking 5€. Umbrella and 2 sunbeds 20€ . Services at nearby kiosks.

reviews.title: Nice beach, but not at all drive the trip from Chania worth. .
reviews.text: When you get to the first parking lot, there is someone who says the road is closed and shows everyone to a parking lot far away from the beach. Just drive by, it is FUSK and that costs twice as much as those that are further down to the beach.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Europe
reviews.text: This beach is magnificent and very large but around 1pm it gets crowded, the crystal clear water makes the beach unmissable but the water is too shallow to stay there all day. This beach is recommended for people who want to tan

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Spectacular beach. We came at 9 am and there is gone we went for 13 to the beach next door (not equipped but beautiful). After 1 pm it gets crowded and so if you just can't go in the morning I suggest you go to the part behind the lagoon of the beach that is much less crowded.If you arrive in the morning you can also take the sunbeds. From the beach car park there is a 5-10 minute walk to the beach, but it is really worth it. If you do like us that you leave at 1pm I recommend you eat at the "Kalomirakis Tavern" very fast to serve.

reviews.title: Parking on arrival fraudulent
reviews.text: We arrived to discover the pink beach which is beautiful but we were stopped by the thief who holds the parking at 5 € per day he told us to stop in order to park here in the end of the free places a little further away it is a shame it is more expensive than a parking in Paris and when you want to negotiate because you saw different prices a parking at 5 € another at 3 € and another further away free this insults you in Greek , the same for the toilets pay 1 € while a little further to the supermarket which are free

reviews.title: Overrated beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach but in my opinion it is overrated. Visit subsequently the beach of Falassarna remained more impressed. Here many people and very few umbrellas but also little beach given the amount of visitors.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: The sand was barely pink, but the water was clear and shallow. It's a popular beach, but you can find a secluded spot if you just walk farther. You can even hike to a cave and a church, but be sure to wear shoes.

reviews.title: Elafonissi parking scam
reviews.text: It was fun. Really cool and beautiful. Obviously a very busy place but to be expected. Arrive early if you want chairs but otherwise the beach is soooo big that there's plenty of room to just set up a towel and lay there.BUT. Please dont be fooled by the first parking. They will tell you that you cant park further but you can for cheaper and one for the same price which is also 5 euros.Tourism scam on that first parking for sure. I was very upset with them and yelled at them. Please spread the word and dont support them! Then owner was rude about it!

reviews.title: For those seeking Rimini in Crete
reviews.text: Nice to see, take a picture and run away as fast as you can.It seems to be in Rimini in mid-August (and this in June), people crowding and screaming and this already in the early morning before the masses descend from the ships.There are definitely more beautiful beaches to live in CreteGreetings

reviews.title: PARKING
reviews.text: WARNING! do not stop in the first parking lot where with signs that make you think that ahead is all full induce you to enter .. ask you 5 euros while in the nearest one immediately after costs 3 euros .. it is not for 2 euros but for the scam way of operating . then the place is beautiful

reviews.title: Choose somewhere else - thank me later
reviews.text: First of all: drive all the way down to the where road closes. The parking-guides will guide you to the first parking, but that’s to far away (20 min walk min) and it’s the most expensive. It’s just a few sunbeds at the beach. So it’s not enough at all. They are also expensive (20 euro). Most important: do not travel here if it’s windy. It was 14 m wind, and it was completely chaos at the beach. The sand blowed all over in ears, eyes and bags, strollers, shoes and stuff blowed away. (Rip nature). I was here 15 years ago - it was a pearl! Now- it’s not worth it at all. To long way of walking (15 min at least), to many tourists and expensive. I will sertantly not go again.

reviews.title: Come early and enjoy
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with clear water. Getting there early is a top priority.  From 11 am the beach is really crowded.  But he's Morgenstern's dream

reviews.title: Go early in the morning!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to enjoy in the early morning. We arrived at 9.30 and until 10.30 we had a great time, then the world arrived. However to see absolutely. Take umbrella (20 euros) or bring a sturdy one because with the wind there are cheap ones flying away (we saw at least 4 in the baskets because broken). We stayed all day it's worth it .Wc costs 1 euro, free showers (look for them!) . Bar to drink and eat with "reasonable" prices for the place it is.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Beach and sea stupendi.Non stop at the first beaches but cross the bay on foot and stop on the beach and coves that you will find there. The real Elafonisi.

reviews.title: The best beach in the world
reviews.text: This beach was the best beach in the world and it was absolutely lovely to snorkle there. The water was crystal clear. The sunset was very nice to watch from the beach.

reviews.title: Definitely worth visiting  but don't expect what you see in the Internet
reviews.text: I visited the beach with my wife on a tour from Rhethymno,  organized by local tour operator Platanos Tour. The tour was very good, in a modern bus, with guide in  English,  French and German. The beach itself really crowded, but I mean the main beach. Following the advice of our guide we crossed the shallow water (but definitely deeper than 20 cm as it was said) to the island. There, right behind the rocks, there was another beach - much less crowded, with the pink sand (again, definitely NOT that huge amount you see in the internet), but without "civilization": no umbrellas etc. to rent,  no shops. Good for us. And if you go further along the beach, there's less and less people... but less and less the pink sand, more and more rocks at the same time. Crystal clear and cool water all the way long,  fishes at hand. Beautiful place anyway. On the main beach the umbrella and two sunbeds cost 20 € (didn't use), toilet right next to the main entrance 1€, showers for free (beware of the HOT water, warmed up by the sun), small changing room for free. Parking fee 3 € according to the signs,  a number of restaurants and shops by the road.

reviews.title: Beautiful windy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very windy, you can not keep the umbrellas open so it is better to go a little 'tanzati. Consiglio, as soon as you arrive by car do not be fooled by the first valets who indicate you to enter their parking, because further on, closer to the beach there are other parking places that cost less.

reviews.title: Beautiful but absolutely overhyped tourist destination
reviews.text: The beach itself is very nice, but nothing of pink/pink sand was visible far and wide. Were there very early (before the crowds arrive by coach etc.), therefore still manageable by the people (being there before 9 am pays off). In my opinion definitely an overhyped tourist destination that you can have seen once, but also missed nothing if not.Parking costs 5€ per day, walk to the beach are about 10 minutes downhill. Nice bar on site.

reviews.title: Beautiful but too many people
reviews.text: Very nice beach that can be reached after a walk of about 10 minutes. I recommend visiting it early in the morning when it is not yet invaded by tourists and especially when the sea is calm because otherwise you will not see the small tongues of sand and pink sand present.From a certain time it starts filling up with people and it's chaos.Still worth a visit!

reviews.title: Nothing exceptional
reviews.text: All smoke and... Beach accessible only on foot. So those who do not walk are not optimal. There is a shuttle that takes you from the parking area near the beach but I think it is not enough. Very breezy and wind gusts force you to stay only time for a bath. I would not recommend it.😔

reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.text: Beautiful lagoon with turquoise waters.When you arrive in Elafonissi, you are required to access the 1st car park which costs 5 euros.Don't be fooled, continue on your way and at about 300 meters you will find parking at 3 euros.But in high season, it is possible that this parking is complete in which case you will have no choice but to pay the 5 euros parking

reviews.title: The Crete tourist scam
reviews.text: It's really a scam. Not only is there nothing pink about the sand, but there are crowds and not a centimeter of shade. For me, it's not a beach, it's a strip of normal, uninteresting beige sand.There are many more beautiful places to see in Crete.Do not take the 1st parking, even if 5€ is cheap, the following are 3€. There are no small savings and the feeling of being fooled is unpleasant.

reviews.title: Worth visiting…with reservations
reviews.text: First of all, don't be fooled into parking in the first parking lot where parking guards hotly and harshly wave in cars. It is not only more expensive (5€) but also further to walk. There are more, cheaper (3€) parking spaces further down the road, also with parking attendants.…then you should expect it to be a 20 minute walk down to the beach, there is no natural shade on the beaches and the sun beds are few compared to the number of visitors.BUT I can not say other than that the place is worth visiting. Crystal clear water, white soft sand, beautiful rock formations and beautiful views.There are supermarkets by the car parks, a tavern before the walk to the beach and pay toilets.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful IF there weren’t 5000 people there. The pink is hard to see but the water is shallow and very pleasant. Unless you get there at the crack of dawn, there are no chairs left. DO NOT park at the first place where the guy will jump in front of your car and say the road ends. You will pay more money to walk VERY far when there is closer parking. Complete scam and disgusting behavior. The walk to the beach from the parking area is relatively easy but long and hot. There is one small concession on the beach with drinks and sandwiches. And a very friendly clerk.

reviews.title: A diving in Elafonisi June 25
reviews.text: We went around 9:30 a.m. to 10:00 a lot of people, "guns" with vests make sense to get into their parking lot. We finally got to the biggest parking lot. From there down "forbidden". Walking about 10-15 minutes, some cut way from some rocks.Beach dream, blue waters, I dropped for a long walk until it reached the middle, but today air (we had our own umbrella, singing) at some point raised and chased the woman in the water although I had put a metal base. And cold sea and salty... Pink sand minimal on the shore We left in 2 orices, medium experience enough inconvenience 1 hour and 25 minutes from Chania to go and another so return, road 25-30 minutes straight (BOAK) 55 turns provincial.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful!! I have never seen a beach and a lagoon so beautiful!You cross the lagoon among the fish and even a Bernard the hermit!!Beach parking at more than adequate rates and enough to eat! If there is a beach to see in Crete it is without hesitation the one

reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: A nightmare, what was a beautiful beach, turned out to be a nightmare. It's not worth taking the ride. Thank God there are many other beautiful beaches.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: A bit overrated, but still a beautiful beach with crystal clear water. Sand isn’t as pink as marketed in photos, but the view is still great. Can get a bit crowded. Two sunbeds and a parasol were 20€, we payed for it in cash.

reviews.title: Overrated, overcrowded and over priced.
reviews.text: Overrated, overcrowded and over priced. Don't get me wrong, it's a beautiful spot but very little pink sand. It's a kilometre hike to the beach from the car park and the guy at the first and furthest away from the beach stands in the road and guides you into his car park. Ignore him and go down as far as you can. There will be spaces. Hundreds of people and very few sunbeds at €30!!!! They even fence off the trees where you would find shade. The water is crystal clear and very shallow so good for kids. I was really looking forward to going there but was disappointed.

reviews.title: Paradisiaca........
reviews.text: A natural paradise...... We immediately fell in love with this place..... sea and dream beach.... We paid 2 sunbeds and 1 umbrella 20 euro...... Parking 5 euro...... Wonderful.

reviews.title: Ranked among the most beautiful in the world
reviews.text: Given some of the most beautiful white beaches in the world, we would like to include it among them. Habitué in June, we have seen that most of the presences stop in the great lagoon and this explains the very high turnout, but if you leave it behind and walk for about half an hour, you open white sand coves edged with pink and rocks, crystal clear water with dunes behind covered with bulbaceous trees and a lot of tranquility.

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Hired a car and drove from Aghia Marina which took about 1 hour 15 minutes. Got there at 10.15 and it was quite busy. The sand and waters are stunning. Loads of car parking is available ranging from a price of €3 to €5 for the day. Cheaper rate is for further away from beach but only a few minute extra walk. Not many sun beds are available for hire considering how busy it gets. We took our own towels had a walk around and swim and left after about 80 minutes. Well worth a visit it’s stunning.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach easy to access.Fish can be seen at the edge of the beach.Warning: pink sand is not as present as in the photos.

reviews.title: Beach beautiful attention to parking...
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. The only negative note when you arrive at the first parking lot make you understand that it is the only one pointing to the sign "cannot park on the beach". The first parking costs 5 euros, those further ahead and therefore closer to the beach cost 3 euros. I mean, they're screwing you!

reviews.title: Scam for parking!!!
reviews.text: You are forced to take the first car park on the pretext that the others are complete and charge you more ( 5 instead of 3€). Besides, they laugh when we point out their dishonesty.

reviews.title: Beautiful place before the many people arrive
reviews.text: A great day at Elafonisi Beach,  we travelled from Chania, by car, we made an early start and arrived at the beach at 9am, this was perfect as there were not many people there.  The cost for the sun lounger was 20 euros for 2 beds and a umberella.  We stayed furthest away from the main area, so lovely to walk around.  By 12 it was getting very busy with busses arriving.  Try and go early or later in day for the sunset.

reviews.title: lovely day trip
reviews.text: We stayed not far away, so we drove the beautiful coastal road to Elafonissi in the early morning, the views are fantastic. Elafonissi has soft sand and the sea in pastel shades, but when busses full of people started to arrive, we were not sorry to leave. The road back through the Topolia Gorge was interesting. We stopped at the Agia Sofia Cave, quite a climb when it's hot, and then at the amazing Komolithi formations, unique on Crete.

reviews.title: Overlaid
reviews.text: The beach is certainly pretty but difficult to find a place to land unless you like to stay in full sun. Lots of people, not enough umbrellas, almost no shaded place, and especially no pink sand. I regret coming.

reviews.title: A great un-missable beach
reviews.text: We hired a car to travel to Elafonisi. The car park is as described in earlier posts. There was plenty of room in the closest car park, despite much arm-waving and sign-pointing telling us it was full from the men in the yellow jackets (we arrived at about 12:15). It cost 5 euros.The beach was incredible. Yes it was busy but spread over a very large area. We walked along the beach, waded through a bit of water and found a quiet spot. Make sure you have your snorkel and mask. The water is crystal clear - the clearest I have ever seen anywhere. It's a beautiful beach and not to be missed. As well as pure white sand peppered with some pink grains,  there are intermittent rock formations where the fish hang out.I cannot comment on sun beds or umbrellas. I never go to a beach to sunbathe - why would you want to be lying on the sand when the water's that beautiful? We spent about 2 and 1/2 hours there and absolutely loved it. Some people advise to go to Falassarna instead claiming it is just as - if not more - beautiful. I disagree. Falassarna was a great beach but a class below Elafonisi.

reviews.title: A paradise beach!!
reviews.text: An incredible stretch of beach, with some glimpses of pink sand. This beach is a must-see if you are visiting Crete and enjoy the beaches with crystal clear water in which to lie down. We stayed there about 5 hours to enjoy all the corners of this beach which is imposing. I recommend this beach for everyone: family, friends, couple! Despite the world, the beach remains very quiet and allows to relax.

reviews.title: Careful parking! However wonderful place!
reviews.text: The 1st car park forces your hand (under excuse road bare) and displays 3 eur and pay later 5 eur. He refuses payment at the entrance and then removes the 3 eur panels and claims 5 eur at the exitThe second car park shows 3 euros! However the place is beautiful and worth a visit.  Shaded location very popular. The sun is beating!

reviews.title: Sardine central
reviews.text: Obviously weren't expecting to see it like on TikTok etc but over crowded is a understatement !!Terrible experience extremely limited sun beds ( obviously I understand this could be for asthetcs ) and what few where there they were packed like sardines touching the next person never seen sun beds so close .Got some nice pics from near the top when you first enter that's all I would recommend really as not worth the 15 min walk to get to the beach any get fried  in the sun 3 stars was for the lovely drive through the mountains to get there .

reviews.title: Disappointing.
reviews.text: Many people unfortunately kittens and a mother cat of a cadaveric thinness who came to the tourists to ask for help she came to me that to do we were at 2:30 from our hotel I went to buy her 2 big chicken sandwiches that we crumbled and we united her a bowl of water she threw herself on what heart puncture you can praise beautiful places but when you see the animal misery it ruins everything

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean
reviews.text: What about it? One of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean, for conformation, colors and height of the water, color of the sand, white with pink shades on the shoreline, extension.

reviews.title: Crowded and windy, but perfect view
reviews.text: The view was perfect, but please check the weather before you go there. On our day there was very windy, the sand all over the body, hurts like needles. We were only half hour there because of that. The beach and all around is great but doesn’t worth it if you go by bus. We were by car so we can left immediately. The view from tavern was stunning (if there was less people on the beach, It would be better 🙂)

reviews.title: Pretty but crowded
reviews.text: The beach itself is very beautiful with clear, shallow water. However, it was very crowded. Sun beds were also all taken. I would recommend coming here independently on a less popular time.

reviews.title: Tour operated visit.
reviews.text: We went expecting an experience where there was shade and cover with sufficient sun beds for the day. On arrival at around 11am the whole area was packed and we subsequently found there were no beds available. Added to this there was no shade as most of the trees are roped off. I would estimate that the temperature was well over 30c.Had we been aware of this situation before we would have bought at least one large umbrella. One thing to bear in mind is that the water is so shallow you can’t swim!!!It is very pretty with the pink sand etc but there isn’t anything else to do.

reviews.title: Unimpressed
reviews.text: There are much nicer beaches in Crete. If you don’t know how to swim, perhaps this beach would be good for you as you can walk through most of it. There’s quite a walk down too so wouldn’t recommend for people with mobility issues. I would definitely choose Balos or Falassarnq over this.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world!
reviews.text: Amazing beach! Went on a day trip, which was a long day but definitely worth it! Can see why it’s has been voted best beach in the world. Went on a Saturday and didn’t feel crowded at all. Best beach I’ve ever visited and definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Amazing beach and day!
reviews.text: Breathtaking beach area! Rented a car in Chania and drive the 1.5 hr to this beach. Parking was 5e then there is a path down to the beach. There is also a nice snack bar which has good food, nice selection of alcoholic drinks as well as coffee. There is also a pay toilet that is clean and costs 1e. Lots of area to spread out. Shallow area was great for families. We were able to walk across the sand bar to another area of the beach which had fewer people. We were here mid May so the summer crowds were not here yet. Water was chilly but not bad. I appreciated how the beach was in its natural state, not built up with shops, etc. Very relaxing and pleasant day!

reviews.title: Paradise for little ones ☺️
reviews.text: Realy nice place , worth the trip to the edge of island. Reccomendations1. Come in the mornin min 9-10am2. Prepare for crowed , 3. You can park realu Close to beach but you will have to walk around 5-10 min, but It’s flat so no worries4. Lots of parking so dont stop at first parking lot , first try the closest one.5. It’s really shadow water so paradise for the little ones.6. Road to REACH it is veeeeeery narrow and lots of turns 😂 good luck and be patient 🤭☺️There are bars , shower, and sun bed s if u want but IF You come late There might be none left because there is a lot of people.P.s it was not that pink as on instagram pics 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂And It’s really wondy dont forget su screen

reviews.title: Pink beach
reviews.text: Beautiful pink beach, with blue sea. Modest prices in the kiosks and also in the parking 3€ (do not stop at the first parking)

reviews.title: Best of Crete
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, only flaw there are few umbrellas, recommended to arrive before 10:00 to not stay under the scorching sun (even with cream you risk). But it's really lovely

reviews.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach paradise! You walk and it never gets deeper! But he has a big defect walking about 1000 meters because there is no access for cars to the beach.We got tired of the sun and the kids couldn't stand it. We never found flooring. It was all full. You have to get your own umbrella. For us tourists it is not easy to have an umbrella.

reviews.title: No sun bed or parasol available to rent, no shaded area on the beach. Buy a parasol at the entrance !!
reviews.text: Long distance to walk from the car park to the actual beach in scorching heat. We were also tricked to get into a car park which was not the mega car park and was quite far away from the beach. No shaded area whatsoever on the beach, all the trees blocked and had a barrier to prevent people from hiding from the heat. Absolutely no parasols or sun-beds  available to rent as they were all sold out. Despite the place being beautiful I would not recommend it unless you go early morning or late afternoon also bring your own parasol, umbrella, tent or whatever  to keep out of the scorching sun. Come on cretan government invest in planting some trees on the beach or build picnic areas with shade. People can collapse and die in this kind of heat. The beach is beautiful and large enough to accommodate the amount of people there.

reviews.title: This has to end.
reviews.text: Once it was a good thing but now it has been destroyed i.e. they have enormous fences old place not to do people camping and as an excuse for a flower that is a protected species while in reality it is in the lighthouse that you do not walk almost a person and is full and it is illegal to fenced forest land and put on parking so that people do not direct the fair things but hello to go to the loungers and hotels while they do not want part time and are forced,that all this is not called a person but a lot!

reviews.title: Like a cattle market. Avoid.
reviews.text: Like a cattle market, I’ve never seen a beach this packed. Be warned; car parking on the way in: the sheisters at the first car park will aggressively beckon you in, stopping you on the road and telling you that you must park with them… as tourists you blindly assume that’s the only option. Ignore it. Keep driving. Cheaper parking available further in towards the beach. I’m furious we believed them; especially as it’s about a mile walk after. The whole area was absolutely rammed; say good bye to nice photos or a pleasant day out. This is a cattle market. We weren’t even there in high season. Coach loads of tourists (there were 7 coaches there when we arrived).Avoid.

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach Crete
reviews.text: Lovely open beach, very family friendly, walk west along the coast and it’s a little more quiet with some nice lagoons and rock formations and a little more pink sand.  Parking is now controlled between 3 & 5 €, about a 5 minute walk to beach.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: So disappointing!  Been to ELAFONISSI beach a few times previously, the last time a couple of years ago.  How it has changed!  It has become a commercialised money making trap.  You used to be able to drive down to the beach and park for free.  Now there are a few car parks up on the hill.  We got hijacked by a man insisting we couldn’t go any further and directed us into his car parks.  We discovered a couple of other car parks further down the hill, charging less money.  You then set off on a walk with thousands of other tourists down to the beach.  Yes it’s a beautiful beach but it has lost its charm for me and we won’t bother coming again.  There are a few traditional tavernas serving lovely food and I do recommend these.

reviews.title: Magical sunset 💫
reviews.text: I visited between 7-9pm and had the most incredible experience. Having read many reviews about this beach, I was unsure whether to visit as I would prefer to spend my time on quiet beaches. I decided to try it at sunset. It was absolutely perfect. Almost everybody had left. Parked up very easily for 5 euros, the very nice parking attendant stayed until I returned just before it got really dark.There were about 10 people there, and then in the 30 mins after sunset, 8:30-9pm, when the sky was at its best and most beautiful, there was nobody else thereThe pink sky reflected the pink sand and it was breathtaking. I’m a huge nature lover and there were lots of birds around and it was incredible to paddle around on the sandbanks. An amazing experience that I’ll never forget. My heart is full 🩷

reviews.title: Crete Maldives
reviews.text: The trip from Agia Mariana went over the mountains, we rented a car for the day (about 600 SEK) the trip contained incredible views. Many have been worried about narrow roads but it was no problem to drive, never felt unsafe.When we rolled into Elafonissi there was a guy and waved us into the first parking lot, it cost 5 Euro per day, do not go in there, go past him, the parking lots that are closer to the beach cost 3 Euro and are much shorter to walk. The road to the beach is partly rocky but no problem walking.The sea was crystal clear and the sand was not so pink anymore but it does not matter, clearly worth the trip. What views.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Elafonissi beach is simply magical: turquoise water, pink sand in places, and an end-of-the-world impression. A must in Crete!

reviews.title: Tourist trap
reviews.text: Tourist trap. ..As soon as you arrive a folding machine encourages you to enter a parking lot. I insisted on continuing but he stayed in the middle of the road making great signs as if I could not go any further. So don't do as I do because the parking cost us 5 euros and 1 km on foot with my disabled husband, while the same parking at the same price is just near the end of the road. What to say on the beach. Probably prettier than others on the island but a crazy world heading to the same place. Fortunately for us the weather was rainy because I dare not imagine if it had been nice.

reviews.title: Don't go
reviews.text: This beach was a BIG disappointment! It's supposedly one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete but it's overcrowded and there is nothing beautiful to see except several hundreds people crampes together. The beach isn't even visible - it's so drowned out by the mass of people (and we arrive in the late morning in May) and the supposedly pink sand was barely pink for 2 meters. There are more picturesque and beautiful beaches to visit on the island.

reviews.title: Keep your expectations low
reviews.text: Is the beach beautiful? Yes. Is the water clean? It looks like a pool, crystal clear. Can you see the pink? Yes, but they are nuances and you notice sometimes more and sometimes less. Don't trust the photos, that intense pink doesn't exist. Otherwise it is a beautiful beach. Go early in the morning to avoid the crowd.

reviews.title: Many times to Elafonissi
reviews.text: Fabulous beach, friendly people, crystal clear sea but never go in July or August, too many people and loses its beauty

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: It was a beautiful beach, but it was very crowded but it was still a stunning beach with lots of pink sand! The only negatives were the walk from the car park because it is very far and hot and how crowded the beach was but overall an amazing beach

reviews.title: Magical
reviews.text: Wonderfull place. Dont go there by normal road. Go by outside road (you pass Falassarna to on that way). Yes its longer but then take the short road on the way back for a wonderful experience. Dont go if its not a good day.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: A really beautiful beach and well worth the visit.  We parked at the Mega Car park which is at the very end of the access road.   It was €5 for all day parking but did have toilets and shops.  Please be aware that there is a car park just before the Mega car park operated by men in yellow hi-viz jackets  who were posing as the official car park so I recommend you just drive past as they were quite insistent.  It is a long walk down a gravel road to the beach (at least 800 metres) so would be difficult for people like me with mobility issues however, we were pleased to find out that is a small minibus which will take you to the beach and bring you back for free which is run by the government   The sunbeds were €20 which consisted of 2 sunbeds and a parasol.  We went in May and was quite busy so I imagine in high season it will be heaving...a beautiful place all the same

reviews.title: Disappointing. The pink sand beach, no pink sand.
reviews.text: It is a beach too far away, ideal for children. You have to walk deep inside to be covered by water.The pink sand, disappeared (it was taken by the wind, it was taken by the sea... it was taken by tourists...?)Paid parking. Between 3 and 5€.Sun loungers with parasol 20€ a couple. And few establishments to drink.In my opinion, it is not worth going, unless you are staying nearby.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: I read all the reviews and was torn about going- but I am so glad I did. In May it was gorgeous and not very crowded.The drive through the mountains from Chania was nice in our rental car. Took about 1.5 hours. Yes there are some tight and winding roads but not too bad in my opinion. I would NOT want to be on a big tour bus for the drive though...lolThat being said, it's a MUST to check the wind speeds. This place would not be fun at all if the wind picks up, which I know happens often. Catch it on a calm day and it's paradise.It was worth it to pay the 5 euros to park by the Mini Market that is the closest and walk down. The walk is not difficult at all, unless you make it difficult by not walking on the gravel road and climbing down the rocks which we saw some people do.We waded over to the "island" and just relaxed all day reading a book. Lots of places to tuck in to-- no need to stay by the main area with all of the loungers unless you have kids and want to do that scene.The water is magical and yes...there are ribbons of pink sand.Very glad I just ignored reviews and checked it out on my own.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach,We look forward to coming again.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach,making it perfect for swimming and water sports. turquoise waters and beautiful scenery, We are had a great weekend with our girls, look forward to coming again.

reviews.title: Best beach in the area
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach in Crete, Greece, is a breathtaking paradise renowned for its pink-hued sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Named the *world’s best beach* in Tripadvisor’s 2025 rankings, it offers a unique blend of natural beauty and tranquility . The shallow lagoon is ideal for families, while the surrounding dunes and hiking trails appeal to adventurers . Visit in May or September for fewer crowds and perfect weather . Note: The pink sand, formed from crushed shells, is fragile—avoid taking souvenirs to preserve its charm . With amenities like sunbeds and snack bars, it’s a must-visit for an unforgettable coastal escape .

reviews.title: Overrated piece of beach
reviews.text: Overrated. Overrated. Very touristy. Don't fall for the parking trap! Guys in yellow vests want to send you into a parking lot because the road ahead would be blocked. Nonsense and costs you 5 euros in parking costs. There is plenty of parking space further down. The walk from the car to the beach is 1.2 km, takes you first past all kinds of shops and then a gravel / rock path. Difficult walking for the elderly and disabled although they have a car for driving (cost unknown). Two sunbeds with parasol cost 20 euros and then you are on a sandy beach with shallow water. You can also walk through, but we didn't. For someone who grew up near Noordwijk, this is very disappointing. I know nicer and quieter beaches on Crete that are free.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BAY..
reviews.text: Upon arrival they invite you, putting yourself in the middle of the road, to park at 5 euros per day... do not do it.... continue in the next parking costs less than 3 euros.... then , after a very short walk in the middle of the moor, you will have a breathtaking view.... THE LAGOON OF ELAFONISSI... good holiday

reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text: Perfect island!!! Amazing blue-green waters!!! You have nothing to envy of the rest of the islands!!! Beaches with sand!!!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: No doubt this is a beautiful spot. We booked a trip through Tui with limited information. If we’d been given honest info we probably wouldn’t have gone. Charged approx £100 for two adults and a 4 year old! 5 minutes before we arrived at the beach we were told if was very windy and often was so we wouldn’t be able to stay as long. Because it’s a nature spot there are only so many sun beds allowed and unlikely to be any by the time we turned up, recommended to by a umbrella at the top of hill by shops/cafes so we did. We weren’t expecting a 20 minute walk down to the beach, when we got there it was rammed and only one cafe open. Sun beds were full. Signs up saying No umbrellas and couldn’t stick it in the ground anyway and wind also made it impossible, €10 wasted. The force of the wind was whipping the sand up and there was no where to escape it and no shade. Weather can’t be helped but if it’s like it the majority of the time it should be mentioned. My daughter couldn’t cope with being sand blasted so we headed back up to the cafes for next few hours. The people “looking after” this area need to make a choice of a spot for tourists or a nature reserve, it can’t be both. Spotted a lot of litter and toilets smelt awful on the beach (and you had to pay!).  Obviously no pink sand like the pictures as it’s all been pinched over the years. Would hate to think what it’s like in the heat of the season.

reviews.title: Elaphonesos!!!
reviews.text: The white beaches in Elafonisos are well known to everyone. Easily accessible place without expensive ferries. Unique beautiful place.

reviews.title: Elafonisso Beach
reviews.text: Can't get anywhere near the beach!Paid parking 5€ Tourist scam After 3 hours of raging road! Don't inflict this torture on yourself or go by boat!

reviews.title: Andate
reviews.text: The beach and the sea are beautiful but a bit wild. To get there there is a hike to do once you leave the car at the parking lot. As I recall, the beach is poorly equipped compared to the huge flow of people who arrive there. Still worth it.

reviews.title: Elafonisi Beach – A Caution for Families and Those with Mobility Issues
reviews.text: Elafonisi Beach – A Caution for Families and Those with Mobility IssuesA visit to Elafonisi Beach turned into an unsettling experience. Upon arrival, drivers were aggressively waved off the main road and funneled into a €5 paid car park, with an added €1 charge to use the toilet. The atmosphere felt more like entering a restricted zone than a popular tourist destination.Despite having a small child in a buggy and a senior with mobility difficulties, parking was only available a 20-minute walk from the nearest café bar — not even the beach itself. As a result, several family members, including one with limited mobility, were unable to make it to the beach at all.On the way back, it became obvious that closer parking spaces were available, but had been deliberately blocked by attendants forming a human barrier. When this was questioned, one attendant removed his sunglasses and physically grabbed a member of the group — an act that felt threatening and escalated the situation unnecessarily. The behaviour was aggressive, and the children in the group were visibly frightened.The beach itself may well be beautiful, but the controlled access, lack of accommodation for families or those with mobility needs, and hostile attitude of the parking staff left a lasting negative impression.Visitors should plan ahead and be aware — for those unfamiliar with the area, Elafonisi is not the peaceful, welcoming spot many online reviews suggest.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Really beautiful, cinematic scenery, we were there at the end of April, still quiet from tourists. Parking lot further away, you could walk for a long time. There was a restaurant open and a shop with beach-friendly products before the beach area.

reviews.title: Really sad to see.
reviews.text: This was once a heavenly spot. But over tourism has ruined it. There are attempts to protect the wild habitats, but it may be too late. In addition, strong tides in recent years have rearranged and removed big swathes of the sand so more people are crowding onto less beach! Do not waste valuable time if it will take you several hours on narrow roads to reach this beach. There are far better ones. Tragic.

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: Fantastic place with incredible waters! The beach is very big but still the world is everywhere. The best month to visit is September!

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach I’ve ever seen!
reviews.text: While the travel to it is a long cliff driving adventure, simply put it is worth it!!!  Don’t park where the first guys are waving you down.  Closer parking is further in.  About 700 meters walk and it looked like a place not on earth.  A little pink sand a lot of shades of blue and a lot of little islands in the near and far distance.  Some of these islands you can wade to without swimming.  One of the most beautiful things I’ve seen!

reviews.title: Top 5 most beautiful beaches Crete.
reviews.text: Beautiful! I was here 25 years ago too. In terms of parking... a lot has changed.Don’t fall for the parking trap!People with yellow vests kind of force you to drive in.And ask €5.00 for a day.Not much in itself but if you drive 100 meters it is free.You used to be able to park just up to something in front of the beach.Now you have to walk a bit.Also on the beach itself have the choice to lie down between the mute.Or you can walk a bit through the water to the island.There you lie a bit more sheltered and you also have beach.The water is very shallow super for children. No stones just sand.There is a restaurant and a newsstand.There are clean toilets available.Just the drive to it is beautiful!

reviews.title: No.1 maybe
reviews.text: Currently rated No.1 beach in the world - Maybe - whilst the pretty lagoon shape, clear waters and soft white sands justify it's appeal , can get very busy even in the shoulder season. Worth doing it once to tick the bucket list , but not sure would make it a habit. Still the loungers ($20 euro for two) and the closest parking fior $5 euro was worth it . We enjoyed a relaxing day here in breezy 23 deg. temps. Got a couple beaches back in NZ that would be as good as  without the crowds. Worth the drive if only once 😄

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach w/ a little pink
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Crystal clear water! Just not pink like the pictures online! It has very little pink nowadays! So if you are only wanting to go to see pink, then you may be disappointed, but I loved the beach! It was huge! Fun day

reviews.title: Great beach, touristy but worth it.
reviews.text: I have given this beach 4 stars as, although an absolutely beautiful beach and sea, it is filled with tourists, you have to pay for toilets and the parking attendants are dishonest. The beach itself is not pink but has some pink sand near the waters edge, I imagine it might be more/less visible in different seasons/weather. The water is lovely and turquoise, can get some great pictures and reminds you of the Caribbean, though the water isn't as warm. When you drive towards the beach you first reach a car park where the attendant stops you and tells you that you can go no further. This is a lie! There is a much closer car park that is also for the supermarket and cafe. Yes I'm busy season it might be full but when we went it definitely wasn't and yet we were still bullied into parking at the first one. It was a longer walk to the beach and if we had known we would have driven on!Deck chairs are €5 and umbrella with 2 deck chairs are €20. Toilets are €1 There is a snack bar on the beach and supermarket/cafe/shop before you get there. Very stoney walk down so people with limited mobility might struggle

reviews.title: Totally stunning beauty.
reviews.text: Totally wow 🤩 did not miss ... it deserves because few roads to access it. Beautiful 🥰Don't necessarily stop at the 1st parking lot paying 5 eur the 2nd qq free place and plan enough to drink and eat. Small convenience stores and souvenir shops.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: The place is the sea is clean and the place is suitable for my summer vacation. I like the place very much

reviews.title: Heaven!!
reviews.text: Earthly paradise Clean water, beautiful location!!Clean beach. It is worth passing across the island. In August there are also the beads of the Virgin Mary that grow in the sand.

reviews.title: Perfect place

reviews.title: PARADIES
reviews.text: By far the most beautiful beach I have seen. Be sure to visit if you are in Crete. Uniquely beautiful ... actually an 11 out of 10!

reviews.title: The best sea in the world
reviews.text: The view was really great The sea was diamond the waters clearly I really liked it recommend you go with your family for a terrific vacation

reviews.title: Amazing experience.
reviews.text: We drove through the mountains and dropped down to this idyllic beach. The crystal clear waters and sandbanks make this place stunning. There's plenty of parking available for a fee, we paid €5 for the day.  Toilets 50c, they were acceptable,  just. The walking track down to the beach is steep in places and topped with stones and gravel.  Care needed for those who are mobility impaired.  It's maybe a 15 minute walk.There were no sunbeds available but it did look as if they were preparing them for the high season. There was a W.C on the beach but I didn't use it.I didn't find any litter bins on the beach.There was a snack bar on the beach, i didn't use it.There are a few Tavernas and shops on the main road.Well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Pink Sand Beach! Beautiful.
reviews.text: A splendid view ....the sea the blond sand with pink reflections....a descent through the cedars and the smell of thyme.A place that deserves....car journey plus descent on foot to the sand.

reviews.title: Disappointment, totally expendable
reviews.text: I wish I could say otherwise, but I would lie and it has entered the top ten of the disappointments of my travels. The visit to this beach is completely dispensable, firstly because in Crete there are dozens of much better alternatives, secondly because it is difficult to find pink sand and thirdly because if in April it looks like the verbena of the Dove, I do not want to imagine what will be in August.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: We were there on March 16th, during the off-season. The beach is huge and very beautiful. The water is an incredible color, and the sand is slightly pink — probably depending on the time of year.There were almost no people, and I even went for a swim! The water was refreshing, around 16°C. The sand was clean, and the place was stunning.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: It is reached in the southwest of the island. From the number of parking lots you can see how busy it is but at the end of April we did well! Parking 5€ , use of adjacent bathrooms 0,50. You walk along a stretch of dirt road and you arrive at a beautiful lagoon. The water is crystal clear and in some places presents this magnificent pink sand. The beach is very large and decidedly Caribbean. It is nature reserve. It deserves the trip to Crete just to see it!

reviews.title: Indescribably beautiful beach
reviews.text: Breathtaking, especially because we got there early and were one of the first to enjoy this beautiful beach and bay and also made a beautiful walk up to chapel. The shades of colour were overwhelming. Turquoise, blue, green, pink. The vegetation was also at its best

reviews.title: For sure will go soon.

reviews.title: Great place! Must see!
reviews.text: This place is not overrated! We loved it! 1h45 drive from Georgiopouli. The road is very nice to get there. Then parking five euros for the day. A short walk to get to this superb beach and quite special because of its many lagoons. A real little jewel! The water is super transparent and turquoise. We had the chance to discover it without deckchairs, umbrellas and with not too many people. A little disappointed however with the sand that is not very pink as you can see on Instagram or other photos but that is the nature, and it is very good like this!☺️ be careful, even in April, plan sunscreen! reviews.title: Elafonisi beach

reviews.title: Moderate... but one must go once.
reviews.text: Fantastic landscape but until there.. not the best beach in the world.. surely one should go once but until there.. I am from Crete (Heraklion) and I have gone 2 times in my life. If it was worth that, I'd go for more. The "best" beach in the world requires you to be able to take a bath! The waters are so shallow there that you can not take a bath.. June - August is the wasteland.. the waters are dirty and blurred by many people.. I for the best beaches in the world would look less famous. For example, the beaches of the open camp in Lefki in Lasithi are infinitely better. It has people but not much, it does not raise waves, it is fantastic .. turquoise water clear .. it has a beach to surf if you want to. The bad thing is that you have to get good weather, i.e. there is no air and the access is far away .. i.e. it is in the most southeastern part of Crete .. Tourists come every year from all over Europe.. last year we met a German who comes every year. If it weren't worth it, people would not have come from this far. So I disagree that Elafonisi is the best beach in the world.

reviews.title: Ruination

reviews.title: The most beautiful beaches ruined by the aggression of tourists
reviews.text: Elafonissi in Crete, like its namesake islet in front of Neapoli in Peloponnese, are two unique and beautiful beaches, too bad that mass tourism has ruined them.Don't go there, by now you would only find an incredible mass of people who have ruined the beauty and uniqueness of these places.If you really want to enjoy them go out of season, from October to May, in this period you can enjoy the uniqueness of the pink sand that plunges into the crystal clear waters. Also not to be missed is walking on the dunes and bending down to observe the flora that is born and lives on the rocks

reviews.title: ELAFONISSI
reviews.text: Good morning. The beach I agree is among the best but I point out that the 1 photo refers to Elafonissos (equally magnificent) which is located in Laconia (Peloponnese) and is the beach of Simos on the island of Elafonissos and the beach is divided into 2 bays a wider one (about 1 KM) which is Sarakiniko while the smallest U-shaped is called Fragos. It is divided by a strip of sand that connects to a wide hillformed by sand dunes in which there are specimens of Cedars although personally they seem to me Junipers and a splendid Mediterranean vegetation enriched by white Lilies

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach!
