If you enjoy people watching and enjoying beautiful waters, then its definitely worth the visit.On the way back,we stopped at a beautiful taverna on a cliff edge.I would definitely visit again, just slightly earlier next time

reviews.title: Exceptional indeed! A paradise
reviews.text: Actually much of what is described in previous reviews and ‘useless to repeat, and indeed, thanks to one of these we arrived in time to get an umbrella with 3 sunbeds for only (for the place that is) 25 € per day!! Recommendation, I recommend it even in August, even with many people, because it is beautiful and the water is wonderful. Just past the dunes and the first rocks looking at the sea on the right there are also fewer people, and you bathe divinely.

reviews.title: Stay away in summer.
reviews.text: Overtourism pure. Horrific crowds, busloads upon busloads of tourists and auto traffic without end. OH, the lovely beaches, just imagine them without 1000's of othervisitors imagining them. Masse Mensch.

reviews.title: Fun, Touristy Beach Spot!
reviews.text: The drive to the beach from Chania was not as bad as I saw online, it's definitely mountainous but just take your time and you'll be fine! The beach itself was gorgeous, but it was extremely busy and full of tourists. So try to get there early to avoid the rush and ensure you get an umbrella/daybeds. It was 20 euros for the day and it really was needed because there was honestly no shade on the beach! Also, be sure to check the weather before hand because it can get extremely windy on the coast and the strong winds made it difficult for us to fully enjoy the beach day (we had originally brought our own beach umbrella and the wind broke it!). Overall, it was a fun, touristy beach spot!

reviews.title: Don’t go there
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach is probably a nice place to visit when there are no tourists. However, in August, it was one of the most miserable places I have ever seen. First, the parking lot is huge, and if it’s windy, you’ll be walking through clouds of dust. From the parking lot, you have to walk a long way to the beach, with no signs or infrastructure to guide you. By the time you get there, exhausted, you’ll be surrounded by millions of people, and if you’re lucky, you won’t end up next to someone with smelly feet. This place is so disorganized and overcrowded that the beauty of the beach is completely lost. Not to mention, the  people who work in the parking lot are exposed to the sun all day long without any protection. This was the worst experience I’ve had in Greece, and I’ve been coming almost every summer for over 30 years

reviews.title: Trip from Chania to Elafonissi
reviews.text: Reading the reviews I expected much more from the beachThe road to get from Chania to Elafonissi is a treasure trove of truly beautiful landscapes: canyons, small villages, a tiny tunnel that you walk in alternate one-way. The sea actually is very beautiful and crystal clear, but of pink sand practically nothing. I've seen more in Balos. Apart from the last two meters from the shore there is no sand but ground mixed with sand that makes it difficult to plant the umbrella. In summary the place is very nice to look at but impractical to stay there a day.

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: Wonderful, the word that describes this wonderful protected area! White sand, with pink reflections, transparent water, turquoise. You walk everywhere with water at leg height. Wow! To reach the beach you have to walk about 1km from the parking lot but I consider it of absolute importance to safeguard the area. In August it is very busy but worth the trip to Crete!

reviews.title: It's a lost paradise, not worth it anymore
reviews.text: A horrible experience.I've known the beach for 15 years and what exists now has nothing to do with it.No pink sand, no peace or relaxation.You can't even admire its beauty.Massage (thousands of clustered people) and businesses (parking, cafeterias) with abusive prices for tourists.The parasols and sunbeds are already like a joke, the price is absolutely crazy.People with reduced mobility cannot go because you have to park far away (in paid parking lots) and the return is totally uphill.I hadn't been there for six years, what a pity of paradise I lost. He'll need time to recover.

reviews.title: Heavenly with some foresight
reviews.text: The beach of Elafonissi is among the most beautiful in Crete and therefore also among the most coveted and frequented, however with some care you can live a pleasant and stress-free day. Shortly before arrival in Elafonissi there are various parking lots where you can leave your car at a price including three € 3 and € 5 per day, essential to arrive early. Leaving the car we proceed on foot to the beach which is divided into two parts: a coastal one where most people stop also because of the presence of bathing establishments; and an island characterized by an offshoot of dunes and rocks that extends offshore. This is the part where Recommendation to go because unspoilt and less frequented, to do so you have to cross a stretch of sea from the height of about 1 meter, doable then walking getting wet up to the waist. Once on the island the setting is heavenly where small bays of white sand alternate with dark rocks, the water, needless to say, seems that of the Caribbean and almost never reaches remarkable heights. If you want to explore this part of the beach Recommendation to take a walk to the most exposed point out to sea, characterized by a higher rocky promontory on which is placed a small church and allows you to enjoy a breathtaking view of the sea and the whole Elafonissi.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but prepare for a lot of people and a bit of an hike.
reviews.text: Great beach. We did not get there early enough to get sunbeds. We were not prepared for the long walk down to the beach. Can be tough with small children. We walked over to the opposite beach and it was quite the adventure. Overall a very nice visit. It was very windy but warm. The children were having a tough time so we cut the visit short.

reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.text: Very nice beach.but don't stop at the first parking lot with 5 E is lower with 3 .forces the other to park given that there is no parking lot below.

reviews.title: I could be paradise if it wasn't for people
reviews.text: The beach is spectacular, but it is so crowded that it loses all its charm.You certainly can't leave in August. Its waters are crystal clear, really pink sand, like a pool. Access is not complicated as they say, if you are not a duck driving, it is not difficult at all.

reviews.title: Best beach in Crete
reviews.text: My favourite beach in Crete: huge (does not feel crowded even with tons of tourists), beautiful, crystal clear water, and easy to reach (unlike Balos for example...) . Unfortunately, it is a bit far from Crete airports, but it is really worth driving all the way there and stay a few days in some accommodation nearby :)

reviews.title: Stupenda!
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, we arrived at noon and parked in the last (giant) parking lot at the bottom, we found a place with our umbrella without problems, there are many people but the beach is so big that there is room for a huge amount of people. Water and fabulous beaches, ideal for children! Must see as Balos!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and crystal clear sea
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach, recommended to go very early if you want to take sunbed and umbrella, the only flaw is the huge amount of people who arrive at all hours, at lunchtime and 'really chaotic. Huge parking about 600 meters from the beach, Recommendation not to go to the first parking lots you meet but to use the mega parking

reviews.title: Not even..
reviews.text: We left Heraklion at 5am (good thing we did! A bathroom without 1000 people around we managed to do it), a decidedly tourist destination and crowded especially after 9.We took the umbrella and 3 sunbeds in the front row paying a correct amount, but after 20 minutes we had in front of us 3 rows of umbrellas not of the beach ..The pink beach does not reflect the photos found online.Recommended if it is maximum one hour from your location.There are no restaurants but only a couple of bars.40 € for two salads, a portion of chips and 2 waters seems a bit excessive ..

reviews.title: Fantastic place
reviews.text: Very nice beach, with blue-green waters and colorful sand. Prefer months when there is not much people to enjoy your bath!

reviews.title: Magnificent place
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with fabulous sea. Pink sand may not be what will catch your eye but the color is phenomenal. We went on Sunday (and I was told that buses organized on this day do not arrive) at 9 am I was already at the beach, the available stations end by 10 am (not after). 20€.on the far right, entering the beach , there is another small place where they rent umbrellas, it is not visible as soon as you enter and then you have to look out (there should be a flag flying). If you go in the afternoon you can try renting instead of leaving. Facing west you have to calculate that there is no unfavorable wind. Recommendation to park at the last parking at a cost of € 5, provides the bathroom at a cost of € 0.50 . You pay at the exit.  You have to stay until sunset and enjoy the beauty of the place. To eat there is immediately a kiosk attached to the beach, and one with a quick kitchen just above. Bathrooms for a fee of 1€.The road from Kissamos is not short and you have to go slowly, narrow roads, hairpin bends and beautiful canyons. Local produce vendors on the street.

reviews.title: Turquoise water pink sand ....magic
reviews.text: Exceptional then yes it is armored, the road is endless especially behind a bus but we take full eyes. We arrived at 10:30 we avoided the first drop-offs to park at the last car park (€5) 2 € more expensive than the car parks at the entrance but we were very happy on the way back to have our car next door after a hard lift in the middle of the country. To access the beach, a downhill walk of 10 min if you have sneakers c is better but can be done in tap. On the spot it was anarchy, I advise you to cross to the islet then tip over to the other side following the marked path after the rescue station, you will be more sheltered from the wind, quieter and with turquoise blue and pink on the sand just to you. Feast!!!!

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.text: Nice enough beach. More of a beach with a shallow river in front of it. Super crowded. No real pink sand. If you go, bring or buy an umbrella and walk over to the island, it is much less crowded over there

reviews.title: Just bad and overrated
reviews.text: Really overrated beach, I have visited much nicer beaches around the world and this beach is in top no idea why, First its long walk from the parking, Parking mafias has occupied area around 2km before beach and force you to park there and then its a long walk to the beach where very difficult with small children to reach the beach, Water is nice and no pink sand as advertised everywhere, its just a beach as any other but difficult to reach. We had bad luck also with the wind, the day we visited it was extremely windy and we could not enjoy much and its overcrowded too.There is lot of potential to make it better by throwing all the parking mafia out and use the empty area near beach to have built parking etc.

reviews.title: Must do
reviews.text: Beautiful beach of fine sand slightly pink. Transparent water , a very pleasant swim! We went there at the end of the day to avoid the world, we took advantage of the low tide and sunset, to end up in a restaurant next to the parking which was very nice!The beach of elagonissi is a must

reviews.title: Come. I saw. I ran away.
reviews.text: Experience overall not recommended, easily categorized among the 12 labors of Hercules.  We left Hersonissos at 6am to arrive on the beach at 11am passing through mountain roads that I do not recommend to those suffering from car sickness. Once we arrived we did just under 1km to get to the beach; since it was high season the umbrellas were already occupied and the beach almost completely full but we still manage to find a place to settle. Very hot day and with gusts of wind, so zigzagging between umbrellas flying and sand rising, we manage to get into the water: clean, spotless but there is no trace of pink, for the most part the height of the water reaches up to the waist. After a fleeting lunch we decide to go up from the beach and wait for our bus to return to the hotel. 8 hours of travel for 3 and a half hours of beach, absolutely not recommended for those leaving from afar. Highly overrated beach that does not reflect the appearance of the photos.

reviews.title: What is hell?
reviews.text: What a disappointment! Beach in theory heavenly but actually a real hell. Lots of people perched everywhere with the illusion of being on the most popular beach in Crete. Dozens of buses and thousands of cars in mega parking lots.

reviews.title: Bath beach with many people
reviews.text: A really nice beach and nice water. But there is not much red sand, to say nothing at all. There were troubled many people, but the weather was also good.

reviews.title: Mass destruction
reviews.text: This beach should be closed to tourism as they already did for Chrissi Island. An impressive amount of people (I counted 22 buses in the mega parking lot and hundreds of cars) are destroying this beautiful and delicate ecosystem and soon it will be just a memory

reviews.title: Unmissable!!!!!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach seen in this area of Crete much more beautiful even than Balos. We arrived at about 11.30 and it was very crowded, but we crossed the sea on foot which has very shallow water and in a few minutes we arrived at the 'island in front where instead there were very few people and we had a great time.Going there, also, you have the opportunity to swim in different areas where the sea is even more spectacular.Sull'island, however, there are no bars or beaches so go equipped.Pink sand is seen at times and depends on the light ....

reviews.title: Best beach ever!
reviews.text: This is the most stunning beach I have ever seen, it takes your breath away. Reading reviews we are apprehensive, but no need to be.Get there by 9 am to guarantee a sunbed, it’s a 10 minute walk from the car park, down hill but not steep.  Coming up was fine. I did it in flip flops.Beach bars were good, well stocked.  You can pay a Euro to pee in a serviced toilet.They have sunbeds on a hard standing for the disabled and a chair on tracks to take them into the sea.

reviews.title: Dare it!!!
reviews.text: Today's experience we reached a good road country narrow without any problem but access to the parking lot is easy and the descent is difficult !!!Set umbrellas 20 enough to go early in the morning to get there!!!They write and prevent the people as if they would go to 5 stars with the jeep in front of the sea!!!If you do not dare you will not receive this magical visit to something beautiful!!!

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Paradise beach. You have to walk for a short distance before reaching the beach, but once you arrive it seems to be in paradise. We went very early to find umbrellas and sunbeds (25€ all set, umbrella and 2 sunbeds)It remains and will remain the most beautiful beach in all of Crete

reviews.title: Holiday in Crete
reviews.text: Crowded beach, after 10 am you can not find a place. To get to the beach there is a dirt road, in full sun, and the route, downhill on the way, then uphill on the way back, it takes about 25 minutes!!Few possibilities 'to eat, just a kiosk with very few seats.Honestly, the way I was described, Elafonissi, I expected better!

reviews.title: A heavenly swimming pool
reviews.text: Perhaps the best beach after balos for beauty. Parking is 5 euros to pay when you leave.Umbrellas cost 20 euros but hurry up, do not think of sleeping late and come comfortably after resting badly. Here you come early or stay on the ground in the free beach. By 9:30 in the morning everything is already full.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Easy walking access (15 minutes walk accessible to all). You have to be there in the morning at 9am and leave at noon when the crowd arrives. Parking 5 € per day with bcp places available in the morning.

reviews.title: Spectacular sea, too bad it's crowded
reviews.text: We arrived at 8:30 and already half of the umbrellas available were occupied.We also recommend coming no later than 8:30 because in a couple of hours the beach fills up in an unlikely way.However spectacular sea and toilet services well organized food and drink showers at the few kiosks available

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Petite reiterates previous reviews: little pink sand, people and a little difficult access. However, these small drawbacks must be put into perspective. Given the experiences described, it is necessary to organize a minimum to make the most of this extraordinary site (yes yes extraordinary). If as we have no choice but to leave in summer, leaving very early in the morning (I speak of 6 or 7am), you will have no one on the beach and you can enjoy an incredible transparency of water. For pink sand, yes, you will see it, even if there are few and it moves in places (I think it also depends on the time of year depending on sunlight). It is worth it, because in my experience I have never seen one elsewhere.:) Reviews to brave mornings and those who appreciate.

reviews.title: Overcrowded! :-(
reviews.text: Very nice but unfortunately too crowded. I would recommend the trip only in a low season and best very early in the morning.Be sure to take water shoes with you and walk the path with sturdy shoes as it is already very rocky.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach!
reviews.text: A stunning beach, we found a quieter spot on the other side of the main beach to chill and swim in the sea. The water is crystal clear and so beautiful! Highly recommend a visit!

reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text: Paradise literally. Reading a lot of reviews from Greeks for a lot of walking , narrow streets etc. I had a little scared but really what the people write. The road from Chania to Elafonisi is really very good. The route is just magical, you pass through mountains, villages etc and the landscape enchanting you. At some point, it's okay, it's narrow but without any danger. Once you get there from the first car park they try to put you inside and well that the others are full but just ignore them and park at the last one called mega parking and costs 5€ all day.From there it is exactly 8 minutes walk with a timetable on a very normal road with sea fields I was okay and didn't slip half a time. As soon as you arrive at the beach there are sunbeds with 20€ the set if you will hardly find it is few. We arrived at 11:30 and although the beaches were full the people were beautifully shared and we sat right in front of the water with our umbrella. The waters are crystal clear, warm and clear and the landscape simply enchanting you.We liked it so much that we walked and swam in all points. For the unorganized there are several canteens right on the beach that offer all the cafes, food and drinks at very normal prices.No reviews are read from grinarides who have consistently parked in the water and parked them for distances etc.

reviews.title: Must go beach!
reviews.text: Undoubtedly one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece!!! Clear, shallow waters and a magnificent landscape, unlike any other.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful.  Few umbrellas available, so Recommendation to get there before 9:30. By 10:00, they were all busy. Cost of 1 umbrella and 2 deck chairs 20 euros. Otherwise, at 10 euros, in the shop before the beach, you can buy one. Beach equipped with bar, toilet at a cost of 1 euro and showers.Pink sand and crystal clear sea. To do about 1km walk from the parking lot to the beach and the route is not difficult, but I recommend sneakers especially to children.

reviews.title: A stunning beauty spot ruined
reviews.text: We visited Elafonisi maybe 10 years ago.  It was quiet with a rough & ready car park amongst the trees.  There was one food outlet, and that was about it.  Now it feels almost industrial in it's effort to get people on the beach.  There are numerous large (and one HUGE), car parks, with "officials" in hi-viz jackets waving you in.  The beach is a long & rough trek down a rocky hill.  There are large fast food type shops.  The beach is absolutely crammed with coachloads of people & sunbeds (at 20 euros a pop). Absolutely spoiled by tourism (and I know I'm just as guilty as everybody else).

reviews.title: Paradise to preserve some human beasts.
reviews.text: See English tourist, what are you going to do with a pink sandbag when you arrive in your gray city?. Please respect the natural spaces and go drink beer that seems like the only thing you can do. You should be fined €10,000 to see if you learn.Besides warning you you kept picking up more sand when I turned... when I told the police you were gone.

reviews.title: If you like to travel don't go
reviews.text: Great reviews do not know why, terrible, overcrowded, a tourist industry.To be avoided absolutely ..

reviews.title: Over rated beach, not worth the drive. Definitely don't go on a windy day!
reviews.text: Over rated beach.We visited when it was windy, which made the beach fairly unpleasant.  Clearly that was one of those things though I noted all the shops on the walk to the beach sold windbreakers. The 1st car park you come to, is v keen for you to park there and crams the cars in which can be tricky if leave early like we did. The parking prices are similar at all the car parks even those closer.The beach is hyped as pink, barely obvious, it has a shallow bay so good if there with little kids. There are sunbeds to hire but I suspect you would need to be v early to get those. It's at least 15 min walk to beach over quite rough terrain, so be aware of that.Personally we felt it wasn't worth the hype, long drive etc, there are much nicer beaches with more accessibility and nicer outlook.

reviews.title: Family trip Elafonissi
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the trip to the “pink” sandy beach was a total failure. The beach was little to no pink, but totally crowded.

reviews.title: The pink beach
reviews.text: Difficult to reach but very suggestive, a huge expanse of light sand with pink shades. Cold sea for my taste but pleasant. A lot of wind! Nearby paid parking and restaurants

reviews.title: Lovely beach, would def visit again
reviews.text: Great beach! Iconic pink sand, and nice shallow depth for miles. Great for both strong swimmers and non swimmers. Lots of access to food, but get early if you want to rent beach umbrellas, it cost us €20. we also had to pay for parking, but we packed a few snacks and water. Very lovely beach with nice soft sand and clear water.

reviews.title: Beautiful and worth a visit. Topolia
reviews.text: Practical advise first... There is a downhill walk to get to the beach (remember it's all uphill to get back). There are shops and places to get refreshments and food that are fairly priced given the location. Parking is chargeable and slightly cheaper if you are happy to walk an extra minute.The view and beach itself are beautiful and will be hard to match, the children loved the fact the sea was calm and very warm. Definitely worth a visit!The main route from north to south where the beach is has a quait town called Topolia which was a lovely bakery and store selling authentic wooden items. The people there went out of their way to be welcoming, worth a stop

reviews.title: To see but like almost all around the island at least once
reviews.text: The French like to complain too much. Personally full of August I had a beautiful perimeter in the water while I was at the Check-out point between the beach and the small island that formed in front of... a crazy world but still many places. You don't have to fight for deckchairs... and you just don't have to go. The beaches of the coast in France are so crowded if not worse sometimes 🤣🤣 nan it's serious enjoy this moment instead of grumbling. The weak point is perhaps the road some tight or mountain passes that make some vertiginous effects. Otherwise go for a ride or enjoy only beautiful beaches all around Crete

reviews.title: World 🌎 Famous Elefonisi
reviews.text: Ok, what else to say about this world 🌍 famous beach ⛱️??? Just Some practical things. You have to park your car around 600 metres away from the beach (parking costs 3€ or 5€ - depending on how far the parking lot is). There is a down hill with 3-4 shops at the beginning. So you can grab coffee food or water. There are also 2-3 cantines on the beach. Sun beds cost 20€ per set. During August come early because you won't even find a place to put your own umbrella!!!

reviews.title: Sea 🔝 pink sand very little, a bit overrated.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, wonderful sea, wrong to advertise it for pink sand, which is really too little and in very few areas, good just for the istagram photo but nothing more...Compared to Balos in my opinion it is less unmissable, a lot of people from 10 to 15:00, if I had to make a comparison, I carry C-section in Salento.If I had to redo 2 hours by car to go back I would not do them again, in my opinion it is very overrated, despite nothing to say to the amazing sea that deserves 5 stars.For services:good parking, not far from the beach, 5 minutes walk, umbrellas not many, you need to arrive early, for 9:00, for food and drink no problem.Toilet for 1 euro, shower for free.

reviews.title: Beautiful lagoon
reviews.text: Beautiful lagoon! Shallow transparent water. Cross to go to the small island opposite, you will see pink sand on the edge and blue lagoon water. Obviously very touristy, only paid parking (5 € for the nearest) and then you have to go down to the beach (and go up in full sun!). But there is when the place to settle and the lagoon is great. Watch the wind.The site deserves to make the road (windy!). It is beautiful!

reviews.title: Long journey with hairpin bends
reviews.text: From Chania 70 km including 38 normal road full of hairpin bends (not recommended for those suffering from car sickness. Once in Elafonissi you will find a series of parking lots, do not stop at the first even if the valets invite you to do so, go to the one closest to the beach. From there, however, on foot you will have to walk for 600 meters a rough road but also feasible with children from 4 years old. Forget about finding Mikonos-style establishments, you will find 4 cross establishments with 20 umbrellas each and 4 shacks, some without tables and chairs, to take salads, sandwiches, hamburgers. If you feel like it, bring a parasol because you will not find a place at the establishments unless you go early in the morning or adapt and lie under a dune or a tree.Beautiful place, shallow water for many meters, ideal place for children under 4 years. Adults will have to stray a long way from the shore before taking a good swim.The pink beach I have not seen.... a dense expanse of people yes. Once enough is enough, I much prefer to return to Falassarna... in my opinion more organized and served and the color of the sea equal.

reviews.title: Crystal water and completely clear
reviews.text: The view is beautiful..The beach plays to be the most beautiful and the cleanest that exists in Crete ⁇  and in Greece ..Unbelievable colors and very shallow that should .. We are talking about the Maldives

reviews.title: To avoid in summer
reviews.text: Very nice beach lagoon but only for the view. In this month of July a lot of people, almost no shade and mediocre deckchairs taken by storm. Besides, we can only wade, not swim. As for pink sand, there is ultimately very little. To visit probably outside of July and August.

reviews.title: Wonderful, until 11..
reviews.text: The beach is breathtaking, definitely worth a visit. We arrived at 11.30 and I felt like I was at the stadium from the confusion, both in the parking lots and on the beach. When I return to Crete, I will definitely go to this beach by 8/8.30 to stay until 11.

reviews.title: Gorgeous!!!
reviews.text: I absolutely love this beach!! It is huge!! The water is cold and sparkling clean!! There are lots of families and young people enjoying themselves! There are sunbeds but unfortunately we did not manage to get one because they were sold out. There are toilets and changing facilities available. There are places to eat near and close to the beach. The walk from the parking lot to the beach is about 20 to 30 minutes.

reviews.title: Magical colors
reviews.text: It is a wonderful beach and its colours are magical. Be well prepared when visiting with kids. It can get quite windy and it is best to arrive early in the morning to get an umbrella and chairs.

reviews.title: Just shit!!
reviews.text: I was unpleasantly surprised when we arrived, they have closed the road to the beach and as far as we read it decided the municipality of Kissamos in 2023 so you are forced to pay for parking which have grown like mushrooms with a charge of 5€ (there is no free crucifixion anywhere) and when you go down to the beach (if you save the trap) has sun loungers that say above ( Municipality of Kissamos) charge 20€ per set!!!! I have come in the past 2 times, it is definitely the last time I come, no longer worth the trouble!

reviews.title: Much wind for nothing
reviews.text: We were yesterday at Elafonisi Beach ,totally crowded ,no more deckchairs available ,the way back and forth to the beach very rocky and long .Of course it looks very nice and the water is clear .But to get to the other side you had to walk through the sea with your things (bags etc ) All in all you can do ,but you don't have to

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, Watch out for the wind, and quite a walk before arriving at the lagoon but it is worth it!!! Very clean beach, with shower and toilet

reviews.title: A lot of people.
reviews.text: Waterlifting tourist trap. Several thousand people and very few beach chairs available, For 30 euros for 2. The pink sand you really need to look for. Lovely beach, with low water, but too oversold

reviews.title: Much overrated
reviews.text: We stayed at this beach a few days ago. Surely the view is really beautiful but the influx of tourists, the total unavailability of services, the great confusion to grab some shaded areas make this area absolutely overrated. The view is certainly beautiful but bathing is practically impossible: you have to do at least a couple of kilometers to have water at shoulder level there is a set of people who do not allow a minimum of relaxation. The services are also poor and totally inadequate for the thousands of people who arrive every morning. A tip there are many parking lots at the beginning of the beach we advise you not to stop at the first three but to reach either the fourth on the left that costs three euros per day or the last one that costs five euros but also the three-euro one is very close to the beach entrance. The first parking lots are a little further away you will see the people who tell you that the road is closed but you can reach the last one that is closest where there is also a small supermarket where you can buy something to drink because there it is absolutely impossible to reach any kind of service Given the considerable number of people who come every morning. Even the road to get there is not particularly easy we were in Chiania we took more than an hour and a half.

reviews.title: Much easier to reach than Balos
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, water and panorama. You can walk all around and it's really nice. The sand, however, is not pink except for tiny stretches on the shore in the distance on the islet opposite. You have to arrive very early because the umbrellas put on the free beach fly for too much wind and the beach fills up immediately. Just two restaurants to eat offering bar-ready and expensive food. Too crowded without free beach services and super hot. Parking near paid 3/5€ per day plus a fairly long walk

reviews.title: Better than his reputation
reviews.text: After a spontaneous visit recently, I would like to put into perspective what you read here.We were there in the high season heading into the evening and we enjoyed it overall. The journey over the funny serpentines is picturesque and unexciting for island conditions. We took the last parking lot before the beach (“Big Parking”) because we are lazy. Slightly before that there was also something for 3€. Both are acceptable to me. Elsewhere, very different amounts are called upon. The beach is not small, so despite the loungers you will find plenty of uncommercialized space. It wasn't really crowded in the water either. No comparison to some sardine beaches on Malle.Beach and water were overall in good condition Some garbage in the water in one place really stood out. A little of the pink sand was also everywhere, if you looked properly. Overall a great bathing evening in an oversized bathtub.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Breathtaking beach, cost umbrella and two sunbeds 20 euros, there is a bar selling stuff to eat, ice cream and soft drinks.Beautiful for both bathing and exploring the place.Also recommended for children since the water is very shallow in some areas of the beach.Parking 5€ but there was also one at 3€ a little further.

reviews.title: Challenging drive, lovely beach, terrible wind and sand/grit blasted
reviews.text: Only 2 stars, mostly because it was incredibly windy - so strong you had to hold onto your sunglasses and it blew sand and grit at you so hard that it hurt. Check the weather forecast before you go! The beach (beaches really) are lovely, with shallow lagoons that you can paddle in. We deliberately arrived late afternoon to avoid the worst of the crowds and sun, and could have got sunbeds, if we'd wanted to. We'd hired a car and the highlight of the day was the drive their (from Chania) through the beautiful mountains and villages. It's a challenging road (very narrow in places, with hairpin bends) and not for the nervous driver, but I enjoyed it. However, we didn't stay for an evening meal in Elafonissi, as I really wouldn't have fancied that mountain pass in the dark! Car parking (€5) is from 2024 a long-ish walk from the beach down an unpleasant grit path  (more wind + grit) and then through the old car park areas nearer the sea - maybe they'll re-wild them eventually, but they're an eyesore for now. A couple of tavernas said they rented rooms, so staying a night or two might be a good bet, if I ever come again.

reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Unfortunately crowded. Just arrived I recommend watching for an umbrella because they sell out very soon. For parking the last one costs 5 euros anyway. In the others you spend 3 euros. I recommend reaching the islet in front of the beach, which you can reach by walking in the water, if you want to be quieter.

reviews.title: Not so extraordinary
reviews.text: 1h30 drive from Chania including 1h of mountain roads. You have to be motivated.  No luck, nois had wind, a little too much for a pleasant experience.  We arrived at 6pm, not too crowded. Pink, you really have to look for it; indeed, a reflection by the water... We were a little disappointed, but the setting was pretty anyway.  Do not hesitate to cross to go to the islet.

reviews.title: Passion
reviews.text: No trouble! It was blowing too much..There is quite a distance from where you leave the car to the beach. The sunbeds €20

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning, paradise like beach with pink sand, not as crowded as we expected, plenty of space to take nice photos without other tourosts in the background, must visit

reviews.title: Too many people and pink it is not.
reviews.text: There were simply too many tourists. It was not to find a place, not even in the sand one could find a place. Otherwise very nice and nice water but unfortunately still too many people. Pink wasn't it. I would recommend going to another beach where there are not so many.

reviews.title: Mages
reviews.text: A magnificent landscape and a beach with such beautiful colors! It may be far from Chania, but it really is worth it!If you start early you will be able to see the beach almost empty and enjoy the landscape

reviews.title: To see! Once...
reviews.text: 1h30 drive to go...so yes it is super pretty, Undoubtedly... nice sea, transparent etc...but you have to go very early! Impressive mass of people, little room, you have to move a little... a small walk is necessary when you leave the parking lot, in full sun, very hot, you have to motivate! 5 euros parking, there is enough to eat but we opted for the insulated backpack, (see the world queuing for drinks ..) short very tourist site, which loses its beauty ....

reviews.title: Very nice place but super busy
reviews.text: This beach was stunning with infamous pink sand on the edge of the water. The coves and beaches around were very impressive and this beach would be nice to spend a long time at (unfortunately we only had enough time to spend an hour or two here).The beach features a very large shallow area which would be perfect for children to swim in unattended.At the top of the beach there is a small cafe/shop where you can buy snacks, drinks or ice creams from which is a necessity as there isn’t loads else in the area.The beach took us around 2.5 hours to get to by car driving from Rethymno. The roads there were slightly treacherous as you drive down a valley on what felt like the edge of a big drop, but a confident driver would manage with no issue. The only downside to this beach was how busy it was. We went at midday on a Thursday in September and it was packed. It was difficult to find an area by the shore to lay our towels.When we went the parking at the beach was closed so we had to park about 1km away and walk to the beach, so be prepared for this just in case.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but a lot of people
reviews.text: The beach is really lovely for the Caribbean colors. Obviously to enjoy it to the fullest you must arrive by 9. However from 11 is practically a carnaio of people both on the beach and in the water .. if there is strong wind you can not even open the umbrella brought from home (as we wanted to do) We say that a day there is not the real relaxation of Greek beach, but the view deserves.

reviews.title: Nice to see, but....
reviews.text: Goin' there takes time (aprox. 3 hrs. if you come from Heraklion area), the road in the mountains is quite dangerous if you're not a good driver. A lot of cars and buses goin' there and not everybody has skills to drive on serpentines. You should arrive early (9 a.m.) to have a sunbed, only two places to have it), otherwise be prepared with your own umbrella. By the way, two sunbeds and one umbrella -20 €, extra bed 5 € :)). To eat-half gyros, some pies, not a vaiery, pricey - 4-5 €, better come with some sandwiches.  Toilets 1 €, no free shower. First part of the day very crowded, in the afternoon the atmosphere became more relaxing. Conclusion: the feeling was that people try to rip you off, a little filthy, good to see but not so special as i've been told, not coming back.

reviews.title: To flee in July August
reviews.text: Here we are! As all the guides indicate this beach as amazing, we drove almost 1h30 from beacon to get there. And the, very big disappointment. The beach is black with people; even thePrivate beaches are invaded with 5 6 people crammed underUmbrellas and 2 sunbeds! Pink sand you said? Even if you look hard, there's none. So certainly the water is translucent but this is not enough to make this beach beautiful. Probably out of season. But in July August to flee, do not waste your time, you will inevitably be disappointed. Not to mention the parking scam on arrival; people blocked our way to tell us their parking indicating that the road was closed. Walking to the beach we realized that they had sent us to the farthest and most expensive parking (double the price of parking near the beach!!!!).

reviews.title: Very pale pink
reviews.text: Very nice beach but it was incredibly crowded which of course you have to expect and the sand was not as pink as you thought when you saw the commercial. Lovely clear water that despite all the people there felt fresh.If you’re in the mood for some snorkeling, it’s fine but it wasn’t that much fish, not surprising considering how many people there were. Guess it's much more exciting when it's not high season

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: As soon as you get to the beach you risk being “disappointed” by the view but if you want to take a walk around the dunes you can easily reach a magnificent place (Recommend to arrive early in the morning because at 10/11 it starts to be already too full) The beauty of this place is the possibility to always walk in the water because you touch practically everywhere and then look for the magical place of this islet away from people. The pink beach is really there, just don’t stop at the first space of sand just arrived

reviews.title: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL BEACH IN THE WORLD
reviews.text: The highlight of the stay!The road to this paradise beach is very dangerous. It is very steep and on the mountainside. Several bus companies fly to this destination from major Cretan cities. For about twenty euros, you will have peace of mind. If you prefer the car, you will probably drive between two buses.Once there, we remain speechless in front of the beauty of this landscape. First of all, the turquoise blue of the lagoons is absolutely beautiful. Then there's the pink sand. Unfortunately, the latter is becoming more and more rare because tourists had become used to taking them home in a plastic bottle. Today this is no longer the case, and there is no police monitoring tourists. The water is warm and pleasant. The ideal beach during heavy heat waves because it is very windy.Must-see during your stay in Crete!

reviews.title: Sea and sun
reviews.text: Spectacular view. Sublime water is worth it. The pictures don't do him justice. Cots can be booked. It is easy to access

reviews.title: This review is for the parking situation
reviews.text: WARNING rip off !!! Keep an eye out for parking. The parking lot (where people in warm vests, standing in the middle of the street, lead you to it) right at the entrance to the town and without price signage is a scam. Closer parking to Elafonesi beach costs 3€ !! When leaving the fraudster parking lot you are told that you have to pay 5€, which is not signposted. If you refuse payment, you are threatened by the controllers.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: 5 stars because there are no others. Two hours drive to get there, but really worth it. Once you arrive you will find several parking lots (for a fee of 5€) with valets inviting you to go to the pirmo (further away), avoid and go further. Try to arrive early if you want to find an umbrella (there are several) at a cost of 20 € including two sunbeds.  The beautiful water and pink sand make this place lovely, other than Balos.

reviews.title: A dream beach 🤩
reviews.text: Well what about, such a place is usually only found in magazines, do not stop at the equipped beach cross the ford and enjoy the white dunes and the various pink beaches, the water has breathtaking colors!To get to the beach you have to park in the various paid parking lots 3/5€, take a very quiet dirt road but in the sun... then you will arrive at the beach equipped with umbrellas and 2 sunbeds for €20 an extra sunbed €5. But to find them available it is recommended to arrive by 9:00!Recommendation to walk along the beach and enjoy the scenery is truly paradise!!!

reviews.title: Pictures don't reflect reality
reviews.text: It was worth seeing... sort of. Having been there, I wouldn't go back. Let me start with the pros. The drive there is scenic and if you like driving along the mountains on serpentine roads, then you'll enjoy the drive. The beach is clean and the water is calm and clear. It is great for kids. As for pros, that's it. Now the cons. Depending on where you're coming from, it can be a long drive. From Rethimnos, it took us 2.5 hours. Parking costs 5€ unless you're early and the closer parking lot is 3€. There are official looking people directing you to lots. They just work for each lot. The walk down to the beach takes 15 minutes to walk over rough terrain. If you want an umbrella and 2 chairs, it costs 20€. If you want more than coffee you have to hike back up. Elafonisi is also known as the pink beach. The pictures online don't reflect reality. There is pink sand but only where the water washes on the sand - thin band.  The rest of the sand is the run of the mill beach sand. It is also very busy and crowded. We went on a Sunday so perhaps it isn't as busy on a weekday but most of the people were tourists anyway. If you're looking for a beach, there are just as nice beaches throughout Crete and with better amenities. I'm glad I saw it, but having seen it, I wouldn't return.

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach is a paradise with pink sand and clear turquoise waters. It’s perfect for relaxing, swimming, and exploring the shallow lagoon. Despite its popularity, it wasn’t overcrowded. The beach has sunbeds, umbrellas, and snack bars. The scenic drive to get there adds to the experience. A must-visit in Crete!

reviews.title: POOR Customer Service! NOT WORTH VISITING!!!!
reviews.text: Worst experience with this paid beach location I've ever had! i just had a family vacation in Crete and heard about this pink (not pink!!) sandy beach. We were very disappointed about this tourtist attraction for the follwing reasons: 1. bad winding and rough road from the gate to the beach, not suitable for elderly and those who have bad knees. It takes about 10min to walk from the gate to the beach. 2. Not enough beach umbrellas and chairs even we are willing to pay! And yet most of the trees are blocked and not allowed to use. Tourists have to rest under shaded tree they can find on the island.3. But WORST OF ALL is the attitude of people guarding this island! Because most of the trees are blocked, we had a hard time to find shaded areas we we could rest and enjoy the beach.  There was a woman who worked there who was very rude and impolite. Instead of helping or telling us which part on the island we can go to find trees for camping, she keeps yelling chasing tourists away from the trees that were blocked. Her behaviour by all means is reflecting POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE!I would not come here again. NOT RECOMMENDED!!!

reviews.title: Funny!!!!
reviews.text: We started from Chania to go!!! The road dangerous in several places with narrow passages. We arrived at 9:00 in the morning. We parked in a huge parking lot and from there you go down a dirt road every ten minutes on foot... Many had babysitters who had to go down this messy road. Especially in the uptake after it is straight discomfort!! Sleeves not for sample. We asked for a price and they told us 30€ but you didn't play to find it until the sun reigned. There were some gaps that they had reserve... Your umbrella does not play to manage to attach as there is a lot of air and do not sit!!! When we left at 12:00 at noon it played to have over 2,000 people!!! Nice beach to get wet to take a swim and leave!!!Good luck!!!

reviews.title: Stunning Pink Sands and Crystal Clear Waters
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach is a paradise! The pink sand and turquoise waters are breathtaking. It's perfect for swimming and relaxing. The beach can get crowded, so arrive early. Facilities are basic, but the natural beauty more than makes up for it. A must-visit in Crete!

reviews.title: Return after 15 years ...
reviews.text: Elafonissi a very beautiful beach, still natural. The beach was pink..now after years of tourist passages,,which took away shells....so much pink is not.  Very nice water and is particular .Sicuramente recommended excursion .Unica thing, we had already been 15 years ago .. unfortunately now it is much more exploited at the level of tourist groups .. so it is not a deserted beach . Even there sunbeds and umbrellas. But not for everyone .. just for those who arrive early .. Anyway it is worth seeing. Take a bath.

reviews.title: Elafonsi July 2024
reviews.text: I must say that the beach was very beautiful and the sea looked like a swimming pool, but it was very crowded and taking a parasol was like winning the lottery. It is considered one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete and for this I expected it but I was not very enthusiastic. The sand is pink only in some places.

reviews.title: Disability experience at Elofonisi beach
reviews.text: I was hesitant to visit elofonisi beach as an ambulatory wheel chair user. The walk down the dirt road seemed daunting when researching the beach before hand. When my husband and I parked in the lot above the dirt road to enter the beach , a parking attendant noticed my wheelchair and guided us to the gate where we were then able to drive the 15 minute walk and access the beach from a closer area. There are board walks to get you to the actual sand, some areas are in rough condition , but with assistance I was able to get right to the umbrella area. The umbrellas are much closer to the water than I expected which was another bonus. Just wanted to share my experience as others may be in a similar situation , that some accommodations are possible to make the experience more accessible!!

reviews.title: Wonderful site without tourists 😏
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, one of the most beautiful ridge. Trip Tip in summer go early, around 9am there until noon because after the world arrive in packages and necessarily loses its charm. Victim of overtourism in the afternoon. Sunbed 20 euros and parking 5 euros.

reviews.title: Paradise on earth
reviews.text: The Lord gave us Heaven on earth. I Love Greece 💙🫶🏻... 20€ for a full day of umbrella and sunbeds in front of eternity ..? What more do you want. Arriving Max at 9:00 am is mandatory if you do not want to lie on the ground. With 1.30h drive from Chania. Road with some curves but asphalted and quiet to do. Organized parking 200m from paradise at 3/5€. Mandatory stop for those coming to Crete 😍

reviews.title: Worth only for your some pic all things considered
reviews.text: Overrated. Tourists have stolen pink pieces of shells.Overpriced sun beds.Parking business owners try guide you to their parking places but you can find parking much closer if you dont follow their guide.Worth of your some pic.

reviews.title: Fantastic place!
reviews.text: Fantastic place! There is good parking, cafes and toilets.  Quite a lot of people in July, but there is enough space for everyone :)

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with pitfalls !
reviews.text: Attention when choosing a parking space. Right at the beginning are several men who have allocated us a parking space at the end of the world (although you could still have driven 800m). The paid parking fee of 5€ is then only valid in this parking lot and must be paid again when repackaging further forward. Since they are ‘different companies’.The beach itself is beautiful but also very touristy (but you can expect that). For loungers you should be early;)Unfortunately, we could later watch two men stealing on the beach (around evening). So don't take valuables to the beach.Kiosk and toilet tip top

reviews.title: Fine, but far to go
reviews.text: Lovely place but a bit far to walk from the parking lot (which was organized by p-guards) and incredibly lots of people. Very shallow water, must go far and long to get to waist plus. But definitely an experience.

reviews.title: Very, very beautiful
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach on the island. The strip of sand that is created between the outcropping rocks creates a shallow lagoon with truly crystal clear water. Before choosing the day of the visit to the beach it is always better to consult the weather, with the strong wind (often present) is less pleasant but still beautiful. Near the beach there are paid parking lots (5 euros), do not be convinced by the caretakers (parking vendors) to park in the first parking lots you meet, it is always better to check for yourself if the one closest to the beach is complete (the cost is the same for everyone). Also in this resort as on other beaches there are umbrellas and sun loungers for a fee and some bars offering food and drinks.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: Wonderful beach with indescribable colors You have to arrive very early to find a free cot we arrived at 8:30 and we had no problems Too bad the crowding especially in the free part The price is worth the wonder of the place 30 euros 2 sunbeds and umbrella For the disabled you can arrive by car in front of the beach Beach not to be missed

reviews.title: The Caribbean in Crete
reviews.text: Beautiful beach... priceless sea... the top of Crete for me... on the way back Recommendation stopping by Statos tavern on the way as soon as you glimpse the gorge by car to return home...

reviews.title: Many people but unique place
reviews.text: Elafonisi is a beautiful and unique beach that they are trying to preserve from the crowds. so the parking has been set back about 500 m from the beach. do not stop at the first parking lots, the last one before the bar is huge and costs only 5 euros per day. then the descent is easy even for children, you get to the beach with umbrellas , two bars, the bathroom (1 euro) and the shower (free). Respect the rules, throw the waste in the many bins and do not make noise. The wind can be strong so you will need the beach umbrella, you will find it free only if you arrive by 9.30 (but already at 14 some leave). 20 euros in July umbrella and two sunbeds. of course this is the busiest part and the peak of crowds you have between 11 and 16. after it returns to be livable and is a paradise. if you can walk to the end of the islet in front there are benches and a church. the colors of the sea are beautiful change depending on where you are and the passing of the day and the direction of the wind. when we were there the wind was 20 knots in the middle of the day and is unbearable but if you go to the left there are more sheltered coves (I wrapped myself in the towel and slept).  We loved it, it's worth the wake up call at dawn, expect big crowds (it's a bit like going to Mont Saint Michel and then complaining).

reviews.title: Paradise early in the morning
reviews.text: Site remarkable for its landscapes, white sand colored red in places, crystal clear water... we take full eyes🤩 arriving between 8 and 9am.Too bad that from 11am the place is overcrowded by tourists who arrive by hordes (bcp bus,cars which explains the size of mandatory parking on arrival)The site then changes and its vision is no longer so idyllic...To do again out of summer season!

reviews.title: Ok beach
reviews.text: Nice beach with lots of wind but extremely many people. Va long to walk from the parking lot which also costs 5 euros. Had expected pink beach but that I saw nothing to.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach I've ever went to. Long beach with pink sand and turqouise shallow water. There are a lot of tourists, but since it's such a long beach it doesn't feel overcrowded at all. There are sunbeds, but if you would like to rent one you should come earlier in the morning. This beach is a must visit if you come to Crete!

reviews.title: It's just a shame, I've known the beach for decades, no sign of pink sand. Just mass tourism.
reviews.text: Just a shame, I have known the beach for decades and was always thrilled. Now I have to say just creepy I was there in June 2023 and immediately went again funfair in the Ruhr area is empty against it! Tried again in April 2024, although empty, there was hardly any trace of the Pink Sand. It is also no wonder as tourists have no respect for nature! Even fenced areas are settled to sunbathe there.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but world!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach crystal clear water, some pink sand by the sea.Lots of deckchair a little expensive (20 euros)Many people because beach very touristy but which remains accessible.Very large parking upstream of the beach.Allow 10-15min walk accessible to all

reviews.title: Elafonisis
reviews.text: From a naturalistic point of view nothing to say, the sea is beautiful... clear water, but too crowded .. at 10 there was no longer room, and you risk finding people 1 MT away... then pink there is nothing more... to be quieter I suggest to go a little 'beyond the main beach... and Recommendation also to bring an umbrella and lots of water ..

reviews.title: Paradisiaca... But on the island
reviews.text: It is something unique, the transparent lagoon between the mainland and the island where you can walk with water between your ankles or up to your bust... Only Recommendation, on the island you are quieter although I have already noticed the increase between the first and second week of July, you get wet maximum up to the lower back but it is absolutely worth it.

reviews.title: Disappointing and sad
reviews.text: 15 years ago it was a beautiful beach.  Today is a disaster.  Almost no pink sand , overcrowded beach ..... a lot of km for not much in the end . The Greek state should do qqch to preserve this place before it is too late.

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: Stunning scenery. We arrived by ten and were able to rent umbrella and sunbeds. In the late morning many people arrived but the beach is so wide that it is not affected. Da vedere!

reviews.title: Nice but for a while!
reviews.text: A different beach. Nice waters if you walk and pass the crowd. Pink sand you ⁇  do not see in the degree of photos circulating on the internet. Now that time you go there is people, as everyone reads the reviews that say to go in the morning! Now the route is okay is not ideal, but it's rough. As soon as you arrive you stop "various" telling you that below there is no parking space, you come in and park 5€ for the whole day. Walking you realize that you were "drunk" and that there were other parking spaces closer at the same cost (and more are being built). It has a mini market where you can buy various items. Below you will see they sell and umbrellas of sea, don't take, from so much air it doesn't stand. So get ready for enough sunscreen, hat and water. It has little walk to reach the beach, not of great difficulty.

reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text: The beach is within a protected nature reserve, the colors are wonderful, especially in the middle hours of the day, when the sun is high, the shallow waters form several islets between or which you walk in water of breathtaking beauty.It is very busy but there are many parking lots (5€ per day) about a kilometer from the beach. To get there you take a dirt road that is definitely feasible for those who can walk (to avoid if with strollers or prams and maybe in the hottest hours).There are some sun loungers and bars but most of the beach is not equipped to preserve its beauty. Windy, the umbrellas do not hold, you should go there early in the morning or after 16 when the crowd begins to drop.The sand is pink but it is not Barbie beach, pink are shades between the white sand, visible especially on the shore.

reviews.title: Different day trip..
reviews.text: We chose the option to go by local bus to spend the day there.(E ketel round trip about 20e)because I didn't want to drive..I had read that the road is a bit difficult and I didn't want to risk it.From Chania departs around 9am and back from the beach around 4pm.There are a couple of hours drive but the bus is comfortable and ours had air.They do not let food on board but you can leave the backpack down where the suitcases.There on the beach there are several cabins to buy food ice drink..everything..There is no shade and it is very easy to burn..Yes, there are people after 12h..but it is also not a crowd as described by people, and the place is plenty of room to get away from the heap..

reviews.title: Unique natural phenomenon
reviews.text: Incredible place, magic! He's walking! You get the necessary things, the umbrella doesn't stand up, you sit a little away! Unless you get sunbeds 20 €! It's not a beach for bathing

reviews.title: A beautiful piece of paradise!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach and lagoon with pristine water, and long stretches of sandy shoreline. The drive down is a picturesque one with deep valleys and huge olive groves. Be sure to be there before 9am otherwise bring your own umbrella as the limited amount available will be taken.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but.....
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with pool style sea, but the path to do on foot is not easy and two adults from other groups fell ruinously on the stones. I add the problem that starting from Kissamos with organized tour when we arrived there was no longer an umbrella available and for survival two of us redid the uphill journey to go buy two umbrellas in the bazaars near the parking lots. They should warn of the journey ahead and the possibility of not finding a place under umbrellas, that with the sun sinking you risk ending up in the emergency room. Last thing you have to hope the wind is not strong, the sand is worse than whippings and you go home breaded

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Crowded of course but still worth a visit. Very beautiful, very hot so bring some sort of shade with you ( very limited amount of sunbeds with shade available. Some walk to beach from parking lot, super clear and warm water, some pink on the waterline left. Super smooth sand

reviews.title: beautiful but impractical
reviews.text: beach very beautiful from a naturalistic point of view but completely impractical, strong wind everywhere, areas of shadows practically non-existent, very crowded. It's worth it for a bath but not for the day.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with pink sand and lots of shallow wading areas.
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach is widely known as "the pink beach" because of its pink sand.  It is a beautiful beach and would be perfect for families with small kids, as the water in most areas ranges from ankle- to waist-deep (on an adult).  There can get to be a lot of people, but the beach is large enough to handle it without feeling crowded in most areas.While the beach does have pink sand - thanks to the ground-up shells of local shellfish - it is not the flamingo pink that you may see in the pictures for the tour companies.  It's still a beautiful beach, but if you're looking for knock-your-socks-off pink, you will be disappointed.The drive there can be a bit... interesting.  If you're not comfortable driving on narrow mountain roads with the occasional switchback and a couple of blind corners, you may want to take a bus tour to get there.  Personally, I'm a control freak so I'd rather be driving than sitting up high in a bus and looking down at all that, but that's just me.The day we went was VERY hot by late morning, and VERY windy.  They offer sunbeds with umbrellas for rent, but there is a limited number available.  On the advice of a friend, we purchased a small beach umbrella for 15 Euros before we arrived and it worked perfectly.  You do want to make sure you push it pretty far into the sand - we saw a few blowing across the beach.  But it is worth it - there is not a lick of shade anywhere on the beach.Speaking of advice - passing along advice from a previous review.  If you arrive by car, park in the 3rd parking area (there is a huge sign above it that says "Mega Park" or something like that).  You can't go further - the road is blocked right after this lot.  It is only 5 Euros to park for the day and you pay when you leave.  There is plenty of parking here, and it's a shorter walk than the other lots.There is a decent walk down to the beach, so you'll want to stay for a bit to make it worthwhile.  The water is amazingly clear and refreshing on a hot day.  We found one of the few sheltered areas next to a hill near the snack bar, planted our umbrella, then went for a bit of a walk and a swim.  We hung out under our handy umbrella a bit for a break from the sun and a quick snack, then went back out to cool off for that walk back up to the car.Also - if you have the chance, stop by the Cave of Agia Sofia afterwards.  Again, a good climb, but it's an amazing cave with religious icons, pigeons, and it's free!  There's also a great little taverna to enjoy a quick break on the way back down.In all - as with most tourist spots, reasonable expectations help to avoid disappointments.  There is pink sand, but it's not glowing pink; it's a great beach for families or just to walk around, but it's windy and very hot in the summertime.  Still definitely worth the trip if you have an open day in your itinerary.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We hired a taxi service to take us from Chania to this beautiful beach. We arrived early, so it was perfect, but by the time we left, it was really crowded.

reviews.title: Great beach but watch the car parking
reviews.text: Great beach but gets busy. Go early if possible, especially if you want to take photos. Very very beautiful though!My one tip is if you’re driving, don’t fall for the car park scam. As you drive in you’ll see various people in hi vis, looking very official, flagging you into car parks, some of them quite a walk from the beach. Just drive by (they’ll try to stop you) and go to the bottom car park by the modern looking restaurant which often has spaces. If not you can always drive back up to the more empty ones.

reviews.title: Beautiful but VERY touristy
reviews.text: The beach is very beautiful, the water is crystal clear. For pink sand, I think we should preserve this site by limiting access. Too many people everywhere.It will cost you 5€ of parking for the day.  Lots of wind, and no shade.Nevertheless the site is worth a visit. This lagoon at the foot of the mountain is really beautiful. It must be much nicer in September or October.The restaurant before the car parks is quite affordable in terms of Award, and the view from the terrace is really beautiful.If you come from the north of the island (Chania, Kissamos), the mountain road is also worth a visit

reviews.title: It's not pink, unserviced
reviews.text: Absolutely in services, more than a km away between brush rocks and sun. Absolutely not pink, people sick on the way back, a van for emergency pay toilets.

reviews.title: Crystal Waters and a must see natural wonder
reviews.text: If you are going to Crete then this is a must. Getting there is not a breeze though as the island is well known for its scary as hell to drive mountainous cliff edge roads. We arrived around 11am expecting it to be packed but any earlier and we might not have had clear roads the entire way. Car parking is €5 which is really cheap. There are a few tacky seaside shops but do stick up ok water. Don’t take little kids. There is zero shade and you won’t get pushchairs down there and you’ll likely end up carrying them which it’s too unsteady and hot to do. Don’t go if you have limited mobility, it’s a place of nature so the Greek have not meddled with it and not should they. There’s a few sun beds and umbrellas at €20 a pair of beds otherwise it’s your beach towel. Water is stunning. Do walk across to Elafonisi island for the pinkest sand and clearest waters (and fewer people). Ignore the negative reviews, this is a 10/10 must see and visit.

reviews.title: Elafonissi beautiful, wild between nature and colors!
reviews.text: The view of this beach is absolutely spectacular. A sea of colors, pink sand and crystal clear sea, shallow waters. Ideal for long and relaxing walks. The beach is huge, beautiful and wild! There are paid car parks for those who come by car. Leaving the car you have to take a walk of about 900 meters on foot. So you can reach small well-served establishments with umbrellas and street for 20 euros, bars and toilets for a fee (1 euro), showers with room temperature water (not for a fee). Elafonissi is a corner of paradise to see and experience for those who come on holiday to Crete. Absolutely fantastic beach 🏖️!

reviews.title: To flee in high season
reviews.text: To flee in high season! Far too many people! parking is 5€ for the day cheap but not reported. Pink sand no longer exists because too many visits! We should preserve this site absolutely!!

reviews.title: Very pretty beach with a tinge of pink sand
reviews.text: Very pretty beach and worth the visit, however be aware it can get vey windy and the sand only has a slight tinge of pink to it.

reviews.title: Pretty, but preferred Falassarna
reviews.text: This beach is very pretty, but so not worth it. It’s packed with people, there are gale-force winds, and it’s tricky to find a spot to lay your towel out. The water in the lagoon is very instagrammable, but it’s too shallow to really swim (unless you’ve got kids). The pink sand is also not like in the pictures. It’s mostly white sand with pink patches, which are beautiful, but you can see pink patches at Falassarna beach, and it’s a much better, bigger beach. People were arriving in droves by 10 am, and we ended up leaving after just under an hour. To windy and crowded to really enjoy. And it’s hard to get good IG pics because of the crowds.

reviews.title: Incredible place
reviews.text: A really beautiful sea that is very reminiscent of the Sardinian sea, the sand is really pink, shallow and it is very pleasant to walk and cool down. Everything is so big that there were a lot of people but in the end you do not even notice. True that you have to arrive early in the morning, both if you want to take an umbrella (we arrived at 10 am and it was all full) and if you want to find a place near the trees where you can take advantage of the shade every now and then (Recommendation to the right of the establishment that we find ourselves in front of just arrived at the beach, there are trees that give shelter). The day was pleasantly breezy and therefore for me the best beach visited in this holiday

reviews.title: Not worth the visit. Too crowded and not pink.
reviews.text: I am so glad we read the some of the reviews before we travelled so we were not expecting much.It is indeed very overrated. Not a pink beach at all. Little sections near the shoreline have some pink sand otherwise it's just sand with a hint of pink. It's definitely not one of the best beaches, it's just a beach with shallow nice crystal clear water but packed with a few hundred people. I've been to many better sandy beaches with great views and a lot less people.We arrived early as recommended by other reviews, 9am. We arrived by car and ignored the first few car parks, as recommended and parked at the closest to the beach. It's 5 euros for the day. We were thankful we parked at the nearest one on the walk back to the car from the beach because of the heat it felt like a 29 minute walk.By 9am nearly all of the sunbeds were taken and within an hour or so the sunbeds were gone and also nearly every stretch of sand was taken. (20 euros for 2 sunbeds / 30 euros for 4 sunbeds)We watched holidaymakers trying to keep their umbrellas up in the wind with a few blowing away and nearly causing serious damage. We were thankful we had sunbeds and an umbrella. You really need some kind of shade as the sun is unrelenting.Toilets are 1 euro to use and guess what there were no queues for it. I guess the warm crystal clear water became a free toilet for many!I think that if you have absolutely nothing else to do and I mean absolutely nothing else ....and you want to spend some time with a few hundred people on a beach then make the long journey to this beach....otherwise read the reviews....you are not missing out on anything.... and give it a miss and find somewhere more worthy of spending your day.

reviews.title: Beautiful but not like the videos
reviews.text: So whilst staying in Kalyves we booked a trip to Elafonisi beach . After getting picked up and grabbing everyone else from the local area . We stopped for breakfast at a local honey place on the way for breakfast . Beautiful.Then the haul through the mountains, very tight for a coach but the driver knew how to drive.We got to elafonisi and it looked amazing. After a ten minute trek to the beach we found that it was absolutely packed ( the videos online are took late afternoon after all the tourists leave ) .Beautiful place and yes glimpses of pink but not like the pictures online where they’ve been enhanced with bright pink . Had the three hours there and enjoyed the scenery and paddling as it doesn’t get very deep . On the return journey we stopped at a taverna in the mountains and tried a local dish which was absolutely stunning. A very long day but worth it to say we had been .The diver and the tour guide were absolutely amazing and told us some great stories and history of the region .

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The road is long and full of curves but you get close, 5 minutes walk from the beach. Huge and equipped beach. Recommendation to arrive early to enjoy the place before the masses arrive. Mass that however in July is not perceived because the place is really great. Immense. You walk a lot and the water always comes to the calf. Incredible colors and lovely water walk. Paradise.

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Very nice place to swim especially when crossing a lagoon, go early in the morning to avoid the crowds. Pink color is not very visible but water clarity yes true to descriptionIt is a beach to make.

reviews.title: wow
reviews.text: one of the best beaches, just wow, the only problem is the road getting there. it is an hour and a half from chania. but worth it

reviews.title: Wonderful.
reviews.text: The beach is really wonderful. Nearby there are ample parking lots. You have to walk a bit (no big deal) and before your eyes a real wonder opens. In the most sheltered part from the wind, there is a bathing establishment and small bar with food and drink (and also some confusion!). Continuing and exploring on foot, there are places where the water forms natural pools: there are fewer people and it is truly a paradise. A spectacle: impossible to resist the temptation to take very long baths. If the wind allows, you can bring and plant your own umbrella. Crystal clear water. Wonderful.

reviews.title: A little paradise
reviews.text: One of the excursions to do absolutely Beach with coves and beautiful sea Equipped with umbrellas, (not many) better arrive early to find a place and toilet Pink sand in some areas.Unfortunately the photos do not do justice to this little paradise on earth

reviews.title: Elafonissi to fail
reviews.text: Good morning, I want to tell you what the elafonissi experience is really like.Then just to start the beach is not pink because they stole it all, then, to reach the beach from the parking lot you have to walk at least 1 km and a half under the sun and it's full of stones and there's no real path, you also risk falling between the stones and on the way back we found a strong wind so as to raise the sand and make it fall on us like so many knives, never lived such a bad experience in all my life.Then, if you want an umbrella with 2 sunbeds, according to them you have to go very early or at 14:00 or 17:00, because the places are few and 'absolutely not true that they are organized, if you want to pay by card you have to take a further walk to the bar, as well as if you want to get water.The problem (another ) is that if you don't have an umbrella then you have to put yourself in the shade and you have to think about it in the sense that if you have low blood pressure or are pregnant they don't give a damn, so the service sucks doubly because you are forced to find shade under trees where the Greeks don't even want you to go in fact they are fenced, but cmq was full of desperate people.As for the sea and 'definitely beautiful but the water and' shallow, you can find the same are with a little higher water and with a service 100 times better in falasarna.Elafonissi 1 umbrella and 2 sunbeds 20 euro.Falasarna 30, but those extra 10 euros are all earned they even bring you lunch under the umbrella.Greetings to all Italians.

reviews.title: Rimini in mid-August
reviews.text: Nice beach, nice view, in a very nice area of Crete. Being the most famous beach in Crete is worth a star for me.Perché ? Because when you arrive they charge you 5 euros for parking. I walk 10-15 minutes to get to the beach and this is fine because so the natural park remains intact. But once you get to the beach it seems to be in Rimini or riccione on August 15. Already when you arrived, we were about 10.15, lookouts already in snake of people walking towards the beach. Once down you see the delirium. People everywhere, both on the beach and in the sea. If you want to come and find tranquility here for sure you will not find it. A real shame about the place.

reviews.title: Place on the side
reviews.text: Parking: 5€ all parking so take the nearest one and don’t be fooled by the folders we can mistake for placiders Location: it’s beautiful yes but it’s really windy and we haven’t seen pink sand. There are people but we know that in the summer, there is still a lot of room not to be stuck to people. Water: very pleasant temperature, we walk away (ideal for children)What really ruined our experience was the wind, the pebbles in the water, the little shade and not seeing the pink sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful few umbrellas lots of crowds
reviews.text: Very nice but with few umbrellas, we arrived at 10:00 and it was already sold out. We parked at the last parking lot paying 5€. Then we left because so many people kept coming

reviews.title: Beautiful beach alayaa to there
reviews.text: On July 24, we started to go to this famous beach!!!!We woke up from 8 a.m. and after driving on a miserable and dangerous road we arrived.They didn't let us go down to the last parking lot and they forced us to park high.After walking a path we reached low to the beach where although it was 10 a.m. you could not sit because of the air but because of the clay. You couldn't put an umbrella.The air took it.At the return we had an obstacle the heat but the hills.... very beautiful beach alayaa.....it is for you to go see it and go...also....classic as in all of Crete....all for the profit....

reviews.title: Crowded paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but really too crowded, will be that we arrived around 10.30, uncomfortable walk to reach it obligatorily feet if you have the stroller.To fully enjoy it it would be advisable to reach it around 8-9 am.We arrived at that time did not find sunbeds available and so we took advantage of the shade of the large cedars near the beach to stay a little protected.Ideal for children as the water is really shallow and degrading so that to take a bath you have to go a little offshore.

reviews.title: Spiaggia meravigliosa!
