reviews.text: Comfortable beach, easily accessible with short walk and flat. White sand with pink shades and crystal clear water. The water is very shallow on the shore and rises gradually. You have to arrive by 9.30/10.00 to find umbrellas and sunbeds, because there are not many. Instead there is plenty of space for free beach. Great beach, must see!

reviews.title: What to do
reviews.text: Beautiful water, only catch he makes to be there very early to have a deckchair Watch out for the folders of the front car parks who try to get you into theirs, while further there is plenty of room 5 € per seat

reviews.title: Very Crowded & More like a Lagoon
reviews.text: We went to a lot of other beaches in Crete and this one was by far the most overrated. The parking was a bit chaotic and you had to convince a man to open a gate into the beach. The beach itself was very overcrowded and filled with trash near the water. We got there around 10:15 and were able to get the last sunbeds they had. The food was abysmal compared to standards around Crete. I think the biggest downside of this beach is that it is way too crowded and does not have any waves. It’s not much of a beach and more like a lagoon. The water is warm enough for swimming. The pink sand was nice but not much like the photos.

reviews.title: Good.
reviews.text: Nice beach for surfing and posing... It is a must on the island but as a beach it has much better... a lot of walking......

reviews.title: Dante's group
reviews.text: But the translation is perhaps...nightmare beach...a long way to go under the scorching sun, despite the countless whyggi down near the beach.Instead they make you park high on buses. Rivers of people going down and up, it's like a Dante ring.Trees that could make a little shade, sadistically are fenced so you don't go.Finally a strong wind that grinds you with sand. an ordeal that does not compensate for the trip

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Beach was ok, very few umbrellas or places for any shade or a break from the heat. We got there at 1100 and not a thing left. Thousands of people already before noon. Not really pink sand, at least when we were there - a little bit at the waters edge. Lots of parking - if you come before noon ignore the first few lots, there’s a big parking lot closer to the beach, as well as a few stores, cafes, washrooms. Lots of other beautiful beaches easier to get to and much less crowded.

reviews.title: Crowded !
reviews.text: It is not worth visiting during peak summer season as there are thousands of people at the same time on the beach. It is crowded and if you arrive after 10 in the morning there is no way to get into sunshade .We traveled al the way from Heraklion ( by car) and we do not recommend the hassle ! The water looks and feels good.To be honest, it is overrated and too crowded ! Stop advertising the pink sand as there are limited time frames where it is visible.

reviews.title: Disappointment!
reviews.text: Is Elafonisi really one of the best beaches in Crete? The answer is ambiguous. The distance from Chania you will spend in the car is definitely not worth it for this beach! The beach is boasted by all the tourist guides, so prepare for the globe. Prepare also for walking from the parking lot to the beach. The beach itself is rather indifferent, drowned in the world and you need to be there early to secure sunbeds... What about the pink sand? It is scattered here and there and definitely not as intense in color as in the photos you will see on the Internet!Prefer one of the adjacent coves, next to the main beach with the island if you want to find somewhere to sit and of course take a bath! In conclusion, beautiful beach but drowned in the world, especially in the summer! Surely there are better beaches in the area!

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in the world!
reviews.text: Amazing views, by far the most beautiful beach we’ve ever been to, if not in the world. Great snorkelling water, as there’s rocks with many species of fish to see. The water is clear and shallow enough to wade out and safe for both kids and non swimmers. The only negative is that’s it’s over crowded as there’s hundreds of people, however you’ll not be disappointed by the views.

reviews.title: A wonderful trip to Elafonisi
reviews.text: A wonderful trip, with a responsible, noble and pleasant guide, Vasilis and with an exciting tour by Mr. Dimitris, whom I consider the best guide I have met so far and who made me know the history of my own place more deeply!!A big thank you for such friendly, familiar, warm and human escort and tour that made this excursion to Elafonisi an unforgettable experience!!Goodbye!!

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and paradisiacal landscape but too touristy for my taste. I recommend arriving very early in the morning to enjoy.

reviews.title: Don't go.
reviews.text: I leave a negative review as highly overrated compared to many beautiful coves of clay. First of all we arrive and they signal us to park at that point, when later there was a huge parking accessible for a fee always at the same price: five euros. After that we arrive after one km, the beach was crowded and full of families with screaming children (we went to coves even on the weekend where we and the goats were). Not bad water but the problem was the very strong wind that lifted the sand. You couldn't even eat sand coming in and stinging you everywhere. Not even a shaded area to shelter from wind and sun. Absolutely not going there.

reviews.title: Beautiful water too bad the wind
reviews.text: Beautiful sea, shame the wind so strong that it pulled up the sand.Baths and showers for a fee a 1 euro xò the bar offered fairly low prices x a sea place.

reviews.title: It's worth being there for sure.
reviews.text: Nice beach! The water is clean, the sand isn't as pink as the Internet photo, but it's still beautiful very. There are places with puddles for children where the water is very shallow and warm. Sunbeds are 20€ for 2 pcs, on the beach cafe with food (pizza, baguette, burger and snacks) drinks and ice cream. Before going down to the beach cafe, restaurant and shops with food and inflatable toys, large parking (5€ day), the possibility to rent a room and tp in the shop drinks and food are of course cheaper than on the beach. It is better to arrive in advance, because sunbeds and places under umbrellas are dismantled very quickly. Toilet on the beach 1€.It was easy and easy from Chania, good road.

reviews.title: Not worth the hype!
reviews.text: This beach has lots of hype surrounding it. I was rather disappointed!No one tells you that's it's a 20min from the car park down a gravel and rocky path. Not for those with limited mobility or young child. Seen families struggle with prams.Once at the beach it had hundreds and hundreds of people on it which kinda takes away the shine of this beach.2 Sunbeds with a parasol and €20! To use the toilet it's €1! Food and drink was OK in price.The tour we took advised us to buy a parasol from the shop at the car park. Some people did but it was a waste of time as the wind just blew them inside out.You can walk across the water to the little island and this is where we seen the most pink sand at the waterline. It's also quite here. Some people carried belongings over the water to turn lie on the quieter island. We didn't as we done want to get out backs wet.The little shop at the carpark sells souvenirs which are OK in price. Also toilets in the carpark for €0.50!I wouldn't make this trip again  but my kids are glad we went today.Also the bus journey is up across the mountains so if you don't like heights I would recommend this trip!

reviews.title: A must, do it!!
reviews.text: Beautiful clear water, first beach in Greece with white soft sand, similar to Cayo Coco, Cuba. Highly recommend it, nice drive thru the villages.

reviews.title: No pink sand
reviews.text: Beautiful blue water but with the best will in the world can not discover pink sand.Way too busy. We turned right around.

reviews.title: Arrive early to avoid disappointment
reviews.text: What an absolutely lovely beach on the western side of Crete! With most popular destinations that tourists will flock to, getting here early to make the most of the beach and getting a good spot is paramount here. This review is based on our visit here in early July 2024. 1) It is quite a long and windy road to get here, if you are driving, you’d need to be a confident driver to navigate the narrow roads. 2) Parking - do not go to the first two places that will try and entice you in, go to the third parking place on the right where you pay €5 for the day upon leaving. 3) Sunbeds / Parasol. There’s plenty of choice if you get here early! We decided to opt for the parasols to the right and managed to get a sun lounger and the parasol at the front near the beach for €20 for a pair (it’s €5 extra if you want any more than two) 4) It will get busy so if you do arrive early, make the most of the water and empty space, busses and coaches full of people will eventually arrive - the beach is big enough to accommodate them all.5) The water is very clear and has some warm parts, it’s very child friendly as it goes up to knee hight, with the deepest park within the cove going up to roughly waist height. An absolutely beautiful beach with some elements of pink sand (not as pink as the heavily edited photos) and you can catch a wonderful sunset here. You can venture over to the other side, make sure you do, to discover another beach and pinkish sand! There is a bar which serves food and drink but will charge a lot more, I’d advise bringing your own food and drink and maybe use the bar/kiosk to buy an ice cream. There are toilets on site but they do charge €1 - we didn’t use them so I cannot say if they’re clean or not.

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Be careful, on arrival you will necessarily be guided to Parking, the track is to go down and up on foot, it is not long and hard, about 10 min, but to plan in case of small children for example.At the beginning of the trail there is a supermarket that sells beach items, cremesolar etc...Paradise beach, to see early in the morning 9am max, before the massive arrival of buses, The water is crystal clear, this Pink sand is really original, there is foot far, the fish are numerous and not fierce to the rocks.The umbrella + deckchair is 20 €, then 5 € per additional deckchair.There is something to eat on site, a snack; where the staff is very friendly; offers sandwich, pizza, gyros, ice cream cold drinks... There are cabins to change and showers to rinse.The toilet is 1 € per person.ET!!! Once you get back to the car park, a person will stand in front of the car, asking you to pay 5 euros for parking.BUT it is a beach to see in his life! Happy holidays!! 🇬🇷

reviews.title: Just too many people
reviews.text: First the good - the water is stunningly blue and nice and shallow so you can go out pretty fat to paddle or swim and it feels very safe. There are lots of places to get drinks and food but thankfully they have not got greedy and things aren’t too expensive. Parking €5 a day, water €0.60 etc. Two sunbeds plus umbrella is €20 but get there early if you want one. I’m sure it’s a v beautiful place to be at 8am or 6pm…The bad - what makes this experience a 3 is the sheer volume of people there. You may as well be in Benidorm in the school holidays, barely a space on the sand and everyone packed in like sardines. Parking is pretty far away so a bit of a rocky trek to get to the beach, so watch out if you have mobility issues. It takes a long time to get there on very winding roads and do not get stuck behind coaches (they leave at 3pm). Is it worth it? Yes, but only out of season or very off peak times

reviews.title: Tip , Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beach to visit there you will find: parking , umbrellas (if you arrive early) bar .Arrived do not stop at umbrellas but visit the beach across the shallow sea .A spectacle , if you need umbrella and towels you will find beautiful places .I recommend arriving early in the morning .

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful place ja nice beach. Sunbeds (20€ /pair) were little expensive. And it was a little bit hard to get down to the beach from the parking lot. But worth it!

reviews.title: A Mediterranean beach with a Caribbean feel
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach, incredibly big with very clear and clean water. You can see the pink sand in many places, resulting from coral and shell deposits. Shallow and so suitable and safe for little kids. Only drawback is the long walk to reach the beach, dusty and uneven in places it might not be right for you if you have lots to carry or mobility issues. Take an umbrella with you or buy one (10eur) before you start the descent to the beach especially if you arrive late. You won't find a place to rent one down there.

reviews.title: A must if staying in western Crete
reviews.text: This place is just as you see in photos! Stunning turquoise seas and some glimpses of pink sand. It is quite a walk from car parks- seems longer in the heat too. A sunshade of some sort is essential! Bar on beach very good prices. Parasols to hire bit pricey. Also a dry bag if you want to set up on island😉

reviews.title: Nice but too busy
reviews.text: Really pretty beach as long as you don't mind sharing a small amount of sand  with a huge amount of people. If you like lots of bodies on a beach then it's for you. If not drive along the coast road and find many other beaches not as crowded, but in my opinion far easier to access, and nowhere near as this tourist trap.

reviews.title: Pink beach
reviews.text: We arrived here around 18 so we easily found free parking, otherwise cost parking 5 euro dia.Poi we walked to the beach it takes 10/15 minuti.Spiaggia rosa really , shallow water, beautiful evening waiting for the sunset

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, spotless, immense. Perfect for children. Nothing to say, perhaps the most beautiful beach I have ever visited.

reviews.title: Is more beautiful in Greece
reviews.text: Camping insufficientToilets partially closedMinimarket not open at allRestaurant except pizza inedibleBe sure to take enough drinking water. Beach beautiful, butgives better

reviews.title: Nice water but overflowing
reviews.text: Clear water but soo crowded. Definitely be there early. We were there at 11:30 and all the beds were already occupied. If you keep to the right you come to a little quieter section and we bought an umbrella for 12€ upstairs before you run down. Is a good option though, this is nothing very firm in strong winds. And the blazing sun is too intense. Small snacks and drinks are available there. You also have to walk down and up again. Parking is available there for 5€. The path there is winding and the roads partly very narrow, but to create.

reviews.title: Nice beach but lots of people.
reviews.text: We really wanted to see this beach and it would be beautiful without all the other people who also really wanted to see this beach!It was very overcrowded at 11.00 on a Friday in June.  There was very very little shade available. All the sun loungers and umbrellas were already taken so I purchased two from the shop adjacent to the car park but it was too windy to use them. The water was nice and warm and there were fish to be seen. We left after about an hour.

reviews.title: Big disappointment
reviews.text: I wanted to discover this beach so much, unfortunately it was a great disappointment.It was like Palavas les Flots in the middle of August of the world to not finish... People were on top of each other.As for the pink sand I'm still looking for it...

reviews.title: Bellissima!
reviews.text: The beach and lagoon are very beautiful, the water is crystal clear and transparent. The experience is definitely worth it, too bad it was really too crowded. I highly recommend bringing the umbrella, those available are few.

reviews.title: Nice beach, worth a visit.
reviews.text: A very nice beach to visit, beautiful color of water and sand.But the water is cold, there are not enough sunbeds and it is very crowded.

reviews.title: In short:
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, more than lagoon beach, very suitable for families with children shallow water and crystal clear sea... a little less for those who swim ad na. Unfortunately very little equipped and without showers with a dizzying ascent to made under the sun.... You can see very little pink. Beautiful and wild but too crowded wouldn't stay there again

reviews.title: Beautiful but not pink
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach. You must go early to enjoy it without there being too many people around. Also, do not go expecting to see a lot of pink sand as there is not a lot of it.  You will see more pink sand at Balos.

reviews.title: Wonderful beaches, historic places and etc
reviews.text: An amazing place! With plenty of attractions for tourism with historical sites and a great reception, exotic food, just to remember I already miss

reviews.title: Discovering paradise...
reviews.text: After a short walk feasible even with children, you arrive in this wonderful lagoon. Pink sand and clear water. Ideal place for children because flat and shallow water.

reviews.title: Paradise, but...
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, a true masterpiece of nature!! Only problem: MAN!!!! Before arriving at the beach a depressing work of cementation is underway 😣😣. Lots and lots of tourists (and we are only in June).... The entrance to the beach should be contingent to limit as much as possible the damage 🙏 otherwise in a few years there will be little and nothing of this paradise ...

reviews.title: A must do experience!
reviews.text: This place is a must see experience! From the mountains on the way to the crystal clear waters when you're there. It is a very popular extraction so I would advise getting there early in the morning to ensure you get a sun lounger. We got there at 9:30am on a Sunday and had our pick on loungers. It got really busy from about 10:30-11am. When you walk onto the beach the main bit in front of you gets really busy so I'd advise going round the corner to the right where there are more loungers and we found it was a bit less crowded.The main car park is well sign posted and is at the bottom of the village. (Don't let the "parking attendants" flagging you down beforehand fool you as they are not part of the main car park, and you'll have further to walk down to the beach). The drive is quite the experience (in a good way!) Driving through and around the mountains.We brought our own food with us so I can't comment on the food prices but we did buy some alcoholic drinks from the huts on the beach which we thought were reasonably priced.

reviews.title: Not as good as Balos.  But a beauty none the less. Only a 4 as the 5 is Balos
reviews.text: A beauty of a beach. But. I must admit. Balos, in my opinion, is much much much … did I say much ? …. Better.  However.  If mobility is an issue, then Elafonissi is your top option.   The only reason this is not a 5. Is Balos is my 5.

reviews.title: Nothing special!
reviews.text: Touted as the best beach in Crete!!! Total disappointment if not for some nice onesBay off the beaten track. When we arrived it looked like a charnel house. Pink beach only on postcards! Islet crowded with tourists since early in the morning. Other bays and beaches are better, you can't understand the fame!!! Cheap beach or upon arrival stay to the right of the bay and continue on foot until you reach some small bays between the rocks that are worth the effort! The rest is completely commercial!!!

reviews.title: Not worth it at all
reviews.text: Long, special drive there.Parking for a fee.Many, many hundreds of people flock there. Completely overcrowded.No shade to be found. No umbrellas or loungers available.No pink beach, no pink water, nothing, not nice.Not worth it at all

reviews.title: Lovely beach shame it will no be the same in a few years.
reviews.text: Possible was just wrong timing. Drove 2 1/2 hours from rethimno. Road winding and tight in places. Stunning views. Got to car parks like a concrete jungle. Acres of stone car parks full to bursting with cars and buses galore. Walk down on stone track. Through another area of gravel that was the previous car parking area possibly??  Like a flattened industrial estate.  Got to actual beach and sea 🌊 standing room only. There are lots of umbrellas with sun beds. Walked into sea with 100s of others and after 5 mins headed back to car for drive home. Stunning beach just over populated. Environmental disaster in the making.

reviews.title: Mass tourism to the supposed hotspot - absolutely not recommended!
reviews.text: Buses full of day trippers make the pilgrimage to the supposed hotspot, only to find no sun loungers or no shaded place to lie down because everything is fenced in. The parking is OK at €5, but otherwise it's only worth visiting in the evening to enjoy the sea with definitely fewer visitors. It's quite exhausting for families with children, as there is a long, unshaded path down from the parking lot to the beach. The worst thing, however, is the crowds that are already there in June. I can't imagine what it's like there in August.

reviews.title: Great beach with plenty of people
reviews.text: Nice beach with hopelessly many people. We got there at 1130 paid 5euro parked.A good distance to walk from the parking lot down to the beach. There are always a lot of people down there, no sunbeds available, so bring your own chairs and parasol. Should have been there at 0900. We just turned around and went back to the hotel. Handicapped parking at the bottom of the gate, but not arranged to get a place all the way down.

reviews.title: Tourist rip-off!⚠️⚠️
reviews.text: Attention!⚠️ Definitely not from June to October! It's a complete rip-off!!!😱😱😱it's like a herd migration, despite there being enough parking spaces you are redirected to private parking lots kilometers away! 😤😤😤

reviews.title: Very nice beach with great water.
reviews.text: Super beautiful beach with crystal clear water. You can walk hundreds of meters into the water.We arrived with a rental car without any problems. The road is completely asphalted up to the parking lot (5€). The way there over the mountains is super beautiful. A few narrower sections of the road, but no problem at all. I can't understand these negative comments at all.It's worth going there in the morning between 9 and 10 a.m., when it's still very empty. Later, from 11 a.m. to 12 p.m., the beach gets really busy. No problem in the water, but not so nice for photos.The infrastructure is there and the prices are really reasonable. It's not a Michelin-starred restaurant, but you can get decent sandwiches, etc.The walk from the parking lot takes about 10 minutes and you can even walk with a stroller.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but very crowded.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, turquoise waters good to swim in, clean...... but...... it was so crowded because it's so popular, this the only reason I couldn't give it a full 5,its a bit of a scetchy trek down from the car parks, so if your a bit infirm it may not be for you. We drove down from Chania on roads that are turbulent to say the least so to be honest wished we had picked another destination but Crete is a busy place now so it may not have been different anywhere else.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful pink beach, a UNESCO heritage site.Beautiful sea, lots of nature and still little invaded by humans.You can get there by leaving the vehicle about 700 meters from the beach, the road is quite comfortable even if there is gravel and dust.There is the possibility of renting umbrellas and sunbeds. Possibility to eat and drink something in the local kiosk, equipped with all services (free showers and paid toilets).The water is very shallow and crystal clear so there is the possibility of taking walks to reach the seabed that has emerged due to the effect of the tides.If you go to Crete you cannot visit Helafonissi.Stupendous

reviews.title: Beautiful and amazing water…
reviews.text: Had read reviews that this is a tourist trap which I try to avoid. Can't agree, the only thing that cost was €5 for the parking. Incredibly beautiful area with turquoise beautiful water. We swam a bit on the outskirts where the surfers hung out and it was clear, nice water... Food, coffee, drinks, toilets, showers are down by the sea. Everything you could need. The walk was neither long nor difficult despite 35* and bright sun. Nice to have visited this famous place 🌸💖

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but with many cons
reviews.text: I have known this beach for years and I think it's a shame how it has developed. The pros are:Nice, shallow, clear water, fine, clean sand, serviced, toilets available for €1.The cons: absolutely overcrowded, even in the off-season, far too few sun loungers/umbrellas, price for a set €20. No quiet spot in the water because the Instagram victims use the space for their pictures. The car park directly on the beach has been closed. Now you have to park about 3km away, for a fee of €5 and then walk 15 minutes to the beach (rough terrain).My conclusion: If you want to see the beach, you have to go extremely early (before 10:00 a.m.) It's worth a visit, but not if you want peace and quiet.

reviews.title: Beautiful but too many people
reviews.text: There are no words to describe the beauty of this beach, but it is absolutely excessively crowded.To use the sunbeds and umbrella, you have to arrive at 8 in the morning, after two hours the beach is a mess.

reviews.title: Just beautiful!
reviews.text: Simply the most beautiful beach I have experienced! We arrived fairly early in the day and were able to obtain two beach chairs and umbrella. The food at the local food stand was fresh and delightful. The water and sand were soothing for my soul. Nothing negative here!

reviews.title: Elafonisi Beach: never again!
reviews.text: The island of Crete has many beautiful beaches, one of the best is Falassarna beach. There is enough space there and the clean water is wonderfully turquoise to deep blue.But why some travel guides praise Elafonissi beach so much seems more than questionable.Depending on where your hotel is, you will arrive at this beach after a more or less long drive through the beautiful Topolia Gorge, and see huge parking lots filled with small rental cars for which you have to pay five euros.After that, you walk for about 20 minutes along the dusty road until you see the oh-so-popular beach. But the small beach is not only overcrowded with all the tourists who have come by themselves, but also with those who were in one of the many dozens of tour buses and who were carted here.If you love this kind of mass tourism, are happy with 1 m² of space on the beach and want to pay a lot for parking and beer: head to Elafonisi beach!Our conclusion: Elafonisi is at least as uninteresting and crowded as the Blue Lagoon in Malta.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Very disappointed, first of all paid parking 5th, toilets 1st, a long walk and when you arrive it's crowded with people. We look for pink sand but I think that with the tourist surplus it is becoming more and more rare. Damage. The site, a few years ago, must have been splendid. Long road to be disappointed. It has become too touristy.

reviews.title: Hard to get to, pretty and busy
reviews.text: Getting to this beach from Chania is a long 90 minute drive through narrow windy roads.   Most people seem to drive slow and cautiously, so it did not feel dangerous, although it did feel long. Once you finally get to the beach, there are several parking lots. The closest one to the end of the road charges five euro for the day. From there, it is a 5 to 10 minute walk down to the beach through a wide dirt road. It’s an easy walk. The beach is small for the number of people there and very very crowded. It is pretty, although not pink at all. They have a couple of snack bars and beach umbrellas for rent, if you are lucky enough to find an open one. There is also a water sports hut, offering windsurfing rentals, wingfoiling, and standup paddling.

reviews.title: crowded
reviews.text: Beautiful beach if you come in March, but in June it is torture. It's so crowded that you can't even put up an umbrella.If you want to rent they charge you 20 euros, but that is free. Add 5 euros for the parking lot, from which you have a long stretch of relentless sun to get to.Add a hellish road from kissamos and you have a happy day.

reviews.title: אלפוניסי - אכזבה
reviews.text: במילה אחת אכזבה! בכמה משפטים: יצאנו במיוחד מקאליבס ליום טיול לחוף אלפוניסי וכמה אתרי תיור מעניינים בדרך (אגיה סופיה למשל מומלץ), כשהגענו לאזור החוף הסתבר שהחניות רחוקות מאוד! (לרדת לחוף מילא אבל כל הדרך חזרה בעליה ובחום לא שווה את המאמץ. אגב חניה, תתעלמו מהמכוונים בסרבלים צהובים ותמשיכו להתקדם עם הרכב הכי קרוב לחוף שניתן (הראשונים פשוט חאפרים ויכוונו אתרם לחניות רחוקות מדי). חוץ מזה, חיפשנו חול/מים ורודים - לא מצאנו! חיפשנו שירותים או מלתחות נאותות - לא מצאנו ברמה נאותה! חיפשנו סככות או כסאות ים - לא מצאנו בכמות מספקת! חיפשנו ברזיות או מקלחות מים מתוקים - כמעט ואין! בקיצור, רוצים ים צלול וחופים נהדרים חפשו באזור אלמרידיס, קאליבס, רתימנו ועוד. חוץ מזה אהבנו את כרתים והיא אהבה אותנו בחזרה.In a word disappointment!  In a few sentences: we especially left Kalyves for a day trip to Elafonissi beach and some interesting sightseeing sites on the way (Agia Sophia for example recommended), when we arrived at the beach area it turned out that the parking spaces are very far away! (Going down to the beach filled but all the way back uphill and in the heat not worth the effort.  By the way, ignore those aiming in yellow jumpsuits and continue to proceed with the vehicle closest to the beach possible (the former are simply diggers and will direct their site to parking spaces that are too far away).  Besides, we were looking for pink sand/water - we couldn't find any! We were looking for proper amenities or wardrobes - we couldn't find an adequate standard! We were looking for sheds or sea chairs - we couldn't find enough of it! We were looking for faucets or freshwater showers - almost none! In short, want clear sea and great beaches Look in the area of Almeridis, Kalyves, Rethymno and more.  Other than that we loved Crete and she loved us back.

reviews.title: Elafonissi - never again!
reviews.text: Warning about Elafonissi: We were there at the beginning of June. Even at this early time of the season, the lagoon is hopelessly overcrowded. By mid-morning, all the sun lounger sets were sold out. Most of the visitors who came in during the day couldn't even find a shady spot on the edge. We were lucky to find a small shady spot for our towels in a corner. That didn't stop a group of six people from crawling over to us, so that one lady almost lay on our towel. We have been to Crete several times and will definitely come back. But we have definitely crossed Elafonissi off our list. If you travel by rental car, you will find many beautiful beaches with few visitors, especially on the south coast.

reviews.title: Day trip with own car
reviews.text: Wow is all i can say this beach is sooo beautiful we arrived 1700 in the evening when the daytime tourists had been and gone it exceeded my expectations however word of warning to those who dont like heights the drive to get to it are hairpin roads sheer drops but oh so very beautiful the views enroute even if heights scare you are amazing and worth it  we stayed for about 90 mins just walking paddling taking in the sight not commercialised at all but   through the various villages enroute were tavernas restaurants and souvenir shops  dotted around. Would highly recommend hiring car and going to this beautiful beach our car was 50 euros and 20 euros petrol for the day but we saw loads of tourist attractions and some not tourist places that would never have got to see on a tour and saved money as the trip through company would have been 30 euros each

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Crete!
reviews.text: Blue-green transparent waters, shallow, suitable for children. Westerly wind (the one that catches all over western Greece) from noon onwards, so prefer a morning bath!! And don't listen to the naysayers about the walk, it's a 10 minute uphill road at least.. with a wonderful view for photos

reviews.title: Great beach, no shade
reviews.text: The lagoon is wonderful and the water is clear and warm. It really does have a Caribbean feel to it. Unfortunately, there are far too few umbrellas and loungers or the possibility of finding a shady spot. You have to be very sun-resistant to lie in the blazing sun for 4 hours and wait for the bus to come back.

reviews.title: FANTASTIC!
reviews.text: It is one of the few beaches in Crete that is famous for its blue-green waters, combined with the incredible natural landscape. Prefer the small beaches located on the islet after the lagoon, as long as you have the patience to walk there. The tranquility and beauty of the landscape will compensate you to the fullest. In several places and especially in the parts of the island, you can see the pink sand from the corals. It is worth visiting at least once. P.S.: The parking of the car is done at a long distance from the beach necessarily, either at any point, or in a parking lot by paying 5 euros. It's a good idea to equip yourself with water bottles and an umbrella.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches
reviews.text: One of the best beaches we have visited. The drive was a little scary some high mountains and no barriers. Scenery is lovely though. Car park €5 for the day which isn’t too bad. Walk down to beach you needed to be careful on the rocks. Toilets were €1Beach was busy but to be expected.Water was clear and traces off pink sand were visible. Water was lovely and you could go out as far as you wanted.Well worth the drive to see and to spend a good few hours.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand and low waters ideal for families with young children. It is a 5 minute walk from the car park and can be very busy even in the off season.

reviews.title: Vastly Overrated
reviews.text: Vastly overrated. Pleasant enough but nothing spectacular, and although traces of pink could be seen if you looked hard enough it’s a real stretch to call the sand pink. People were packed like sardines even in relatively slow times. Nice scenery on both of the main roads leading to the beach. In all honesty not worth the considerable effort to get there.

reviews.title: OVERRATED
reviews.text: Only positive point: the crystal clear water 🌊The negative points : - a commercial beach, everything is paid for (parking, deckchair, parasols, etc.)- a beach crowded with people- be wary of retouched images... you have to look and be very vigilant to see the few grains of pink sandNot worth the detour…

reviews.title: You can but you don't have to
reviews.text: OVERRATED OVERRATED AND OVERRATED AGAIN. It's miles away from pink. Mass tourism like no other. You'll have to pay €5 for parking BUT: what's on offer is ridiculous. If you want to lie down (lounger with umbrella €25) or stand on the beach (which is anything but pink) with what feels like 100,000 people, then you've come to the right place.

reviews.title: Yes for the beach, no for the pink sand
reviews.text: Very pretty beach, but you have to go early, it fills up quickly and we were there in May. in high season it must be crowded. if you go there for the “pink sand” on the other hand, forget it!!   it is barely visible. disappointment. If you are looking for a place to eat, go without hesitation to the Taverna Kalomirakis Family, very warm welcome and very good meal at reasonable prices.

reviews.title: good but nothing more
reviews.text: pretty but less than what people say the sand is more slightly pink in places. more touristy and oversold than it's worth the sand is wet so laying out your towel is complicated. there is no toilet shade available for a fee 1st

reviews.title: Paradise & more
reviews.text: Lot of points to share 1. Public Transport to elafonisi  - absolutely convenient , from KTEL central bus station Chania - reach by 8.30 and the bus is at 9 , buy tickets from window , 22 euro return journey (43.90 precisely for couple) . They take out your bags and keep in storage area of bus , except water & your cross bag nothing is allowed so finish your coffee & croissants before entering. There is a good outlet at bus station to enjoy a coffee and snack if you have started early & had no time for breakfast. 8.45 boarding starts & 9 sharp bus leaves. It took us 2 hrs ( goes via Kismoss) , buses comfortable, AC . Scenic journey through mountains ( left side) , sea views( right) . Bus waits whole day at the beach parking & return at 16.00 hrs ( in Chania around 17.30 return was faster than going) . From parking you will walk a kilometer or so to reach the actual beach . 2. What to carry - food: at the parking itself there is a nice shop that sells food & drinks , other accessories. It is decently priced with chicken beef sandwiches etc at 3.50 euro and water big bottle 1. Euro, ice creams 2.50 ish and other bakery products like pies , vegan option available too. So as you get down you can pick your picnic but only hitch is half of the bus crowds enters the shop & it’s queued . I carried our own picnic , mat . Beach umbrellas seats are sold at 20 euro 5 euro extra bed. It’s super sunny and there is absolutely no shade where you can lay your mat. So if possible carry a beach umbrella or be prepared to stay under sun or spend 20 euros. At the beach itself there was just 1 shop half closed half open ( may 20,2024) may be in summer there will be more but best is to have your food drinks stock with you . 3. The beach - the beach is dreamy & a must visit I will say. The waters is like Maldives , crystal clear blue with soft white sand. Best for kids & non swimmers . It’s in fact a very different beach than I have ever seen sure you can have spots with deep water to swim but the main attraction is the 2 lagoon like beach sections yes sections as first 1 kilometer of stretch is shallow ( and such wide stretch ) and you can literally walk through to reach the another small sand bay which again is extended to next water stretch again walkable , standable. How much crowded it gets you can still find your private spot to swim it’s that large & wide. Water shines like diamonds & truly it’s magical . Kids & adult both will be smitten by its beauty. There are restrooms 1 euro , covered changing spots free. 4. Pink sand - yes the sand appears as white at first but as you enter more and especially at second lagoon you see stretches of pink colour , it’s beautiful truly . You can easily carry your mobile or camera and take pics , let your hat & sun glasses stay on you as the beach is more like a huge huge salt water swimming pool without waves , calm absolutely. You have to experience its beauty to know what I am saying . 5. Return: my advice is carry your picnic and save budget for return snacks. After swim & change to be in bus if 4 you must leave the beach atleast at 15.15 to walk comfortably and reach parking by 15.45 . It’s a mild uphill & sun is sapping your energy. Then you can enjoy an ice cream in the parking shop . So much worth the expense 😀. Bus leaves sharp at 4.00 and I think KTEL is doing a fabulous job for people without car. 6. For those who drive , ample parking available at euro 5 ( I assume for day ) and roads are good , steep mountain curve so be prepared for showing off your good driving skills . If you have car I will suggest come by 15.00 do sun is milder and beach gets emptier with all bus crowd returning . Sun sets are beautiful & dreamy I have heard not seen. Hope this helps , enjoy your visit . You will see lot of olive trees. I did not take much pictures as I loved to swim more but there are plenty of pictures on google & I confirm that matches the site.

reviews.title: Amazing beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Crystal clear water and pinkish tinged sands at the shore. You can walk out a long distance, including to and around the island.  Be prepared for a little walk from the parking areas. Bathrooms (1 Euro) and some food is available at the beach. Drive from Chania is pretty, but the small mountain roads can be congested. Great mountain, gorge, and small village views along the way. We took a different route along the coast back to Chania to avoid traffic. It was beautiful but full of harrowing switchbacks, so I suggest sticking with the main roads (Google map directions).  A set of lounge chairs and tiki umbrella was 20 Euro, but they fill up fast.

reviews.title: Overestimated beach
reviews.text: Overestimated beach, not competitive with most of nice italian beaches. Don't understand why do famous. Moreover high prices for everything.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Fantastic, there is no other word! The water is so clear, the landscape magnificent...and the road to get there is splendid.

reviews.title: very nice beach!
reviews.text: were there in April and there was very little going on. The weather was great and the water was fantastic😍 the drive there with the narrow streets was an adventure in itself😅

reviews.title: a site to visit
reviews.text: Pretty beach, reception from the well-organized parking lot. The space and the beach are magnificent.Staff on site welcoming and at your disposal.

reviews.title: Too expencive
reviews.text: The Beach itself is nice, but the sunbeds are 20 € a pair in May! That is just a bit too expencive. Also the parking is 1 km away from the beach and it cost 5€. The road down to the beach is not that easy to walk, so good shoes is a benefit. I do not recommend, it's not worth the money.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach that shimmers slightly pink. Very gently sloping beach, so very suitable for children. We were there on Sunday and it was very busy.The parking fee of 5 euros is fair, as there are actually no additional costs. The toilets are awful, hygiene is a foreign word here.

reviews.title: nice beach but sand not necessarily pink
reviews.text: In May there were relatively few people but in high season it must be crowded. Still worth seeing. It's easy to access and there are still a few places with shade. The water was too cold for us but people were swimming (shallow water)We were supposed to see the beach during a plane flight but the wind did not allow us to go that far.

reviews.title: Lafonisi
reviews.text: Charge 5 euros for parking. The mini market is expensive. Charge to use the toilet. Twenty euros for the sunbeds, and the employees are rude, too bad I thought they were old men in Crete, and how the lavender characterizes them, but it was lost as it seems and false magic took its place.

reviews.title: Friend
reviews.text: I love the place and the people, I love the countryside, I love the landscapes, I love raclette, I love the view!! Commmmo lo pestro my friend

reviews.title: Don't waste your day,  overrated.
reviews.text: Elafonisi "Pink beach " You'll read online that this is one of the most beautiful beaches in Europe. This is in our view an overstatement.  Elafonisi is nice but nothing that takes your breath away. In all honesty it is EXTREMELY OVER-RATED and looks nothing like the tour brochures you'll see or what they want you to believe. The drive will literally drive you to drink 🤣 or want to. Winding narrow roads,  sometimes with sheer drops at the side of them.  No wonder they have a RAKI house on the way 🤣 Difficult at times for 2 cars to pass,  so imagine a bus 😳 as you'll see in one of the photos. You have to be extremely careful, especially after stopping by the RAKI house 🤣which is highly recommended before and after. There's a tunnel that is barely as wide as the car,  its one way and not very well lit, even with your lights on, it's along the winding road with next to nothing for a barrier. There's a light along the drive that tells you when you can drive through the tunnel.  I couldn't enjoy the drive back up...it was so stressful when the bus turned the corner and the vehicles coming down had to back up in order for him not to drive off the road.  Extremly narrow in some parts including through the villages, so imagine the heart of tourism.  No thanks!!!The mountains are stunning driving down but hard to enjoy with your focus on the narrow passages.  Like my companion said you have to focus on the road otherwise you'll go over the cliff.  I think if you insist on seeing Elafonisi that a boat tour is better. There were very small traces of pink in the sand where the sea laps the shore and that was about it. Nothing spectacular. Lots of parking for 5€ , but the walk down the gravelly road is not wheelchair accessible and you have to watch your step regardless so you don't twist your ankle.  The walk down to the beach and back up is an arduous one especially in the boiling sunshine. Signage isn't that great for trails that take you down to the beach.Walking back.... humid as hell.  Make sure you have lots of water on hand. 10+  minutes from the parking lot to the beach. To use the toilet,  if that's what you want to call them it will cost you 1€And to rent a beach chair is 20€ for 2/10€ each. 2.5x more than other parts of the island that rent lounge chairs, which have much more to offer in facilities, accommodation and scenery.  Beach chairs packed like sardines with tourists.  Windy as hell, apparently even in the heart of summer its known to be quite windy. Only a couple of cafes and slim pickings for accommodation. Massively over populated beach with tourists before the heart of the season.  Very shallow water that's great for kids.Would I go back? NoWhy? Because there are many other places on Crete that have beautiful sandy beaches, turquoise glistening sea and views that will take your breath away.  The drive from Kaliviani Kissamou to Elafonisi took an hour. It will be a nightmare in the heart of tourism. We returned to our glorious accommodation after less than 2 hours at Elafonisi and reserved for an additional night before leaving the area.Our accommodation was the highlight of our adventure as well as the scenic boat tour to Gramvousa and Balos Lagoon which are worth the time to visit. This is my honest review based on my personal experience and I know my companion agrees with me 100%.

reviews.title: Not so pink as you think
reviews.text: Convenient parking right next to the attraction, 5 euros for the whole day. The beach is not as pink as in the colored photos, but it is still impressive. Hot water.

reviews.title: Good, not great
reviews.text: We read that this was one of the most beautiful beaches in Europe and drove 2.5 hours to explore. It really is a beautiful beach but very crowded. We arrived at noon so maybe it would be better if you got there really early. We parked and walked abt 20 mins to get to the beach, which I don’t really mind. It was an easy walk.  The pink sand was just sorta pink. All in all, I’m not sure I would go again just because of the crowds.

reviews.title: Not as in pictures
reviews.text: Nice beach, but not with pink colors in the sand while we were there. First of the season with good space, and clean and tidy.Stand cafe with ok prices and good service

reviews.title: The Paradise
reviews.text: It's really worth the getaway. Beautiful wherever you look at it. We went from Gouves Beach, about 7 hours round trip is worth it. 5 euros for parking and a bit of walking. The landscape is crazy!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach! 🌊😍
reviews.text: This beach is stunning with beautiful clear waters and a pleasant temperature, making it a fantastic place to relax and enjoy. Keep in mind that there isn't much shade, so come prepared. You'll park your car and walk a few minutes to reach the beach, but it's worth the effort. There's also a canteen on the beach in case you get hungry. All in all, this is a must-visit beach! 🏖

reviews.title: PARADISE
reviews.text: Beach that looks like it's from another planet, the water is clear with shades of turquoise. The sand, imagine it's pink, only access is a little difficult, but it's worth it as I took wonderful photos of the mountains.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We used a tour operator who took us back to this magnificent beach with translucent water. Wonderful !! The water is not pink as shown in the photos but it remains a very beautiful beach. When you arrive at the car park, it takes 10 minutes to walk to the beach. Toilets cost 50 cents near the parking lot and 1 euros on the beach. there is a bar at the entrance which is shaded which is not the case on the beach. Bring a hat, good cream and water because it can be very hot there.

reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous
reviews.text: Stunning Beach. Despite cold water in early May, we loved the beach nonetheless. It’s a gorgeous beach. Anyone who says otherwise isn’t being accurate.I’d read reviews mentioning challenges parking, a long walk to the beach and crowds. In early May, we had no trouble parking our car or finding a private spot further down the beach. The walk from parking isn’t short, but it’s absolutely worth it unless you’re hauling a lot of stuff or not able to walk very well. No beach is fun when overcrowded so I can’t speak as to peak season, but I can confirm that the beach is beautiful and with warm water it must be amazing.

reviews.title: Unfortunately, to flee
reviews.text: Beautiful place, really, but too touristy. I can't imagine in the middle of summer...Non-existent pink sand. Too much road for nothing.

reviews.title: Suffering
reviews.text: If you exclude the beautiful beach, you will leave there with a cold from the wind that blows all day, and it will make your nerves ragged, the weather is not even a correct forecast because the place is completely western and you will find yourself in front of surprises with the weather. Never again, unless you are nearby and want to go for a bit and a dare... Taverns are also very expensive...

reviews.title: Absolutely worth doing
reviews.text: Wonderful beach... leaves you speechless..Despite the wind we still managed to swim... the water was cold but bearable

reviews.title: Beautiful beach  a must see !!!
reviews.text: Stunning beach with pink sand.  Amazing shallow water which links to other parts of the island. Well worth visiting especially  if you're staying in Western Crete. There's plenty of space to  get away from the crowds which is what I  prefer to do.  If you want to avoid the crowds then best to go early in the morning before the boats of tourists arrive or  and even better option would be to rent one of the  nice apartments on top of the hill so that way you can have the place to yourself and take in the incredible sunset.

reviews.title: As everyone says, busy and beautiful
reviews.text: 5 stars for nature doing its thing and being amazing. 0 stars for the over-tourism here. And yes I know we are all to blame! Elafonisi beach really is stunning, I’ve never seen such clear and shallow waters that reach for metres and metres out to sea. Plus the fish life is also incredible and they get so close! I spent ages just watching them dart around below, so clear and right there. We knew it would be a bit of a risk going at the very start of the tourist season but we so wanted to see it for ourselves and we stayed only an hour away.We walked the track from the car park which was pleasantly empty when we arrived at around 11am on an early May Thursday, and turned left as we got to the beach, finding a small little mini-beach between the rocks with only one other couple. Maybe we had something good going on here, we thought, as we watched the main beach get busier and busier and busier. But alas, after an hour or so of blissful solitude, exploring the waters on our little patch, more humans kept flooding in to our little cove and just did not stop to the point where we were squashed up against the rocks of our little sandy patch, by the sea. We called it a day after sticking it out for about 3 hours and so wanting to make the most of the most incredible sea waters we’ve ever seen, and headed back to the calm of our AirBnB for the afternoon. I think it would be a real gem to see the natural beauty of this place in the middle of a cold December or January for example. I don’t even know what the solution is with places like this! It will only get worse through the season and through the years and this was only May. We came, we saw, we left, we’ve ‘done’ it!

reviews.title: Ugh
reviews.text: A lot of overrated opinions for this beach in my opinion.The pink sand is minimal and the place is crowded with people so it is difficult to enjoy it during the summer.so-so

reviews.title: Pink sand
reviews.text: Very relaxing place with a pink sand beachOn the other hand, I recommend taking a hotel because the road is tiring if you come from the Heraklion side.

reviews.title: Disappointing.
reviews.text: Totally disappointed with this beach, the pink sand, almost non-existent, you have to know it and look carefully to see it. Even if the landscape is magnificent, this beach is not worth the detour.We preferred the Balos lagoon 100 times despite the gray weather and the difficult access road.

reviews.title: Parking scam
reviews.text: We are returning from Elafonisi Square.Magnificent place with a dream landscape. T⁰ideal and uncrowded in the season.A pleasant time with the family until we left by car where we were asked to pay 5 euros for 2 hours of unspecified parking at the entrance.

reviews.title: Beautiful but worth it
reviews.text: Superb site which is worth it after a 3.5 hour drive from Heraklion, including 37 km in 1 hour in the mountains.The pink sand can be seen but is not obvious.At this time not too many people but in summer it must be hell.

reviews.title: A must see
reviews.text: Magnificent beach. Visit the island on foot. Large sand dunes. Small coves. Very pleasant for swimming despite the wind.

reviews.title: Visit April 2024
reviews.text: Magical place.Heavenly beach with the mountain in the background. A true taste of paradise. It’s really something to see.

reviews.title: Unavoidable
reviews.text: In this month of April, not too many people, the good friend crossed the lagoon to go to the open sea behind the dune, few people and a magnificent beach.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach with lots of nooks and crannies and easy access
reviews.text: Splendid place! The water is turquoise, the sand pink. Access is easy, parking (paid) right next door and several restaurants (only one open at the beginning of April). You only have to walk 10’ to get to the beach. We also went to Balos but we preferred this beach!

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: İt's an amazing beach with the pink sands although a difficult transport there. Maybe reaching it with a boat tour is better.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with clean water. Beautiful surroundings and a nice place to relax, enjoy the weather and swim. However, we were just a little disappointed that the sand is nowhere near as pink as it is described and seen in pictures online.

reviews.title: Blue-green magic!!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with turquoise waters! Another magical beach of Crete! You should definitely visit it! Magic!

reviews.title: Very pretty, LOTS of people
reviews.text: We had high expectations regarding this pink sand beach, often listed as the best in the world. You have to spend a lot of time getting there, from Heraklion it is more than 3 hours, from Chania an hour and a half.Upon arrival it is very poorly organized, the parking lot is very far away, you have to walk quite a bit with a strong sun between stones and dirt. Now on the beach the sand is not as pink as in the photos, only in small stretches and there are a lot of people and wind. There are no services, bathrooms with queues and very few, the spaces to disturb on the beach are taken by stalls where they charge, generally very messy and expensive.We walked towards the central point and things improved a lot there. Fewer people, more depth and turquoise colors in the water and a bit of the famous pink sand. Bellaplaya but complicated, I would not return.

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Incredible experience, wonderful place!! The person who took us was Victor, a wonderful person, very polite and attentive, a great professional!!

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: This is a must-do on Crete!  We enjoyed the drive and had a great time at the beach, but please load up on SPF!  We saw so many people burnt to a crisp and even got burnt ourselves despite using sunscreen.  The sun is no joke here.  The pink sand isn't as pink everywhere as social media portrays it to be -- but it's there!  The water was clear and beautiful.

reviews.title: Give it a miss unless out of season.
reviews.text: This is so sad.  We went to Elafonisi many times - but over 10 years ago.  What on earth have they done to it!.  The beach and water cannot have changed but we couldn’t see it for hordes and hordes of sun beds (hugely expensive) and even more hordes of people.  Parking was a Joke - an absolute free for all.  If lucky enough to find a space you then cannot find any shade at all or in fact any space to sit sun or shade!Admittedly we were there in August last year so expect crowds but not on that scale.I think the only time to see it as it should be seen is to go very out of season.  If you can’t do that then really don’t bother - there are many other lovely places on Crete.

reviews.title: Morning/Day Trip to Elafonissi
reviews.text: We loved going to this beach! It was a very cloudy day which made it actually too cold to swim in the late spring time, but we greatly enjoyed the trip nonetheless. We drove about 1.5 hours from Kissamos down a very scenic drive (just don’t do it if it’s going to rain/storm!) through the mountains. There we stops for food along the way, which we used on the way back for a lovely cafe lunch. The beach itself had plenty of parking if you arrive EARLY (8am-9am). Once we left around noon, a flood of people arrived (off of cruise ships docked nearby it seemed), along with a storm. The beach is huge, unique, diverse, and truly beautiful even from the ground view. Bathrooms require payment, be prepped, and they made us pay for seats even though we left soon after arriving due to the rain storm, which wasn’t very fair. But the location itself was wonderful.

reviews.title: The blue paradise of Chania
reviews.text: Elafonisi is more than just an island; it's a paradise.The beach boasts a remarkable diversity: tranquil coves for those seeking an easy swim, rocky areas perfect for snorkeling (with an impressive array of fish), deeper waters catering to experienced swimmers, a shallow bay ideal for children; there is a place where water sports enthusiasts can rent boats, but we didn't reach it.There are both organized beaches, requiring tourists to pay a fee, and free beaches, especially in the dunes area.Access to Elafonisi is possible both by water and public transport. From the north coast of the island, you can reach it from Chania or, even more conveniently, from Kissamos. However, it's advisable to book your ticket in advance, as the two or three daily runs are insufficient to accommodate the large number of tourists eager to visit the beach.

reviews.title: beautiful without tourists
reviews.text: It was amazing! it was very nice weather and the beach was empty and beautiful. The sunset was magical. no coaches and endless tourists are fantastic!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: The beaches are magnificent. The water is cool and the coasts windy, we went there at the beginning of June, it must be different in summer. The landscape is wonderful. The children have fun and can have fun peacefully.As for parking, don't stop at the 1st one when you arrive, there are several further down as you get closer to the beaches. It is truly a place to see.

reviews.title: Lagoon
reviews.text: It's a shame that the water was cold (September). There are also very dirty corners, humans don't respect anything. Too much people...

reviews.title: WHY MANY CENTURIES AGO IT WAS NAMED AND CALLED LAFONISI AND NOT "ELAFONISI"
reviews.text: Lafonisi, as the inhabitants of the surrounding area called it and have been saying it for centuries, it is called, not Elafonisi which was originally written by some stupid etymological illiterates and many imitate them until now without thinking that it is neither shaped like a deer nor has it ever lived.. .deer on this small island but also throughout Crete. The etymology is from the verb λαπτο = to swallow to devour and it means a place that (because of many reefs there) swallows ships. There are many shipwrecks from thousands of years in its surrounding seabed with the most dramatic being that of the ocean liner Imperatrice (Emperor) around 1930 when many of its passengers drowned and others were saved thanks to the heroism of some excellent swimmers from the surrounding villages...From the ancient verb lapto (see e.g. the 8th volume of Liddel&Scott's Greek Dictionary) with the usual conversion of the labial π to the labial φ or b (like for example the ancient verb Απτο becomes Αφτο and from an = Απτο / Ανάτο the light. "I light the lamp or turn off (light) the fuse". From lapto came the newest verb of the Cretan dialect "laftako" or (c)laftako. "Laftaka (or glaftaka) the water or oil in a container that we hold to pour into another, for example, it means that it is strongly agitated, risking spilling on us. Also probably the word booty because these were objects washed up by the sea from cargoes or shipwrecks of ships after heavy seas.Kostas S. Doudoulakis, associate teacher, scholar of the Greek language and etymology of the West Cretan dialect.

reviews.title: Handsome
reviews.text: The place is beautiful, the water fantastic. Clearly you have to take into account that there are many tourists and that a strong wind often blows.

reviews.title: THE beach to go to near Chania
reviews.text: beautiful beach, chairs available for rent, very good restaurant on the beach, easy access and they deliver to your beach chair

reviews.title: Boccaperta😜
reviews.text: After twenty years it has evolved touristically but still quite natural, no longer wild as it once was but always enchanting especially in this season.Breathtaking 😎

reviews.title: Spectacular!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have seen in my life. Not very difficult to reach, it is always very crowded, but thanks to its vastness it holds up well to the impact... Just don't stop at the first umbrellas... A bit of a walk is worth the view. The services are well maintained (free bathrooms and showers) but they are close to the car parks, so to enter the wildest and most beautiful part you need to go with a minimum of organization (umbrellas, water etc.) unless you want to go back to "the civilization". There are some designated areas where you cannot enter to protect the landscape and that seems correct to me. Highly recommended place for snorkeling.

reviews.title: A postcard place
reviews.text: A wonderful place which, even if it has undergone strong tourist exploitation in the last decade, remains a naturalistically intact place. A beach like no other in Europe, a lagoon with shallow water where you can walk in the water for hundreds of metres. Crystal clear water, shades of blue, emerald green and turquoise, pink and golden sand frame this wonder. There are two or three bars on the beach where you can buy food and drinks at average prices. It's an easy walk to get to the beach from the car park. In high season there are a lot of people but in June the beach was very liveable.

reviews.title: perfect
reviews.text: It is a wonderful place to visit, I will return very soon I recommend it, it is perfect.greetings everyone see you

reviews.title: Stunning paradise...
reviews.text: Breathtaking Beach.  Crystal blue and turquoise water as far as your eyes can see. Soft sand, some pink sand at the waters edge. I must see.

reviews.title: Gorgeous slice of paradise
reviews.text: Really amazing beaches, all with slightly different characters and all idyllic.We went in October at the end of the season and it was busy, I imagine in peak season it would be too crowded to enjoy fully- October definitely a good time to go. Really stunning place.

reviews.title: Only for instagram photos
reviews.text: Positive: Excellent beach suitable for familiesDisabled access to the shoreNegative: from the parking lot you have to walk on an uneven dirt road for 15 minutes (with the watch!!!!) ....1€ toilet fee. (Don't get lucky!!!!) …..5€ parking fee….20€ the set of sunbeds …..

reviews.title: Finally car...out!
reviews.text: Elafonissi is certainly one of the most beautiful places on the Cretan coast. And finally the authorities realized that a first step to guarantee its best conservation was to remove cars, coaches and campers by setting up parking lots a few hundred meters away. Furthermore, the access areas on the dunes have been demarcated. Well done. Although it is difficult to keep thousands of people at bay every day. Even in October at the end of the season.

reviews.title: Worth the drive to get there! Stunning
reviews.text: Wonderful beach - remote and beautiful, really worth the slightly tough drive to get there! The water is just fabulous, if you like a little adventure and nice beach -- this is a must do!

reviews.title: Good place not to miss once in Crete
reviews.text: The beach is large and ideal for families with young children. Laggon is very shallow water, water is very clear. You can spend 2-8h all day if you like.Just remember to drive down the whole street and do not get fooled from "official parking place guides" - there are 2 or 3 parking lots private but directly before beach is the Mega Parking for beach and costs as well 5€, but you save 1km walking......

reviews.title: A paradise
reviews.text: Beautiful beach...a beautiful experience starting from the journey to reach this magnificent beach...a Caribbean sea...comfortable services on the beach...possibility of having lunch on the beach

reviews.title: A lovely beach, definitely overhyped though!
reviews.text: It's a long old drive across to Elafonsi from Chania but with some lovely little villages and sights on the way as you make your way through winding narrow roads, sometimes with sheer drops at the side of them. Anyway about the beach. It's one of the nicest beaches we've ever visited, however it's seriously overhyped and looks nothing like the pictures you'll see in tour guide brochures. There are very small traces of pink in the sand where the sea laps the shore but that's about it.  We visited in late October on a weekday. It was quite busy but not to the point it was uncomfortable. The water was crystal clear, warm and shallow, making it a safe place for families or those that are not strong swimmers.When you arrive, ignore the people trying to persuade you to park on their premises and keep driving until you can't drive any further. You'll get to some bollards in the road and just before them on the right hand side is the closest car park, with plenty of spaces. It costs 5 Euros to park for the day. The walk down to and back up from the beach is a bit of an arduous one, especially in the boiling sunshine.

reviews.title: Beautiful Area, Heaving With People
reviews.text: This is a lovely area with fantastic extended beach. The throngs of people, even late in the season, makes it less than relaxing, however. Go as far out as you can,and enjoy the shallow waters

reviews.title: One of the best beaches you’ll ever see !!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and is as shown, sand is white and where the shore meets the sand, that is where there are pink patches. Water is clean and clear with very good visibility and you can see your feet until you can’t stand. The beach has plenty of Nissis where the sand and see meet to form water that looks like ice. Gorgeous and would recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Doesn't necessarily have to be...
reviews.text: Very crowded. The beach is beautiful, the water is clear and nice and shallow, but not as special as advertised. The pink strip with shell limestone is very narrow and you have to look for it. There are certainly equally beautiful bays on Crete that you can enjoy in peace...

reviews.title: King & Queen + prince
reviews.text: A beach paradise, fantastic water, a interesting bus trip with narrow roads and mountains to go there.

reviews.title: Busy commercial beach
reviews.text: If you like crowds this is for you . We went mid - October, mid week, dread to think what main holiday season would be like car park is 5euro,  if you want the toilet it’s 1 euro, dread to think where people who don’t want to pay go 🙀- just not our cuppa

reviews.title: A paradise on earth
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have ever been to is not only beautiful, with beautiful shades of the sea in every possible blue color, but also wonderful exotic vegetation and wonderful sand on the beach. We were lucky because in October there were no crowds on this beach and we could enjoy the charm of the island and the beach

reviews.title: Definitely worth it
reviews.text: Beautiful drive there, some parts in the rain can accommodate 1 car and the tunnel was also an experience. Parking for the whole day is 5 euros, you have to walk a bit to get there, but then you have something. Come on. early because it will be busy later in the day. Find a spot on the other side, where it is much quieter. Nice area for snorkeling. There is not much pink sand, but it can be found. Keep it clean, it is a unique area but definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: How to spoil one of your best natural assets
reviews.text: Just come back from a wasted trip to Elafonisos beach. (The spelling is taken from my Cretan map.)  I should have been pre warned by the packed car parks; must have been well in excess of 1000 cars plus coaches and this in October.  Heaven only knows what high season is like.The trek down to the beach is past tavernas and souvenir sellers and once you get there, rows of sunshades and beds and people, so many  people.On a positive note, the water IS crystal clear in amazing shades of blue and turquoise and I've no doubt that without all the humanity, it is quite spectacular. Unfortunately tourism has not done it any favours.  Such a shame.

reviews.title: Paradise, indeed!
reviews.text: The finest beach in the world is this one. It took me 4 hours to get there from the other side of the island, and I wish I could have stayed longer since it truly is a captivating paradise.

reviews.title: It's high time that people question themselves!
reviews.text: I will give 3 stars out of 5. Not for the site it is but for the sadness of tourism.I went scuba diving there, I was able to admire the clarity of the water and the beauty of the fine white sand. Gorgeous ! I was also able to admire paper towels, cigarette butts and trash in what nature offers us. A gold star also to those who collect pink sand to take home as a souvenir. In a few years, thanks to you, there will be no more. People's selfishness will never stop...Apart from that, bring a small vest anyway because it is very windy. Also bring a small snack because there really isn't much "food" there. Paying toilets (1€), I do not condone. People go into the bushes to do what creates papers all over the beach.In summary, a beautiful place which will gradually be destroyed by mass tourism.

reviews.title: Pink Sand. Very busy
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, the most striking thing is the pink sand. Otherwise it is very crowded and overexploited. The parking lots are a little far away for traveling with small children, although access is easy. It is worth visiting although there are better beaches in Crete

reviews.title: Too many people
reviews.text: Nice place spoiled by too many people. And again, it was the end of September... I think you have to go there completely out of season to enjoy the natural beauty of the place. Otherwise, it would feel like you were on a beach in the south of France in August, which is a shame.

reviews.title: Too many people and that’s in October!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with clear water and pink sands HOWEVER far too many prople bus loads and car parks full Note it’s 5 euros a day to park and 2 sunbeds and an umbrella is 20 euros! 1 euro to use the WC! Signs show it’s a place of natural wonders however too many people lots of rubbish and deserted caravans upon entry Such a shame

reviews.title: Crete's most beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with sandy bottom and blue sea. Definitely worth a visit. Parking for 5 euros for the whole day. From the square there is a long way down to the water, be careful about what you take to the beach. Definitely worth a visit. However, we remember that 10-15 years ago you could park closer.

reviews.title: opinions differ
reviews.text: everyone says the best about this particular beach, but I personally didn't find anything that drove me crazy. a simple boardwalk

reviews.title: Elafonissi beach
reviews.text: A beautiful place, worth visiting. Beautiful nature, rich life in the water. Lovely place. the day we were there it was very windy. We experienced a sandstorm 😅 😂 it is recommended to check the weather beforehand - we have done it anyway but did not expect it to be as troublesome as it actually was. TO faith in all things beautiful 🙂Parking 5 euros

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Even a large crowd of tourists will not be able to spoil the impressions of the beach. Don't expect pink sand all over the beach. Pink stripes can be seen on the surf line (0.5-1m), and this is also very beautiful. Expensive to the beach - this is a real paradise, I think everyone should see it

reviews.title: Elafonissi - only pink in June and 14 days into July
reviews.text: Our son and daughter-in-law visited Elafonissi Beach a few years ago - the most beautiful thing they had seen. So we rented a car here in September. - drove across Crete and reached Elafonissi which was absolutely packed with SO many people. Impossible to find a place to be. There was at this time of year - NO pink beach. If you want to see it, it must come in June and 14 days into July - the pink mussels search deeper in the high season and return in March. Access to the beach is definitely not for the faint of heart - due to large stones and very, very uneven.This review so you don't spend a whole day there in vain. The Greeks visit the beautiful place every year in June and early July...we would have greatly appreciated if we had been informed about all this.We had - on top of that - spoken to a guide the day before about the trip and were told that it was very beautiful, but nothing about the conditions at this time of year.There are SO many other beautiful beaches with the cleanest water.This review, so you don't run after an experience that can only be seen in June / July

reviews.title: Mixed feelings about this
reviews.text: Do you like hard winds with sand smattered all over your body into you pores? Then this is the place to go! Road there is managable but not so pleasant, of course, you couldnt expect more.( We drove from Galatas)Looks like roads children paint in kindergarten. The beach is very beautiful though. May be worth a visit. Im glad im home.

reviews.title: Don't Bother
reviews.text: Car park is 5 euros but they don't tell you how far you have to walk to the beach - it feels like miles, honestly its a long way. We turned round, didn't bother, went bak to car and headed back to Hotel. Rammed with people anyway. What a wasted journey

reviews.title: Former paradise
reviews.text: Bitter disappointment. Hordes of tourists, paid parking (5€), paid bathroom (1€) and valets who have to sort the constant coming and going of cars and buses. After parking, there is a walk under the scorching sun to arrive at a beach covered with rude swimmers. The pink sand can barely be seen. The shallow water makes you think more of a swamp than a paradise beach. We took a drive and ran away.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Ultra crowded beach. From this year you will pay 5 euros for parking. The rental of umbrellas and sunbeds has shameful prices. 10 years ago 7 euros umbrella + 2 sunbeds and the rest free, obviously. The party's over, drop the buck

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: A beach that can be reached with difficulty by car via two routes, the internal mountainous one 44 km and the coastal one 54 km, both very dangerous, the guard rails were almost completely missing, narrow roads which had more right of passage for donkeys, sheep and goats👀🤦🏻‍♀️😂, the Greek guide leaves much to be desired but….Elafonissi is beautiful, so it was worth the trip! There are bars, taverns, hotels, small shops, public toilets, umbrella with 2 sunbeds for €15, but if you go in the morning you can fully enjoy everything, after 11am various buses arrive and lots of people in cars (parking for €5 before going down to the beach) and there are waves of people chasing the umbrella 🤦🏻‍♀️

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in Europe
reviews.text: The beach is not obviously pink, but has some pink crystals you can spot when looking carefully. It's worth visiting this place as the beach has a lot of sections naturally divided by the nature.

reviews.title: Beautiful area
reviews.text: Very beautiful place with translucent waters. It is advisable to get there early if you want to enjoy the place before the tourist buses arrive... and choose a parasol on the beach.However, be careful with the images seen on the internet, the sand is not pink everywhere, which does not detract from the beauty of the place however.

reviews.title: Definitely go😎🏝️
reviews.text: We were there early at 9.30 a.m. on the recommendation of our hosts... and had an "almost" free choice of loungers and umbrellas 😎Parking space 5 euros is okayGetting 3 loungers and 1 umbrella for 25 euros is also okayGreat clean beach. Snack stand at normal prices.Beach wasn't as crowded as we feared... just get there early. We were there for about 5 hours.Great water... wonderful 🏝️🌞

reviews.title: Instead of quality, above all quantity
reviews.text: It would be a one-off, but in September there are too many tourists, too many people. Next time I'll go there in December.

reviews.title: Elafonisi
reviews.text: Stunning beach, evocative scenery, breathtaking viewThe only flaw for those like me who struggle with anxieties is the journey to reach this wonderful paradise! The journey is a bit long and the curves, the height and the absence of gardareil in some parts are not the best! However, it is worth making this effortI recommend going very early to find space in the areas or bring at least an umbrella with you

reviews.title: Fantastic place!!! TO
reviews.text: Wonderful water, and very fine sand, ideal place for those with children, if you want to use the Lo Scosiglio lido (umbrellas attached) umbrella cost €20 1 deckchair €5, on the coast there are kiosks for eating and drinking, accessible for disabled people.
