If you want to stay calm in uncontaminated nature you can walk a little and find solitary places, as it is very crowded (But it's worth it!!!)

reviews.title: Prepare yourself for the sad spectacle!!
reviews.text: And yes, we knew it but what a shame!!!4th time in Crete in the last 10 years, we wanted to finally see this beautiful and famous beach 😏A 2-hour drive from Chania crossing the Topolia gorges (magnificent winding road, I do not validate some opinions...), we discover the business of this “protected” natural site.Arriving at 10:30 a.m., the parking lots are already full 😓… The tourist bus stop is located right in front of a small supermarket which fills up with people at high speed, it puts you in the mood….! You are already struggling to buy a simple bottle of water!What can we say about the beach…. 😱 very pretty of course but ruined by mass tourism.People are literally stuck together on the sandbanks.It is therefore normal that the famous pink sand is now so rare…Be careful of the harsh sun... no shaded corners... you cook very quickly! It is also almost impossible to use a parasol because the site is very windy.Escape the overcrowded main beach, head to the left where you will find several small coves to isolate yourself but be careful, the tranquility is only short-lived!We left at 1 p.m., it was becoming unbearable...😭We preferred Balos but we have bitter memories of these 2 superb sites which have been badly deteriorated. It would be urgent to establish at least visitor quotas!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Super nice and cozy - can definitely be recommended!!! Possibility to park nearby for 5eur and several places nearby if you can buy food and drinks

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: So what can I say. Shared between the fact that the site is magnificent, but that it is completely ruined by the amount of people found there. It has become a tourist trap with its parking lots for €5, its deckchairs for €20 per day, its toilets for €1 and the various merchants, each as unpleasant as the next.The water is transparent and warm. For the pink sand.... thank you photoshop. In short I wanted to give a rating of 5/5 for the place but it will be 2 max.

reviews.title: Idyllic in book photos
reviews.text: It's a view and a paddle with hundreds or even more of other people. If you love being very close and personal with other people this is for you, drone flyers paradise to invade your privacy, and a square metre of sand to relax. We felt it was just too overcrowded, queues to get there, queues to get to the beach, 500 metre walk, and queue to pay your 5eur car park fee. The photos of empty beaches and idyllic scenery are best seen in books....in short an experience...not in my itinerary to do again.

reviews.title: A special place worth seeing.
reviews.text: I read the last review from Pamela I think from Patonga Aust and wondered whether I should go or not. I am so glad I did not let that review put me off. This is a special place. Yes the drive there was at times hair raising but boy when isn’t it in the Greek islands. The place was thronging with people and we ignored the first couple of parking lots and kept driving until we could go no further and there is abuse parking lot there. They charge 5€ for the day, 300 metre walk to the beach. I agree it’s crowded and so my advice would be go very early but despite the crowds we had a great time. The place is picturesque with an amazing back drop. On the way back drop into one of the many small tavernas in the small mountain villages.

reviews.title: Pink beach
reviews.text: Without a doubt, the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. Of course, there can be a lot of people, but even that doesn't bother us. 2013.

reviews.title: Turquoise sea
reviews.text: Very pleasant lagoon with sand, the sea is clear and turquoise. It is very hot with little shade, it is better to go there early in the morning before the arrival of tourists like us! Paid parking but don't let the first guard influence you to park closer to the beach.

reviews.title: Everything is possible, nothing is neccesary.
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, certainly one of the most beautiful in Crete, but unfortunately difficult to get to and very crowded with tourists. The journey from Chania was cheap. €29 per person for a guided trip and return (the price with public transport is €20). Unfortunately, we only stayed for 3.5 hours but spent 2.5 hours each way there and back (54 km each way). We can say "we saw it", but we wouldn't have to make the journey again.

reviews.title: nice place for walk around the isle, and shalow and clear water
reviews.text: nice beach, perfect for a morning walk around the island.nice and clear water, recomended to stay until 11.00, maximum 12.00, when it willbe too crowdedmust arrive until 9, because are just few sunbedspink sand? just a joke, and marketing 😉

reviews.title: Magnificent site
reviews.text: Always the same, try to get there early in the morning to avoid the crowds.This site is exceptional and unique of its kind.The pink sand is not present everywhere and is not eye-catching but this place remains magnificent 😀

reviews.title: Nice but too many people
reviews.text: At ten in the morning the umbrellas of the first establishment you come across were already finished! Then from 11am hundreds of people started arriving (even buses for groups) and the beach became unlivable... the water is obviously very beautiful and always very shallow, warm and the place is immense, there are many small beaches that you come to create between one rock and another and make the experience curious. Instead the pink sand is no longer there because tourists have taken it away over the years and now it is imperceptible, if you have seen it pink on Google it is only thanks to photoshop! With fewer people it would have been a different experience, which is a shame because it is a truly beautiful and special place.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Enchanting beach with intense light blue water, very fine pink sand, the only drawback is the road to get from Kissamos which is tortuous and at times with overhangs

reviews.title: Don't go there! It's not like it used to be!!!
reviews.text: It's terrible what has happened to this beautiful beach. We were there in 2022 and 2021. It was full, you had to be there early in the morning. Everything was fine for once. But this year everything is different! Parking spaces far above the beach, the fun costs €5. Then you walk towards the beach with what feels like thousands of other people. Then the big surprise. There are only 1/5 of the loungers and umbrellas left at most! At 10 a.m. everything was already taken. We saw many astonished faces. We then decided to leave this terrible place and went to Falassarna beach. Avoid at all costs!

reviews.title: Too hard for anyone with disabilities
reviews.text: Far to far to walk for a person with disabilities … no transport to assist. Hardly any shelter.  Beautiful views but it should be made clear that it’s only for people who are able bodied.

reviews.title: Indecency once again in a natural environment!
reviews.text: Once again in another beautiful landscape of our country, money, rudeness and the plug, excel!Parking with a fee of 5 euros with the way I want (while there is a free space next to the beach) because someone likes it that way.Charge from the canteen to go (listen, listen) to the toilet!The need became chargeable. As for the employees, let's not argue, they were the rudest I've ever met.Shame on the rest of the Cretans for the defamation!

reviews.title: What pink sand?
reviews.text: After an 1/12 hour death defying drive from Chania we discovered that you had to use a fee charging, over crowded parking area and then walk at least a kilometre from the car to the beach.  The beach was also crowded with tourists from the buses.  We rested at a restaurant overlooking the beach for a mediocre lunch.  From there we observed the beach and the people and decided it wasn’t worth the effort.Perhaps it was because it was midday arriving that there was no visible pink sand?  Realised it was a tourist trap, decided not to stay and prayed we got home again!

reviews.title: Definitely not a must!!
reviews.text: First of all, the beach is really beautiful, but unfortunately you can't enjoy it at all. In the morning it's still OK but around midday there are crowds of people that you can't imagine and there were more and more of them. We had positioned ourselves at the edge and when we came out of the water we could hardly get to our towels because we were surrounded by others, only a few centimeters away. Most people were lying in the sun the whole time in temperatures of over 30 degrees, they're sure to have fun the next day. Then we walked back to the car and saw the extent of it when all the parking lots and the street were full, plus there were at least 8 tour buses, you'd think you were at an exhibition center. You can definitely save yourself the trouble, we've been to beaches that were at least as beautiful and that you could enjoy.

reviews.title: Stunning view
reviews.text: The views were amazing and being in a pink sand beach was breathtaking. We went early morning so we had the beach just for ourselves.

reviews.title: Death roads on Crete
reviews.text: ROAD NOT AS IT SEEMS - Be very careful, if taking a trip from Elafonissi  to Paleochora the sat nav will give you 3 routes… do NOT TAKE THE SHORTEST ROUTE !! This route starts off okay with a decent tarmac road and barriers, but after about 8 km when you’re on top of the mountain through the tunnel and along a bit -  it turns into a gravel TRACK only fit for donkeys - you are so far up and there’s nowhere to turn around, there are no barriers and the drops are absolutely white, knuckling horrendous!!  for some reason Google Waze, and other Sat nav’s will give you this route as a good road - but it is not- , people will die here - this is not a joke - please take a paper map  so you can see these roads are completely uncompleted and are absolutely terrifying, anyone in a small car will not make it and if you think you’re going to take an hour like the sat nav advises think again - it’ll take you over three hours terrifying cliff edges and rocks falling down along the way. The cliffs absolutely so dangerous- do not go this route.  turn back as soon as you see gravel dirt road after tarmac and go the longer route !!!

reviews.title: Pure magic!!!
reviews.text: What can you say about this beach!Just take a look at photos, imagine that when you are there it is even more beautiful and you will get an idea.. My advice: visit it as early as you can so that it is less crowded, because as the time goes by it gets suffocatingly full, take a hat and a strong sunscreen (there aren't many shady areas) and ideally, closed shoes as it takes a bit of walking to get there. Drinks and snacks can also be found near the car park.

reviews.title: Excursions
reviews.text: Magnificent beaches, the sand is very pink. We had a good swimThe sun was shining. We found a place where we were alone.

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviews.text: A very nice beach on the south side of the island . Like all Greek islands , you should always check the wind speed and direction before heading out to a beach . If its windy from the north direction, go to the south beaches and vice versa. I agree with others who say that it gets really busy and getting an umbrella and lounges may be a problem . The water is crystal clear and remains shallow quite far out . Interestingly though , I kept feeling myself getting bit on my legs by tiny fish . Like others have also said , we found little to no pink sand . Nonetheless, you should visit while in Crete.

reviews.title: Stunning but busy
reviews.text: This beach is quite rightly listed as one of the best beaches in the world. It is stunning and in certain locations it is also pink which is very beautiful.However as you would expect with such a beautiful beach it gets very busy and unless you get there early you are unlikely to get anywhere with shade. The water is crystal clear and shallow so ideal for children.One other thing to note is that you can not park that close to the beach so there is quite a walk to the beach which is up hill on the way back.Would recommend that you visit but be prepared for the crowds.

reviews.title: A nugget
reviews.text: Indeed, parking lots are chargeable, 5th mid-September. We parked further up the road but be careful we arrived early because otherwise you will have to walk.From the last parking lot, 10/15 min walk downhill with stones, and then you will have to find a place on the sand. I saw a water pull-out for disabled people but I will admit that I wondered how they managed to get down to the beach from the public parking lot. Perhaps the nearest parking lot, currently closed to most people, is accessible to them.The good news is that the site is huge, in mid-September there were a lot of people but not overcrowded.The advantage of this beach compared to Balos is snorkeling. In Balos there is not much in the lagoon, you will have to dive into the deep blue where the strong winds cool the water temperature. Here too the wind can blow but there is excitement under the water even at the edge. Especially sars who will be delighted to enjoy your few picnic crumbs. Moving towards the rocks, you won't know where to look under the turquoise waters.You directly see the pink on the sand at the water's edge. It's not neon like some filter-loving Instagrammers would like you to believe, but the pink is there and it's beautiful, really. We actually shook our towels well when we left to leave these little shells and stones where they were born!

reviews.title: Lovely- as per everyone's photo's
reviews.text: Went as part of a coach tour (good luck if you drive on these roads not wide enough for two vehicles to pass). The pink sand was a few inches as the tide comes in . Beautiful place nonetheless. Sea seemed a mixture of turquoise,blue and green.safe and sandy.5 euros to park all day.few eating places and mini markets before you go down on to the beach. Definitely worth the effort.

reviews.title: Disappointing development, although the beach was great until now
reviews.text: Absolutely disappointing development! We were there in June and September 2022 and really enjoyed the time - you could drive close to the beach, for free, had plenty of space, enough loungers and umbrellas at an OK price - a lot of people, but absolutely OK and everything was well distributed.Since mid-2023, the area has been converted into a "nature reserve" which really doesn't deserve its name! Since the parking spaces are now much further up and are now subject to a fee, all the crowds of people just walk all over the so-called protected area and leave plastic behind like everywhere else and trample everything down - hardly in the spirit of nature conservation! Only a small part of the beach has loungers and umbrellas, you can't "just" rent loungers for further back, it's unbearable without an umbrella - which means that people even put their beach towels in the shade in the cordoned off areas - counterproductive if you want to preserve nature!!We are extremely disappointed that it is now just a money-making scheme - we would have happily paid for the parking space further down the road a year ago if it hadn't been so run down. I hope those responsible will take another look at this extremely questionable concept.

reviews.title: A highlight of our Crete holiday this year
reviews.text: We thought long and hard about whether we should take the two-hour trip to the beach with a small child and ultimately decided to do it. We were not disappointed. Yes, it is all very touristy, but the view of the beach makes up for everything. Simply fantastic. We were also lucky enough to be there early enough to get one of the few loungers with a parasol. For us, it was a highlight of this year's Crete holiday.

reviews.title: A day at the beach
reviews.text: The beach was probably not pink as the advertisements say, but we had a really nice day, the water is completely crystal clear and the sandy bottom is just lovely. It was worth the whole drive.

reviews.title: Elafonissi
reviews.text: As others before me wrote, it is very overrated! Big difference from when we were here 5 years ago. There are better places to visit for a bath.

reviews.title: Influencer catastrophe
reviews.text: Completely overrated. Was there 15 years ago in September, you could drive to the beach, there were no loungers, etc. and you had the island to yourself. Currently you can see how certain influencers are ruining all the insider tips. In mid-September 2023, it feels like thousands of people are there, parking spaces are full and rip-offs from the parking lot to the lounger. When there are even tour buses in the parking lot, you know it's better to turn around. I'm glad I saw Elafonissi earlier without this madness. The same goes for Balos and Falassarna.

reviews.title: Crowded, but…
reviews.text: When it is crowded, it’s not nearly the experience one thinks they’re going to get from the pics. By early afternoon (it was a 2 hr drive!) every umbrella and lounger is taken and you are relegated to the hard, wet sand exposed by the tides.Within an hour of arrival, the winds started picking up and things (not just ours!) were blowing away!The water really is turquoise and beautiful, but that’s because it’s about 3 feet deep with a sandy bottom in the cove. Of course, with such a well-known, beautiful location, one shouldn’t expect to have it to oneself, but we were surprised at just how busy it was for mid-Sept.Be prepared to walk at least 1km downhill to the beach area (and uphill on the way back) from the multiple car parks up the hill from the beach, where you will pay 5€ to park on a flattened rocky area.I would imagine it COULD feel like paradise very early or late in the day, when you may have the views and beach to yourself, but outside LC that, it felt very much like a “check the box” experience on the very southwestern edge of Crete.The drive TO the beach from the east takes one through some very rugged and narrow terrain, although the raid quality itself was quite decent. Be prepared to stop on some corners, as two cars are one too many in certain locations! Driving through the tunnel was cool though and I’ve no idea how the tour buses manage the drive?!I certainly don’t want to leave a negative impression, because I’m sure we could have had a very different experience if our trip had been a little more planned or thought out, but just be prepared to wonder both where the pink sand is and how on earth most of the empty beach pictures were taken!All in all, definitely a meh day out for us, given it was a 4 hr round trip drive to visit.Take-always: Get there early. Buy shade. Take frequent dips. Try to stay out of the way of all the “soon-to-be Insta-Famous” 20-somethings. Bring suitable footwear for a somewhat steep and rocky 1Km+ walk to and from your parking spot.(If you are Disabled and have the permit, I believe you can drive down to the beach!)ENJOY! Caveat emptor.

reviews.title: Liefonissi
reviews.text: Like many, Elafonissi was sold to us as “the most beautiful beach on the ridge”, but paradise is only in name and then some.Firstly, the road is very, very long! We traveled 2 hours 40 minutes to get there, praying all you want to get there alive. The path is of unprecedented ignominy: steep path, narrow road, car rushing like madmen in front… in short, a nightmare as winding as it is endless. Don't worry, the rental car poses no risk, unlike your increased stress during the trip.Then, we “Park” you in a location that obviously costs €5 and then you have to walk down for about 15 minutes (the journey is not difficult and that’s the only thing)We arrived early and yet there was already a slew of tourists, as if the entire ridge had arranged to meet up that day (during the week)No deckchair available but at 20€ the sunbathing next to it is legal theft.Provide protection, parasols etc. because there is no shade and believe me it will cook like a cake in the oven.Let's talk about the beach now, certainly not everything is to be thrown away, the water is fresh and it feels good and translucent yes but it is in no way a paradise beach for me... but rather a shell in which to soak the feet. For that you have to go to Chrisi, Balos, Kedrodasos which is a few minutes away and much more sumptuous!In short, let's not even talk about pink which is non-existent, especially don't expect the Barbie pink that they sell you on the internet photos and postcards well Photoshopped for the occasion. There is a slight reflection but it doesn't break a duck's 3 legs and it's not worth driving so much for that.Unspoiled beach which is not that much... a lot of dirty places, it is forbidden to take "pink" sand at home, many do it so afterwards we should not be surprised that it eventually does not or more pink.There you go, very disappointed, having the feeling of having wasted my time to see a debacle of tourists, each more noisy and disrespectful than the other. Not at all relaxing!!To flee ! First category tourist trap.Ps: don't even think about dodging the parking payment, we'll kindly wait for you with the CB reader at the exit ;)

reviews.title: We are not in Riccione
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, certainly a destination for many and therefore quite crowded but if you adapt a little you can find a quiet space.As for the color, well, I didn't expect a pink beach from top to bottom (obviously) but even in this case if you move away from the masses and walk in the more isolated areas the sand on the shore is pink!Another fact that no one cares about: In my opinion, to be able to enjoy a holiday in places like Crete you need a bit of an adventurous spirit, a desire to walk (15 minute drive to reach the beach) and above all it is It is necessary to keep in mind that we are not in Riccione!That said, I highly recommend this beach!(P.s. even my grandmother could have done it on foot)

reviews.title: A paradise!!
reviews.text: The most beautiful place in Crete, after 26 years we returned and apart from the umbrellas and deckchairs and the kiosk it has fortunately remained unchanged, lots of people but in any case if you arrive early you can enjoy its charm.

reviews.title: Always beautiful
reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Crete and not only absolutely worth seeing with all the ingredients for a day to remember even if a little out of the way but a few more kilometers does not detract from the beauty of this beachSince the last time two years ago I have found some news they have made large paid parking lots about 1km before arriving at the beach they have removed all the umbrellas that were on the strip of sand that connects the various islets and they have increased the prices €20 per an umbrella and two sunbeds

reviews.title: Gorgeous !
reviews.text: The beach is magnificent!The lagoon is turquoise. Ideal in the off-season and don't hesitate to go a little further away from the beach to be even more peaceful!We were staying at the hotel next to the car park, so it was ideal.

reviews.title: The most amazing world class Greek beach.  Worth a visit.
reviews.text: Go early! We arrived around 8:30 AM and left around 1 PM. The parking lot is a bit of a walk from the beach. The beach is amazing for swimming and walking to the other side of rock formations. The sand at the water's edge is pink from seashells. The water is crystal clear and very shallow for a ways from the edge.  We took many beautiful photos.  Bring towels, water, and lunch.  There are paid bathrooms (which is a shame.)

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: It will also be the most beautiful beach in Crete or one of the most beautiful, go there if you love being overwhelmed by the crazy crowd. And even if you find yourself in a cot you won't even have space to turn around and for what then? the much photographed pink is now reduced to almost nothing, water certainly clear and beautiful as in many of our Sardinian beaches... nothing more!The sea of Greece is the Mediterranean emerald or sapphire, deep clean.. blue!I went there (and also early in the morning) I left the car in the car park, I walked and reached the beach I looked at it... or rather I tried to look at it by slaloming between the heads and I immediately went backIn Crete there is much, much better

reviews.title: Nice beach but gets extremely crowded.
reviews.text: The beach is really beautiful, but before the crowds arrive (of course, everyone wants to see this beach, we were among them). We were there at a quarter to 9 (we set off at 5 a.m.). There were only 4 loungers occupied, so we still had the best choice. It is advisable to get a lounger in the front row, as you get the sun there all day (if you want, otherwise there are parasols everywhere) and no one can lie in front of you. The view from there is really beautiful. After we arrived, we were able to take pictures in peace and there was nothing to see in the background except the sea. Around 11 it gets really busy, you look around regularly and can't believe how many people are there at once. There is also a lot going on in the water afterwards.The pink in the water looks pretty, but not "to fall to your knees", perhaps there are days when this seems more intense. The water is really crystal clear and you can go very far into the water, so people are spread out relatively well.Parking costs €5 (I think that's too expensive) and two loungers + parasol €20 (I think that's OK), but I think the toilet use for €1 each is outrageous, especially because the toilets are pretty "filthy" and don't get any cleaner over the course of the day.

reviews.title: Still as beautiful but...
reviews.text: For reasons apparently of nature protection, parking has become paid and much further back from the beach (5€)!Why not if it's for a good cause, except that you shouldn't hesitate to go to the lowest parking lot and not be fooled by the callers who push you to park as soon as you arrive at the top, even if it means retrace your steps if indeed it is complete.Pay them by credit card, it's much safer....for nature 😉Sanitary facilities 1€ (and yes, nature must be preserved)A word of advice: It is better to be there at 10 a.m. if you want to get a parking space not very far away and a deckchair (20€/2) because places have become rare.What made this island strong was the kindness and smile of its inhabitants, the ease of everything. That was before... 4th and last stay for me 🥲

reviews.title: Commercialization has now reached Greek beaches
reviews.text: We visited the beach for the first time 2 years ago and were absolutely delighted. The parking spaces were close to the beach and free of charge, and the beach was equipped with loungers and parasols in such a way that you could still book loungers at 10 a.m. for a reasonable price. This year was completely different: you were no longer allowed to drive into the old parking spaces, but a large number of new parking spaces had been created above the beach, for which you had to pay €5. The loungers and parasols were equipped in such a way that you could no longer get anything by 9:30 a.m., which you only noticed after walking from the parking lot to the beach. In addition, 3 loungers and an umbrella cost €25. We then started our way home, but noticed that the most important item in the shops above the beach was an extremely large number of parasols. They were bought in abundance. As Greeks told us, this phenomenon has been observed since this year, after large parts of the area above the beach were apparently sold at the end of last year. What is happening here is what is now being reversed in other southern countries, namely commercialization at any price. We hope that many tourists will decide, as we did and will continue to do when visiting Crete, to avoid this beach despite its beauty.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: We arrived at this beach attracted by the idea of seeing the pink sand, but once we got there the pink color could barely be seen, the beach is certainly beautiful, very wide and with crystal clear water but the main reason why we went there it was actually the sand, which unfortunately left us with a bit of a bad taste in our mouths

reviews.title: PA-RA-DI-SI-A-CA
reviews.text: A magical place, with two types of sea: on one side swimming pool water with views reminiscent of La Maddalena, the other side with Caribbean colours, all framed by a wonderful pink sand which makes it, as a sea not as a view, more beautiful from Balos.It's all a free beach, you only pay 5 euros for parking and on the way back, after a tiring ascent, the market offers water for just 50 cents.After Cayo Largo, the most beautiful sea I've seen in my life.

reviews.title: exceptional
reviews.text: Spectacular beach with water so crystal clear that you can safely drink breathtaking colors, umbrellas and sunbeds for the price of €20, 5 meters from the water, top of the top of the island of Crete, an experience that I will never forget in my exceptional life

reviews.title: Delicious crest, where are you?
reviews.text: Beach indeed very beautiful but let's look around. First of all, 6 years ago, we left the cars in a large parking lot adjacent to the beach, today it is paid parking, 5€, and stations of the cross to reach the sea, no path, everyone passes anywhere, scrap metal on the ground, trampled vegetation, remains of cement.... So we logically wonder where the parking money goes? To the municipality? Local mafia? No ticket here, just a kidam who jumps on you to get the money and believe me, there is something to do, no definitely, it is no longer the ridge that we loved so much, now we see the tourist coming from very, very far away and it's who will gorge themselves the most. For us, the ridge is over. And be careful, the beaches are covered with parasols and deckchairs, obviously paying. Example of a beach in Bali where you can no longer see the sand and it’s only just beginning!!!! 😢

reviews.title: Not the best on the island
reviews.text: This beach seems overrated. It is wicked windy, barely any pink sand and it’s crowded. I much preferred balos and Gramvousa island over here. Also have to pay for parking and then it’s about a 15 minute walk to the beach and good luck finding a spot. They should also try to get more chairs and umbrellas because im sure more people would pay.

reviews.title: beautiful but...
reviews.text: unsurprisingly, the beach is crowded even when arriving early in the morning. very beautiful beach all the same. It's quite windy, bring a parasol because places near rocks or shrubs are expensive.

reviews.title: Beautiful but at what price?
reviews.text: We had a hard time, there were a lot of people, it was impossible to park despite the touts asking us to join their parking lots. Then we had to walk 10 minutes to reach the beach, there were gusts of wind, we were getting sand and dust everywhere. On the beach it was even more exposed. We got so much sand in our faces that we had to leave after 20 minutes. Make sure there is no wind at all before going. In the end, 1h30 drive for 20 minutes of beach eating sand and 5 euros for parking. Ugh

reviews.title: Better to go to another beach.
reviews.text: We were terribly disappointed. The way there was adventurous but doable on good roads, but the way back was pure hell. No solid roads up or down. We set off extra early to avoid the rush, which worked out really well, but it was slightly cloudy and what pink sand was left was barely noticeable. Not recommended at all.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Beautiful lagoon. On the other hand, don't expect to see pink sand (or maybe it depends on the time of day). Despite the crowds you can find tranquility if you go opposite. We had a little cove all to ourselves.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Wonderful place. Go there early in the morning, to avoid the crowds with the excursions (arrive around 11:30). There is something to eat nearby, it is possible to rent deckchairs on the beach.

reviews.title: Maybe a little overrated place.
reviews.text: Beach is nice and swimmable yes, but car parking area very far of the beach ,uphill walk over a 1km...If you want to rent a sunbed, you must be there very early. 9am is too late, then all beds are sold out already...And the amount of people..... 5000-7000 visitors every day and only 200 sunbeds... Still we enjoyed our stay there for a day in extreme heat.

reviews.title: Natural swimming pool or sea?
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches we visited this year in Crete. Definitely on the podium, equal with Balos. It feels like being in natural pools: shallow, crystalline water and fine white sand. Lido umbrella + 2 sunbeds = €20The only flaw is that the beach stations are too close to each other

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: One of the most amazing beaches I’ve ever seen in my life.  It was hard to get to but totally worth it!!!  Perfect water perfect sand.  Thank you universe :)

reviews.title: Don't waste your time...
reviews.text: Go on your way, long journey to get there, the photos you see do not reflect reality. Too many people in the afternoon on September 6 (impossible to go there in the morning because it rained that day), color of the water certainly beautiful but beach with wet sand, towel soaked instantly before even going into the water . Parking 5€ per day, by touts while the place is not private, you can go higher without paying. Don't expect to park near the water as you can see on GoogleMaps, this parking lot is closed you have to walk (besides everyone tramples the vegetation hoping to find the shortest path, nature doesn't tell you no thanks...). In short there are other beaches more beautiful and more relaxing than here, most come to take photos, no interest in rest. Place for tourists, not for travelers ;)

reviews.title: Crystal clear water and pink sand
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, a little crowded.Equipped with umbrellas for €20, I recommend not arriving after 10.00 because they end quickly

reviews.title: Spectacular play
reviews.text: Spectacular beach... From the level of Balos beach. But much bigger. Crystal clear water, lagoon...a paradise...the downside is the road to get there and the crowds of people...but since the beach is large it is perfect. Parking costs 5 euros and you walk 5 minutes from the parking lot because they don't allow car access to the beach... fortunately...It is a beach that is windy...but not in an exaggerated way... It has bathrooms and some snack bars. Ice cream....on the beach

reviews.title: Heaven!
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing!! There are several car parks (4) costing €5 for the whole day. There is a bit of walking downhill on a dirt road, 5 minutes but the view is guaranteed! There are 3 mini establishments with umbrellas, walkways, bathrooms, showers also for people with disabilities. If you can't find an umbrella, there are trees on the sides (both right and left) to find some shade. The roads to reach this beach, by Greek standards, are excellent: I started from Paleochora, some were recently asphalted.

reviews.title: Clay in the heart
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, with a thousand colours, very suggestive. There is a bar just after the path to drink and eat... we were 2 families with children and the only flaw is that there is little shade and few umbrellas but absolutely worth seeing

reviews.title: Elafonisi beach
reviews.text: I will start with caveats don’t stop at first car park they r trying to get you drive on as there is another car park closer. It’s 10 min from there to beach b prepared to pay £20 for two deckchairs cash or card there are enough cafes for food and drink . Water is clear and sand is pink on edges check the weather as we went when windy but it is lovely and shallow (doesn’t suit everyone but safer for younglings ) just walk out further

reviews.title: A holiday in Crete alone is worth it..
reviews.text: Stunning beach, difficult to identify the contours that protrude and fall following the shape of the many small bays that compose it. The context is that of a natural oasis, therefore being able to observe the typical dunes, the rocks protruding from the sometimes pink sand and the semi-desert vegetation with plants and flowers. One of the most beautiful beaches ever seen, perhaps the most beautiful. It's true, lots of people but the effect of the crowding thins out as you push towards the end of the route, a few extra steps rewarded by the hidden beauty of the more distant bays.

reviews.title: Depends!
reviews.text: It depends where you're from! The sea is clear and the surrounding landscape is particular, made up of mountains and red earth. Very nice but a little overrated. For those accustomed to the beautiful sea this is not all a surprise. However, the pink sand and the always shallow water are particular. This is why it is recommended for children.Beach equipped with only a few umbrellas, so you have to arrive in the early hours of the morning but it depends on the day..Then pay attention to the journey to get there... Road with sheer mountain bends, buses pass almost miraculously! However, the view is very beautiful, truly breathtaking, but for those who suffer from vertigo there is a good half hour of fear 😅Despite everything recommended!

reviews.title: Beautiful lagoon but a lot to do for the environment
reviews.text: The lagoon is still beautiful, however it is regrettable that paths are not made to go to the beach, everyone walks anywhere on the vegetationConsidering the price of parking, I think that this income could be used to improve the surroundings of the beach and create paths.

reviews.title: Holiday at the end of August
reviews.text: In my opinion it is overrated.Very crowded, with few umbrellas that do not satisfy the needs of the thousands of people who are there...And then the pink beach?? ....we didn't see it....Crete is all beautiful, but in my opinion there are other beaches in the south of the island (e.g. SKINARIA, in my opinion the best ever) which are less known but which are worth visiting as they have nothing to envy of Elafonissi or to the famous balos lagoon...

reviews.title: Very beautiful
reviews.text: Gorgeous sea. I won't add anything else to what has already been written in other reviews except that in September the water is particularly cold. Maybe better in other periods.

reviews.title: A paradise!!!
reviews.text: It is absolutely heaven on earth, truly beautiful!Shallow water at first calm and crystal clear! Possibility to do water sports, my husband did kitesurfing!Umbrella and 2 sunbeds for €20 all day, which considering the place is quite a bit!However, you have to come early in the morning because then people start to arrive and you risk not finding a place, there is also a lot of free beach space that you can use.There's a spit of land that you can cross and go to a really gorgeous little island!The beach is equipped with everything: bars, bathrooms, showers! I highly recommend it because it's worth it!!

reviews.title: Absolutely yes, but definitely worth it!
reviews.text: You have to agree with the previous comments. It is very, very crowded and very overcrowded. Lots of tourists come and go. Not necessarily suitable for relaxing.BUT:The beach makes up for everything. The water is a wonderful blue. The beach is slightly pink as described. Sometimes more, sometimes less. You can dive wonderfully and look for fish. There is something to eat and drink and the day is saved. The journey there is just as beautiful and eventful. It is definitely worth it, as the large crowds of people also disperse.

reviews.title: Dream beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach which is worth the detour but don't expect to see pink sand!There are a few here and there but it's not as rosy as on the Internet!But still very niceTo do

reviews.title: UNMISSABLE
reviews.text: Elafonissi is certainly on the podium of the most beautiful beaches in Crete, nothing to say, it deserves it!I recommend arriving VERY early especially in the peak months, as it fills up very quickly, if you want to enjoy it without many people and walk on every side of this beautiful beach you have to be there by 9 in the morning.Possibility of renting umbrellas and sunbeds at a cost of 20 euros, but arrive very early for these too, they sell like hot cakes!Possibility of a free beach, there are some bars, which offer salads, clubs, sandwiches, ice creams, drinks.The closest car park is the first one, i.e. the last one you find when arriving by car costs 5 euros, from there you will then have to walk and reach the beach, it is a stony stretch but mostly flat, it is not very tiring, if you have the better shoes.The sand is pink and is enchanting reflected in its crystal clear waters.Arrive early and then leave around 3pm at the latest, as especially on Sundays crowds of people will arrive, and the beach will lose its real beauty.Elafonissi has a special place in my heart.

reviews.title: A corner of paradise
reviews.text: It is truly a beautiful beach, an expanse of water and shades, a corner of paradise. A long way to reach it but when you are there Roman enchanted.

reviews.title: Pity.
reviews.text: Fantastic site spoiled by the cult of money. They cut off the access of vehicles (after the asphalt road) and they "have" a parking space for you, right before (essentially they oblige you because the first free space is 1km before) for 5€ all day. The sunbeds, the set €20(!!!).

reviews.title: Fabulous place
reviews.text: I, who am not a beach person, had difficulty leaving this place, simply extraordinarily beautiful!!!

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Another superb beach in the Chania region, easier to access than Balos and the same colors the site is perhaps larger than Balosbring water and a picnic to have a good time (downstairs there is something to eat, the prices are reasonable but I didn't find it terrible).

reviews.title: Tourist trap
reviews.text: Winding road but largely doable to get into the clutches of the parking lot touts (5€).11 a.m. hundreds of people head towards the beach, it loses all its charm.We went there one day when the wind was blowing quite strongly.. the deckchairs were taken over and the sand was wet. Soaked towels before even sitting down.We left for Aspri Limni Beach

reviews.title: It’s very beautiful. It’s very fine. The sand is certainly not as pink as in the advertisement. From the parking lot it’s a good 15 minutes walk, you need to have a comfortable
reviews.text: Everything is beautiful. Only a lot of buses and private cars and crowds of people arrive at once. There is no place to lie down. The parking lot is far from the beach. It’s very beautiful

reviews.title: Not easily accessible
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but not easily accessible,  from car park there is a downhill walk and the walk back up, not recommended for those with mobility issues

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Absolutely worth visiting. For those who aren't early risers like us, the advice is to go for a swim after 5pm, when the crowds begin to thin out and you can find parking in the space closest to the entrance (5 euros). The walk to the beach takes only 10 minutes (timed), which at that time is very doable without getting too hot.There is very little pink left, but the place is a true paradise. A mandatory stop for anyone visiting Crete.

reviews.title: Not for handicap or strollers
reviews.text: The beach was okay. But if you are diable this is not the place 4 you. We showed them out handicap sign but was direktet on a pakedspace 1, 2km from the beach.The walk to the beach was not handicapfreindly nore stroller friendly. The trip brokke our stroller.

reviews.title: Stick to the pictures.
reviews.text: Great beach, but.... Unbelievable people, literally "Siloam's swimming pool". If it somehow magically had 1/10 of the world it does, it would be the most beautiful beach. Now not.....it also has more than 500 meters of walking, -while some cars have gone all the way down-.and of course because of the people it wasn't clean either. The road to reach it, full of turns. Stick to the pictures.

reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.text: A lovely beach with some pink sand (dependant upon the season of your visit) and clear, turquoise waters (which are a very pleasant temperature due the heat the south of Crete experiences in the peak season). Due to the amount of tourists visiting, the beach will be busy however you will still, comfortably, find yourself a spot. If you want a more peaceful and tranquil experience, consider visiting the island which can be accessed by a short walk through the sea.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Amazing place. I recommend arriving early (9.00 maximum) to find free umbrellas in the central part and enjoy the beach and the sea before it fills up. However, even when full it is a beautiful place

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: For me it's not the most beautiful, I've seen more pink sand on Balos.And above all there are so many people, the water is warm, the sand fine but overpriced

reviews.title: Superb site to do BEFORE the Balos lagoon (not after)
reviews.text: Superb beach, quite touristy obviously, with some pink reflections.After the Balos Lagoon, we still didn't have the "wow" effect.We arrived there around 4 p.m., crowded but it was manageable.We stayed 1 night at the Elafonissi resort, ideal for parking and great in terms of services (hotel, dinner, breakfast, reception).A very beautiful site!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Superb beach. The site is splendid.One of the most beautiful beaches in Crete.Parking price at 5€ is expensiveCatering on site is very expensive, eg €7 per portion of fries, it's a bit of a scam.

reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.text: Enchanting place, it looks like a natural swimming pool because the water is very shallow and clear. I recommend going early and taking an umbrella because there are few shady places and it is hot. The path to get there is short and very doable. There is a small refreshment point there (they sell sandwiches), while where there is the car park, above, you will find a restaurant.

reviews.title: A piece of heaven on earth
reviews.text: We stayed on the last Sunday of August, before 9.30am and found a place for a sunbed and umbrella for 20 euros. The beach is a dream, and until 11.30 there weren't many people, then it filled up. The pink sand and natural pools with shallow, calm water make this place a true paradise. Absolutely not to be missed

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: So magical beach it was fantastic!!The waters are green blue like Maldives of Europe.The best beach who ever seen!!Must visit

reviews.title: The perfect beach, with wonderful waters!
reviews.text: The perfect beach, with wonderful waters! The parking costs 5 euros and from there you walk for 5 easy minutes. It has a canteen to get a coffee, and plenty of space to put your umbrella. No matter how crowded it is, it's great! You better come as early as possible!

reviews.title: Elafonisi - Too good to be true
reviews.text: Nice place would be SOMEDAY. With so many people gathering now and with the air we achieved, you are not happy about it. The buses leave you quite a distance to walk on rocky places and with the sun baking you until you reach the beach. We could NOT see the famous pink sand - maybe - because of the wind.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with pink sand
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, you have to arrive early enough for the sunbeds, by 9.30 they are still on the right side. Alternatively, a large free beach, they also sell umbrellas at the top of the beach.The road by car is quite simple, a few curves. Once you arrive you can park for 5 euros all day and go down for a few minutes. Nothing too complex.It is worth going to see the islet, the water is beautiful and there are fewer people there compared to the main beach which gets quite crowded.Two flaws: the food was nothing special and where we ate towards the beginning the lady at the cash register was a little rude.As for the sunbeds, wait to pay and get a receipt before going for a walk and leaving them unattended, we witnessed an argument between those who had bought the sunbed very early but had not yet paid and those who had paid for it and grabbed it even though they had arrived. late, the fault of the managers of the sunbeds who did not check that they were really free. The cost is 20 euros, cash only.In general, a beach not to be missed.

reviews.title: Super
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Low and warm water, very few people. Stunning pine forest and super excellent bars for everyone's palate.

reviews.title: Over advertised
reviews.text: Over advertised!All the charm and all the potential beauty disappears in the crowd of all the people and the lack of sunbeds.No, unfortunately it wasn't worth wasting a whole day,

reviews.title: Elafonissi, unmissable beach
reviews.text: wherever you are in Crete, Elafonissi beach, in the prefecture of Chania, cannot be missed.an expanse of sea awaits you with five different shades of blue in which strips of white and coral pink sand are inserted. if you are lying in the water you have to make sure you are wet, you may not notice it as it is transparent and crystalline.bring water and something to eat with you and stay in this place as long as you can.unmissable

reviews.title: Good bath but overcrowded!
reviews.text: The place itself is amazing; a large area of shallow, turquoise water with a sandy beach in between. The sand is sometimes (depending on the winds) shimmering pink - but not when we were there, a Saturday in August.The information you don't get before you go there is that the car parks cost €5 (a pittance) but it's a long way to walk through the terrain, on rocky ground down to the beach area itself. There are very limited parasols and sunbeds, if you come after 10, the place feels packed. We found a rock to put our things on while we bathed.There is nowhere to buy refreshments down on the beach area - from what we saw anyway. Bring everything you need to eat and drink and wear good shoes for the hike down and back!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but lower your expectations about the “pinkness of the sand” very low depth of water so you cant actually swim there and parking costs 5 euros.

reviews.title: Recommended experience
reviews.text: You arrive at this beach after about thirty km of mountain roads, narrow and full of hairpin bends and, unfortunately, also traveled by tourist buses. After leaving the car there is then a stretch of about a quarter of an hour to walk. We arrived at 11am and there were no more umbrellas available. Obviously there is the possibility of bringing your own. Huge beach, gorgeous water.

reviews.title: Hordes of tourists
reviews.text: Do you think Benidorm beach is full in summer? You don't know Elafonisi's. The limits of physics are not met here. There is so much crowding that the main business is the several giant parking lots for so many cars. From there, an endless line of ants for almost 15 minutes until reaching the beach, where the umbrellas are immediately occupied, and there is no shade to shelter under.The shore is not pink sand, but there is a narrow pink strip made of shells. The photos on the internet are highly retouched. If the intention is to visit a beautiful place, I don't think that crowding justifies it.

reviews.title: The most beautiful
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach for us,Parking cost 5 euros.You travel along a small, fairly "arid" stretch of road and then immerse yourself in a paradise of life.Ideal for children and for those who love walking in the water, a "packed lunch" is recommended because during peak hours the place to eat is a considerable distance away and also very crowded.Even though there were many people, we managed to fully enjoy this paradise.Absolutely not to be missed!😍

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: This beach cannot be described, you have to come here and immerse yourself in the beauty of this paradise, I have never seen such a fascinating and wonderful beach.At times very windy, but pleasant because the day is very hot, the road to get there is very doable, nothing dangerous, the road is entirely asphalted. Park in the last open space before the descent which can be done easily with trainers.Heaven is here!!!!!

reviews.title: Paradise😎😎😎😎😎😎😎
reviews.text: Beach of dazzling beauty... crystal clear and clean water nothing to envy of the Caribbean... I recommend arriving early to see the almost deserted lagoon before the crowds arrive... an absolute must see

reviews.title: A miracle!!
reviews.text: It will take you almost 1.5 hours to reach the beach.There are enough parking lots to park but quite far from the beach. It takes at least 15 minutes of walkingTo the beach.Although much further down right next to the beach there is a HUGE parking lot that is unknown why they don't let people go. But if you persist, they might let you go. If you have a health problem or some other problem, they will definitely let you go! We, after a lot of fuss with a rude gentleman, passed!There are canteens that have snacks drinks soft drinks etcThe set of sunbeds costs €20, but they are relatively few for the volume of people. If you are there early, eg until 9, you might find.The beach really is a miracle!! Wonderful clear waters with unique pink sand!! Unique images that we only see in photos, come to life in front of you! It is more than worth visiting this unique place which, in my opinion, is one of the most beautiful beaches in Greece!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but it feels like being at a fair
reviews.text: We stayed during a day in mid-August, perhaps not exactly the best time.Although the beach is truly beautiful and the sea is stupendous, too many tourists reign supreme. Buses arrive from all over the island and an infinite amount of cars which cause many queues entering and leaving the beach. They are very organized with huge car parks, bars and taverns which, despite being comfortable, ruin the landscape in my opinion.A trip to take two photos is worth doing but a whole day is too much (at least when we were there).

reviews.title: Great beach, but getting there stinks now
reviews.text: I travel to Greece every year, and this beach is by far one of my favorite beaches in Greece. That was up until this summer. After an hour drive down there, the road was blocked off at a certain point and you had to park in their lots. It was only €5, but the walk absolutely sucked. Over 100° carrying all of your things, without any shade for 20 minutes. The walk out is even worse because it’s all uphill and some uneven rock areas. I’m very saddened by this because just the summer before in 2022 you could park right up to the beach area and just get out of your car and be at the beach. This completely ruined it for me. And let me tell you this beach is unbelievable.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: The sea is crystal clear but there are really a lot of people. A 2 minute drive away there is a much more beautiful but less known beach. The lagoon is suitable for children. The pink sand is really there.

reviews.title: Arrive early and go to the island
reviews.text: Beautiful beaches, not to be missed, but very crowded.When I was there 20+ years ago it was an almost deserted paradise, now it is more crowded than a lido on the Romagna Riviera.They should put a limited number with reservationYou need to arrive early (before 9:00) and go to the island, as far forward as possible to avoid the crowds in the area where there are umbrellas and sunbeds.If you want shade, bring an umbrella or buy one on the street.Parking at €5: reasonable (don't stop at the first parking lots).Umbrellas for €20: expensive, but given the amount of people they could charge whatever price they want.Then there are the usual idiots who take away pink sand.

reviews.title: Crowded beach with long walk
reviews.text: The beach is like a crowded Bellevue or Hornbæk beach.Quite nice, but not suitable for people with poor walking. Not something to brag about. Long descent and you also have to go up again. A small train would help those who have difficulty walking and they are also tourists who must have the opportunity.

reviews.title: Elafonissi, Crete
reviews.text: Getting to Elafonissi from Eraklion is not easy, the last 20 km of road are tortuous, of course everything is rewarded by the spectacle that lies before you, no parking problems, at the fixed cost of 5 euros. Sneakers are recommended for the easy descent into the sea. Given the large number of people who enjoy this beach, it is best to bring your own umbrella and waterproof mats because the ground is often full of water. Stunning beach and unmissable for anyone visiting Crete; Please don't take the local pink sand in an uncivilized way, it's running out and it's a shame.

reviews.title: Overrated beach
reviews.text: Overrated beach, marketed as the pink beach but only the rocks right at the water's edge are pink. It's beautiful and shallow, but insanely crowded and for a family with children, it's too far to walk for small children's legs.

reviews.title: Busy Beach
reviews.text: Somewhere here there is a beautiful beach trying to escape. However, before you undertake a 3 hour car journey, pay 5€ to park your hire car and walk 15 minutes to the beach, this stretch of occasional pink sand is populated by thousands upon thousands of well meaning, sun seeking tourists. Make no mistake, this place is busy, very busy, bodies everywhere, for us a beach we could not remain on. So after staying for 10 minutes we preferred the 3 hour return journey. That’s just us, perhaps we should have researched a little deeper before we picked this day trip. At least if you read this review you’ll know what to expect.

reviews.title: Heavenly, even crowded
reviews.text: We went on mid-August, left from Planias, an hour's drive, arrived around 2pm, lots of people, but at that time we found a parking space because there are always people coming and going. Full car park, we parked in a small street before the descent, without needing a ticket.A short downhill road reaches the beach, there is a refreshment point, with showers and umbrella/sunbed sets. From the beach there is a strip of sand that goes towards the sea, if there is wind you can move to the more sheltered side, or go beyond the dune which is located at the end of the strip of sand. However, it is so large that once you get past the initial part you will find plenty of space to sunbathe while lying on the huge shoreline, you can play beach volleyball, tennis or just stay and admire the pink sand under your feet.The next day we preferred to come back here rather than go to Balos beach.

reviews.title: Negative
reviews.text: One of the most irritating places in all of Crete.10.30 am, super crowded with people and children screaming.The beach itself is very beautiful but at 8.30 in the morning.Negative experience.

reviews.title: Great beach, lots of people
reviews.text: The beach and the scenery are magical! The only negative is that it was too crowded! I would suggest the unorganized spots because the organized ones were quite dirty. It is worth visiting! Easy access with children too! Also, leaving your car in the last parking lot costs the same as the rest and you will travel a much shorter distance on foot!

reviews.title: This is not heaven.
reviews.text: Stunning colors, but that's all.Parking nearby and a quiet 5/10 minute walk to get to the beach.Very few umbrellas (we arrived at the beach by car at 9.30 and there were perhaps 4/5 left in the area on the right, the least beautiful).Around 11 all the organized tours arrive and the beach loses all its charm.Very crowded, noisy, people everywhere, mainly shallow and warm water.Fortunately we "explored" the beach as soon as we arrived and enjoyed the wonderful coves beyond the hill when they were still deserted, an indescribable peace.From midday onwards the water takes on even more unforgettable shades, but the strong wind picks up (strong enough to windsurf, impossible to keep a hat on your head).In short, if you go to Crete, a day in Elafonissi is mandatory, but see it once and never go back again.

reviews.title: Passage to elafonissi
reviews.text: It’s a magnificent place that you absolutely must do early in the morning, after 11 a.m. it’s just mass tourism.I confirm some opinions that the beach is not pink but that you can admire in certain places pieces of coral coloring the sand pink.

reviews.title: Camp
reviews.text: Wonderful place but really poorly managed. Forget the umbrella and get ready for a very wild and not very relaxing day!A shame!

reviews.title: A dream
reviews.text: A beach to see at least once in your life and will become your comparison for all the others you will see, cheap and convenient parking, cheap services but there are also large isolated and heavenly spaces for walks and the sea

reviews.title: A beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beach with a spectacular view.The water with different shades of blue… great for families and to enjoy a relaxed day at the beach.Lack of umbrellas for the number of visitors it receives.I recommend the visit

reviews.title: A disappointment!!
reviews.text: You don't describe in words if no one sees it!!!! The influx of people like ants has no sunbeds (we didn't even have such a request!!) Not even a small piece of land to sit on!!! To clarify, we were there at 10:30 !!! Well, we paid 5 euros for parking, you mean with a 10' walk because we didn't have any other choice!! Passing a little water, they explained to us that this happens every day from 9 in the morning when all the buses arrive and leave tourists until 2 in the afternoon!! In the simple world that comes from very early!! We didn't know that!!! We ate all the twists and turns until we arrived!!! Like a view - water - very very shallow on one side - we didn't go on the other!! We had to go over the world!!

reviews.title: Lovely beach with pink sand, great snorkeling
reviews.text: We went for Elafonissi with an organized tour and had 4 hours at the beach. The busses stops about 15-20 minutes walking distance from the actual beach but the walk isn’t too bad as long as you make sure to wear sunblock, a hat and have water with you. There was a lot of people there but we still managed to get our own spot on the beach close to the waterline and the pink sand. The waters were crystal clear and while snorkeling we saw lots of different fish. It was quite windy which was good in regards to the heat, but we were also covered in sand. Lovely day though!

reviews.title: Sublime beach
reviews.text: Very busy beach but worth the detour. Beyond the famous pink sand there are magnificent shades of blue. The water temperature is ideal but be careful of sunburn.

reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: We went there after Balos so it didn't impress us too much. It’s a pretty beach to go very, very early because by 9 a.m. there are no more deckchairs and no shade and by 11 a.m./12 p.m. hundreds of people arrive,I put two photos, the first at 9 a.m. the second at 12 p.m.
Fairytale lagoon with adjoining island reachable on a strip of sand. The only flaw is that the umbrellas are too close together

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very nice sandy beach. The transparent and clear water with the sand having a light pink color. When you arrive there is parking at a cost of 5 euros for the whole day, then there is a small walk to get to the beach but it is very doable. Once you arrive at the beach there is both an equipped and a free beach and there are also bars and kiosks for lunch. For the free beach, equip yourself with an umbrella because it is very hot and there is nothing to shelter from the sun.I highly recommend arriving early in the morning because the beach then fills up with people and you risk having trouble finding a good place to put your towel.

reviews.title: Boring for families with children
reviews.text: Magical landscape.. wonderful, exotic.But if you make the mistake of going with a baby, or if you don't have the stamina to walk... you stepped on it.I had been there before years ago. What is valid now is that it is not allowed to drive down to the beach. So after taking 1 hour of turns, you have to walk 10 minutes to get there.Ok go for it…. Come on, it's uphill with incredible sun, it's very difficult. I'm not talking about it if you carry equipment with you (umbrellas, chairs, etc.)...We went at 9 in the morning and it had about 300 people. When we left at 1, it had over 3000... you could barely fit in to swim or put your towel on.Set of sunbeds €20, a good deal compared to other prices on other beaches. Refreshment very expensive.Put on a triple layer of sunscreen or you'll need yogurt afterwards for the burns ☺️

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Nice beautiful beach but cold seaThere is a lagoon with shallow waterThe area is very ventilatedYou arrive by car, parking €5 then a doable walk to the beachThere are sun loungers at the bar and a free beach

reviews.title: Disrespectful tourists
reviews.text: The place is very beautiful, particular, definitely worth visiting if you go and see the photos on the internet you can get an idea of what it really is like... but: you have to go very early, the crowd (we're talking about more than 6000 people) arrives around 10. This means that the beach becomes a frenzy, there is a shortage of space for umbrellas and you certainly won't find paid ones.Don't stop at the beginning of the beach, cross over and go to the other side towards the open sea. It is equally beautiful but more sheltered from the wind and there are fewer people on the beach. Rudeness and lack of respect prevail due to the inaction of staff. You will find residues of human shit (yeah) if you move under the trees and many regardless of the crumbling fences bivouac among the very rare wild flowers in the dunes. Very sad.I hope that instead of illegal car parkers they will put a toll and a limited number of parking spaces, otherwise very little will remain of the beautiful dunes and the lagoon with the pink beach.

reviews.title: HEAVENLY place!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Beach absolutely worth seeing!!!!!We left Chania at around 7.30am, as it takes around an hour and a half to get there; the road is a bit winding, but well asphalted (DJ advised us to take the internal road, because it got longer with the more panoramic road).Parking cost 5 euros per day.I recommend comfortable shoes or sandals as there is a slightly dirt shortcut to get to the beach.It is preferable to arrive at the beach at 9.30 at the latest because otherwise there will be no umbrellas available (to be on the safe side I recommend bringing your own umbrella in case nothing is free).The place is difficult to describe....you have to see it!!!!Calling it a beach is an understatement!!!!!On the side towards the sea there are some stretches where the pink sand can be seen very well!!!!!!MANDATORY stop!!!!!

reviews.title: Rose??? A little bit
reviews.text: We arrived no later than 10.30am even earlier and all the few sunbeds were already sold out. All that remains is to lie down on the ground, too bad that the sand is very damp (perhaps because it gets flooded with water in the evening? Dunno) and the towels get so soaked in humidity that they are very wet. I recommend bringing a mat/something plastic to avoid this. Overcrowded (ok it's August). Water actually super clean (on the left side more beautiful, turquoise while on the right even lower and tending towards green/very transparent). I have proof that many photos are full of filters: pink can be seen very little in the photo and on the same beach as I imagined it is not very present.. Well maybe it was a question of sea storms and I was unlucky! There is only one shower: think about the queue... However, the experience itself was quite disappointing compared to how busy the beach is, at least for me who hates the free beach.

reviews.title: Many people
reviews.text: Beach full of people. In the evening when everyone has gone you can enjoy a paradise while the sun sets. In my opinion Falasarna is much better.

reviews.title: I strongly advise against
reviews.text: A word of advice, move on! The road to get there is horrible, for long hours you are on zigzag mountain paths at very high altitude and once you arrive there there will be so many people that it looks more like the Cergy pond than a heavenly beach. Besides, don’t be fooled by the advertising of pink sand, there isn’t any left at all!

reviews.title: Paradises in destruction
reviews.text: The beach and the surroundings are wonderful but like everything that becomes popular, in summer it is massive. I have known this beach and this environment for more than 20 years and the change in the last 4+pandemic + post-pandemic has been dizzying.Although they prevent (it is not clear that they have authorization to do so) parking in the old parking lots and that makes the cars further away, it has been at the cost of creating parking monstrosities that charge you without a ticket or receipt at 5 €.the environmental awareness posters have disappeared. You will only see some 20x40 handwritten signs that ask you not to uproot plants or take shells or sand. Nothing about exposing the environmental wealth of the area.Then there is that this parking business has some workers of Pakistani origin as jobs (who you will also see in the tuner asking to clean your car while you wait). You will see that in an area of the old parking lot, when you go down to the beach, there is a group of old girls who seem to have a bad life.Then there are the people who skip the dune protection cord to settle under the trees of the coastal dune or explore the islet, like an explorer. The locals do this, the Germans, the English, Italians, Spaniards...Then there is kite surfing. That after the pandemic has literally taken over the beach, usurping one of the islets to the family bathroom. Why can a kite surf school and a motorcycle company take over half of the beach?Then there is the plastic. Greenhouses have grown massively on the island, and this area is no exception.The environment is on its way to becoming a landscape like that of Paleochora. This year they continue to grow.Hopefully soon the local authorities will protect this wonder a little, taking care of environmental education with posters and some surveillance; controlling these businesses (motorcycles and kites, parking...and those to come) so that they become businesses but coexist better with the urgent need for environmental sustainability, the rights of workers (the car park caretakers housed in caravans), etc.But I'm telling you, the road works herald an even more massive future...🤞🏼.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, white/pink seabed, one of the most beautiful I've seen. It's a shame, but with the period it couldn't have been otherwise, due to the sea of people. Come like us at 8 in the morning and spend the morning, at 12 it is already full although livable. If you arrive early there are trees which with their shade will save you the money for the umbrella, which ran out already at 9am. For parking, as already said by others, it is best to use the last one before the closed road, even if they try to let you in first.

reviews.title: an open-air swimming pool
reviews.text: Sea with a thousand shades of blue, very spacious beach, but poorly used (there are only 2 establishments), shades of pink only on the shore. Arrive early in the morning to get an umbrella!

reviews.title: A paradise on earth!
reviews.text: The beauty of the water and the beach in this little corner of Crete will leave you speechless! Here are some indications:- the road to get from Kissamos (1 hour) is full of curves but entirely asphalted;- parking costs 5 euros and is a 10 minute walk away;- I arrived at the beach at 9.45 and there were still few people;- at 11.30 the beach filled up and at 12.00 the initial part was really invaded;- to enjoy tranquility, I recommend moving to the "islet"... the further you go the fewer people you will find. Here you will find yourself in a postcard environment with white beaches, dunes and a wonderful sea. In this way, we were able to enjoy tranquility even on a very popular day like Sunday 13 August.

reviews.title: a dream beach in Crete
reviews.text: Fabulous beach, it's worth seeing and spending the day here.Despite being very popular with tourists, it is also very large so there is always space to lie down on the sand.it is often very exposed to the wind but there are some areas that are more sheltered than others.The colors of the water here are incomparable, wonderful, it looks like a swimming pool due to how transparent it is. You never want to get out of the water...A fairy tale!The journey to reach it is a bit long and at times tortuous but nothing impossible.Wonderful!

reviews.title: Elafonisi in October
reviews.text: Magnificent beach known for its crystal clear water and pink sand. I went there on October 26, it was hot from late morning and the water was very pleasant.When you arrive there is ample free parking.We arrive at a first crescent-shaped beach, but we can cross the sea to the right, water height at thigh-waist level (I'm 1.57m) to access another area of the beach, quieter. This area appeals to me. was more reminiscent of the Landes with its small weeds obviously without its waves.Corner suitable for children.

reviews.title: Privatization of the beach
reviews.text: I am sorry that such a beautiful beach, being one of the treasures of Greece, has become miserable.They force you to leave the car 20 minutes before the beach and to pay the €5 fee. From there you have to walk to the beach, where they don't charge you €30 for a set of sunbeds with umbrellas. There are very few sunbeds and you have to go very early in the morning to find a seat.The world is countless and the beauty of the landscape is destroyed.The use of the toilet is also charged with €1 per visit.Having visited this beach many times in the past, I am disappointed. It has been privatized and the current owners of the beach have sacrificed everything on the altar of money.We probably want this Greece. Deserving of our fate.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The views were  amazing. The beach has a lovely pink hue. It's shallow waters go on for miles. In crystal clear waters. A must go if your in Crete.

reviews.title: Fantastic sandy beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach. There are numerous loungers and umbrellas available for a fee. It is very busy, but the beach is also very large. You can go far into the water without sinking.It is a beautiful sandy beach with a very gentle slope and is also suitable for non-swimmers. Parking spaces on site can be scarce, but it was worth it.

reviews.title: Heavenly, but you better arrive early
reviews.text: Beautiful area.The road is worth the detour,The success of the place is deserved.You have to accept being on the peak in August... there are people.Let all the authors of the comments about tourists rest assured, they are indeed one of them!

reviews.title: All on the altar of money
reviews.text: You drive 1 and a half hours to get there from Chania and when you arrive there is a ban on cars and vehicles 1 kilometer before the sea and they oblige you to leave the car in a parking lot (payment means 5€). They informed us that the beach has changed ownership and for this reason they no longer allow motor vehicles to proceed to the beach while it has plenty of space to park cars (in short exploitation to take them from the private parking lot). As for the beach, good, but avoid it when it's windy. Few sunbeds for the crowd that gathers. All at the altar of money. I'm not going to come again.

reviews.title: Shit black
reviews.text: We left the car at the third parking lot and walked for half an hour to the beach... They all say pink sand and there was none.... inside, the sea was too shallow to be able to swim, you had to go all the way in... and because windy the beach was dirty... Also it was so windy that the sand rose up, you couldn't put your umbrella and it was so crowded that we were on top of each other... I have never been to a worse beach I don't recommend it to anyone to go

reviews.title: Overcrowded beach!
reviews.text: A word of advice: go your way, it’s a tourist trap!We went there at the end of the day, thinking that the “most” of the crowds had passed (seeing all the buses/cars coming back up) big mistake! The beach was still crowded, I didn’t take any photos…not interesting with so many people!In fact the beach must be nice but not in July/August…but I find its reputation more than overrated :/There is almost no pink sand (or more), of course it is pleasant to walk on a sandy bottom but with all these people, less…The icing on the cake, if I may say so, as the toilets are chargeable (1 euro is not excessive either!) some preferred...defecating in the water :(

reviewsWithKeywords.title: to slow down in the city
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Huge park.With multiple options for walking or lounging.There are paid sectors (botanical garden, Japanese park), free sectors (lakes), paths between the roses, in forest, on a stone bridge.Sculptures, museums.I don't think even a week is enough to meet him.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely park with wide trails, lakes, sculptures and a huge conservatory to pass a few hrs walking around.  A good link between the Golden Gate bridge  and the Haight-Ashbury area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, probably the most beautiful park ever seen so far; not only considering the USA.Amazing variety and respect for nature to the maximum; really recommended

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Golden Gate Park visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were lucky enough to join the free tour thru the Japanese Tea Harden offered by  the park volunteers. Our guide, Hope’s presentation was thought provoking describing the Japanese family devoted to caring for the garden. We so enjoyed her description of the garden’s history.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: San Francisco’s Green Gem!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Golden Gate Park is a San Francisco treasure, larger than Central Park and full of things to explore. You’ll find miles of trails for walking or biking, wide lawns for picnics, and lakes with paddle boats. At Strawberry Hill, the park’s highest point, you can enjoy peaceful views, a small waterfall, and dog-friendly paths. We even came across a fun “sea monster” exhibition. Perfect for families, pet owners, or anyone who loves the outdoors.

Golden Gate Park is a sprawling urban oasis that never disappoints. My family spent hours exploring gardens, lakes, and museums, with plenty of shaded paths and open lawns for picnics or play. The free shuttle and bike rentals make it easy to navigate, and seasonal events like concerts or flower blooms add extra charm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bison paddock👍🏻
