allReviews.text: Travel expert here & I was honored to spend new years day on Eagle Beach! Easy to get to from the cruise port.. lots of busses for $5 a person. Crystal clear water and beautiful soft white sand!! Fairly spacious so plenty of room on the beach & in the water! I could float here for days! Bring your sunscreen!!

allReviews.title: Great beach.
allReviews.text: Very pretty beach. Parking wasn't a problem at 11am. Can rent umbrella and chairs -but very expensive. Met someone who rented chairs and umbrella for week from coconut rentals and was very pleased.  Sun is very strong so need coverage. Water and sand lovely.

allReviews.title: Great family photo spot!
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is always a great spot in Aruba to enjoy the sunset. Take family photos or just hang out by the beach during the day.

allReviews.title: Float
allReviews.text: Beautiful calm water beach with white sand. Best beach to just float on a donut float and relax. Most people are from the local resorts but beaches are open to the public in Aruba. If you get there later in the day you can use their lawn chair under a palapa that people leave behind. We were never pressured to rent a chair. People were relaxed but timing was not high season. There is a food hut 🛖 with great healthy affordable options and drinks🍹

allReviews.title: Better beaches elsewhere
allReviews.text: Super crowded on a Friday afternoon - there are definitely better beaches on Aruba. Lots of boats and jet skis buzzing around close to shore.

allReviews.title: Better than Palm Beach
allReviews.text: We visited Eagle Beach after disappointment at Palm Beach, which was too touristy and busy for us. Eagle Beach is home to the low rises, and they are actually across the road from the beach, so you don't have that chaos. The physical beach and water was similar at Eagle Beach, but Eagle Beach was so much more laid back and peaceful. It is a very long stretch of beach which is great for walks, and the sunsets are quite nice here.

allReviews.title: Amazing beach
allReviews.text: You MUST visit this magnificent beach.  My husband and I hunt for the most beautiful beaches in the world and we can say that this one ranks high.  the beach is more than spacious, white, crystalline sand. The endless turquoise sea.  There is no crowd, you can find a secluded place and enjoy.

allReviews.title: Murky water, white sands, no shades, NOT the best beach in the world
allReviews.text: Overrated in my opinion, but, not a bad beach, reminded me of South Miami Beach, but the sands are much whiter here.  It's a long strip of beach, no shades you can cool off.  The beach bed/bench is $60 all day and you do get an umbrella.  There is a public free shower place.  There is a public bathroom but we didn't use it, I read some reviews saying that it's $1 fee.  I also read that the sunset is one of the best, but I didn't experience it, had to leave early.  No big waves when we visited.  Clean beach and no one trying to sell you stuff.  Water was a little warm, but very murky, not pristine at all.  We snorkeled and found no fish, also not many seashells, so how could this be one of the "best beaches in the world"?

allReviews.title: horrible experience- scam beach
allReviews.text: Scam Beach- Not worth the hype. Beach is $50 for two chairs, waves were a bit high, and the restaurant is horrible. so expensive and a 45 minute wait for a quesadilla. save your money and skip.

allReviews.title: Amazing beach and wonderful scenery, and some advice.
allReviews.text: My experience was amazing and the sun was shining even in the winter, the water and beach was clean and beautiful. I would re apply every hour though because I am dark skinned myself but I still burned. Overall amazing 10/10 would recommend.

allReviews.title: Aruba not worth it
allReviews.text: Aruba is an island that is not worth visiting, it is very small, it has only 3 beaches, one of which is rocky and the others are full of people, without much appeal regarding a Miami beach. You have to fight for palapas, the sea is normal, I would go to Curacao 20 times more than there. To go to Palm Beach you have to be in the mega hotels, and anyway it is not very nice beach.

allReviews.title: 50$ for a beach bed
allReviews.text: Nice beach, wide and long. White sand and beautiful clear water. But... 50 $ for two cots and a screen?!?! That's against scams. We'll never come here again and, judging by the reactions of those around us, we're not the only ones. Afrader!

allReviews.title: Pristine white sand beach....
allReviews.text: Amazing beach and island Aruba. Rated as one of the best beaches in the world is indeed so true.... I loved Aruba very much!!

allReviews.title: Take your own chairs and umbrellas!
allReviews.text: As far as a beach goes, it was just okay. We were only there for a few hours on a cruise so we needed to rent a couple of chairs and umbrella. $50? Yeah, nope. We used our towels and soaked up the Vitamin D. The beach is clean though and the sand is soft. The waves can get a little rough at times so beware with littles. FYI: there’s only porta-potties for bathrooms. 🥴

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Only our second beach on island but if you’re a beach walker this is it. Activities offered jet skis. Snorkeling possible. A couple food options.

allReviews.title: The Beautiful Eagle Beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: The crystal clear waters and powdery white sands of Eagle Beach in Aruba, in itself insures you will long to return to Aruba... again and again. We're hooked, you will be too, save us a spot. Enjoy! E

allReviews.title: Angry Beach Chair Attendant
allReviews.text: Among the beaches we visited in Aruba this was the only bad one due to an overly aggressive, extremely rude beach chair attendant with some anger issues. He screamed at my wife for sitting on one of the many empty beach chairs while I went to the booth to pay for it. Apparently that was the incorrect protocol for beach chair rental here, it must be paid for before you select where you want to sit (?). With so many other beautiful beaches to visit and vendors who appreciate their customers, we cut this one short and moved on.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: Awesome location,  breakfast package is a great value.  All staff extremely helpful.   Quick 5 min walk to Eagle Beach. Bell Captain Pablo Hoyos super efficient.

allReviews.title: The best sunset
allReviews.text: A wide and very nice beach...it was easy to get place to park...seeing the sunset on this beach is just spectacular

allReviews.title: Beautiful eagle beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach with great calm water and soft sand. Rental umbrellas and chairs available, along with a bar that serves food

allReviews.title: Horrible Horrible Horrible Experience
allReviews.text: These people need training and really should have been reported.  To the tourism Board of Aruba. Again it is my experience that white people get seen and respectable treatment than others. Horrible horrible horrible experience which has left me severely traumatized. Extremely disappointed and hurt by the level of service and treatment given, was an embarrassing experience that I cannot even fully express my way through. I was doubled charged for my room from my original booking and I had to leave without a full explanation or an account for the charges. Change your dollars to local these ppl take serious advantage use there money!!!!

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach: Soft sands
allReviews.text: It is Aruba's largest beach and very famous for its soft sand. It has infrastructure: shaded areas, a few tents and many options for the practice of water sports.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach experience
allReviews.text: Eagle beach was beautiful . There was plenty to do whether you wanted to relax quietly or rent jet skis ! Plenty of shadeOptions as well.

allReviews.title: Beautiful stop off on cruise
allReviews.text: Gorgeous, clean beach. Great for sunbathing and swimming. There's some nice beach bars and you can rent a jet ski etc or pay to go on a speedboat/inflatable ride!

allReviews.title: Awesome Beach and Axccomodations.
allReviews.text: OMG, it's such a cool beach with all the accommodations one could expect.  Our first time here and there is everything: cabanas, recliners, wifi, electricity (after 4:30 pm), bathrooms, and a Bar/Grill.  We are in awe of this place and will be back.  No need to be crowded on the Marriott Aruba Surf Club Beach.  v/r, Dr. and Mrs. King.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: An amazing beach in Aruba to spend the day with the family with a beautiful sunset, you cannot miss it, we will surely return to enjoy it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach and clear warm waters
allReviews.text: Stunning beach, and my favourite on the island. It definitely lives up to its reputation of one of the best in the Caribbean.  We caught the bus from Oranjestad where we were staying, which was an easy and cheap way to get there.  The beach is a great size, and it's easy to find a quiet spot to yourselves.  There ate plenty of options for water sports etc. Definitely recommend a visit.

allReviews.title: Great Beach if you know where to go.
allReviews.text: Great beach if you choose where to go. Large stretches have hotels on them spoiling it. However there are still some areas with no hotels which are much nicer. We found a lovely stretch with virtually nobody on it. It tended to get busier after 1.pm but not too much. The sea was very safe to swim in.

allReviews.title: Spectacular beach
allReviews.text: We arrived on this island for our honeymoon, this beach is spectacular you can not explain it in words. It's the second day here and I don't want to leave. Super recommended , a crystal clear sea, white sand.... I've never seen better.

allReviews.title: Relaxing Beach
allReviews.text: This beach is nice and flat with no rocks. A couple of places to get lunch within walking distance. Would recommend going in the morning to put out your chairs.

allReviews.title: Looking for the best beach
allReviews.text: I have travelled twice to Aruba, this time as a couple. Unlike Palm Beach, Eagle offers wider, mostly natural beaches (I mean less commercial invasion). Top-rated contrasts between the sand and the different shades offered by the sea.The problem I find is that being all public, some are very much invaded by jet ski rentals (more in Palm than in eagle).

allReviews.title: Excellent , paradise beaches
allReviews.text: Beautiful, it is expensive to serve highchairs and umbrellas, us 35. Because it is not advisable to stay long on the beach, the sun burns!!

allReviews.title: Stunning beach!
allReviews.text: Eagle beach has not gained its reputation for nothing. We booked a hotel just by the beach and it was a great choice since me and my husband totally loved this beach!

allReviews.title: The best beach for afternoon
allReviews.text: The most popular beach because on this one you find all the condos and hotels. The sunset view is simply spectacular. Additional waves are low and almost zero

allReviews.title: For a Relax Day
allReviews.text: Excellent beach, one of my favorite beaches, very clean beautiful perfect for relaxing with family and friends.Highly recommended!

allReviews.title: Over rated
allReviews.text: So it’s great but over rated. I like it a little less busy. But the sand and sea are as goodas it gets. I prefer palm beach, but that’s just me and we splitting hairs. Aruba is a wonderful location for any beach holiday, and all the people are wonderful.

allReviews.title: Eagle Resort- Amazing place
allReviews.text: An amazing place, rooms are clean & spacious, staff is knowledgeable and very helpful. They make your stay so relaxing and comfortable, especially the front desk with Joenna, Melissa, Lucy & Ryan. Tony's outdoor restaurant convenient with very good food and service. Compliments to our servers Nieves & Carla & Michael the supervisor who are some of the finest on the island they are caring and attentive to all your needs. Mario the pool attendant was super also. Nelinda the reservations manager went out of her way to find us the perfect room along with her competent staff. We could not find any issues with the resort. They attempt to make you feel a part of the Eagle family. very reasonably priced.

allReviews.title: The most incredible beach
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Aruba! We visited quite a few beaches and kept coming back to Eagle. By far the most beautiful, sand like flour, very gentle waves if any. Absolute perfection. VERY hot, so make sure you bring or get shade.

allReviews.title: beautiful beach, nice clear water and white sands
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach with some waves but not a lot.  Go early so you can grab a free palapas.  No bathrooms but plenty of restaurants nearby so you can use their restrooms.

allReviews.title: Definitely worth the visit
allReviews.text: The beach was beautiful! We got there early in the morning and rented chairs and an umbrella feet from the water. White sand is soft and water was pristine and refreshing. I understand why it's such a popular beach. Only disappointment is that the area we were at only had 1 bathroom for such a popular beach resulting in a 30 minute wait.

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: Gorgeous beach!! Sunsets are breathtaking, water is beautiful, and the area has nice food and drinks. The fofoti trees are so unique too!

allReviews.title: Paradis
allReviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It was unfortunately cloudy but still nice. Nice and warm water. We will be back.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Incredible beach with beautiful sand. We were surprised that the water was quite cool even on a 90 degree day. We did this beach break on an excursion after an island tour. We give the beach a 5, we give Royal Caribbean a 0 for their crappy and less than acceptable beach chairs that your customers have to drag across the beach and set up themselves.

allReviews.title: Friendlies Beach In Aruba
allReviews.text: The main reason my wife and I love this beach is because it is amazing for swimming, for us it is perfect.  Also, it is not as commercialized as some other beaches like Palm Beach, but you can get there by car in 5 minutes. On Eagle Beach you can have your privacy or socialize as much as you want, everyone is friendly.

allReviews.title: Love Eagle Beach!
allReviews.text: Friends week at Paradise Villas with the beautiful Eagle Beach across the street. Beautiful white sand and blue clean water. Couldn’t ask for more!

allReviews.title: Nice beach
allReviews.text: A very nice beach. Busy on cruise days and very windy in August but still highly recommend. Beach chairs can be rented and there are plenty of places to eat.

allReviews.title: Don't believe the hype.  Consider going elsewhere.
allReviews.text: Pleasant beach, but there are better.  No idea how it got it's high rating.Poor facilities.Exorbitantly priced loungers and umbrellas.  $50 for 2 rusty loungers and an umbrella.  These guys are blatantly ripping you off.Very windy the day we went, felt like you were getting sand blasted.Not too much to look at if you are wanting the day snorkelling.The immediate area along the road behind the beach looked shabby.Wish we'd have gone elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach is truly spectacular
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is truly spectacular, living up to its reputation as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The sand is incredibly soft, and because it's made of coral rather than rocks, it doesn’t heat up under the sun—meaning you can walk barefoot without worrying about burning your feet. The water is a stunning aquamarine, crystal-clear, and free from algae or jellyfish. It’s perfect for snorkeling with kids, as the calm, wave-free waters are safe and filled with tiny fish. The water is also pleasantly lukewarm, making it ideal for a relaxing swim.As for amenities, the beach offers free umbrellas, though these are often claimed by early risers around 6 a.m. However, there’s no need to worry if you miss out—private companies along the coast rent out umbrellas and recliners. The coastline is also dotted with various restaurant options. I highly recommend *Passions on the Beach*, a must-visit spot. While it’s on the pricier side and even hosts the occasional beach wedding, the live music and excellent food make it worth the splurge. For a special meal with your toes in the sand, you’ll need to book a table about three days in advance, but even the walk-in tables offer the same breathtaking views of Eagle Beach.Another great feature is the free parking available in the beach area, making it convenient to spend the day here without extra hassle. Overall, Eagle Beach offers a perfect mix of natural beauty and convenient amenities, making it an ideal destination for families, couples, or anyone looking to enjoy one of the best beaches in the world.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel and tip in General de Cartagena
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel and tour. Just beware of those who work there want to put you consumption that you did not take and in the port from where the boat leaves; beware of those boaters who are scammers and use the modus operandi of selling you tours through the free and when they are going to charge you they want to carry thousands of Colombian pesos and threatening you knowing that the authorities will do nothing. Cartagena is cute, but take tours with operators from your hotel. That's safer.

allReviews.title: Wonderful beach!
allReviews.text: The views were amazing! We stayed at the LA Cabana on Eagle Beach and it was a walk across the street for us. The most beautiful beach I've ever seen in person.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
allReviews.text: The beach itself is beautiful but the day we went it was extremely windy and that was not enjoyable because of the amount of blowing sand so not sure if that is an everyday occurrence or not. Lots of water sports to choose from if desired.  The beachside bar is good for snacks and beverages.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach
allReviews.text: This beach is amazing!!!! Very big beach so you can find a quiet spot away from the crowds - we rented chairs, umbrella, and cooler for the week so we were able to sit right by the water - if you sit next to the water be ready for strong wind gusts. Not a snorkeling spot but crystal clear water!

allReviews.title: Gorgeous beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful and calm blue water, clean and safe beach, powdery white sand, free palapas on our section (place chairs by 7:00 AM to be sure you get one!), short walks to beach restaurants/bars, plenty of room for Spikeball and other beach/water games on our section of the beach near Oceania Residences. Loved it!

allReviews.title: Beautiful and serene
allReviews.text: I'm from Florida so I know beaches. What a beautiful, fantastic stretch of white sand and cool water. Several hotels dot the area. Stay at one and enjoy this world class beach.

allReviews.title: Best beach of Aruba
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach has been rated as one of the best beaches in the world and a top beach in the Caribbean time and time again. This pristine long stretch of beach with soft white sands and aqua blue waters features a variety of water sports and some palapas. Eagle Beach is a favorite among locals and tourists and is located in front of the low-rise hotels.

allReviews.title: Breathtaking
allReviews.text: White sand, crystal clear water, the perfect description of the Caribbean Sea. Worth a visit, busy beach but free parking in Aruba

allReviews.title: The best beach.
allReviews.text: We had the possibility to tour the whole island and its beaches. The first place is shared with Baby Beach. Eagle Beach is beautiful, full of fish and many activities to do. We never missed a place to sit, there was always a palapa (as the umbrella is called here) available. Best beach I ever knew.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Beach
allReviews.text: Just LOVE Eagle Beach!!!  The beach is so beautiful and the area is so clean.  The Tiki Huts are just awesome to have some shade, but can get plenty sun if you like.

allReviews.title: Wordless
allReviews.text: What a beach! Crystal clear, ample water, white sand to spend a beautiful family time, you can do water sports, sunbathe or walk.

allReviews.title: Stunning! Right out of a travel magazine.
allReviews.text: The water is absolutely stunning! You've stepped right into a dream. The sand is white, so it stays cool under your feet. There is always a breeze in Aruba, which is nice because it cools you off without the sand blowing. I do recommend towel clips! Water clear and great for swimming, but not much snorkeling. Definitely a relax, read and swim type of beach. Plan to arrive before 10am if you want a good parking spot and under one of the free public thatched umbrellas (palapas) as they are first come, first serve. Otherwise, there are ample umbrellas/beach lounges for rent. Parking is free. Probably best to avoid cruise ship arrival days if you want fewer crowds.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand. The water so clear and calm. For snorkeling not much. They have water sport too. Jet ski, boating.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach at sunset
allReviews.text: Busy beach, but we came later in the day and many were leaving.  Bar with food, drinks and bathrooms nearby.  Sand is amazingly soft with clear water.  No water shoes needed. Enjoyed the beautiful sunset and saw baby turtles hatch (random event).  There is a group of volunteers who watch the roped off areas. We happened to be in the right place at the right time.

allReviews.title: Extensive and beautiful
allReviews.text: Far the largest beach in Aruba, is extensive, has palapas and the water is crystal clear, you can see Silver fish, very beautiful

allReviews.title: Beach with calm and crystal clear waters
allReviews.text: It's a really beautiful beach. Calm waters, transparent sea, warm water. It is quite quiet compared to Palm Beach, where most resorts are located, since Eagle is a 30-minute walk south of Palm and downtown. So the decision about which area to stay will depend on whether you are looking for more tranquility or being closer to the center to go for a walk or enjoy bars and restaurants that I must say are very expensive

allReviews.title: Not “2nd best beach in the world” worthy
allReviews.text: Not sure how it got the 2nd best beach in the world title but if that’s why you’re coming, you’ll be disappointed. I mean, it’s pretty, but that’s about it.

allReviews.title: Most beautiful beach we’ve been to!
allReviews.text: What a beautiful beach! We also checked out tres trapi, Boca Catalina, baby beach and Mangel Halto. The beaches in Aruba are stellar! We didn’t like the rocky bottom at MH but all others were awesome!     At Eagle Beach especially the ocean and beach were so beautiful hardly anyone was at the pool, which we’d never seen before in other places the pool is always packed. Aruba’s  Beaches are more beautiful than Oahu or Kauai imo and Mexico’s (playa mujeres or Cancun) beaches are no comparison to  Hawaii or Aruba. Aruba water is shallow, warm and waves much less aggressive than we’ve ever seen.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach.
allReviews.text: It is a beautiful beach with its white sand and turquoise water.  We did a little snorkeling and saw some nice fish. The water was just right.

allReviews.title: Beautiful BUT be careful
allReviews.text: It's beautiful here! Definitely worth a visit - BUT be careful! Our bag was stolen there - so it's best to leave all valuables in the car!

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: A beautiful beach, with services to eat and drink. Rental of umbrellas and chairs. Water sports are not offered out of respect for marine fauna.  You may be lucky to find turtles swimming next to you. Follow the recommendations if you come across them.  It is the southernmost beach on the island, I hope the hotel complex under construction does not ruin it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches on the island. Quite wide.  With aquatic services, rental of chairs and umbrellas. Drink and food purchase points.

allReviews.title: Perfect Beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Nice public/free beach not far from the Cruise terminal. The water was perfect, the beach was rather clean and seemed safe, the sand never got too hot. Was a great beach to just hang out and drink and catch some sun.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Caribbean Blues
allReviews.text: This is the most amazing beach in the world. Long expanse of white sand which allows it to never feel crowded. The idyllic water which displays three dominant colors of blue will simply take your breath away

allReviews.title: Excellent tour guides! Very exciting tour and experience!
allReviews.text: Jersey and Carlos were THE BEST! Funny, happy, entertaining, thorough, and grateful. Lots of history in his talks. And they changed a flat in only moments. Experienced and polite. We enjoyed our tour very much.

allReviews.title: My Favorite Beach
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches in the Caribbean, No Seaweed!!! Calm waters, long beautiful walks on white sand with gorgeous sunset views. We alway stay at the Oceania Residences right across the street.

allReviews.title: Nice walking boardwalk/path
allReviews.text: Calm waters with no seaweed. Not very many dining options on the water. Gorgeous sunset and safe relaxed atmosphere. Will be visiting again.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach had the softest sand and was beautiful.  The water was three or four different shades of blues and turquoise each day. Since it is on the low rise side of the island, it was peaceful and relaxing. However, when the waves kicked up, it was fun to bounce around in them. Valuable lessons - bring an insulated cup for your drinks (everything gets warm quick) and get yourself a pool noodle to float in the water. We will definitely return.

allReviews.title: Perfect beach day.
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful.  The beach is clean, the water is clear. No water shoes needed. There are chairs and umbrellas for rent.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous beach
allReviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches and it wasn’t crowded. We went on a Saturday afternoon. Sand was so soft, beautiful water and a quiet beach.

allReviews.title: Bring your sunglasses!
allReviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach to catch a lot of sun and play. Take the time to walk the  entire beach! Go on a jet ski and visit other beaches and resorts.

allReviews.title: La Cabana resort....the beach with lounge chair avalability.
allReviews.text: When you get off the cruise ship and take a taxi to Eagle Beach they will typically drop you off at Cocoa Beach Bar area. All the cruise passengers are typically directed to this beach by the  taxi drivers. Once you get there, there are no chairs or umbrellas available. Best to go down to La Cabana Beach across from that hotel there were plenty of chairs available at 11:00 when we arrived

allReviews.title: Stunning beach one of the best in the Caribbean
allReviews.text: Second time on Eagle it’s worth the effort. Top tip stay up near the Fofoti trees there’s not much to see past there. The water is crystal clear & a beautiful hues of blue as you’d expect in the Caribbean. We’re glad we’ve been however were surprised by the lack of facilities.

allReviews.title: Alright
allReviews.text: We went to this beach 5 times during our stay in Aruba. It is the 2nd most beautiful beach on this earth according to many. It is very long. The sand is fine and pale. The water was a little cold, but it was also refreshing. The water was cloudy.

allReviews.title: Lovely beach.
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach with nice calm waters. The people keep it clean and provide comfortable chaise lounges. I felt so comfortable that I fell asleep on the chaise lounge. And unlike other beaches I’ve been to, it wasn’t that crowded and you felt like you had enough room to enjoy the water and the land. Definitely recommend this beach to check out if you are in Aruba.

allReviews.title: Family beach fun
allReviews.text: By far the better beach vs Palm. Also better than Noord beaches. Quiet, wide sand area, clean, no seaweed water. Some wind & slightly strong waves but not too wild

allReviews.title: Eagle beach how to get there
allReviews.text: An excellent beach and easy to get to from cruise ship. Just walk around the back of the shops to the bus station. It is only $2.50 fare each and drops you at the beach in 15 mins.Beach chairs and umbrellas $20 for daySuperb swimming and water sports.

allReviews.title: Heaven
allReviews.text: What a beautiful place! It doesn't get any better than that. White sand, blue ocean. The best of the Caribbean sea. Also has a very nice structure and the famous trees

allReviews.title: Crystal Clear Water!
allReviews.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches I’ve ever seen! This was our first port and it didn’t disappoint! The sand is soft and the water is clear! If your short on time like we were ask your taxi driver to take you to see the famous Divi tree! It was located on the other end of eagle beach.

allReviews.title: The best beach on the island
allReviews.text: The best beach on the island. A little breeze. The wind is a bit strong but it can be a very good experience. Don't forget to visit it

allReviews.title: First time
allReviews.text: Cute place... The food is delicious, the animators and vendors are nice, the programs are good... The beach and the pool are nice and clean, but unfortunately the rooms are the opposite... They could be cleaner...

allReviews.title: Summary i like the place, and like more then the peoples.
allReviews.text: We are here 10 days termin. The hotel is good, but the service team are the best. The animators, the managing director, the seesecrets guys, shisa, coctail boy. They supported our hollydays to perfect level. We see lot of see animals, dolphins, and many more. The eats are also realy good, and the evening programs are very interresting. So fully we has a very nice 10 days here, and i hope we’ll meet again. Weak point maybe the room vleankng and wifi, but that was forgetable. :)

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: Eagle beach was great! Clear and calm water and not crowded. If I were to rank the beaches it is Baby beach then Eagle. We went to Eagle beach most days because not only is it beautiful but close to our condo. The have water sports available and chair and umbrella rentals.

allReviews.title: Stop busing cruise passengers
allReviews.text: Still beautiful but cruise ship daytrippers are having an impact. On certain days buses dump enough cruise passengers to make it look like Coney Island. On a positive side we took 2 hour walks most days and enjoyed the beautiful waters.

allReviews.title: Awesome Beach!!
allReviews.text: During a recent cruise stop, we did a tour that ended up at Arashi Beach. It was too rocky so we asked the tour operator to take us t another beach and drop us off. That is how we ended up at Eagle Beach. It is minutes away from the port and such a beautiful beach! It is what I expected a beach in Aruba to look like. As soon as we got there we were greeted at the entrance by Juan Hernandez. He made sure we had seating and we also did some water sports through him. He was so helpful and sociable, everyone was shouting him out. The best art about this beach is that there was ample shaded areas to sit and relax. If you go to Eagle Beach, make sure you look for Juan!

allReviews.title: Beautiful but does smell
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is gorgeous.  The sand is so soft and powdery.  The water is calm and clear. But…the sewage facility is near by.  It definitely stinks.  Paradise shouldn’t smell like poop.

allReviews.title: Best beach in the Caribbean
allReviews.text: I loved Aruba, Eagle Beach is one of its best beaches. Our hotel was on that beach. Super recommended!! Since it is a quiet, large beach I loved it!!

allReviews.title: Aruba is amazing!
allReviews.text: The Caribbean is unique! Aruba then, no comments needed - just going to find out! Take a tour around the entire island! It's so worth it!

allReviews.title: If you like the smell of sewage, this beach is for you!
allReviews.text: The beach itself is beautiful (blue calm water) with a lot of amenities. However, the beach smells like a sewer. It is a strong smell. It is not a top beach—no way.

allReviews.title: Best Beach Experience in a Long Time
allReviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach. Two chairs and an umbrella will run you $50 and only cash is accepted. It's well worth it. The bar was hopping and there was a party going strong in the middle of the day. It was Aruba's Flag Day, so maybe that's why the celebration was big on a Monday afternoon. I recommend this place for a day in the sun, the sand, and the ocean. The water was warm and calm.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is a MUST!!!
allReviews.text: The water was so clear!  The bottom of the ocean was all white sand. The colors of the ocean at Eagle Beach were amazing!!!  It’s hard to capture it in photos 🏖️🏝️🩱♥️. We rented an umbrella and two chairs for $50 (usd), no time limit. Beautiful being words.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is amazing! Beautiful white sand that stretches for miles! The water is crystal clear and views are breathtaking!

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience, beautiful island, go to relax and have a good time
allReviews.text: The happy island, beautiful, safe. To go as a family, with a partner or alone, beautiful beaches and beautiful places to take photos and admire

allReviews.title: Paradise
allReviews.text: Sunny, cool breeze, crystal clear water, powdery sand. Just like a movie! People were friendly. Beach was clean. Just the relaxing experience we were hoping for to get a break from the New England snow.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable, beach day!
allReviews.text: We took City bus to Eagle Beach. It’s an easy walk from the cruise port. We were on a carnival ship. This was our first time walking to the bus station and using it to go anywhere. This beach was one of the first stops. The sand is really soft here and we didn’t need water shoes. There is no racks when you’re walking in to the water although there is a pretty big drop off in the sand to get down from where your chairs are to the water the day we were there, the waves were strong And we still enjoyed the water but it helped to have a floaty to hang onto. The temperature of the water was wonderful in January and there was no seagrass. We rented a lounge chair for $10. There were also restaurants where you could order drinks or food although we did not partake in that. The bus stop is right next to one of the restaurants , and easy to find when you’re ready to go back to the port area. This was a really good day for a very reasonable price!

allReviews.title: Excellent Beach - Close to Cruise Terminal
allReviews.text: While cruising to Aruba, our group went to Eagle Beach. as it came highly recommended.Now, you may think, well everyone from the cruise will be here and the place will be packed. True, a lot of people from your cruise ship will be here but, the beach is huge. There is a lot of room to spread out.On the downside, umbrellas run out quickly (never understood this, don't you want to keep a big supply of umbrellas and make money?). So, if you don't get there early, you will have to camp under one of the trees that puts you not close to the water.Second down side, limited facilities. Two Port-o-potties and a single occupancy men's room and ladies room, do not facilities make.Overall, this is an excellent beach to go to from the cruise. Could use a little more but still worth the visit.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach, but the sewer stink will ruin your day.
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the Caribbean, bar none. However, they have a serious sewer issue here and it smells terrible. Aruba needs to step up and correct the over development and insufficient infrastructure. Its really an issue, not occasional, consistent.

allReviews.title: Aruba beach
allReviews.text: The beach kept going and going.   It was exceptionally clean. Plenty of restaurants nearby.   The water was beautiful and inviting.  The nearby bar was fun and active with an outside shower to wash the sand off.

allReviews.title: Great time in ARUBA
allReviews.text: Had a wonderful time in Aruba, Clean beaches, Very, Very friendly people. Great shopping district. Said my wife.$$$. The Beef we ate their was so much better that in the USA. No Added Hormones nor Antibiotics. I mean CLEAN beef.Awesome.

allReviews.title: Loving today!
allReviews.text: Loving Aruba Enjoying Eagle Beach. Just relaxing, gorgeous, one of the best beaches in Aruba. Bring your drinks, food and chairs.

allReviews.title: Worth visit
allReviews.text: Very nice beach to have long walks and collect shells. Not necessarily the quietest place to visit , music can get loud. Spectacular view

allReviews.title: Must see
allReviews.text: Nestled along the serene shores of Aruba lies the pristine paradise of Eagle Beach, a tranquil oasis that stands in stark contrast to the bustling energy of Palm Beach. Having experienced both, I can confidently attest to the incomparable beauty and serenity that Eagle Beach offers, making it a standout destination for those seeking peace and relaxation.Unlike its counterpart, Palm Beach, which is often crowded with noise and commotion, Eagle Beach exudes a sense of calm and tranquility. Here, the gentle waves lapping against the shore provide a soothing soundtrack, creating the perfect atmosphere for unwinding and rejuvenation.Moreover, the atmosphere at Eagle Beach is one of natural splendor and unspoiled beauty. With its pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters, it's easy to see why Eagle Beach consistently ranks among the top beaches in the world. Whether you're strolling along the shoreline, basking in the sun, or simply taking in the breathtaking views, every moment spent at Eagle Beach feels like a true escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.Additionally, the ambiance at Eagle Beach is far more laid-back and peaceful compared to Palm Beach. Here, you won't find the crowds or noise that often accompany tourist-heavy areas, allowing for a more intimate and authentic beach experience.In conclusion, while both Palm Beach and Eagle Beach have their own unique charms, it is Eagle Beach that truly stands out as a haven of tranquility and natural beauty. For those seeking a peaceful retreat away from the crowds and noise, Eagle Beach is the perfect destination.

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches I've ever been to!!!There is always wind, but it is never bothersome. We spent very nice days in Aruba.

allReviews.title: Aruba is now our family tradition
allReviews.text: Already purchased our room for next January. Aruba is beautiful,  friendly, and adventurous,  with some of the finest dining. Beaches are georgious with soft, cool, white sand. The breeze keeps the feeling of humidity way down. No hairspray! Let the salt air give your hair the body and natural look it needs!  We felt very safe to explore the island. The residents and natives are the nicest people we've experienced anywhere. The beaches and resorts are first class!

allReviews.title: One of the best in the world
allReviews.text: Easy access.  Smooth beach for walking. Lots of activities.  Little choppy in the water when the pleasure boats zip by - but nothing objectionable.

allReviews.title: Nice but massively overpriced
allReviews.text: Visited for one afternoon from a cruise ship. Nice beach, strong current in sea but outrageous pricing of sun beds. Quoted $50 for two beds with one umbrella..then asked for one umbrella and one bed instead and quoted $40. (At coco loco beach ).Arrogant attitude of sun bed attendants was truly shocking and the greed of them is unbelievable. Grand Anse Beach in Grenada is much better at $30 for the same.No idea how this can be said to be the 2nd best beach of the carrier as clearly isn’t

allReviews.title: Beautiful, picture perfect, clean
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach. White powdery sand, crystal clear water. I did not try snorkelling here so cannot comment on wildlife. It is a long beach with a number of palapas. (Straw roof shelters). These are free for public use but if you want beach chairs, you need to bring your own or hire them from a beach attendant. We were charged $37 for 2 at 15:30pm. The sea was lovely and warm to swim in and the sand very clean. It was picture perfect and a very enjoyable place to swim

allReviews.title: Beach day.
allReviews.text: Definitely a happy island, We have so much fun every time we go It is my favorite in the Caribbean There is a lot to do every time I'm looking forward to going back every time highly recommend 🌴🌴🌴

allReviews.title: Favorite beach
allReviews.text: Favorite beach ever! Beautiful turquoise water, soft white sand, friendly people. Everyone claps as the sun disappears beneath a pastel sky. The weather was perfect every day, with comfortable temps and a constant warm breeze. Stayed across the street at Eagle Aruba, so chairs were provided and beach access is free. Needed lots of sun protection but not a mosquito around and almost no seaweed.

allReviews.title: Definitely NOT  THE BEST BEACH
allReviews.text: Not sure from where to begin… very disappointed. First time for Aruba and we had a different expectation about the water on here . We had a breze day but the water is nothing like clear just has the turquoise colour, the waves were quite big is an open long beach but expensive too . They  are charging $30 for umbrella & $10 for a sun-bed chair . Facilities are just in 2 places, where you can have a drink , use the toilets & showers . A beer price is $7 , taxi $7 pp one way . Not sure why is a number one best beaches in Aruba but not for us . Then we visit Palm beach too, please don’t go just if you are part of the hotels around , as you can’t rent a chair just if you are staying in the hotel . Best to spend your day probably is to go to a private Island 🏝️ like Palm Island , where the water is clear ,you can do snorkelling, see flamingo on the beach and have the best of what Aruba can offer .

allReviews.title: One of the best beaches in Aruba
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches in Aruba with crystal clear and calm water like a swimming pool. It has facilities for water sports and is well connected with public transport from the center of Oranjestad (5 dollars).

allReviews.title: Cute but not the best.
allReviews.text: It is a very nice beach, but I highly recommend Divi Bech and Manchebo Beach, they are less crowded and I found them much more beautiful.And if they have a car, baby beach is also very cute

allReviews.title: Amazing sunsets
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, not too crowded, great place to take in a sunset. The nearby jet ski rental makes for an awful lot of noise, so not a 5-star experience. Pro-tip: people who live in the nearby condos donate extra beach chairs by placing them under the palapas early in the morning, free for anyone who may need one! At least, I can only assume they are giving away their Tommy Bahama chairs, because they certainly wouldn't be attempting to reserve a palapa for much later in the day, that would be an unbecoming display of entitlement…

allReviews.title: Must see beach. You won’t regret it
allReviews.text: Definitely visit this beach. Beautiful soft sand, wide beach. Great for a long walk. You can rent a lounge chair for $10 each for the day. Umbrella $35 (a little steep). Get there early enough and snag a palapa or under tree. The beach is clean and there are places to grab a drink or food if needed.

allReviews.title: one happy island
allReviews.text: You can dare to say that it is the quietest and safest place you can be in the world, it is like being in paradise, there are no street vendors interrupting your tranquility. It is the maximum

allReviews.title: Great place to spend the day. I would recommend this beach to anyone who wants to enjoy a day in the sun.
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is great for an individual or an entire family. The beach is clean and well maintained. We found the people on the beach to be very friendly. There are plenty of places close by for eating or you can bring your own food. It is a great place to spend the day relaxing or just having fun in the sun.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: The beach is beautiful. Very clean. Wide beach area. As we walked down the beach we noted very little , if any, seaweed or debris. This beach is rated the top beach in Aruba for good reason.

allReviews.title: A unique day at the beach
allReviews.text: A beautiful beach, its crystal clear water, its white sand, the comfort of not being bothered by vendors and being calm. Its sunsets, everything is spectacular.

allReviews.title: one more beach, but with the best sunset
allReviews.text: overrated beach. It is very pretty, yes, but it is not one of the best in the Caribbean. It is wide, the sand is clear, the water depending on the wind and the day (like everywhere) is more turquoise. I highlight that the landscape at sunset is one of the best I have seen in my life.

allReviews.title: A beautiful wow
allReviews.text: Beach 4.8 km from the terminal by taxi at a good price. Chairs at $20 for 2 and umbrella (which we didn't take) at $35. The water is magnificent and the beach is very long for those who like to walk. There is supposed to be wifi but we were never able to connect.

allReviews.title: Disappointed

allReviews.title: Bucuti & Tara - Closest thing to heaven on earth.
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Bucuti & Tara resort in Eagle Beach - it was the epitome of luxury and hospitality without any pretentiousness.

allReviews.title: Very good
allReviews.text: Very good view nice beaches .. breezy and nice.Would love to visit this area soon.Recommendations to visit this place.

allReviews.title: Excellent for swimming and sunset

allReviews.title: Eagle beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach that was not over crowded at this time of year. Cool vibe! Easy to get to from most hotels. We had drinks at Passions beach bar.

allReviews.title: Must See Beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach in Aruba is like stepping into a dream – soft, powdery sand, clear turquoise waters, and those iconic divi divi trees create a serene paradise. It's not just a beach; it's a genuine escape where time slows down, and every sunset feels like a masterpiece.

allReviews.title: A movie beach
allReviews.text: Eagle beach, like many other beaches in Aruba, is a movie set, a beach of fine white sand with a spectacular turquoise sea and where you can do many water activities.

allReviews.title: An amazing beach!⛱️
allReviews.text: It is a calm, relaxing beach this you would LOVE to go on! It's so quiet, [on most days] and it is fit for the whole family. I would go there any day!❤️

allReviews.title: Wonderful Eagle Beach

allReviews.title: That beach is the best to spend the day with beach umbrellas
allReviews.text: Wide beaches and crystal clear sea.Free straw umbrellas. And you can rent pastries. That area is better to stay than Palm beach. Although spacious, 2 meters from the shore in Palm Beach theSeabed is decomposing..

allReviews.title: Paradise on the Little Rock
allReviews.text: Under appreciated and underrated. Despite being named as one of the world’s best beaches, many still miss enjoying it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: I stayed at a hotel on Eagle Beach. A very beautiful beach, calm sea and not crowded. There are kiosks to sit at, but everything is paid (if your hotel is not facing the sea).

allReviews.title: Residence of the most famous Fofoti Tree
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is one of the most famous beaches in Aruba because of the Fofoti Tree.I found it to be a beautiful beach, it wasn't crowded and there are kiosks for tourists.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: Very good beach, the biggest attraction in the country is there due to the resort and movement it has. I don't like the beach, for me it's just walking around the urban area.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach is changing...
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful beach that has up until now been a real haven for those who stay in Aruba.  It's still beautiful and worth a visit.  The fine white powdered sand and turquoise waters are rare jewels to behold!  It has been a quiet and peaceful area until recent years. Cruise ship buses are now bringing hordes of people at noon and dumping them onto Eagle beach all at once, right across from Oceania Resorts and MVC.  This, in addition to all of the new high rises, is changing the nature of the Aruba we have come to love.  I hope island politicians do what they can to protect this paradise before it is too late.

allReviews.title: Best beach in Aruba, breathtaking and serene!
allReviews.text: Breathtaking, beautiful serene beach, not too crowded, lovely crystal clean water, gentle waves, bring a water hammock float and just drift away, pure bliss! Beach bar nearby, chairs, and palapas available for shade (first come, first serve but some open up later in the day too). No noisy motorboats or constant watersports here.   No dumb rules, just enjoy the beach!

allReviews.title: Commercial
allReviews.text: You are only welcome here if you stay in the hotels on the beach. Beds cannot be rented if another guest shouts or is expensive. Very unwelcome feeling for locals or other guests.

allReviews.title: Good option
allReviews.text: It was the first beach we went to on the island and it is very beautiful, it is large, clean and its waters are excellent. Although I prefer other beaches.I recommend arriving early to have a good spot.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: I spend my days on this beautiful beach. White sand and turquoise water. The beach is clean. You can lounge all day like I did or go jet skiing. The sunset is beautiful.

allReviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world
allReviews.text: By far one of the best beaches in the world... spacious, generous parking space, coral sand, crystal clear waters... Divine

allReviews.title: Very cute
allReviews.text: We really liked this beach, the white sand, calm, not as rocky as Arashi beach. You can rent jet skis and boat rides, although we did not use them. Further ahead there is a very quiet beach that I loved.

allReviews.title: What a paradise
allReviews.text: We spent a few hours on this beach during a cruise stop. The colors of the sea are spectacular and the water is warm

allReviews.title: Ocean was beautiful, some options for chairs/umbrellas, not so much for food
allReviews.text: Aruba's beaches are beautiful no matter which one you pick. Amenities however are a big deal. Once dropped off by taxi from the cruise port across from Amsterdam Manor on Eagle beach we noticed there were some options, but we came in mid day and all the palapas in one area were all taken. We went to the area to our right and paid $50 US for the largest umbrella I've ever seen and chairs. So that was great! We didn't even mind the heavy price tag because a lot of people were turning their noses up to the high price and only five families were on this large swath of beach! The ocean in front of us was pretty empty which was great with us! We saw people with coolers, but they are tourists visiting on the island, not cruise ship tourists. Tough for us to bring food and drinks with us.Now the bad. There are no restrooms in this area (unless you eat/drink at the hotels across the street), no real restaurants unless you use the ones for the hotels there. If you went to the far end there was one bar area and that's where my husband found the drinks at a little red and green shack behind the straw palapas close to Amsterdam Manor. Their 4pm two for one local beer was great but otherwise expensive. This was the ONLY place that took cash everywhere else you must use you credit card.  We've been burnt by that before.ALSO NOTE: My husband and I decided to invest in a beach chair lock bag with combination lock to keep our valuables safe. Were we ever glad we did! We were in the ocean when we saw someone hovering over our chairs my husband swam and ran out of the ocean as fast as he could and scared him off. What if we had walked away on a beach walk and not had it. More than likely our valuables would have been gone if we didn't have that locked bag. The loose bag I brough only had sun lotions and books in it so no great loss but still. I understand you have to be careful no matter where you go, but my husband and I are big fans of a combination lock beach bag now!Next time we will be going to Palm beach or Arashi beah instead. Palm beach we now know has far more options although a little denser population on the beaches there are just better options for food and drinks, and their downtown area is just off that area, and from the youtube videos we saw after the fact would have been a better option for us. If you want a less crowded area Eagle beach would be fine for you, a lot of people still go to it, but I couldn't see  me spending a whole lot of time there since food options are limited.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Caribbean Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is one of the most enjoyable beaches in Aruba with a variety of recreational opportunities.  When we visited in February the weather was super nice and the waves were pretty calm.  Parking was relatively easy to find, and we walked on the beach one way and returned to the car by way of the paved path parallel to the beach.  Several resorts and pricey restaurants are located in the area.  The Fofoti trees on Eagle Beach are very photogenic, being permanently swayed towards the ocean by winds.  They make the perfect photo-op.  The beach is very wide with and very clean.  Eagle Beach offers beautiful Caribbean ocean views.

allReviews.title: Waste of time
allReviews.text: Looked forward to visiting what was touted one of best beaches in the world . Got better in UK . Yes blue sea white sand . Facilities poor bars poor would not waste time going again

allReviews.title: Bad smell from sewage plant
allReviews.text: It looks nice but unfortunately the smell was really bad several days in a row. After googling "sewage smell eagle beach", I learned there is a sewage plant nearby and it seems to have some problems. A shame that such a nice looking beach is spoiled by the smell.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is Amazing and NOT crowded
allReviews.text: Best beach experience. Not crowded and the palapa were free to visitors. As they advertised, the sand is white and soft and the water truly amazing. There were little fish swimming around us in the ocean.

allReviews.title: Great day trip or excursion
allReviews.text: Aruba was a cruise stop for us and after some research decided on Eagle Beach due to its beauty and location. We told a taxi the beach’s name and he dropped us off at Coco Loco Beach Bar where nearby we rented 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas for $100. Kinda pricey but we couldn’t provide our own so what ya gonna do. The beach is long and the sand is light beige. A lot like Destin, FL (but better) if you’re familiar with that area. The water is surprisingly so many beautiful shades of blue and very clean. Once in the water the sand felt almost like mud, which was kinda neat. Temp of the water was quite comfortable for Dec. We got drinks at Coco Loco and they had a bathroom for everyone to use. Overall great stop for a day.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever been to, although I also loved Baby Beach. A beach with a long stretch of white sand and several options of bars and hotels. Comparable to the northeast of Brazil, they are far superior to the beaches I saw in Europe. Only in the Caribbean and Brazil do we find this warm water and good bar options on the beaches. I was there in January 2017

allReviews.title: Best beach on the island
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches to visit the beach and sea is amazing. The only downfall is the high prices charged for beds and umbrellas

allReviews.title: Great Beaches
allReviews.text: We took a private tour to Eagle and Palm Beaches to enjoy the great beaches that Aruba has to offer.  Lots of low rise and high rise hotels along the way to satify everyones budget.  I think I liked the colourful Amsterdam Hotel the best.We then drove through Oranjestad and headed off to San Nicolsas to have a look at Baby Beach.  After spending 30 mins there we went back to San Nicholas to take pictures of the very colourful and beautiful wall murals that adorned many walls in the town.  Then it was back to Oranjestad.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is beautiful, but bring cash!
allReviews.text: Our cruise ship docked in Aruba for the day and after some shopping in the morning we decided to spend the afternoon at the beach. A few people recommended Eagle Beach, so we decided to check it out. My word of advice if you go is to bring a lot of cash. We rented chairs and an umbrella for $65. Umbrella and 2 chairs were $50, and each additional chair was $15. Renting an umbrella and chairs also gives you access to the bathroom and showers at Coco Loco bar. If you are going to be at the beach for any amount of time, I would suggest chairs and an umbrella. The shade is very limited. We took a taxi from the cruise port. It was $15 each way plus tip. Be aware it could be as much as $25 each way. It depends on the driver. You are definitely at their mercy on the way back to the ship. We enjoyed our afternoon but the beach is a bit rough so you will want to keep a really good eye on small children in and near the water. If I can answer any questions for you, please feel free to send me a message.

allReviews.title: Nice beach
allReviews.text: A very nice beach, its landscapes and views are beautiful, however when I went there was a lot of current and it was difficult to swim with children, a very good place to do beach sports.

allReviews.title: Mindblown
allReviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach. The sunsets were incredible. We loved the rentable scooters and e-bikes along the beach as well!

allReviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches
allReviews.text: It was considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the worldIn fact, it is very beautiful, with white sand and clear waters.It's a much less crowded beach than Palm Beach, with less infrastructure, but it's worth visiting.I stayed in a condominium on this beach and it was worth it.

allReviews.title: Aruba's most famous beach
allReviews.text: Quiet beach, water a wonderful shade of blue, at this time it was cold, but with the hot sun it was great.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach: The Crown Jewel of the Caribbean!
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is the most expansive beach on the island boasting the softest sand and loads of amenities. We stay at the Costa Linda Beach Resort (Time Share) located at the widest point of the beach. The services are second to none and everything you want to do is close by. Facing the Caribbean to the right are jet skis, snorkeling, tubing, parasailing and more. All reasonably priced. It’s almost never crowded as most tourists end up in the high rise where all the big restaurants and shopping is done. But the low-rise? That’s where the magic is and Eagle Beach is the crown jewel. Spectacular views, the best photos and perfect sunsets! You have to experience it to really believe it!

allReviews.title: Mama food truck!
allReviews.text: This review is for Mamas food truck/ Truck di Mama and not the beach. The beach is great, sand, sun and sea. But, if you are there get to this food truck right across from Chalet de  Suisse. Get there early as they open at 11 and close when the food runs out, which it does. Portions, flavour, sauce, service all fantastic. We split a chicken, shrimp and fish platter, for one person it’s a good sized meal, we split it as we had been eating like crazy all vacation and were both satisfied with the quantity but super impressed with the quality. Shrimp was better than Zeerovers. Fish and chicken were healthy portions and seasoned with local flavours. The sauces are awesome!  The pink hot sauce (papaya I think) is the bomb. Definitely hit this place up. They aren’t on trip advisor but you can find some info I. The forums and on the google reviews.

allReviews.title: Fourth time cruise stop
allReviews.text: Our fourth time on a cruise stop in Aruba. The beach was just as we left it pre-covid. $15 cab from the cruise port. Beach is free but 2 chairs and umbrella was $50 all day. There was a steeper entry into the surf than I remember but if you walk the beach you can find an easy entry/exit spot. Maybe hurricane leftover. Nice sandy bottom, no seaweed.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach a bit more choppy than Palm Beach
allReviews.text: Due to shaky weather mostly, not a fault of the beach I think, the waves were more choppy at Eagle Beach than they were at Palm Beach. But Palm Beach has a deeper (further away form the shore) sand shelf to break the waves than Eagle Beach.   Over a one week stay, we went to the beach 4 times, but the last time it was a lot smoother and easy to stand in the water without getting hit hard by a wave.  But getting a beach umbrella was easy at $25 for the day (or however long you stayed during the day) was reasonable.

allReviews.title: The most beautiful in Aruba!!
allReviews.text: This beach is a dream, one of the most beautiful in the Caribbean: white beach, crystal clear waters and absence of algae, thanks to the particular currents that wash the island! Those who go to this beach can choose tranquility by positioning themselves towards Manchebo and Divi, or they can try various water sports by approaching the Fofoti area.Beautiful!

allReviews.title: Eagle beach, nice beach but I think it is very "inflated"
allReviews.text: We were there on June 23, we stayed in a condominium 2 blocks from the beach. The area is pleasant although there are not many shops or rest compared to Palm Beach. Umbrellas can be used free of charge on the beach. A lot of wind, at times with sand flying that sometimes bothers a little. It is a very nice beach but the truth is, in my opinion, as I am lucky enough to see many beaches in the Caribbean, I think this one, like all of Aruba, is very well sold. This is a very expensive destination compared to others in the Caribbean and I think it is not worth what it costs, perhaps more than double that of other destinations.

allReviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beach on the entire island! It is super extensive, white sand, turquoise water, super safe. You can leave your things without fear. They also have public straw umbrellas, which can be used free of charge and there is usually a place because there are few people. The best sunsets are seen from here. Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Top 5 in the world
allReviews.text: Very beautiful beach, the most beautiful on the island and in the top 5 in the world, soft sand, like powder, remains cool in the sun, clean beach (except the few smokers who bury their cigarette butts in the sand)

allReviews.title: The refreshing sand.
allReviews.text: Many positive comments have already been written about this beach and without waste I think that having named it the best beach in the world is fair. I'm just going to mention something that I haven't read and that seems significant to me: Eagle Beach, Aruba has white sand that never gets warm; not even at noon. It is common to walk barefoot on the beach.

allReviews.title: Beach erosion
allReviews.text: Went to  Aruba in October, beach was totally eroded,dissapointed.stay at palm beach.Wish they would post current pictures.....beware!!

allReviews.title: Great beach lousy services
allReviews.text: Great beach with few amenities. I would have given it a 5 star review but the attitude of the chair rental guys and $55 dollars for ripped up  couple of chairs and an umbrella are the reason for the lesser review. This could be a real winner but they need to improve the customer service experience.

allReviews.title: Congratulations!
allReviews.text: A good hotel, good food, good service, very clean rooms, a hotel to return to and enjoy a little vacation. Thank you !

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: This is a great beach. Sand is soft and water warm. It is a great place to stay for the day. Parking free. There is skidoo rentals for 80.00 for half hour. They also sell beach chairs. There is no shells or rocks in the water. Nice and smooth bottom.

allReviews.title: Amazing and safe beach
allReviews.text: Less glamorous than Palm Beach, it is a family beach, quiet and safe, but with all the beauty of Aruba's beaches. The calm sea with beautiful colors and the fine sand form a beautiful frame for the typical trees, the “fofoti”.As a Brazilian traveling alone, I really resisted leaving my things, including my wallet, passport and cell phone, unattended until I was in Eagle Beach. There, I really felt safe and swam for a long time away from my belongings, which remained untouched where I left them (which would certainly happen anywhere in Aruba).I listened to good music and really enjoyed the sea and the sun, but it was difficult to ignore the screams of “religious” in a microphone somewhere nearby, but we Brazilians also understood that.

allReviews.title: people
allReviews.text: very popular beach. super crowded, with nothing different. It has structure and is close to the resorts. Very calm water.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of space for everyone. Activities if you wish!Sunbeds & parasol.Beautiful sunset on the first floor!

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach where memories are made❤️
allReviews.text: 30+ years of staying at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort on Eagle beach. My home away from home. Spectacular beach at an excellent resort. For many reasons it’s my happy place. If the opportunity presents itself come visit you’ll keep going back.❤️🌴

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach and wonderful sea
allReviews.text: A beautiful white sandy beach with a lovely cooling blue sea. It's super quiet. Here and there there are wicker parasols where you can sit, but you can also rent parasols and beds. Definitely recommended.

allReviews.title: Best beach in the world
allReviews.text: Best beach I've ever been to! Eagle Beach is an amazing beach with white sand, clear blue waters, and warm water swimming.

allReviews.title: One of the pretties beaches we've been to in the Carribean
allReviews.text: We stayed at Costa Linda right on Eagle Beach. Quite Expansive and clean w/ crystal clear water. We are usually pool types but this beach drew us everyday.

allReviews.title: Great beach crappy chair and umbrella rentals
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach! Not crowded. Easy taxi ride from the cruise port. The only issue we had was chair and umbrella rentals are OUTRAGEOUS… 50 bucks for 2 chairs and an umbrella and you can’t get 3 chairs it has to be 2 chairs per umbrella. The man selling was absolutely rude as well. Do yourself a favor and bring a blanket, there were shade trees that others were sitting under and didn’t have to pay for the umbrellas and chairs. There was a restroom at the little restaurant/bar at the beach but the line was really long.

allReviews.title: Hard to find enough space to swim
allReviews.text: Too many people along the shore and was very hard to find a space to swim.  Also the waterskis were very close to the swimmers

allReviews.title: Strong Current
allReviews.text: This is a popular cruise tourist beach.  Beware that the currents in Aruba are very strong, not just this beach but also others like Arashi also.  There was only one bathroom and the line took 20 minutes for women.  We only stayed one hour, which at first I thought would not be enough, but because the current was strong, it was enough for me.

allReviews.title: Good
allReviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Carry plenty of sun screens... and hydrate yourself often... avoid the midday sun

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach with great views
allReviews.text: This beautiful white sand beach offers amazing views, lots of space so you don't feel crowded and various bars etc to enjoy your day. Trees provide shade for free, the sun loungers and umbrellas cost a lot more. However, we spent a while just relaxing and people watching.

allReviews.title: beautiful...water that is nice and warm...mostly calm/gentle waves
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, soft white sand, friendly helpers, and gorgeous sunsets. A great place to relax, read a book...not too commercial, not too crowded.

allReviews.title: Sun& sea& sand 🌞🐢🐢🐢🇦🇼
allReviews.text: I like Eagle Beach because it's perfect for tanning, white sand and the magical, calm emerald green water. But...Unfortunately there are too many annoying jet skis that make it difficult to take a picture yourself, jet skis everywhere.Street dogs also walked past a few times.In the afternoon Eagle Beach turns into a picnic area. The primitive ignorant people leave the rubbish there.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: This is a very wonderful hotel with good food, there are toys for children, parties, there are water toys, and everyone who works in a hotel is very good.

allReviews.title: Beautiful but not wow
allReviews.text: Beautiful, long, equipped and worth experiencing and visiting at least once. If you stop here you could say that it is the best beach in Aruba but baby beach lagoon is even better. Overall a magical and beautiful beach.

allReviews.title: Relaxation at its Best
allReviews.text: Best beach in the World.  Even at home ( New York), I rather wait all year around to get here. The water is warm and clear most of the time and relaxing. The best Sundown picture Perfect you can have on a Portafolio or a phone screen.  It's unbelievable.

allReviews.title: One of our favourite beaches
allReviews.text: We love this beach for all that it is, calm blue waters excellent for swimming and soft white sand.  My wife and I go every year and we are never disappointed, the beach is certainly beautiful.  It can get busy but we always find a spot regardless of the time day.  Wether hotel/beach staff, other tourists or island residents we find people are respectful and mind their own business.  But we mostly love this beach because we can enjoy our vacation hassle-free of beach vendors and no one bothers us, we can socialize as much as we want or we can have our privacy, this is why we keep coming back to Eagle Beach.

allReviews.title: Quiet and familiar plays
allReviews.text: The beach is really very quiet. There are fewer people than in Palm Beach; however, it is necessary to pay for any chairs, umbrellas or related items. It's more of a family-friendly destination, although I feel like Aruba has become a family destination overall.

allReviews.title: Nothing Special About this Beach
allReviews.text: A nice beach but nothing special to make it stand out.  It was very crowded on the day we were there and a storm was rolling in (we did get to see a pretty impressive double rainbow).

allReviews.title: Recommended
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand and blue water. Often wonderfully quiet. There are chairs and umbrellas for rent

allReviews.title: Service with a smile
allReviews.text: A group of us had dinner at a restaurant called the Aquarius. We had the most spectacular waitress Adriana, and her team they went above and beyond it happened to be my birthday and they saying happy birthday to me as well. The meal was excellent I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Beauty from the beaches to the people
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beech yet. The weather is amazing, the people are so inviting. Great shopping. The drinks are worth it ( no skimping in Aruba). No extra shots required !!

allReviews.title: Awesome beach
allReviews.text: This broad, long beach never seems crowded, with plenty of room for everyone.  A diversity of people are engaged in many activities.  It is a perfect beach for strolling along the water's edge, especially in the morning when the winds are not as strong.  Aruba does not allow individual vendors to walk along the beach and try and sell items, so the beach is hassle free.  There are a few kiosks with vendors for watersports. There seem to be fewer vendors for umbrellas now, so finding shade if you're a visitor is a challenge.  Some of the palapas are staked out before 7 am.  Come early if you want parking for a car. Areas for swimming are marked to exclude watercraft.  The beach slopes gradually into the water for easy entry, especially for kids.  Calm, clean water.  No big waves.  No seaweed.  Not much to see when snorkeling, though.  People of all ages from many different places enjoy this beach.  Everyone was respectful of the space of others.  Swimwear ranged from my g-string to some trendy thongs and cheeky bikinis, and all manner of styles for fun in the sun.  Good place to be yourself and enjoy your vacation.The summer brings much stronger winds.  A breeze of 20 to 30 kmh provides cooling, but when wind gusts reach 40 to 60 kmh it becomes unpleasant getting sandblasted.  At least the wind gusts are not constant.  The fine, powdery white sand doesn't get too hot.  Good to see loggerhead turtle nesting sites marked off and protected.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Wonderful, relaxing beach with calm water. Has ample parking and a few restaurants and bars on the beach.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: We went to Aruba on a Royal Caribbean cruise and visited this beach, it is one of the most beautiful beaches we have visited. While there we had lunch at a fast food restaurant Aruba Blue Beach bar and terrace, all very tasty. Back to the ship we take public transport, a mini van of those that pass by constantly.

allReviews.title: We stayed in front of the beach, one of the best we saw in the Caribbean
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, ideal for walking, calmer than Palm Beach, beautiful and transparent water, there are the famous divi trees in Aruba, in my opinion the best next to Baby Beach

allReviews.title: BEACH TIME
allReviews.text: We stayed in resort directly across from the beach.  It was great.  Aruba owns all beaches and they are not private we were told.  Which is okay with me.  Get there early to get the chairs and palm umbrella.  They have people that will take drink and food orders. It was super crowded even the day 2 cruise ships arrived. .

allReviews.title: Eagle beach is just WOW!!
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is amazing!  Beautiful beach in Aruba, water is crystal clear.  There are beach chairs and umbrellas available to rent.

allReviews.title: Beautiful pristine beach
allReviews.text: What can I say this  beach is awesome.  Clear aqua water, talcum powder soft sand. (By the way you can’t take any home with you or shells or you will get a fine) enjoy the spotless clean area and walking looking at the fish. There are jet ski rentals available, and parasailing for the adventurous type.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach and cristal water
allReviews.text: Beautiful Beach cristal water, perfect sand but a way too much off shore wind that with the sand doesn t make a very good combination.

allReviews.title: Decent
allReviews.text: Very nice but still a little crowded, The buses that we took from the island were very nice and not expensive.

allReviews.title: White white sand, blue blue water
allReviews.text: Beautiful white sand and turquoise water! Less crowded than the palm beach area and much quieter. Iconic Caribbean beach.

allReviews.title: One Of the Most Beautiful
allReviews.text: This is by far one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. If traveling to Aruba must check it out.

allReviews.title: Stunning
allReviews.text: One of the top rated beaches in the world!!Clean sandy with incredible shades of blue water.No better place to relax.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach review
allReviews.text: Stayed at an AirBnB very close to eagle beach. Very nice beach- beautiful water, fine sand and not too busy. Wife and I walked on the paved walkway near road in AM and hit the beach later in day.  Head south away from eagle and palm beach for even more seclusion.

allReviews.title: HORRIBLE
allReviews.text: It was a horrible experience, we spent close to $700 to go to this beach because we didn’t stay in the hotel, we were promised floats , snorkels and kayaks . We were given none of that all day , they had tons of floats in the back but the lazy worker refused to let us use just one . All of the cabanas were “booked” but there was literally no one over there . The managers name is Moon she is a disrespectful person . I highly recommend baby beach and not this one .

allReviews.title: Gorgeous!
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is an absolutely beautiful beach.  One of my favorites in the Caribbean!  A must visit when in Aruba.

allReviews.title: Beautiful but...
allReviews.text: Arrived here via taxi from the carnival cruise port, 20 dollars..  dropped right at the beach by a beach bar, coco locoWalked onto a beautiful white sandy beach, we didn't hire beds as expensive for 4 of us but bought towels with us. The beach area was very busy, someone us on the sand, some hired bedsSea was gorgeous colour so had a dip and a swim about, again very busyWe then walked to the left towards the ports, the further you walk the quieter the beach, wish we'd headed that direction from the start! We took snorkels with us but not a good snorkeling beachFree WiFi by the beach bar!Taxi back sfter 2 hours sun, too hot and no shade for any longer!

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: Lovely beach with white sands and marked off swimming areas. Need to arrive early to get a Palapa for shade. The sun is strong so use lots of reef safe suntan lotion. Chairs are available to rent.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: The beach was amazing.  The best beach we have ever experienced.  The beach was located across from our hotel and the hotel would shuttle us to the entrance.  There was always lounge chairs available which were set up for us upon arrival.

allReviews.title: was not impressed
allReviews.text: Quiet beach with white sands and clear water, but beyond that, not amazing. Expensive to rent chairs and umbrella (which are really necessary for a full day trip). No bathrooms to be found, at least where we were. Very few nearby restaurants, etc. We like Palm Beach better even though it was more crowded.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: First time in a Aruba as a solo traveler. Eagle beach was my first stop really beautiful beach. Came every day to get a good spot under the umbrella trees. Recommend coming early to get you a spot under the Parasols  that are posted through out the beach

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach!
allReviews.text: Water is clear with amazing temperature! I enjoyed it very much. It is across the street from my hotel. It feels so peaceful In the early morning. The sunset is so beautiful. Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: My Favorite Beach
