allReviews.text: What an amazing spot! You can rent the cabanas, chairs…it’s less touristy than palm and eagle with all the beauty. It was my favorite area. I loved Passions on the Beach for breakfast.

allReviews.title: Voted best beach in the Carribean for a reason
allReviews.text: Blue waters, white sand, seemingly endless stretch of beach - it gets pretty crowded over the weekends and during major holidays. Still worth going - try and watch the sunsets here - they are memorable!

allReviews.title: Large uncrowded beach.
allReviews.text: Spent an afternoon under a palapa. $20 per chair. Bring your own if you have them available from your hotel. Gorgeous Beach and water.

allReviews.title: Incredible beach
allReviews.text: One of the most beautiful and pristine beaches I have ever been to. Amazing sunsets. Breathtaking!!

allReviews.title: Okay
allReviews.text: Mmmmm not what I was expecting   The water was nice but it was super busy with equipment rental and we weren’t quite sure how to go about renting neach chairs and stuff.  I don’t know just an ok experience

allReviews.title: Relax and enjoy the beach
allReviews.text: The sand is very soft and white. The area is very relaxing and quiet. If you’re looking for more action and activities you should go to palm Beach which is not far

allReviews.title: Eagle beach
allReviews.text: Amazing white sand beach with warm crystal clear Caribbean blue water!   If there is a negative, it is windy at the beach.  Not enough wind to ruin your time

allReviews.title: One happy Tourist on one happy island
allReviews.text: This was our 3rd time to Aruba and it was a cruise stop. We remembered how amazing Eagle beach was the first time and figured we should spend most of our day there. It cost us $5 each to get on a bus that dropped us off there. We found a place that rented beach umbrellas, lounge chairs plus included water each. There was also an option to order food from the restaurant. The beaches here are some of the best in the world. I can see why the call it one happy island. I think it would be hard to be sad with these turquoise water and white sand beaches. The water was perfect!There wasn't too many people which was nice. but it does help that the beach goes on for miles.

allReviews.title: Most beautiful beach in the world
allReviews.text: Don’t forget to bring sun protection. It will be windy but that enhances the danger for sunburn. This is one of the best beaches in the world and it doesn’t disappoint. Water is beautiful. You want to be early if you want a lounge from the hotel.

allReviews.title: 1000 shades of blue
allReviews.text: The 1000 shades of blue.The colour of the water in Aruba is something really magical. We been in different islands of the Caribbean but Aruba has the best waters ever so far. The only similar one should be Anguilla. This beach is really for everyone, with plenty of space. there are chances to rent the sunbeds or bring the own one. the only negative things is the wind, sometimes can get really windy but the island has more other  beaches with no wind at all.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach in Aruba was awesome. The beach is beautiful. I recommend visiting this beach MORE THAN once. The water was clear and the beach area was not crowded at all.

allReviews.title: #3 in the world for a reason!
allReviews.text: White sand, picturesque views! Pure paradise! One happy island and there’s a reason why. The beaches, the sand, the people.

allReviews.title: A piece of paradise
allReviews.text: So looking forward to visiting this place and it didn’t disappoint!  Soft white cleans sands with crystal clear calm waters. Down side was a very expensive trip  example paying s50 for 2 su loungers and parasol, would 100% recommend this beautiful piece of paradise

allReviews.title: It was great
allReviews.text: Best beach! Crystal clear water, clean white sand. We had very peaceful relaxing time there and highly appreciate how clean is it.

allReviews.title: Great beach day from cruise
allReviews.text: Loved this beautiful beach!  Aruba was a stop on a cruise for us. Instead of booking an expensive shore excursion we took a public bus (clean, free wifi and just $5 round trip!) to Eagle Beach. The water was gorgeous and we throughly enjoyed a wonderful beach day. Can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Clean beach. Water was refreshing. The security guy Ervin was great and made sure we were taking care of. The women who collect the money for the chairs were not as pleasant or communicative. It took us a very long time to get our change back

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: The beach is extensive with clean white sand. The water is transparent and lovely. There aren’t a lot op restaurants to eat during lunch on a Sunday since they close Sundays.

allReviews.title: Aruba the island with beautiful beaches.
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is a beautiful sandy beach. Beautiful contrast of the white sand and the blue sea water.The beauty of Aruba is that the government has decided by law that all beaches belong to the people. Everyone is allowed on every beach, even the beaches at the most expensive Hotels.

allReviews.title: Beautiful but expensive
allReviews.text: Amazing beach, white sand and clear blue water, what the Caribbean is famous for. We arrived off the cruise ship and local prices on loungers and umbrellas suddenly shot up, expect to pay up to $50 for a couple, unless you are happy to lie down under a tree. Also, no snorkelling on this beach. A bottle of beer $9 in a beach bar, wifi is available.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach just OK
allReviews.text: First trip to Aruba.  Everything here is wonderful but we don’t see the hype about Eagle Beach.  Two different days with both morning and afternoon trips. Both times the water was murky (couldn’t see our feet in 2 foot of water) and the sand is just ok.  Water was kind of chilly as well.  Just not what we were expecting at all.  Honestly, the beach in Destin Florida blows Eagle Beach away in our opinion.

allReviews.title: Aruba Eagle Beach chairs ???
allReviews.text: On a Cruise day visit to Aruba, me and my wife choose to visit the Eagle beach. The beach is fantastic. The negative side of the visit was the hiring of 2 beach chairs with an umbrella. They charged us $ 50.00On Curaçao, the next visit, 2 chairs were $ 10.00. Other islands we have visited, none were near the price we paid on Aruba.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach!
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach!  Get there by  10 for an umbrella and chairs. The tiki huts are reserved for the timeshares across the street.

allReviews.title: Nice!
allReviews.text: Very nice beach. Big! Right in the heart of hotel row. Cabanas available to rent. Small walk-up grill to eat/get drinks at. Consistently busy: Some cigarette butts & beer caps in the sand. Great water, clear & good waves to play in.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: A beautiful beach with crystal clear water of many different colors, with a sugar-white sand beach.  The beach is a little steep in the tide area, making it tough for walking, but it is quite wide above the tide / wave zone.  Very few (if any) seaweed.  The north end of the beach had a bit of a sewage smell on the day we visited, but we are told that is not normal.

allReviews.title: Beach House Paradise
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Beach House Aruba.  Very quiet apartments away from the High Rise area.  We have stayed at the Beach House our last 10 visits to Aruba.

allReviews.title: Exceptional
allReviews.text: Natural beauty of the beach, the unbelievable aqua colors of the water and the welcoming nature of the people in Aruba. We stayed at the Costa Linda resort. It was exceptionally clean, well maintained and very friendly. We had a great massage while we were there as well. Would highly recommend a vacation in Aruba!

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach with soft white sand
allReviews.text: Visited Aruba on a cruise ship, so caught a taxi to Eagle Beach (USD15 each way). Absolutely beautiful with soft white sand.

allReviews.title: It’s a very nice beach to visit!
allReviews.text: We visited Eagle beach back in December and it was fantastic! Aruba in a nutshell is a friendly place to visit. You can choose to stay at a hotel or off site. The people are very helpful if you go about and tour the island. Many other sites to see here also.

allReviews.title: Great Trip
allReviews.text: The weather is amazing all the time.   The breeze while on the beach or at the pool is nice.  The UTV excursion was great!

allReviews.title: Top #2 Beach in the world
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach. Rated #2 top beach in the world. Lots of restaurants and bars near and at the beach.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach - Best on the island!
allReviews.text: Great beach, always clean and friendly environment.  Hotels and resorts close to Eagle Beach is a must whenever we visit Aruba.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is one of the best beaches in the world!
allReviews.text: The beach is always clean and sea weed free.  The Tiki's are are owned by the government, however, you need to get there EARLY by 06:30am to get one.  The hotels (if you are staying at one) will give you a chaise or chair but be sue to bring your towel so you can be identified.  You can rent chaise lounges from "Julio Watersports" if you are not staying at Eagle Aruba or LaCabanna.  The drinks are reasonable during happy hour and staff will come around to get food orders if interested.  As always Tips are appreciated by the service staffs and I've been coming here for over 20 years and always had great experiences.  FYI...don't leave your Tiki unattended for too long as the security staff will remove your belongings!   ENJOY!

allReviews.title: Peaceful and beautiful
allReviews.text: We took a local bus to eagle beach, walked the “boardwalk”, got some chairs and had some drinks. Wonderful, beautiful beach, friendly and helpful people all around. . Hopped the bus back to Oranjestad and got back on our cruise ship. Great day.

allReviews.title: Great Beach Day
allReviews.text: Great beach to visit as a stop on a cruise. The water was calm closer to the shore but a little rougher (not much)  as you went out. Beautiful. If you are looking for the famous trees, when you are facing the water, they will be to the right - a bit of a walk - all the way around the crescent beach. You can rent chairs if you get there in time. I didn’t see many shady characters hanging around, but make sure you attach your backpack to the chair.If you set up camp on the right side of the concrete pillar, just know that watercraft come onshore around there. Renting a cab was an easy process. The drive was simple and didn’t take long.

allReviews.title: Wonderful beach!
allReviews.text: We stayed at a condominium complex within walking distance to Eagle beach and enjoyed the white sand, sea grape shade trees, & clear water.  There was always a strong breeze so expect a little blowing sand, but that didn’t detract at all from our enjoyment.

allReviews.title: Superb beach, pristine water, surf can be treacherous at times
allReviews.text: Shore breakers are prevalent at this beach so be careful. Witnessed many accidents. Overall the beach is beautiful, clean and pristine. Bathrooms and snack stand right at the beach as well as beach chairs and umbrellas, which go fast if you are not there early. Easy $15 cab fare one way from the port to the beach. Highly recommend experiencing this beach, very walkable beach, one could walk to Palm Beach down the way

allReviews.title: Peaceful
allReviews.text: Beautiful , wide white sand beach, gentle warm crystal water, lots of action available for fun seekers, but also great for serenity

allReviews.title: Postcard Perfect Beach
allReviews.text: We walked from the cruise port to the Arubus station and took the public bus to the Amsterdam Manor stop at Eagle Beach. The cost is $5 per person return if you purchase a card at the terminal kiosk. We arrived late and all the rental loungers were taken. Most of the loungers are owned by the resorts and only available to their guests. We found a shady spot under a palapas and parked for the day. The palapas are not owned by the resorts and anyone can sit under them. We had a delicious lunch from Passions on the Beach. It was a very simple bus journey back to the town center. I would recommend this beach highly but would certainly get there much earlier next time.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach Aruba
allReviews.text: Eagle beach has by far the clearest water to swim in. The beach was clean of seaweed.The beach consists of white fine sand. You won’t be disappointed!

allReviews.title: Clear blue water but full of big scary sharks
allReviews.text: Clear blue water but full of big scary sharksI know they have a home in the sea but really scary when they brush past you, especially before lunch when you haven't had a cue drinks to calm the nerves

allReviews.title: Amazingly blue water and white beach!
allReviews.text: Eagle beach was beautiful the sand was white and the ocean was very blue colour. There was very little rocks in the sand it was mostly white sand.

allReviews.title: Wow - what a beach
allReviews.text: Eagle beach really is spectacular.  In relation to it's main competitor (Palm Beach), eagle beach seems to have more beach distance from the hotels to the water than Palm beach, Eagle's sand is softer than Palm, but there are some decent size waves that crash the beach making the first 20 feet of Eagle's water cloudier than Palm.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous
allReviews.text: I absolutely love this beach. I do think it’s very crowded when you’re around the resorts but if you walk a little bit further down where the construction is, it’s quiet. I assume that they’re building another resort, so in a few years, this beach will be packed. I hate how the resorts take all the space in the The beach and don’t leave any room for anyone else to just sit there quietly . Enjoy it while it lasts.

allReviews.title: Best time ever
allReviews.text: This beach is full of fun and great people. So, much to do here at this beach. But if you want to go to the beach and not be crowed down the beach toward uptown very nice peaceful spot.

allReviews.title: Busy beach but beautiful ocean
allReviews.text: Beautiful water beautiful white sand But it’s packed of people So if looking for a quite beach this is not for you

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: Very long sandy beach near hotels and has snack shop.  We stopped here on a tour from a cruise ship but the wind was blowing very hard and we felt we were getting sand blasted so we spent our time up in the shelter of the snack shop.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and clean beach
allReviews.text: My friends and I came to this beach every single day. It’s beautiful and plenty of places to sit in the shade if needed.

allReviews.title: Favorite Beach on Aruba
allReviews.text: Previous visit was a pre-COVID cruise. Found it right where I left it.  $5US per person cab ride each way from cruise pier. Chairs and umbrellas available. Restaurant and restrooms available One of my two favorite beaches in the caribbean.

allReviews.title: Well Deserved Beach
allReviews.text: This was a clean beach with soft, white sand and appears to be very popular with locals and tourists alike. When we went, it was Valentines Day evening and beach was essentially ours. There are no hotels on the beach. Highly recommend if possible.

allReviews.title: Favorite Beach!
allReviews.text: This is a great beach!  Of course, it's super long and spread out over many miles, which may be why it seems so uncrowded. This beach is much calmer than Palm Beach. It's  not always close to bathroom facilities or restaurants, though there are probably spots that are closer to these amenities, especially near the hotels/ condos. It has a nice sandy bottom and seems like a good place for families and kids.

allReviews.title: Best beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach. South side has more open space but therefore stronger winds that can blow sand at you. North side is more crowded but you can get a lounger, just pay the guy a few bucks. Water is nice and kelp-free for most of he way.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and clean beach!
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is clean and the water is incredible! We stay at La Cabana so the walk is short but if we stayed anywhere else we would definitely go out of our way to spend the day here!

allReviews.title: Great beach for relaxing and swimming.
allReviews.text: No high-pressure or annoying vendors selling wares. Plenty of rentals, tour, eateries, resorts, and bars available. Safe place for families.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach FTW!
allReviews.text: At first we weren't sure what to pick - Eagle or Palm beach. After reading about both beaches, we booked an accommodation near Eagle beach and it was THE best decision ever!Lots of sand, space, open areas and beautiful clear blue water. It still had palapas and caffees etc, but it wasn't crowded. Later when we visited Palm Beach we were shocked at the difference - at Palm beach people where all crowded together, so much noise, the sand strip was quite narrow, everyone was swimming side by side because there were many jet ski areas and pier restaurants taking up the swimming space etc.TLDR:Eagle beach -  if you prefer vibing on your own and personal space, clear waters, lots of sand.Palm beach - if you don't mind people, a busy beach and want lots of different options for water activities/places to eat and drink.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: In my opinion, it is the best beach on the island. Quiet area without a lot of wild parties. Beautiful sand and surf.

allReviews.title: Delightful beach
allReviews.text: This is a long beach with great fine sand and clear water. It is easily reached by taxi from Oranjestad for $15 each way. We arrived about midday and all the loungers and beach umbrellas were taken but there is plenty of shade to be found under the trees backing the beach. It is not heavily commercialised with only the one bar at our end and a limited selection of water sports. However this is much nicer than Palm Beach which is backed by high rise hotels.

allReviews.title: BEST BEACH ON ARUBA
allReviews.text: Best beach on Aruba! Not crowded, white sand and water color to die for. Went to most of them and this one wins.

allReviews.title: Worth a visit
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, crowded though. Hard to find a palapa. Expensive to rent an umbrella and beach chairs.

allReviews.title: Amazing beach and water
allReviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach we have ever been to. Clear turquoise waters and white sands. The beach is wide and long and the water calm.Came here on a cruise and loved it. Easy to get to from the cruise port for $5/ person.There are bars and restaurants along the beach and even with 2 ships in town it didn't feel overly crowded.

allReviews.title: Ricardos a gem of a find restaurant
allReviews.text: ricardos is a small restaurant located on Eagle Beach right on the sand. All the food is prepped to order the staff fantastic the food outstanding and the price is moderate, my wife and I enjoy having dinner in the evening and watching the sun sink into the ocean. And in the mornings we enjoy having breakfast. Watching the sunrise the restaurant is small, but very romantic.

allReviews.title: White Sands
allReviews.text: White sands, clean, clear, calm water. Constant temps and light breeze. Lots of activities and lots of people. Never had trouble finding a spot thought.

allReviews.title: It is Just Simply Perfect
allReviews.text: We have stayed in Aruba a few times as both a couple and with family, at both Palm Beach and Eagle Beach.  The beaches here are impeccable.  The sand is white, powdery, soft, and exceptionally clean.  The water is crystal clear, and you can see your feet even when you are waist-deep (or deeper) as if you are looking through a pane of glass.  The weather is absolutely perfect, never varying by more than a few degrees.  Rain is minimal to non-existent.  This beach, along with the island in general, is an enduring exercise in vacation perfection, obviously thanks in large part to the island’s government and oversight.  My wife and I often don't like to vacation in the same place more than once, but rest assured we will continue to revisit this place.

allReviews.title: More laid back beach
allReviews.text: This beach has more of a local island vibe IMO.  The hotels are across the street and the beach has many access points.  It felt more like just a beach than the others that have the big hotels and high rise buildings right on them.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and Refreshing
allReviews.text: White soft sand and blue-green water as far as one can see. Many options to purchase chairs and umbrellas as well as food and drink. Service was friendly. Even though there were a lot of beach goers, we had sufficient space. It was a lovely day!

allReviews.title: White Sand & Blue Sea - perfect
allReviews.text: Fabulous white sand beach, clear waters.  Plenty of sunbeds & umbrellas for hire.  Not many beach bars so be sure to pitch up near one if you want drinks & food.  More expensive than some of the other islands but a fun day out.

allReviews.title: Breathtaking!
allReviews.text: The color of the water is exactly like it is in these photos...simply breathtaking! I can see why it is rated as one of the top beaches in the world. Def. more calm and relaxing compared to palm beach.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: I wish there had been more seating late in the day. We went late with a cruise tour and there were no chairs or umbrellas left.

allReviews.title: Great way to spend the day!!
allReviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach. Great for walking. Public and resort usage. Palapa’s available on a first come first served basis. Lounge chairs available to rent or bring your own. Facilities on site. Water sport’s available for purchase. Beverages available for purchase. About a 4 km walk from the cruise port. Public transportation also available. Sunscreen is a must!!!

allReviews.title: Great beach area with Lots of bars, shops and good food nearby
allReviews.text: Great beautiful Beach, lots of bars and cafes, plenty to do. Big hotel chains, high rise  in Eagle Beach area, but still Classy

allReviews.title: Gentle waves and clear waters
allReviews.text: I visited Eagle Beach while taking a bus around the island with De Palm Tours, and everyone in my family loved it! As a Floridian, I've visited several beaches, but Eagle Beach is one of my favorites:)

allReviews.title: Heaven!
allReviews.text: I so enjoyed the beautiful white sand beach.  You have to go early to stake out your spot, but the security for each resort is very friendly and accommodating.  You can leave your stuff without worry for up to 1 1/2 hours.  Then security will remove it to a secure location.  The water was so refreshing to the body.  A bit cool on first dip, but once you're wet, it is amazing.

allReviews.title: Crystal Clear Waters & Soft White Sand
allReviews.text: Beautiful crystal blue waters, soft white sand, wide beach so there’s plenty of room to spread out. Certain spots along the beach had strong waves so watch where you decide to put your chairs and swim.

allReviews.title: So Beautiful!
allReviews.text: We loved Eagle beach! It was very clean, absolutely no seaweed. No rocks on the sand which was great because we noticed a lot of beaches in Aruba had rocks in the sand and water. Very relaxing and not as crowded as other ones we went to. The sunset on this beach was one of my favorites I seen in the Caribbean!

allReviews.title: Family Beach
allReviews.text: Gorgeous beach and much quieter than Palm Beach. It's the best beach for families with small children. There are playgrounds, snack bars, chairs and umbrellas to rent. Its less populated so there is room to spread out. This is also the beach where you'll find the Fototi tree that is popular in many Aruba vacation pics.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach beautiful but rough
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach but a bit rough and getting crowded but not as crowded as palm beach. Not a great beach for young children. Sometimes hard to get palapas.

allReviews.title: Ocean waters
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is one of the best! so warm and clean. Lots of friendly people and many water spots to do.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: We stayed at ABC and absolutely loved this little section of the beach. Soft sand, clear waters, litter free 🌊🏖️

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: We walked along Eagle Beach several mornings during our stay. I can’t say what it’s like later in the day, but around 7-8 in the morning it’s very peaceful.

allReviews.title: It has captured us.
allReviews.text: My wife and I have fell in love with Aruba. This beach is one reason why. The pristine sand, the moderate temperatures all play a part in why we vacation here at least once a year.

allReviews.title: Truly one beautiful beach
allReviews.text: The only downside was crazy jetskiers, but this is a really clean and beautiful beach.   The sunsets from this beach or spectacular.

allReviews.title: Nice reprieve from the hotel crowds!
allReviews.text: We wanted to escape the crowds at the high rises on Palm Beach, so we took a quick drive down to Eagle Beach arriving around 10:30 AM.  There were very few people there, and we had our choice of chairs and umbrellas which we rented for $40 (for 2) for the day.  A little pricey, but worth it if you don’t have your own gear.  As the beach filled up, we had people on either side of us but everyone was quiet and pleasant.  The sand and the water are remarkable.  Very calm, absolutely beautiful.  I don’t know that I would rank it #9 in the world, but it certainly was nice.  One note . . . The chair guy told us that it gets very crowded when cruise ships are in port.  There was only 1 today, so not bad.

allReviews.title: Beautiful water
allReviews.text: Beautiful water. We went to this beach as an excursion from the cruise we were on. We were told that this was a beautiful beach with all sorts of amenities. What a joke. We paid $19.99 per person with the cruise excision on our cruise. Then when we get to Eagle Beach we have to pay $10 per person to get a sun damage lounger to sit on. We were told that none of the umbrellas worked, so we would have to find shade to protect ourselves from the sun. We asked were the restrooms were and the guy told us that we could use the restroom at the hotel across the street. We went to the hotel across the street to get food from the restaurant and were told that the hotel was only available to customers staying at the hotel. The lady told us to go to the food truck. You could actually smell the grease in the food. We went to the bar to use the restroom and we were told that it cost $1.00.

allReviews.title: Paradise
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach appears much quieter than other beaches we saw. It couldn't be more gorgeous. We were at Manchebo and while it was a bit of walk to the water from their lovely palapas, it was worth every stride.

allReviews.title: Beautiful waters
allReviews.text: We were lucky enough to have Eagle Beach as our main beach with our resort- La Cabana! Recommend staying at a Resort that gives you access to this incredible beach!!

allReviews.title: Beach trip
allReviews.text: October 4, 2022- Visited this beach on one of our cruise ports. Took the arubus for $2.50 US pp each way. Paid for a day pass to Paradise Beach Villas, across the street, which allowed us to use pool and bathroom access. A beautiful beach. Water so clean and clear

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: This is a nice stretch of beach to lay out an catch some sunshine or float around in the beautiful blue water.  We enjoyed a nice lunch at one of the bar/restaurants on the beach.

allReviews.title: Relaxing
allReviews.text: Eagle beach was the best beach for relaxing. Super soft sand and the water temperature was perfect. Plenty of shade offered under the cabana’s

allReviews.title: Beautiful eagle beach
allReviews.text: Clean. Water is amazing. So e seaweed but I think that was due to hurricanes being in the Caribbean. There is a slight incline so those with mobility issues should be aware.  Not a shell beach. Water sports kept well away from swimming.

allReviews.title: Soft white sand
allReviews.text: This beach is beautiful, with soft white sand. Please know that the palm straw palapas are free so don’t let locals try and charge you!

allReviews.title: Favorite Beach
allReviews.text: My husband and I went to Eagle Beach everyday during our honeymoon vacation!! Absolutely love this beach!!!

allReviews.title: great for cruisers
allReviews.text: We took the bus to Eagle Beach getting off at Amsterdam Manor. There was a huge downpour so we waited until it cleared. Some people vacated chairs so we were able to sit down under a Palapa. We didn't realize we were on AM chairs although you can go next door and rent some. I happened to have an orange watch which matched their wristbands so we weren't bothered. The water was lovely and the sand soft. Made for a great beach day off the ship. We took the bus back to the pier.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beaches I have ever been on.  From the white powdery sand to the crystal-clear water, you cannot go wrong here.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: This beach is beautiful, with soft white sand, however it gets crowded in certain areas when the cruises dock. Please know that the palm straw palapas are free so don’t let locals try and charge you!

allReviews.title: Amazing Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach has the most amazing turquoise blue waters and white soft sand!  The beaches go on and on forever.  And better yet no seaweed!!  Like many other places in the Caribbean are infortunately experiencing.  Big open beach with lots of space and very minimal crowds.  Beautiful sunsets as it faces directly west. One of the best beaches I've ever seen.

allReviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
allReviews.text: the most beautiful beach I've seen.  I've sailed the carribeans a lot but Aruba is by far my most favorite

allReviews.title: Excellent beach
allReviews.text: Excellent beach. No seaweed or pebbles to worry about when getting in.  Buses available in front of the beach. Short walk to Super Foods grocery store. It has a hot food section and seating so you can grab a cheap lunch. Alternatively, many good beachfront restaurants. Don’t like the way they lock up the lounge chairs. Sometimes it takes a while to get the attendant to unlock it for you. Water always warm.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Excellent beach with lovely cabanas.  Right across the street from La Cabana where we stayed.  Chairs also available.

allReviews.title: Easy access by bus
allReviews.text: The local bus goes there and it cost $2.60 U.S. per person per trip. it a nice beach you can bring your beach chair and sit under the palm tree. Need a romantic dinner  while watching the sunset there a restaurant on the beach that have nightly dinner. However, you need to make a reservation. You can also bring out the inner child in you by swinging on the swing on the beach or take part in one of the water sport offer by the locals.

allReviews.title: Go see for yourself
allReviews.text: Beautiful Beach I really enjoyed the relaxation the service the blue calming waters and the nightly sunsets which is very different. More space you’re not overwhelmed or crowded. It’s perfect

allReviews.title: picture perfect
allReviews.text: This beach lives up to its reviews, we spent everyday of our. 7 day vacation on the beach. The breeze is amazing the water is crystal clear and have you camera ready for the sunsets

allReviews.title: great beach & plenty of it
allReviews.text: Make sure and get there early if you want to be shaded under one of the few Palapas. But don't worry if you get there later because there is plenty of trees to get shaded under.Water is perfect for swimming and or just cooling off in.

allReviews.title: Picture perfect beach.
allReviews.text: What can you say about the white sands, crystal clear turquoise water with a rum punch in your hand watching the sun set right in front of you? Heaven on Earth.

allReviews.title: Great beach!
allReviews.text: The public beach section of Eagle Beach is amazing!  The sand was clean and the water was very nice and generally seaweed free.  The only thing I didn't love was the loud music from the bar.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Eagle beach was by far the best beach on the island and La Cabana was an amazing place to stay. Definitely recommend this resort!

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Crowded but beautiful. Didn't see much difference from Palm Beach from a water perspective. Lots of jet skiers. Calm waters

allReviews.title: Most beautiful beach on Aruba!
allReviews.text: What makes Eagle beach so great is that it isn't crowded, there are no rocks or coral, and the sand goes on forever!  Light on commerce which is nice for a more relaxed vibe.

allReviews.title: Top beach… for these reasons
allReviews.text: We had the privilege to rent a car and drive around to all the beaches of the island. In my humble opinion, Eagle beach was an awesome place to relax under a tree or umbrella, rent a jet ski, other water sports, swim, and watch the sunset. It’s the perfect place to spend a whole day. Multiple booths rent umbrellas and chairs for $30-40 per person. There is also plenty of shade under trees. You can also just as well sit on the sand, which is never hot because it is made of crushed coral. The jet skis rent for $80 per 30 minutes. They accept credit cards with a 6% fee. The rentals all stop at 5 pm on Sunday. I think I heard the booth operators say that during the week they close at 4pm. Sunset was gorgeous as this beach is facing west so the views are wonderful.

allReviews.title: Beautiful place 😍
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beach .clean water, clean beach.Excelente for vacation.Quietly and great restaurant on the side of beach.

allReviews.title: Believe the Reviews on Beautiful Beach!
allReviews.text: Beautiful, clean beach with that expected teal water. Lovely sunsets. Less crowded than de Palm Beach but de Palm has all the shopping & restaurants.  Sister hotels: Eagle Aruba Resort & Casino (casino closed) & La Cabana Resort & Casino (small, but open)  provide "shade cabanas," chairs & towels. (Cabanas & chairs run out, so go early). Small bar hut. No restroom. VERY friendly attendants assign the cabanas & chairs. Water sports rentals. Note: Hotels in this area are not directly on the beach. There is a 2-way street and a walking path between the hotels and the beach, but this wasn't a problem. Pedestrian crossing & all vehicles stop. Very easy walk to the beach. See YouTube videos!

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach Blue Beach
allReviews.text: One of my favorite beaches, once you arrive you can see the Blue aqua ocean from the street literally, they do have Wi-Fi , bathrooms and full bar Passions on the Beach, breakfast, lunch and dinner is served with the most beautiful sunset. The ocean is clean the white sand and when your in the ocean it’s like stepping on a down comforter that’s how soft the sand is. Yes you will see fish swimming and enjoying snorkeling  ride jet skis and other excursions.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is wonderful!
allReviews.text: When in Aruba I always stay at Paradise Beach Villas. Eagle Beach is just across the street from the Villas. It is a beautiful beach! The sand is kept clean. The water is always clear and refreshing. Wave action is calm...so, get your boarding in elsewhere...and is perfect for floating. There are shades and lounge chairs available for Villas' patrons. I love the place! 😎

allReviews.title: great beach and must hit for jet skiing
allReviews.text: I wonderful beach for snorkeling, swimming and jetskiing which is off the beaten track from the tourist's Palm Beach

allReviews.title: Best beach
allReviews.text: This beach is the best!  Clear water, not crowed and close to port if cruising. Make sure to take your sunscreen. The sun is extremely powerful!

allReviews.title: Best beach ever!
allReviews.text: We spent all but one day on this beach. The water is amazing. We cannot wait to come back and relax.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous beach with free palapas!
allReviews.text: This beach is beautiful. We brought our own chairs and used one of the freestanding palapas for shade. Water is gorgeous. Loved the beach bar right nearby too (Coco Loco). Just make sure you're not in front of a hotel---those palapas are only for their registered guests. Plenty of others on the public part that are free/first come, first served.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous beach
allReviews.text: We spent every day on this beach, which was right outside our hotel. It's gorgeous, not too crowded and a perfect "beach getaway destination"!  People suggested other beaches but we didn't rent a car, and we didn't regret it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful white sand beach
allReviews.text: Amazing beach, and far enough away from the high rise hotel areas that it was actually quite quiet there. There are quite a few shaded areas which are free to use. If you need chairs, the attendants ask for donations to help keep the beaches clean. There are also a few huts where you can rent wave runners etc.. and there was at least one small restaurant/bar near where we sat. Bathrooms are quite limited if you aren't staying at the smaller hotels here, and you need to buy something from the restaurant to get access to them.

allReviews.title: Great Vacation
allReviews.text: Great clean room. All rooms Re-done so nice and kitchens well equipped.  Great staff.   Great live music.

allReviews.title: Just like a post card!
allReviews.text: This beach looks just like a post card!  It was not very busy.  My son rented a jet ski here (closer to the Palm Beach end).   Felt a little safer to drive a jet ski here, since it doesn't have as much activity as Palm Beach.  We walked down the beach and rented a palapa from the La Quinta vendor ($30).

allReviews.title: Soft Sand and Great People Watching
allReviews.text: You can walk and walk on Eagle Beach which spans the entire hotel zone. The water is very clear. There are quite a few patches of sea grass fixed to the bottom, but the first 50-100 feet in are usually clear. The incline of the beach is nice for walking.

allReviews.title: Literal Heaven
allReviews.text: I was down on the beach nearly every single day of my visit, be it to spend several hours laying and relaxing or just a bit to watch the perfect sunset.  This beach is perfect, the sand is soft and clean, the water is clear warm and beautiful.  despite being possibly the finest beach in the world it was not over crowded.  If I had one knock it would be the jetski etc rentals creating noise and general nuisance but this was minimal.

allReviews.title: Absolutely one of the best beaches on the planet!
allReviews.text: If thin, white, soft sand. Relaxing waves and blue/green water is your thing - Eagle beach Aruba needs to be on your bucket list for sure. Come once and you will be back again for sure.

allReviews.title: Great rate, needs updating.
allReviews.text: It was a nice hotel, condos rented out as hotel rooms really. They were old, the tv did not work at all. The pools were huge and alot of fun for the kids. The staff was great, super friendly. The beach was closed due to turtle nesting, had to travel to other beaches. Dunkin donuts on site was very convenient. The kitchen set up in the room was nice, provided cooking utensils and such. Laundry room available. The beds were alright, kind of small. again it needed alot of updating but it was definitely a great value.

allReviews.title: Favorite
allReviews.text: Low rises, quiet beach but still active.  Variety of places to eat.  Loved this area.  Long beach walks.  Clear water and calm.  Great volleyball games.  Places to rent for shade/chairs.  Loved our hotel Eagle Beach Resort Casino.  No good snorkeling.  Buses easy to catch.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous water
allReviews.text: Clean, easy and free to park, not at all crowded, there are trees and shrubs in areas to find shade.

allReviews.title: Favorite Beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: This beach is gorgeous, beautiful clear water, white sand and very clean.  Enjoyed watching the boats and we rented jet skis one day which was very fun!

allReviews.title: 2nd Best Beach we visited.
allReviews.text: This was a nice beach without the rocks Aruba's beaches are known for. Also, little tiki bars that serve you on the beach.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: The beach at Eagle are one of the best beaches in Aruba. Its a great place to walk, run and definitely go swimming.

allReviews.title: beautiful
allReviews.text: Water was warm! Just like pool water. Lots of activities at this beach like parasailing, banana boats, you can book atvs and jet skis here.

allReviews.title: Certainly the best in Aruba, one of the best in the world
allReviews.text: Second time to Manchebo/Eagle beach.  Far and away the best beaches in the Caribbean.  Clean, quiet, and sporting a view of the western sunset that’s second to none.  We’ll be back for third trip next year in June - the best time to travel to Aruba.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: Simply Beautiful, clean, warm, super clear water, lots of water activities like jet skies, sunset boat tours, relaxing.

allReviews.title: Soars
allReviews.text: Less commercial and busy than palm beach. Less water sport. Amazing sand and turquoise water. A few bars around. Lots of shelter under hot things. Have to pay for sun bed though. Beautiful beach really.

allReviews.title: Quiet and beautiful beach
allReviews.text: We stayed near Eagle beach and loved visiting every afternoon. We never had a problem getting a palapa (opposite Aruba breeze condos). The beach is stunning, perfect white sand and turquoise sea. It was never very busy, always relaxing and beautiful. There's a park with play equipment for kids near the road. Very safe and enjoyable. Glad we stayed here.

allReviews.title: Best beach ever!
allReviews.text: The beach is made up of crushed shells, so it is not hot like Florida beaches.   The beach was never very busy and we never had trouble securing a free cabana within walking distance to Coco Loco, our favorite bar.  Not a lot of sea creatures, but did see a cushioned sea star on the first day.  We ended every single night on this beach to enjoy the gorgeous sunsets.  Ten out of ten.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beaches
allReviews.text: Clean, white, sandy (shell) beaches. Go sit on the sand during sunrise & sunset. Water is always clear & warm.

allReviews.title: Our favorite Beach
allReviews.text: We love Eagle Beach. Beautiful sand and water. Not too crowded and noisy. Plenty of options for dining both fast food and high end.

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: It is a beautiful beach! The water is so clear and perfect for the warm days in Aruba. You may be able to see white angel fish while swimming and some other sea life. There are plenty chairs to sit from. Drinks from the bar are also delicious!

allReviews.title: A must to visit
allReviews.text: Turquoise water and white sandy beach. Not crowded and nice to relax. There are many restaurants around and shopping establishments

allReviews.title: Best Beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is the prettiest in Aruba.  We stay every year in the low rise section of the island because we can enjoy Eagle Beach everyday!

allReviews.title: worth the trip
allReviews.text: This is the best beach that we visited , the water is ideal ans the sand is super smooth . I like this beach more than all the others.

allReviews.title: Visiting a Postcard
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, picturesque Caribbean beach. The sand is white and soft. The wind is at your back when facing the water. The water is turquoise, into a deep blue not so far out. It does get deeper here more quickly than at Palm Beach. It is also much quieter, although there is still an abundance of restaurants, many palapas and jet ski rentals. The sun is much stronger than you expect. We stayed at Oceana Resort.

allReviews.title: Amazing sunsets
allReviews.text: It's a great beach, although quite busy. Perfect for a morning walk or to watch the sunset. There's also a bike lane nearby so you can bike too.

allReviews.title: Eagle beach is awesome!!
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is amazing with lots of activities and dining options to choose from. The beach is clean and water very clear. Lots of trees in certain sections for shade and it does have some pavilions. One of the best beaches in the world.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: You have to visit to believe it. The sand just massages your feet and the water is so clear and blue it is amazing!

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is a must!
allReviews.text: So many words to describe but boils down to one!  Amazing, quiet, beautiful sunsets, great food, relaxing, all adults, wonderful staff!

allReviews.title: Great Beach
allReviews.text: jet skis, Big Mable ride, sun sun sun , and beautiful blue water. I loved the relaxing atmosphere. Wear plenty of sunscreen and buy a floatie.  No life guards , however the water was calm.

allReviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world!  Eagle Beach, Aruba
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is located in the “low rise” district of Aruba.  Less hotels & concentration of people.  Great for any ages for relaxing and taking in scenery.  Many turtle nests roped off (stay away & do not disturb).  The official divi tree is at the west top of beach near the Amsterdam resort.  Numerous parking spots both in lots & on the road.  Since all the beaches are public, recommend getting to the beach early for a great spot or a Palapa.  Take your snorkeling gear to explore some of the small reefs and all the underwater creatures that eagle beach has to offer. Don’t forget your sunblock & Enjoy!

allReviews.title: Nice beach
allReviews.text: Nice beach at a short walk from our hotel. Nice path next to the beach for a nice stroll or ride with a bike.

allReviews.title: Best beach in the world
allReviews.text: Best beach in the world.                  Here for 2 weeks and will visit it every other day. Lots to do with jet ski, parasailing. Clear clean water

allReviews.title: Best beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Lovely, quiet, and expansive...Eagle beach is just what the doctor ordered if you need some quiet time to recharge in the sunshine!

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: Fantastic beach! Stayed across the street amazing sunsets every night ! Beach was clean and not crowded!

allReviews.title: Calm and beautiful beach.
allReviews.text: Beautiful, powdery white sand, and crystal clear waters. Our favorite beach, by far. Took the local buses there. It was calm and uncrowded. Just be aware, renting chairs and umbrellas very expensive.

allReviews.title: Flawless Beaches by Darren Chaker
allReviews.text: Not far from the Ritz Carlton in Aruba, is Eagle Beach. The water is clear, pristine, and cannot imagine a more beautiful place to spend the place in complete solitude. Wish everyone here a good 2022, Darren Chaker

allReviews.title: Mother Daughter Trip
allReviews.text: This was paradise- one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen!  Gorgeous!! We took a cruise and we went where they the cruise ship recommended and where not impressed- got a taxi and asked him to take us to another beach and he took us here!!! Wow!!!  The 1st beach had a large sand dune you had to get over before getting to the water but this beach was perfect!!

allReviews.title: amazing
allReviews.text: Just beautiful, the water , the weather and all! I could stay there forever. Looking out of my hotel window evey morning  was breath taking.

allReviews.title: 2 Stays
allReviews.text: I came in October and participated in the Halloween party. My husband and I had a good time so when I returned in April with my mother and sister, I figured we would return. My experience and impression was the same both times: -beautiful property -most of the staff is friendly - clean and spacious rooms- the service at Uncle Tony’s was horrible both times for each meal. You can wait an eternity to be seated or even addressed. Food is great though! Katie is attentive. - no casino within hotel (closed both times but no one advised us at check-in) it’s not a huge deal to me, but should be communicated - Double Down Restaurant is great (thank you to young man Jean and to Adonaida - they are impeccable and attentive). Meals are huge and delicious! - short walk to Eagle beach (need additional staff to help distribute beach chairs to guests, great that chairs and palapas included for hotel guests)If the service was improved at Uncle Tony’s, they would easily earn a 5.

allReviews.title: PARADISE BEACH
allReviews.text: One of the most famous beaches in the Caribbean and apparently rated one of the best in the world. Approximately 15 minute taxi journey from the Aruba cruise dock port. Absolute tropical paradise. A must see.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: I walk it every day - love the fact that all the beaches are public. This is a beautiful, sandy beach, and perfect for watching sunsets.

allReviews.title: Sunscreen required, public beach, stay to the left of the water sports when looking at the beach
allReviews.text: Best beach in the area but you have to be to the left of the water sports if you are looking at the beach. Aruba can be rocky in certain areas. Also be mindful if you like to sit on the beach the sand is so fine it blows it around and you get sand stings. Beautiful sunset and Mamas food truck is there. Catch it during lunch time Waterproof phone case is a must.

allReviews.title: white sands
allReviews.text: probably the only actual white sand beach ive ever been on.  divi tree and blowholes were cool.  area kept spotless clean as well

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: This beach is beautiful, clean and the staff is very friendly. But if you want a good spot, make sure you go early to grab one - 5:30AM and remember there is a time limit on how long your things can be left unattended. This is so that people don't take advantage of saving their spot when others could have used it.

allReviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever had the pleasure to visit.
allReviews.text: The beaches are beautiful in Aruba, the people make the island what it is. A friendly, happy vacation spot.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: Beach is beautiful, water stunning! Someone should replace, repair palapa roofs!!!  Our beach attendant was amazing. Made sure we had chairs daily.

allReviews.title: Disappointing odor
allReviews.text: I have come here several times over 16 years, such a beautiful beach, however this time the sewer smell was just awful. We asked about it and the general idea is that the waste treatment plant us too small for all of the added hotels and businesses. I heard it suggested that one solution could be to dome over the plant to capture the methane and use it for fuel. Please fix thus or the resorts will be in  big trouble.

allReviews.title: Aruba
allReviews.text: Great beach for swimming or snorkeling with family and friends.  Take an umbrella and chairs with lots of sunscreen.

allReviews.title: It has a very clean beach and water is crystal clear.
allReviews.text: The most gorgeous clear aqua colored water you will ever see.  Beaches are clean, plenty of lounge chairs, the palapas are well maintained along with beach staff who bring you chairs and are extremely friendly.  All the water sports you can think of there is offered.

allReviews.title: Paradise
allReviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the world. Not too busy, crystal waters and sugar sand beach. This is the only place for us now and in the future. Can't say any more!

allReviews.title: unpleasant day at the beach
allReviews.text: have to take taxi from cruise ship.  no signs stating you have to - or where to rent chairs and umbrella - with limited supply.  where we were was mostly beach, 1 bar/restaurant. bathroom.  otherwise had to cross street - few bocks to shopping center.  waves were very high this day - never seen this inn aruba and had unpleasant experience in water.  tourists kept coming throughout the day looking for chairs and umbrellas and were unhappy - no place for them.i will continue to stick to palm beach.  wish there were more day pass opportunities.

allReviews.title: Quiet, white sandy beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful clean beach, great palapa huts, not too busy at all. You can do water sports here away from the crowds. The water is clean and waves are low. Definitely a must do to spend a quiet beach day.

allReviews.title: Paridise
allReviews.text: Best beach ever! Great water sand the weather is always great, not crowded very relaxing.  It’s my happy place. The fish and the pelicans put on a great show. The sunset is amazing.

allReviews.title: Beautiful, but rough for little ones
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is absolutely gorgeous, however it was a little rough for our daughter. We heard it was family friendly because it was less crowded then palm beach. It is good for kids 5+ unless you want to be attached nonstop to your little one. We ended up doing baby beach numerous times and had the most amazing time.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is a great beach located in Aruba. Definitely worth checking out when you are in Aruba. They have beach chairs.

allReviews.title: Caribbean Beach at its best 😎
allReviews.text: No wonder Eagle Beach is rated regularly one of the most beautiful beaches in the world - it lives up to it! Pure white sand stretching for it seems miles, clear warm water in shades of blue an turquoise, more seagulls than people and funny pelicans that plunge into the sea for fish that you can see without having to snorkle.It's perfect for bathing - shallow at waters edge without rocks or corals, then soon deep enough for swimming with a li little surf. Every now and then you'll find rentals for sunbeds and umbrellas - not cheap. But if you have your own equipment - there's room enough.Hardly restaurants or bars, bring drinks and enjoy!

allReviews.title: Swim with the fishes
allReviews.text: Another wonderful  beach!  We arrived later than we wanted, but still found an umbrella. They are first come, first serve and you can rent lounge chairs. Only complaint - These were not the most comfortable. Walk up bar, walk up water sports, restroom across the street in the hotel pool area. GREAT coconut shrimp served beachside. The water was so clear here you could see the schools of fish swimming at your feet. We were here 20 years ago for our honeymoon and it is still just as pretty.

allReviews.title: Cruise ship port day
allReviews.text: Visited on Tues Jan 25 - Aruba 9am - 11pm via carnival horizon cruise ship - [ ] Visited eagle beach - [ ] $15 for 3 people cab ride. Approx 15 min ride - [ ] Was dropped Beside Coco loco beach bar. Good service and prices - [ ] chairs and umbrella costs around $30 most places (3 chairs + umbrella) - [ ] Jet skis $80 for half hour 2 peopleLove the constant breeze in Aruba

allReviews.title: Beautiful, soft sand paradise!
allReviews.text: A short taxi ride from the cruise terminal. this is a delightful little spot. The beach has a very soft, fine clean sand with no shells or rocks to worry about. It's an easy walk into the ocean with no steep drop off. Lounger chairs and umbrellas are available for rent. A great spot to plop down and chill. There is also a beach bar nearby with food and drinks available for purchase.

allReviews.title: A must visit beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: We visited Eagle Beach since our resort did not have much of a beach area. We were so happy with the decision! The sand is powder soft and the water is absolutely gorgeous. It was calm and shallow for while from the shore. We rented chairs and an umbrella from one of the local stands for $40. Worth noting that this is a public beach so there are no restrooms, but we were able to use the one across the street at a hotel. Highly recommend visiting during your stay.

allReviews.title: The sand is white and the sea is transparent and calm.
allReviews.text: It is a beautiful beach where some resorts are located. After the waterfront area, there are some lakes that are areas of environmental preservation. There are some unfinished buildings that have probably suffered the economic impact of the pandemic. The resorts maintain beach huts for their guests and bar services, but like all beaches in Aruba, there is no entry fee. The sand is white and the sea is transparent and calm.

allReviews.title: Love! Great for beach not the best snorkeling.
allReviews.text: Love this beach. As beautiful as can be. Not much to see when snorkeling but a great relaxing beach day. Restaurant and bar close by and some available shade.

allReviews.title: Aruba was great - Will go back
allReviews.text: Nice beach, clean and beautiful. Ocean a little cold for January 2022. Spent 10 days. It was a little expensive.

allReviews.title: Fabulous Day at the Beach
allReviews.text: We had 4-5 hours to spend in Aruba on our cruise stop. We chose Eagle Beach. What a fabulous spot!  Long, white sand beaches with beautiful water.  Nearby restaurants a d shopping make it a great place to spend the day.

allReviews.title: Best Beach
allReviews.text: This is the best beach on Aruba and the best beach I’ve ever been to! Not too crowded, mix of tourists and locals, sand that resembles powder, and crystal clear water. I love this beach!

allReviews.title: The place to go for sunsets
allReviews.text: this beach is the best place to go to watch a sunset. spectacular doe snot even describe the sun.  plenty of beach. of d and drink is right there. go hang out for the day and enjoy the warm beach and beautiful scenery

allReviews.title: Easy Beach for Cruisers
allReviews.text: We arrived in Aruba on a Carnival Cruise ship.  My daughter and I decided to go solo and find our own excursion.  Right outside of the cruise terminal is a taxi service.  For $5 one way an open air taxi will transport you to Eagle Beach.  They return every hour for the return trip.  I think it was about a 10-15 minute ride. They drop you right off at the beach.  It is beautiful!  The day we were there it was not crowded at all.  There is a rental place for umbrellas($25), lounges($10), and rafts($5). The staff places the umbrella where you want to sit.  They even returned to see if we wanted it moved back.  There were no vendors trying to sell, pictures, massages, braids, etc.  The beach had a food truck selling tacos and other snacks.  It was a low-key and peaceful experience. Restrooms were available nearby.

allReviews.title: Great Beach to Visit
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is accessible to many resorts and hotels, near and far. It is such a beautiful beach. The water is clean, clear, blue and inviting. The sand is soft and warm. The workers, whether at the bar/restaurant or on the jet scooter or just cleaning the beach , were all very friendly. Even the creepy crawly inhabitants (lizards) appears to be friendly creatures.  The funniest thing. All in all I had many wonderful experiences at the Beach.

allReviews.title: The best beach I’ve ever been to
allReviews.text: Arguably the best beach I have ever been to in my life!  The sand is silky and not hot to the feet, and the water is a perfect temperature.  Loved Loved Loved it.

allReviews.title: Great chillin' beach
allReviews.text: Great beach to just chill - not super-packed and close to food & beverages. jet-skis and all the 'ocean toys' if you're so inclined. And if you need to stretch your legs, there's enough room to take nice long walks along the shoreline.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach Paradise
allReviews.text: We had an amazing week at Eagle Beach!  The sand is super soft, the beach is wide and the water is perfect!

allReviews.title: One of the finest in the Caribbean
allReviews.text: We've been to most of the Caribbean islands in search of the best beaches the region has to offer, and Eagle Beach is right up there in the Top 10. Wide, uncrowded even during the Christmas season, and covered in fine white sand and lapped gently by turquoise waters, we can't wait to return and experience it again.

allReviews.title: Our Favorite Beach
allReviews.text: Sand is perfect water is clear and warm and so nice. Love how easy it is to get an umbrella too. Spend a day or a week like we did!!

allReviews.title: Very nice beach
allReviews.text: Everything you wish for, white sandy beach, very  clean, nice calm water and beautiful sunset. Because it’s huge there’s always a nice quiet place to relax.

allReviews.title: Relaxing and full of life!
allReviews.text: The beach is about 2 miles long with access to chairs and cabanas. The water is gorgeous and draws you in.

allReviews.title: Best vacation destination!
allReviews.text: Best beach by far… i visited..Clear blue water, calm and perfect temperature🙏The home of high rise building, lots of great restaurants, bars, shoppings, water sports and nice , happy people and perfect to unwind from busy life!

allReviews.title: Love eagle beach!
allReviews.text: The beach is huge which is a major plus! We were able to get a palapa (straw umbrella) on the beach every day we needed one. We were at the tropicana and la cabana and those 2 hotels share an area of the beach. BUT people go to the beach AT SUNRISE to reserve a palapa. A member from our group went down every morning at like 7am to grab one. Hotel staff are there to assign you one and bring your chairs over. If you leave a bag or towel marking your territory you have it basically all day. If you don't plan to be there all day though give it away because lots of people end up without one. The beach starts to clear out around 4 so when we went to the beach later on certain days we still got a palapa. They clean the beach every night (at least in our hotels area) so it's always great. There are snack and drink huts along the beach and places to book excursion and parasail etc. This beach was also our favorite to play in the waves. The waves can be HUGE but it depends on the wind, other times it was relativity calm. There were people of all ages, baby to adult. We spent a lot of time here. I will say, on our first day we wandered around looking for a palapa ourselves and people told us to go talk to a staff member in order to get one. Plus, the chairs are all locked up to prevent random people from taking the chairs... if you aren't staying at a hotel on eagle beach you will have to rent chairs and an umbrella (not palapa). This is a plus to staying ON eagle beach!

allReviews.title: 2021 Aruba Vacation
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach, clear and warm water! Having a beach bar is a big plus. Staff is there to setup chairs for you and find an shady area for you. Rental umbrellas are also available.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: This might be the nicest beach I've ever been to. Definitely the nicest swimming beach on the island--way better than Palm Beach, and much less crowded. Sand is soft, surf is nice, views are beautiful, lots of space.

allReviews.title: Clean beach
allReviews.text: Clean beach with beautiful sand and lots of people. It can be windy here so the waves may be large at times. It can be difficult to find shade but all in all I think I prefer this beach over the others.

allReviews.title: Best beach
allReviews.text: One of the best beaches I have ever been, you can see turtles there, white send, and crystal clear water. Big recommendation

allReviews.title: Best beach on the island
allReviews.text: If you want quiet, peaceful, and yet close to many great eating establishments and grocery shopping. Perfect water with gentle waves breaking right at the shoreline. Like having a perfect clear wave pool to stand and chat with friends . I think everyone on this island are nice enough to rival Ireland, and that is saying a lot!

allReviews.title: Dec2021 Travels to Aruba
allReviews.text: An amazing place to relax and enjoy your time here. The beach is white white sand and the water is blue blue blue. Very Nice

allReviews.title: Best beach, this is it
allReviews.text: White sandy beaches, blue skies and Caribbean waters. Close to perfection. Tropical temperature, nice people. Amsterdam Manor Beach resort at Eagle Beach is highly recommended🔆🌴🍀

allReviews.title: One of the best beaches!
allReviews.text: The beach was less crowded than palm beach but the water was more choppy so if you like waves this place is for you. I enjoyed the  beach experience. Tip: Go on a day when there are no cruises. We went on a Saturday.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and well-maintained resort!
allReviews.text: Highly recommended!! Fantastic amenities! very helpful and happy staff! Stayed in the ocean front unit!

allReviews.title: Nice beach
allReviews.text: Great beach and we spent few hours swimming and lot of beach activities as well. Nice and clean water and you have jetski and few activities. There is crowded area and there is not so crowded area. You can spend time in relaxed way compared to Palm beach where there are lot of people in beach.

allReviews.title: Perfect beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful beach  in the heart of the low rise area White sand that doesn’t burn your feet just the right temperature turquoise water.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: We took a taxi to eagle beach after a recommendation. Picturesque. Beautiful sand and water. We enjoyed spending some time here and wish it had been longer.

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: This beach was amazing and wish we would have went sooner than our last day.  Free hits and ten dollars a chair.

allReviews.title: EAGLE BEACH, A BEACH LOVER'S PARADISE!
allReviews.text: White powdery sand.  Wide, wide, beach.  Crystal clear blue water.  Sandy bottom, no rocks.  Swimmable.   Very few people.    NO beach vendors.  Paradise found!

allReviews.title: Eagle beach
allReviews.text: Best beach in Aruba! We stay at LaCabana right across a two lane street, easy to get to, very short walk. White sand and gorgeous water.

allReviews.title: Fun spot with gorgeous views
allReviews.text: Simply beautiful! Great spot to sun and swim while taking in some truly breathtaking views. There is lots to do here from laying on the beach to parasailing, boat rides and more. Prices are tight and guides are experienced.

allReviews.title: It’s good to have choices
allReviews.text: It’s beautiful and calming you can jet ski or any other water sports or just relax under your polopa and enjoy all the good food and drink

allReviews.title: What a water, what a sand
allReviews.text: Terrific beach. Sand is awesome. There aren't many people so you can have a beach for yourself. Water is perfect - clean and warm. In the evenings you can see hatching turtles.

allReviews.title: Best Beach Out There
allReviews.text: I've been to a lot of beaches. This was the nicest one I've ever seen. Got off the cruise ship, bought a roundtrip bus ticket to Eagle Beach for $5 a person, spent the whole day at the beach, enjoyed every second of it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Every Day Beach
allReviews.text: Wonderful!  Step away from the hotels right on the water and park closer to the jet ski rentals.  There are plenty of places to set your chair, blanket, and cooler.  I love the warm water, hues of blue, and breezes.  In the afternoon, like 1pm or so, the jet ski rentals can get a little busy- but they run farther out.  Just enjoy the waves! The sand is soft and there are very few shells.  I tried snorkeling, but no dice!

allReviews.title: Great beach
allReviews.text: This beach across from our quarters (MVC-Eagle) is a great place to chill out and swim. Crystal clear water and great views.

allReviews.title: Great beach
allReviews.text: Love it here this is my third time. The attendants are nice and there is cold water. Most of all the water is inviting and the snorkeling is good

allReviews.title: To die for
allReviews.text: This beach is #2 but honestly should be #1. The beach is beautiful and the sunsets are to die for… stop by Passions on the Beach.. especially for sunset dinner.. (make reservations) just do it..

allReviews.title: My personal favorite beach in the world
allReviews.text: Soft white sand with crystal clear water and well maintained. This isn't a shelly or rocky beach which makes it easy to walk around barefoot. Tends to be less crowded than Palm Beach but not as many restaurants nearby. There are some beach bars you can pop into for a quick bite/drink.

allReviews.title: Beautiful pool
allReviews.text: Love this huge swimming pool!  Light waves, sometimes heavy breeze but always beautiful crystal clear blue water that can get pretty deep the father out you go. Not a great place to snorkel. I suggest bringing chairs and food/water.  There are a couple of brown pelicans that like to scare the crap out of you by diving for fish while your back is turned.  There is a jet ski rental there. Very clean beach too!

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: I LOVED Eagle beach. There were plenty of palapas, the beach was well maintained and there were waves, but not anything rough. The only drawbacks were that there were not many food options and if you want a chair and you don't bring one, you'll have to rent one ($10US)

allReviews.title: My favorite beach
allReviews.text: This beach was my all time favorite in Aruba for so many reasons - not crowded -  water was clear and calm -  no rocks in the sand -  trees for shade or you can rent an umbrella and chairs- restaurant on site - bathrooms and rinse off station - also small playground by parking lot -  so many fishes in the water

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful beach ! soft white sand, warm clear water. This is a must visit area of Aruba. We will be back in the future.

allReviews.title: go for a walk
allReviews.text: We walked up and down the beach and some spots are better than others, but all in all its beautiful.

allReviews.title: Best beach on the island
allReviews.text: This is my favorite beach in Aruba. It's so clean and clear. The sand is always white. My favorite part is that I always feel like it has the right temperature it was very refreshing. It's beautiful.

allReviews.title: Nice long beach, fine sand, nice food options nearby
allReviews.text: Easy to spend a day on the beaches here and dip in and out of the sea. Wide and long beach, with loungers etc depending which hotel youre staying in. We bought our own deckchairs on arrival and used them where we went.

allReviews.title: EXECELLENT!!!
allReviews.text: The people of Aruba were so nice to me.  I ate at 12 different places. Strongly suggest that you rent a car to explore Aruba at your own pace. Enjoyed many sunsets on Eagle Beach. Stayed at an Airbnb and they had bikes for their guest and l rode the bike along the seashore every morning. Took a ride to the bottom of the sea on a submarine.

allReviews.title: Beautiful and serene!
allReviews.text: Crystal clear water and white sandy beach. Though I have seen and experienced such beaches before, Eagle beach has more to offer than others - the water adventures, the no-vendors on beach rule, the availability of restaurants within walking distance,  facilities for the beach such as sunbeds etc, and the friendly locals make Eagle beach exceptional.

allReviews.title: Best
allReviews.text: Best Beach ever. Water is perfect. So many things to do. Just love it. Also great place to walk forever

allReviews.title: Heaven’s Beach
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach is Heaven’s Beach. We stayed away from the main tourist area, and had the beach pretty much to ourselves. The sand was soft like clouds, the water inviting like an Angel’s song, and the water calm. There was nothing like watching and swimming as the sun sets.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: We are staying nearby, and the beach is absolutely beautiful. The sand is perfect, the waves are mellow, the water is a good temperature. There are some negatives, however. In some areas, there is an extremely powerful sewage stench that literally made me gag. This is not what you want to smell at the beach, particularly because it very likely means that there is drainage nearby and thus in the water.

allReviews.title: Convenient beach for a cruise day in port
allReviews.text: We were here for a day on the Celebrity Summit, and we took a taxi to Eagle Beach. We rented beach chairs under an umbrella for $10/person, and we really enjoyed the beach. There were quite a few people on the beach and in the water, but the sand was powdery soft and the beach is LONG. It’s a great place to take a long walk in the sand. The water was warm and calm on the day we were there.

allReviews.title: It's a beach
allReviews.text: Not my favorite part of the island. Definitely not my favorite beach. But you're probably close to it if you are staying in a resort. Water wasn't too rough, but the wind caused me to be sandblasted while on the beach. Took me days to get it out of my hair. Honestly, this is pretty whiny. It's still a lovely beach. But if you have a car, you can access much better ones.

allReviews.title: Quiet and less croqded
allReviews.text: The water was bit more aggressive than Baby and Palm beach but we really liked the non-touristy aspect of the beach.

allReviews.title: My fav beach in Aruba! Loved every moment!
allReviews.text: We picked this beach 3 times during our stay (our hotel was 10 minutes drive from Eagle) because The Bar (next to Linda playa hotel) had happy hours between 12-7pm :D :D :D so guess what, we had a pretty happy time. For 8 or 9 dollars you got 2 pretty good coctails :) the beach is calmer than fe durf beach or next to the lighthouse north. You can see beautiful sunset in front of you, the sun goes down the the sea.

allReviews.title: its everything that you would expect from paradise
allReviews.text: Exactly what you think.  Gorgeous soft sandy white beaches, amazing crystal turquois water and a fantastic constant light trade winds breeze.  Doesn't get much better.

allReviews.title: Amazing Calm Clear Beach. The best beach on the island
allReviews.text: Amazing beach.  We lived in Ocenaia Condos so we walked to the Eagle Beach every day.  We always could find a free palapa!  The beach is taken care of every day we saw maintanance people come and clean the debris near the road.   The beach itself is very calm, very spacious and water is an amazing turquoise color!   We also saw rainbow over horizon twice.  You can not go wrong by choosing to be here especially with young kids!

allReviews.title: A little bit of heaven
allReviews.text: The beach was beautiful, the water was wonderful but the sunset was simply amazing. Walking along the beach at sunset was breathtaking and amazing.

allReviews.title: Beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach. Great views not crowded at all. I get bored at the beach, but no fault of the site. It WAS beautiful though.

allReviews.title: Best Beach
allReviews.text: Best beach on Aruba.  Pure white sand and a wide beach to relax on.  Long Beach is ideal for taking long walks. Chairs and umbrellas available for renting during the day.

allReviews.title: Sun Sand and Fun
allReviews.text: Spent four hours.. we ate good, had good drinks got on jet skis .. had a awesome time make sure to eat at Blue Beach

allReviews.title: Beautiful beaches
allReviews.text: We loved Eagle beach for the beauty,  quiet and serenity.  It was not as crowded as Palm beach.  Easy access to restaurants and shopping.

allReviews.title: Loved this beach!
allReviews.text: We visited several beaches and this by far was the best one because you don't need water shoes to enjoy it!  It does not have too many rocks on the bottom to hurt your feet and the cabanas are nice too!

allReviews.title: Most Amazing Beach
allReviews.text: This is the most amazing beach on earth. Never seems overly crowded and not to wavy. Crystal clear water and it’s shallow enough to walk out a pretty good ways. My 6 year old daughter and I played in the water for hours and hours. Plenty of palapas to shade from the sun as well.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach!!
allReviews.text: Gorgeous beach, quiet. The only issues I had was there wasn’t anyone to assist with renting a chair. It was also very hard to get a taxi back to resort.  Other than that beautiful,quite beach.

allReviews.title: Experiencing Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: This beautiful and pristine white sand beach offers a relaxing atmosphere for soaking up the sun, swimming in the ocean, great photo opportunities, and water sports.  If you want to stick your toes in the sand, lay back,  and let your stress drift away then Eagle Beach is for you!!

allReviews.title: eagle beach
allReviews.text: jet ski , swimming , walking beach ,eating at  restaurants ,site seeing ,,talking to other guess.ooooo ooo  ooooo oooo ooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

allReviews.title: White Sand and Blue Water
allReviews.text: This is a terrific beach for day use.  We got there early and stayed the morning.  The white sand and blue water is unbelievable.  Makes for a perfect Aruban picture.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: This beach is over-rated and not worth tourists visiting. The beaches near the resort are nicer and less crowded. There's also a great beach north of the resort hotels.

allReviews.title: This beach ruined all other beaches on the island for my family
allReviews.text: For how many beaches I’ve been to, this is definitely hanging in the Top 3.  My family and I stayed in the hi-rise resort area and were so happy with Palm Beach; we were shouting out praises of how beautiful it was, how awesome the water was and how nice the sand was.  Then we went to Eagle Beach - and it just blows Palm Beach out of the water (sorry for the cheesy puns).  Here are some notes:- Crystal clear waters.  It’s cold, but not uncomfortable cold.  It’s that refreshing cold like drinking an ice cold coca cola on a hot summer day.- The finest white sand.  It was so pillowy under my feet.  I wasn’t scared to step anywhere, nor did we hesitate to build sand castles or bury my son in the sand.  There were no rocks, trash, creatures or anything hiding or littered in it.  - Waters are calm in the early hours.  From our experience, the waves started coming in when more and more people were out on jet skis (we went on a thurs, the waves got more and more around noon).  We showed up between 830a and 900a and had a few hours of pristinely calm waters.  I don’t know about you, but I don’t like to be in the beach during the hottest times of the day (12p-4p).  It might be nice and breezy but that sun is still a killer during those hours.- Show up early!  Bring your own chairs or beach blanket and get a palapa (they are free, the chairs are not).  We were told that the hotels furnish the chairs but we just saw people ignoring the ones already set out and plop their own chairs.
