allReviews.title: Wonderful beach but...
allReviews.text: Easy access via local inexpensive buses (we did a day trip off a cruise ship).  Wonderful powdery white sand, clean calm water.  But very little natural shade , crowded and rental of chairs ($10 each) and umbrella ($25) was just outrageous.

allReviews.title: Clean, Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: While the beach is one o the most popular, it was not packed. The water was glorious and my husband and I were able to hang in a section all to ourselves. The one downside was that there was no bathroom around besides at local bars.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach
allReviews.text: We spent an afternoon at Eagle Beach during our week long visit to the island. It is a wonderful place to relax and enjoy dipping into the ocean.

allReviews.title: Lovely
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful laid back beach perfect for relaxing and if you want some excitement they rent jet ski's, boat rides etc.. The beach bars have 2 for 1 happy hour too!!

allReviews.title: Beaches
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach was & is one of the most beautiful beaches on Earth !! Powder white sand , pristine turquoise water make the most beautiful beach I’ve EVER experienced!!!

allReviews.title: Nice Beach
allReviews.text: Loved this beach & the weather. We ate at the Passion on the beach restuant which has decent food. Service was a little slow but it was still a nice scenery to have lunch. We ended doing the water tubing which was so much fun ! I initially wanted to do fly boarding but they didn't have it available that day which was a bummer. The beach was packed but not crowded. Would still recommend.

allReviews.title: Aruba by cruise
allReviews.text: We came to Aruba by cruise so our time was limited.We bought an unlimited bus ticket for the day $10 each.  First we visited Arashy then in the way of coming back to the pier we visited Eagle.It was crowded has a lot of paid chairs and umbrellas. Water motos and other things to do in the beach.Drinks and food too. Please drink a lot of water and bring sunblock. If you use the bus be aware of the time the bus arrives... Every 45 minutes aprox. Going back to the pier is a 20 minutes drive.

allReviews.title: Top place
allReviews.text: We have really enjoyed few mojitos in the bar, and relaxed on the beach, which have great white sand and azure water.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach
allReviews.text: Although it was raining on the day we visited, the beach is beautiful and clean.  It requires transportation from the cruise port to get there .. but there are plenty of vendors to choose from and it’s a short 10 minute ride.

allReviews.title: Just Lay Back
allReviews.text: The perfect laid back experience with a few trimmings. It’s just easier if you can hang closer to the bar and grill area. Food is quick and pretty good. Watchful security seems to keep an eye on things, outhouse, beach boy, all in good order. The bus is an easy way to get to this beach area from town and on the way to Palm Beach. We stayed here for a week, traded via Holiday Systems. We had a cheaper studio and was great for two people. Thought for a moment about an upgrade but we hardly spent any time at Paradise Beach  Villa. We were always going someplace, on the move. I also recommend at least a half day of island tour from De Palm Tours or whomever. . We paid slightly more for an air conditioned bus and glad we did.

allReviews.title: Is a beautiful beach but....
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is a wide beautiful beach but bring your own chairs, very little shade.  The low rise hotels have chairs, shade and other amenities there but for their guests only.  Some areas you can rent chairs but they are low and difficult to get out of.

allReviews.title: One Of The Best Beach's We've Been On
allReviews.text: We've been to several Caribbean Islands, Mexico and Costa Rica and spent many hours in the sand.  It's not hard to understand why Eagle Beach was voted one of the best beaches in the world and you won't get an argument from me.  Not only is Eagle Beach large, spacious and beautiful, its also convenient.  The beach has it's own access road separated from regular traffic and it includes ample parking along the way.  Coral sand beach which is incredibly soft at the waters edge where you will find a slight surf step.  No coral heads or rocks here like some beach we've been to like in Cancun.  There is shade available under palm huts or natural shade from foliage along the back beach.  The water is of course that beautiful Caribbean blue that never gets old.  There are several areas where the cruise ships drop off bus loads of cruisers.  No snorkeling here but there is plenty of that elsewhere on the island.  No question one of the best beaches we've been to.

allReviews.title: Absolutely one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!

allReviews.title: Hate to leave it is such a beautiful beach.

It is a large beach but by the time you arrive there  you'll be exhausted after working your way into the ocean.  Way too many people for us.  With so many absolutely beautiful beaches in Aruba I just wouldn't waste your time with this one.  Palm Beach is way more beautiful with calmer waters and much more socially active area.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Beach

It gets busier when the big ship tours get in.Waves are more forgiving than many other warm water locations.Water is nice and warm.....in the 26 centigrade range which makes it great for extended water time.

allReviews.title: Best Beach!!

A small bar/restaurant was there with a single bathroom and 2 head shower.  2 chairs and an umbrella cost $40, very substantial.  The beach was breathtaking l!!!  Beautiful white sand, turquoise blue water, NOT crowded.  Water was rough in the morning, big waves (my sunglasses are gone!) but settled down as the day went on.  Current was strong for little ones-- I would not let them in the water without a life vest.  Would go back in a heartbeat!

There were storms off in the distance that were kicking up the waves and more than one person had to be escorted out of the water. Many people were knocked down and rolled out....and one young lady was thrown out onto the beach. Some of it was just comical.  Nonetheless, on the days where the water was perfect, it was amazing.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach

allReviews.title: Plans To Come Back
allReviews.text: We left our cruise ship and had a mini tour of the west coast of the island and then spent 4 hours on this fantastic beach. I area was wide and open between  2 large resorts and not that crowded. The sand and the warm blue water were great and we have plans to come back in April, this time a little farther north to the Palm Beach area. The rates for 2 chairs and umbrella were high at $40, but the vendors have you under these circumstances. Across the street there was a little bar and restaurant with a very limited menu, and the lone employee couldn't have been any slower. They also charge you $1 to use the bathroom.

The water is just lovely, it was the breeze that was chilly.  A Bar is set-up at one of the entrances so you don't have to go far to get a cool drink.  We loved the atmosphere, sandy bottom and clean ocean water.

allReviews.title: Amazing Beach But...
allReviews.text: I am going to be the nay-sayer here with some caveats. I recently went to Aruba for the first time in October 2019, and the trip was amazing. I relied heavily on Trip Advisor and other sources to plan my trip. I had seen so many great reviews of Eagle Beach, and even reports that it's in the top 5 beaches in the world. I was very excited to try it out. I want to be clear that it is truly a beautiful beach, and there's nothing particularly wrong with it. In fact, all of the reviews that tout it as amazing are accurate, but, if I had it to do over again, I would have spent 100% of my beach time on Baby Beach. I went there later in my trip, and I found it to be far superior to Eagle Beach. The water is even calmer and you can wade out SUPER far because it's so shallow. The sand was even nicer, and it was less crowded since it's about 30 minutes away from the hotel high rise area. Plus, the cabanas, umbrellas and chairs were a little bit cheaper. There was a guy who came up to us and offered cabanas and chairs, and proceeded to bring us drinks and food all day delivered right to our cabanas. We paid $60 for a cabana which comes with two nice lounge chairs. So $30 per person for all day. Just don't forget to tip the guys for their service. The one downer is that there aren't a lot of food and drink options like there are on Eagle Beach. In fact, there is just one option: Big Mama's Grill. But the food and drinks are good, so it's not the end of the world, and like I said, if you get a cabana and chairs, the same guys that rent those work for Big Mama's so you can order from them and have anything you want delivered to you. Also, I should mention the bathroom situation at Baby Beach. You have to pay to use the bathroom unless you are a customer at Big Mama's since the bathroom is owned by the restaurant. There is a woman who sits in the bathroom and takes either money or bathroom tokens from paying customers.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is Fantastic!
allReviews.text: Great beach. Less commercial than Palm beach. Although there is development in process there's no big hotels yet. White sand, gentle entry to the sea. Beach chair and umbrella was a little high for us so we spread our beach cover on the soft sand, spent most of our time in the water, and stayed for a few hours. Sunscreen is a necessity. If you walk the beach to the point you might see some turtles at the right time of year.We took a taxi but the bus from Oranjestad is still cheap ($5 round trip).

allReviews.title: Pristine White Sand
allReviews.text: Incredible,  Beautiful soft white sand beach, with the right amount and size waves that enhance the warm clean clear tropical ocean experance.

allReviews.title: Eagle Beach is Simply Beautiful!
allReviews.text: This is our second visit to Aruba and Eagle Beach is our favorite spot! Beautiful sand, fantastic waves, gorgeous sunsets! Eagle Beach has it all! The security is top notch...we always felt safe and welcome! Definitely a 5 Star beach!

allReviews.title: Great beach nice surf hot sun!

allReviews.title: Beautiful and Spacious Beach
allReviews.text: We drove our rental car to this beach and parked in free parking right next to the beach.  Since it was already early afternoon we only paid $10 for a palapa and 2 beach chairs.  The beach is spacious which means less people around you.  The water is beautiful and calm.  Definitely the preferred beach if you want to avoid the more crowded but equally beautiful Palm Beach.

allReviews.title: Mr

allReviews.title: Best beach ever
allReviews.text: After cruising over a dozen times, we found the most beautiful beach. Not over crowed, white sand almost like baby powder!

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: Very nice pretty place to relaxed and enjoy your self with a lot of activities for kids and adults great

allReviews.title: Beach for a cruise
allReviews.text: Very pretty wide beach. Not overly crowded, but there are a lot of people there. About 15 minutes and a $15 cab ride from cruise port. Chairs $10, toilet $1

allReviews.title: Nicest beach in Aruba
allReviews.text: Truly a treasure, if you visit this island you must walk this beach at least once! Very long, very wide, the sand is soft and clean. A great place to walk anytime in either direction. Nice spot for sunsets. Fewer people to be found here, plenty of places to park nearby and much less commercialism versus Palm. Pack a cooler, bring your beach chairs and lotion and have a great day on Eagle.

allReviews.title: Absolutely the best
allReviews.text: We stayed nearby.  All of the beaches we visited were great, but Eagle Beach was the best by far.  The sand is super soft and not hot at all.  There were a few people around, but there is plenty of space to spread out.  The water is crystal clear and it is gently sloped out with few waves.  If you’re looking to windsurf, this isn’t for you.  If you want to relax and float, Eagle Beach is it.

allReviews.title: Best beach in the world
allReviews.text: Eagle beach is just fantastic.  Nothing compares with the white  powder sand that stretches over 150 feet from our resort cabana to the water.  We travel a lot and this is by far the best beach anywhere.

allReviews.title: Beautiful!
allReviews.text: From the cruise terminal, we went across the street to the Arubus terminal, bought a day pass($10) and hopped the bus to Eagle Beach, the bus driver told us he would drop us at the best spot on the beach(it's very large) and boy did he! the beach was phenomenal! Beautiful water, great sand, not too hot(we were there from 4-6pm) and not crowded. My kids(4 & 6) loved playing in the sand and snorkeling in the shallow waters, there were tons of tiny schooling fish to watch. Everyone we had talked to on the island said that Eagle Beach was one of the best, they weren't kidding. None of us wanted to leave, and we are already discussing going back to stay for a week!

allReviews.title: Beautiful blue water
allReviews.text: The sand was white and the water was so clear you could see thee bottom. It was not a lot of people on the beach.

allReviews.title: Excellent quiet beach
allReviews.text: A stretch of beach away from the tourists and the big hotels and almost empty. Plenty of parking space. Beach chairs for rent. Section along the beach only for bathers. There are a few jet-ski rentals along the beach. We had our beach-chairs, plenty of water and sandwiches with us. The beach is safe from pickpocketing this usually happens on the crowded beaches in front of the hotels, and there is always someone who can keep an eye on your goodies. There are various bus stops along the beach but the service can’t be trusted.

allReviews.title: Best beach ever
allReviews.text: Water crystal clear, warm like bath water and absolutely no waves, absolutely perfect beach in every single way!

allReviews.title: Vacation!!!!!!!!!!  Oh yeah!
allReviews.text: Very clean beach!  Clean white sand with hardly any shells, stones, and other debris. Clear warm water. Beautiful. Less populated than other beaches near resorts and hotels.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: Beautiful colors in the water, gorgeous white sand beach. Loved every minute of it. This is the less busy section of the beach but there are still some watersports nearby.

allReviews.title: espectacular beach!!!
allReviews.text: Amazing beach! calm warm waters, clean beach, confortable beach chairs, it is ranked one of the top ten beaches in the world for a reason.!

allReviews.title: Spectacular beach!!!
allReviews.text: I am a beach lover and this one is extremely beautiful and very kid-friendly... there are some areas that are very populated because many of the hotels are along this beach but if you walk a little far toward the north of the island you will find a paradise... If you are like the one that likes water sport so stay in the hotel area.  Just be very aware any sport or water entertainment there is expensive... like 10 or 15 minutes in some kind of boat .. can be like 20$... but this is the bussines in the area. Also be aware you need to pay for the chairs ... the only thing you can take and no pay are the huts... those are free.. just go early... the beach is also easy reach by public transpostation..

allReviews.title: Excellent Beach
allReviews.text: This beach is everything it’s said to be. Absolutely beautiful, stunning, picture perfect. The swimming is great and the tiki huts are first come first served.

allReviews.title: AMAZING!
allReviews.text: Very few beaches compare to Eagle Beach.  Soft, white sand lead into perfectly calm blue water.  There are plenty of good hotels and rentals and there is always a spot to lay out along this stretch of beach.  We stayed at the Divi less than a mile down the beach, which has a nice beach, but the main Eagle Beach area is much nicer and worth the walk.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: We stayed at the LaCabana on Eagle Beach. Beautiful views and miles of beach that you can walk. The water is so clear!

allReviews.title: One of the best beaches
allReviews.text: This is one of the best beaches i have ever been to clear blue water, white sand, fofoti tree, and i felt very safe

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, amazing, super clean and white sand. I highly recommend it. It's a must go. I will definitely visit this beach again.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach.
allReviews.text: Beautiful long white sand beach. Sea water is blue and very warm. Just an amazing beach to spend the day relaxing and soaking in the beauty.

allReviews.title: Absolutely awesome
allReviews.text: When my wife and I are in a rouble we stay at the Devi village and Eagle beach is our go to we love it there

allReviews.title: Beach
allReviews.text: A day at the beach is always a pleasure but most of all if it is a beach in aruba, pure clean water and amazing white sand.

allReviews.title: Beautiful beach
allReviews.text: The beach was beautiful. I had a lovely time. The water felt like pool water. I cannot wait to go back and visit this beach.

allReviews.title: Beautiful
allReviews.text: We was staying in Oranjestad so wanted to spend the day at eagle beach. It’s absolutely beautiful, the sand the clear water was amazing. We walked all the way along and back. We paid for sun loungers with a umbrella which cost 15 dollars each which I thought was quite expensive. Had a couple of drinks in passions and my husband popped down the road to the super market to have some food and drinks on the beach. Was a lovely but expensive trip.

allReviews.title: Aruba Beaches
allReviews.text: Eagle Beach in September is a great place to be if you don't like  crowds. The attendants were right there if you desired a chair or lounger.  You could keep your spot all day be leaving you possessions behind.

allReviews.title: Passions on the Beach
allReviews.text: Went to Passions last Friday at 6.00pm. It is a restaurant on the beach where you eat your meal at a table set on the sand on Eagle Beach. We ate and watched the sun set over the sea which was beautiful. The area is lit by flame torch lights and lights around the surrounding trees. There was a saxophonist playing soft music in the background. The food was good and it was an unforgettable experience. Would recommend a visit
